projects.name: AutoGPT
projects.description: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
projects.summary: 開放嘅 AI agent 平台，用嚟由一個目標自動拆解任務。佢可以自己揀工具、跑步驟同整理結果，等你專注喺想完成嘅事，而唔使由零砌晒成條工具鏈。你畀一個目標就得，執行過程可以自己托管。
projects.summary_en: An open AI agent platform that automatically breaks a goal down into tasks. It can choose tools, run steps, and organize results on its own, so you can focus on what you want done without building the whole toolchain from scratch. You only need to give it a goal, and the execution can be self-hosted.

projects.name: dify
projects.description: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace. Deploy on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted, so teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding the stack.
projects.summary: 用嚟搭建 agent 工作流同 RAG 應用嘅平台。你可以接多種模型、知識庫同工具，用視覺化流程編排，然後放喺雲端或者自己架，做成可以對話同執行任務嘅應用。做好嘅應用可以俾其他人用對話介面直接開。
projects.summary_en: A platform for building agent workflows and RAG applications. You can connect multiple models, knowledge bases, and tools, arrange them in a visual flow, then put the result in the cloud or host it yourself as an application that can chat and carry out tasks. Finished applications can be opened directly by other people through a chat interface.

projects.name: langflow
projects.description: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
projects.summary: 用視覺化流程搭建同部署 AI agent 同工作流。每個節點可以係模型、提示詞、工具或者資料來源，拉線就組成一條流程，方便試完即刻運行。流程儲低之後可以再改節點，唔使推倒重來。
projects.summary_en: Build and deploy AI agents and workflows with visual flows. Each node can be a model, a prompt, a tool, or a data source, and drawing connections forms a flow you can try and run right away. After a flow is saved, you can change the nodes without starting over.

projects.name: langchain
projects.description: The agent engineering platform.
projects.summary: 開發 agent 嘅工程平台，將模型、工具、記憶同流程砌成可重用嘅應用。適合想用程式控制每一步、而唔係只靠一個大提示詞嘅人，去接自己嘅數據同系統。適合要接資料庫、API 同自己內部系統嘅工程師。
projects.summary_en: An engineering platform for developing agents, assembling models, tools, memory, and flows into reusable applications. It suits people who want to control each step in code, rather than relying on one large prompt, and who want to connect their own data and systems. It suits engineers who need to connect databases, APIs, and their own internal systems.

projects.name: browser-use
projects.description: Open-source Python library for AI browser agents, plus Browser Use Cloud: stealth browsers and a hosted agent API.
projects.summary: 畀 AI agent 操控瀏覽器嘅 Python 庫。佢可以自己打開網頁、撳掣、填表同拎資料，將睇網頁變成 agent 可以完成嘅動作，而唔使你逐步寫選擇器。登入後台、跨頁搬資料呢類步驟可以交俾佢試。
projects.summary_en: A Python library that lets an AI agent control a browser. It can open pages, click buttons, fill forms, and extract data on its own, turning browsing into actions an agent can complete without you writing selectors step by step. Steps such as logging into an admin backend and moving data across pages can be handed to it to try.

projects.name: gemini-cli
projects.description: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
projects.summary: 將 Gemini 帶入終端機嘅開源 agent。你可以喺命令列交代開發工作，由佢讀專案、建議改動同執行指令，唔使離開而家用開嘅終端環境。改完可以留喺原本個 repo，唔使轉去另一個編輯器。
projects.summary_en: An open-source agent that brings Gemini into the terminal. You can assign development work from the command line and have it read the project, suggest changes, and run commands without leaving the terminal you already use. After the edits, they can stay in the original repo, so you do not have to switch to another editor.

projects.name: ragflow
projects.description: RAGFlow is a leading open-source Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that fuses cutting-edge RAG with Agent capabilities to create a superior context layer for LLMs
projects.summary: 結合檢索增強生成同 agent 嘅開源引擎。佢負責將文件切段、建立索引，再喺回答時拎返有出處嘅上下文，令大模型唔使單靠自己記憶作答。答錯時可以對返被引用嘅段落，而唔係只睇最後一句。
projects.summary_en: An open-source engine that combines retrieval-augmented generation with agents. It splits documents, builds indexes, and retrieves sourced context when answering, so the large model does not have to answer from its own memory alone. When an answer is wrong, you can check it against the cited passages instead of looking only at the final sentence.

projects.name: OpenHands
projects.description: 🙌 OpenHands: AI-Driven Development
projects.summary: 用 AI 做軟件開發嘅 agent。你可以交一個開發任務俾佢，佢會自己改程式、跑指令、睇測試結果，再按失敗繼續修，而唔係只吐一段建議程式碼。測試失敗會留喺同一輪，等佢繼續改到過到為止。
projects.summary_en: An agent that uses AI for software development. You can hand it a development task, and it will edit code, run commands, read test results, and keep fixing based on failures, rather than only emitting a suggested snippet. A failed test stays in the same round so it can keep editing until the tests pass.

projects.name: deer-flow
projects.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
projects.summary: 長時程 agent 框架，可以做研究、寫程式同創作。複雜任務會拆開，交俾沙盒、記憶同子 agent 各自處理，避免一個對話要由頭記晒所有步驟。研究、寫程式同創作可以拆給唔同子任務一齊跑。
projects.summary_en: A long-horizon agent framework for research, coding, and creative work. Complex tasks are split and handed to sandboxes, memory, and sub-agents to handle separately, so one conversation does not have to remember every step from the start. Research, coding, and creative work can be split into different subtasks and run together.

projects.name: ruflo
projects.description: 🌊 The original agent harness. Deploy intelligent multi-player swarms, coordinate autonomous workflows, and build conversational AI systems. Features adaptive memory, self-learning intelligence, federation, vector RAG integration, and native Claude Code / Codex / Hermes and many more Integrated
projects.summary: 一個 agent harness，用嚟協調多個 agent、自動工作流同帶記憶嘅對話系統。重點係將角色、工具同狀態放喺同一個執行環境，方便一齊完成較長嘅任務。狀態唔會因為開新對話就消失，較長工作流先用得着。
projects.summary_en: An agent harness for coordinating multiple agents, automated workflows, and conversational systems with memory. The focus is putting roles, tools, and state in the same execution environment so they can finish longer tasks together. State does not disappear when a new conversation starts, which is what longer workflows need.

projects.name: MetaGPT
projects.description: 🌟 The Multi-Agent Framework: First AI Software Company, Towards Natural Language Programming
projects.summary: 多 agent 框架，將產品、設計同工程角色編成一個軟件團隊。你用自然語言講需求，佢哋會按職位分工，產出設計同程式，而唔係由單一聊天機器人一次過做晒。產出會按職位分檔，方便你只審設計或者只審程式。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent framework that organizes product, design, and engineering roles into a software team. You describe requirements in natural language, and they divide the work by role to produce designs and code, rather than having one chatbot do everything at once. Outputs are filed by role, so you can review only the design or only the code.

projects.name: cline
projects.description: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
projects.summary: 可以獨立寫程式嘅 coding agent，有 IDE 擴充、SDK 同命令列幾種用法。佢可以讀專案、改檔案同跑指令，適合想喺編輯器入面直接交辦開發工作嘅人。同一套指示可以喺編輯器或命令列重用。
projects.summary_en: A coding agent that can write code on its own, with an IDE extension, an SDK, and a command-line interface. It can read a project, edit files, and run commands, which suits people who want to assign development work directly inside the editor. The same instructions can be reused in the editor or on the command line.

projects.name: openinterpreter
projects.description: A coding agent for open models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.3
projects.summary: 面向開源模型嘅 coding agent，可以喺本機寫程式同執行指令。你用自然語言講想做嘅事，佢就喺你部機產生程式並運行，檔案同環境都留喺本地。生成嘅程式會喺本機運行，結果檔留喺你部電腦。
projects.summary_en: A coding agent aimed at open-source models that can write code and run commands on the local machine. You describe what you want in natural language, and it generates and runs programs on your machine, with files and the environment staying local. Generated programs run locally, and result files stay on your computer.

projects.name: mem0
projects.description: The Memory Layer for AI Agents - Drop-in memory infrastructure for AI agents and apps. Context that persists. Built for production.
projects.summary: 畀 AI agent 用嘅記憶層。對話入面值得記住嘅事實會被抽出並保存，之後新對話可以再搵返，令 agent 唔使每次都當你係第一次見面。新會話開始時可以搵返舊事實，唔使用戶重講一次。
projects.summary_en: A memory layer for AI agents. Facts worth remembering in a conversation are extracted and stored, then retrieved in later conversations, so the agent does not treat you as a first meeting every time. When a new session starts, it can look up old facts so the user does not have to say them again.

projects.name: anything-llm
projects.description: Stop renting your intelligence. Own it with AnythingLLM. Everything you need for a powerful local-first agent experience
projects.summary: 可以自託管嘅本地優先工作台。文件、對話同 agent 都放喺自己部機或者自己嘅伺服器，適合想用私有資料做問答，又唔想將文件交出去嘅人。私有文件可以只留喺自己伺服器再做問答。
projects.summary_en: A self-hostable, local-first workspace. Documents, conversations, and agents stay on your own machine or your own server, which suits people who want question answering over private data without handing the files over. Private files can stay only on your own server while you still ask questions about them.

projects.name: autogen
projects.description: A programming framework for agentic AI
projects.summary: 微軟嘅 agent 程式框架，用嚟編排多個可以對話同使用工具嘅 AI。你可以定義每個 agent 嘅角色同可以呼叫嘅功能，再讓佢哋輪流討論直到完成任務。適合要幾個專門角色互相覆核先交結果嘅流程。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's agent programming framework for orchestrating multiple AIs that can converse and use tools. You can define each agent's role and the functions it can call, then let them take turns discussing until the task is done. It suits workflows where several specialized roles review one another before a result is delivered.

projects.name: crewAI
projects.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents. By fostering collaborative intelligence, CrewAI empowers agents to work together seamlessly, tackling complex tasks.
projects.summary: 將唔同角色嘅自主 agent 組成團隊，一齊完成比較複雜嘅任務。每個成員有自己嘅目標同工具，由流程決定邊個先做、邊個接住做，而唔係單人包辦。你要改嘅係角色分工，而唔係一整段越寫越長嘅提示。
projects.summary_en: Forms autonomous agents in different roles into a team that completes more complex tasks together. Each member has its own goal and tools, and the flow decides who goes first and who continues, rather than one agent doing everything. What you change is the division of roles, not one prompt that keeps getting longer.

projects.name: goose
projects.description: an open source, extensible AI agent that goes beyond code suggestions - install, execute, edit, and test with any LLM
projects.summary: 可擴展嘅 AI agent，唔止建議程式碼，仲可以安裝、執行、修改同測試。佢喺本機按你嘅指示操作開發環境，適合想有一個可以真係動手嘅終端助手。安裝依賴同跑測試都係佢自己做，唔止係出 diff。
projects.summary_en: An extensible AI agent that does more than suggest code: it can also install, run, edit, and test. It operates the development environment on the local machine according to your instructions, which suits people who want a terminal assistant that can actually do the work. Installing dependencies and running tests are things it does itself, not only producing a diff.

projects.name: Flowise
projects.description: Build AI Agents, Visually
projects.summary: 用拖放方式搭建 AI agent 同語言模型流程。節點可以接模型、記憶同工具，適合想先用圖形試流程嘅人。倉庫已封存，但仍然係常見嘅視覺化起點。倉庫已封存，而家較適合當教學同舊流程參考。
projects.summary_en: Build AI agents and language-model flows by drag and drop. Nodes can connect models, memory, and tools, which suits people who want to try a flow graphically first. The repository is archived, but it is still a common visual starting point. The repository is archived, and it is now better suited as a teaching reference and a reference for older flows.

projects.name: cherry-studio
projects.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
projects.summary: 桌面 AI 工作台，將聊天、自主 agent 同大量助手放喺同一個程式。你可以接唔同模型供應商，用本機介面管理對話、工具同常用工作流。換模型供應商時，對話同助手清單仍然留喺本機。
projects.summary_en: A desktop AI workspace that puts chat, autonomous agents, and a large set of assistants in one program. You can connect different model providers and use a local interface to manage conversations, tools, and common workflows. When you switch model providers, the conversations and the assistant list still stay on the local machine.

projects.name: llama_index
projects.description: LlamaIndex is the document processing platform for AI
projects.summary: 文件處理同檢索平台，用嚟將資料接駁到可以查詢同採取行動嘅 AI 應用。佢負責讀入文件、做索引同檢索，再交俾模型回答或者交俾 agent 繼續執行。先處理文件，再決定係問答定交俾 agent 行動。
projects.summary_en: A document processing and retrieval platform for connecting data to AI applications that can query and take action. It loads documents, builds indexes, and retrieves, then hands the result to a model to answer or to an agent to continue. Process the documents first, then decide whether to do question answering or hand the work to an agent.

projects.name: nanobot
projects.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
projects.summary: 輕量、可自託管嘅個人 agent 框架。佢帶網頁介面、工具、記憶同多 agent 工作流，適合想喺自己部機跑一個小型助手，而唔使先部署一整套平台。想先有一個細規模助手，唔使一開始就部署大平台。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, self-hostable personal agent framework. It includes a web interface, tools, memory, and multi-agent workflows, which suits people who want to run a small assistant on their own machine without first deploying a full platform. If you want a small-scale assistant first, you do not have to deploy a large platform at the start.

projects.name: CowAgent
projects.description: Open-source personal AI assistant & Agent Harness. Plans tasks, runs tools and skills, self-evolves with memory and knowledge. Multi-agent, multi-model, multi-channel. Lightweight, extensible, one-line install.
projects.summary: 開源個人 AI 助手，可以計劃任務、使用工具同技能。佢會將對話同知識記住，之後嘅任務可以引用之前學到嘅嘢，而唔係每次都由空白上下文開始。技能同知識會累積，重複交代同一件事會少啲。
projects.summary_en: An open-source personal AI assistant that can plan tasks and use tools and skills. It remembers conversations and knowledge, so later tasks can refer to what it learned before instead of starting from an empty context every time. Skills and knowledge accumulate, so you repeat the same instructions less often.

projects.name: langgraph
projects.description: Build resilient agents.
projects.summary: 用圖結構編排可靠嘅 agent 流程。節點同邊可以表達分支、循環同人工確認，適合步驟會返轉頭、或者要跑好耐先完成嘅任務，而唔係一條直線呼叫。要人撳確認、或者失敗後返轉頭再試，都可以畫成圖。
projects.summary_en: Orchestrate reliable agent flows with a graph. Nodes and edges can express branches, loops, and human confirmation, which suits tasks whose steps loop back, or that take a long time to finish, rather than a straight line of calls. Requiring a person to press confirm, or going back to try again after a failure, can both be drawn as a graph.

projects.name: agno
projects.description: The self-driving agent platform
projects.summary: 一個可以自我改進嘅 agent 平台，用嚟建立同運行 AI agent。你可以定義工具同知識，讓 agent 喺執行之後累積經驗，下一次處理類似工作時少走彎路。同類工作做完一次，下次可以沿用之前嘅做法。
projects.summary_en: A self-improving agent platform for building and running AI agents. You can define tools and knowledge so the agent accumulates experience after a run and takes fewer detours the next time it handles similar work. Once a similar job has been done, the next time it can follow the earlier approach.

projects.name: BettaFish
projects.description: 微舆：人人可用的多Agent舆情分析助手，打破信息茧房，还原舆情原貌，预测未来走向，辅助决策！从0实现，不依赖任何框架。
projects.summary: 多 agent 輿情分析助手，由零實現。幾個角色會分工搜集公眾討論、整理時間線同還原事件，幫你判斷一個話題點樣發酵，而唔係只交回一堆連結。適合追一單公眾事件點樣發酵，而唔係寫一般聊天機械人。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent public-opinion analysis assistant, implemented from scratch. Several roles divide the work of collecting public discussion, organizing a timeline, and reconstructing the event, helping you judge how a topic spread rather than only returning a pile of links. It suits tracking how one public event developed, rather than writing a general chatbot.

projects.name: dspy
projects.description: DSPy: The framework for programming—not prompting—language models
projects.summary: 用程式而唔係手寫提示去組合語言模型。你將任務拆成一個個模組，再由框架優化每一步嘅提示，適合想系統化調教流程、而唔係逐句試 prompt 嘅人。改任務時改模組，而唔係每次手動試一句新提示。
projects.summary_en: Compose language models in code instead of handwritten prompts. You split a task into modules, and the framework optimizes the prompt for each step, which suits people who want to tune a flow systematically rather than trying prompts sentence by sentence. When the task changes, you change the modules instead of manually trying a new prompt each time.

projects.name: continue
projects.description: open-source coding agent
projects.summary: 開源 coding agent，可以喺編輯器入面讀寫程式同完成開發任務。佢睇到而家嘅專案上下文，按你嘅指示改碼、解釋同執行，而唔使將成個倉庫貼去聊天視窗。指示會對住你開住嘅檔案，減少貼錯上下文。
projects.summary_en: An open-source coding agent that can read and write code and finish development tasks inside the editor. It sees the current project context and edits, explains, and runs according to your instructions, without you pasting the whole repository into a chat window. Instructions are aimed at the files you have open, which reduces pasting the wrong context.

projects.name: ChatDev
projects.description: ChatDev 2.0: Dev All through LLM-powered Multi-Agent Collaboration
projects.summary: 用多個語言模型 agent 扮演開發團隊，協作完成軟件設計同實作。產品、程式同測試等角色會輪流交檔，將一句需求推進到可以睇嘅程式，而唔係一次過生成。一句需求會行完整個小團隊，先至見到可讀嘅程式。
projects.summary_en: Uses multiple language-model agents to play a development team and collaborate on software design and implementation. Roles such as product, coding, and testing take turns handing off work, moving one requirement toward code you can read, rather than generating it all at once. One requirement runs through the whole small team before you see readable code.

projects.name: openai-agents-python
projects.description: A lightweight, powerful framework for multi-agent workflows
projects.summary: OpenAI 嘅輕量 Python 框架，用嚟編排多 agent 工作流。你可以定義交接、工具同防護欄，讓幾個 agent 分工，適合想直接跟官方介面寫 agent 嘅人。想跟 OpenAI 而家嘅 agent 介面，呢套比舊教學框架貼近官方。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's lightweight Python framework for orchestrating multi-agent workflows. You can define handoffs, tools, and guardrails so several agents divide the work, which suits people who want to write agents directly against the official interface. If you want to follow OpenAI's current agent interface, this is closer to the official one than older tutorial frameworks.

projects.name: gpt-researcher
projects.description: An autonomous agent that conducts deep research on any data using any LLM providers
projects.summary: 自主研究 agent，可以就一個題目搜集資料並寫成有來源嘅研究報告。佢會自己計劃要查咩、讀取結果再綜合，而唔係只根據你貼上嚟嘅幾段文字作答。你交題目就得，唔使先自己搵好十篇文再貼上去。
projects.summary_en: An autonomous research agent that can gather material on a topic and write a sourced research report. It plans what to look up, reads the results, and synthesizes them, rather than answering only from a few passages you pasted in. You only need to give it a topic, without first finding ten papers yourself and pasting them in.

projects.name: smolagents
projects.description: 🤗 smolagents: a barebones library for agents that think in code.
projects.summary: Hugging Face 嘅精簡 agent 庫。Agent 主要靠寫程式碼嚟思考同行動，將一步步計劃變成可執行嘅程式，適合想用少量抽象、直接控制工具呼叫嘅人。步驟錯咗可以睇返佢寫出嚟嘅程式，而唔係一段含糊推理。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's compact agent library. Agents mainly think and act by writing code, turning a step-by-step plan into an executable program, which suits people who want little abstraction and direct control over tool calls. When a step goes wrong, you can look back at the program it wrote instead of a vague piece of reasoning.

projects.name: mastra
projects.description: Mastra is the modern TypeScript framework for AI-powered applications and agents.
projects.summary: 用 TypeScript 建立 AI 應用同 agent 嘅框架。工作流、工具同模型呼叫都用程式組織，方便放進現有嘅網頁或服務端專案，而唔使另起一套 Python 服務。已經用 TypeScript 嘅服務可以直駁，唔使另開 Python。
projects.summary_en: A framework for building AI applications and agents in TypeScript. Workflows, tools, and model calls are organized in code, so they fit into an existing web or server project without standing up a separate Python service. A service that already uses TypeScript can connect directly, without opening a separate Python service.

projects.name: semantic-kernel
projects.description: Integrate cutting-edge LLM technology quickly and easily into your apps
projects.summary: 微軟嘅 SDK，用嚟將大語言模型、外掛同規劃能力接進應用程式。你可以用程式定義技能，再讓模型決定幾時呼叫你已有嘅業務功能。現有 C# 或其他程式嘅功能可以註冊成模型叫到嘅技能。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's SDK for connecting large language models, plugins, and planning into an application. You define skills in code, then let the model decide when to call business functions you already have. Functions in existing C# or other programs can be registered as skills the model can call.

projects.name: haystack
projects.description: Open-source AI orchestration framework for building context-engineered, production-ready LLM applications. Design modular pipelines and agent workflows with explicit control over retrieval, routing, memory, and generation. Built for scalable agents, RAG, multimodal applications, semantic search, and conversational systems.
projects.summary: 用模組化流程搭建可上線嘅語言模型同 agent 應用。檢索、生成同工具都係可以替換嘅組件，方便你控制每一步嘅輸入輸出，而唔係將成條鏈藏喺一個黑盒。上線時可以換檢索或模型組件，而唔使整條流程重寫。
projects.summary_en: Build production language-model and agent applications with modular pipelines. Retrieval, generation, and tools are replaceable components, so you can control the input and output of each step instead of hiding the whole chain in a black box. In production you can swap the retrieval or model component without rewriting the entire pipeline.

projects.name: letta
projects.description: Platform for stateful agents: AI with advanced memory that can learn and self-improve over time.
projects.summary: 有狀態嘅 agent 平台，前身係 MemGPT，重點係長期記憶。Agent 可以將重要內容寫入記憶、需要時再讀返，令一個專案可以跨越多次對話累積。同一個 agent 隔幾日再打開，仍然記得先前寫低嘅重點。
projects.summary_en: A stateful agent platform, formerly MemGPT, focused on long-term memory. An agent can write important content into memory and read it back when needed, so a project can accumulate across many conversations. Open the same agent again a few days later, and it still remembers the key points it wrote down before.

projects.name: python-sdk
projects.description: The official Python SDK for Model Context Protocol servers and clients
projects.summary: Model Context Protocol 嘅官方 Python SDK。用佢可以寫 agent 能夠呼叫嘅工具伺服器，或者寫連接呢啲工具嘅客戶端，令唔同程式用同一套方式交換能力。你寫嘅工具，其他支援呢套協議嘅 agent 都可以呼叫。
projects.summary_en: The official Python SDK for the Model Context Protocol. You can use it to write tool servers that agents can call, or clients that connect to those tools, so different programs exchange capabilities in the same way. Tools you write can be called by other agents that support this protocol.

projects.name: skyvern
projects.description: Automate browser based workflows with AI
projects.summary: 用 AI 自動完成瀏覽器上嘅工作流，例如填表、登入後台同跨幾個網頁搬資料。佢按頁面內容決定下一步，適合網站經常改版、難以靠固定腳本維護嘅流程。網站改版之後，固定選擇器易壞，呢類流程會穩陣啲。
projects.summary_en: Uses AI to automate browser workflows such as filling forms, logging into admin backends, and moving data across several pages. It decides the next step from the page content, which suits sites that change often and flows that are hard to maintain with fixed scripts. After a site redesign, fixed selectors break easily, and this kind of flow is more stable.

projects.name: babyagi
projects.summary: 早期出名嘅自主 agent 實驗。你畀一個目標，佢就不斷產生下一步任務、按優先次序執行，再將結果變做新任務。程式本身好短，主要係示範呢個循環。而家多當歷史範例嚟讀，唔係功能齊全嘅產品。
projects.summary_en: An early, well-known autonomous agent experiment. You give it a goal, and it keeps creating the next task, executing by priority, and turning the results into new tasks. The program itself is very short and mainly demonstrates this loop. It is now mostly read as a historical example, not a full-featured product.

projects.name: camel
projects.description: 🐫 CAMEL: The first and the best multi-agent framework. Finding the Scaling Law of Agents. https://www.camel-ai.org
projects.summary: 多 agent 框架，用角色扮演同對話令幾個 agent 協作。你可以指定兩個或多個角色嘅立場，讓佢哋互相追問同完成任務，而唔係由一個助手單向回答。適合試多角色辯論同分工，再決定要唔要換成更重嘅框架。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent framework that uses role-play and conversation to make several agents collaborate. You can specify the stance of two or more roles and let them question each other and finish the task, rather than having one assistant answer in one direction. It suits trying multi-role debate and division of work before deciding whether to switch to a heavier framework.

projects.name: pydantic-ai
projects.description: How Python does AI. Agents, realtime voice, image generation, embeddings. Every model, every interface, typed end to end.
projects.summary: 用類型清楚嘅 Python 方式建立 agent。輸入、工具參數同輸出都可以用型別描述，方便接唔同模型同介面，亦減少模型交返一堆對唔上結構嘅文字。模型輸出對唔上型別時會明顯失敗，方便你攔截。
projects.summary_en: Build agents in Python with clear types. Inputs, tool parameters, and outputs can all be described with types, which makes it easier to connect different models and interfaces and reduces cases where the model returns a pile of text that does not match the structure. When model output does not match the type, it fails clearly so you can catch it.

projects.name: swarm
projects.description: Educational framework exploring ergonomic, lightweight multi-agent orchestration. Managed by OpenAI Solution team.
projects.summary: OpenAI 出嚟嘅輕量多 agent 教學框架。佢示範點樣將工作由一個 agent 交畀另一個，程式刻意保持短小，適合用嚟理解交接，而唔係當作完整生產平台。官方後來有更新嘅 agent SDK，呢個保留作輕量示範。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight multi-agent tutorial framework from OpenAI. It shows how to hand work from one agent to another, and the code is deliberately kept short, so it is for understanding handoffs rather than as a full production platform. OpenAI later released a newer agent SDK, and this one is kept as a lightweight demonstration.

projects.name: stable-diffusion-webui
projects.description: Stable Diffusion web UI
projects.summary: 廣泛使用嘅 Stable Diffusion 網頁介面，用嚟喺本機用文字生成同調整圖像。你可以裝擴充、換模型、做局部重繪同放大，唔使自己寫推理程式。模型、擴充同重繪都喺同一個頁面換，係很多人嘅本機出圖入口。
projects.summary_en: A widely used Stable Diffusion web interface for generating and adjusting images from text on your own machine. You can install extensions, switch models, inpaint, and upscale without writing your own inference code. Models, extensions, and inpainting are all switched on the same page, and it is many people's local entry point for generating images.

projects.name: ComfyUI
projects.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.
projects.summary: 用節點圖搭建擴散模型流程嘅介面同後端。每個步驟，例如載入模型、提示詞、ControlNet 同輸出，都係一個節點，適合要重複、要改流程嘅圖像生成。同一張圖可以存成工作流，下次換提示詞再跑一次。
projects.summary_en: An interface and backend for building diffusion-model pipelines as node graphs. Each step, such as loading a model, the prompt, ControlNet, and the output, is a node, which suits image generation you need to repeat and whose flow you need to change. The same graph can be saved as a workflow and run again next time with a different prompt.

projects.name: PaddleOCR
projects.description: Turn any PDF or image document into structured data for your AI. A powerful, lightweight OCR toolkit that bridges the gap between images/PDFs and LLMs. Supports 100+ languages.
projects.summary: 輕量 OCR 工具，可以將圖片同 PDF 轉成結構化文字。支援大量語言同版面，適合要從掃描件、截圖或者表格入面抽出文字，而唔使先訓練自己嘅模型。版面同表格都處理到，唔止係認單行字。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight OCR tool that can turn images and PDFs into structured text. It supports many languages and layouts, which suits extracting text from scans, screenshots, or tables without first training your own model. It can handle layout and tables, not only single lines of text.

projects.name: opencv
projects.description: Open Source Computer Vision Library
projects.summary: 開源電腦視覺庫，處理圖像同影片嘅讀取、濾鏡、特徵同偵測。科研同產品都會用佢做底層操作，例如縮放、找邊緣、追蹤物體，再交俾更高層嘅模型。自己寫視覺流程時，讀寫、幾何同特徵多數先經呢度。
projects.summary_en: An open-source computer vision library for reading images and video and for filters, features, and detection. Research and products both use it for low-level operations such as resizing, finding edges, and tracking objects, then pass the result to a higher-level model. When you write your own vision pipeline, reading and writing, geometry, and features usually go through it first.

projects.name: tesseract
projects.description: Tesseract Open Source OCR Engine (main repository)
projects.summary: 經典開源光學字元識別引擎，可以從圖片抽出文字。佢歷史長、語言包多，適合做命令列或者嵌入其他程式嘅文字識別，而唔一定要上神經網路服務。沒有顯示卡都可以跑，適合嵌進舊系統做批量認字。
projects.summary_en: A classic open-source optical character recognition engine that can extract text from images. It has a long history and many language packs, and it suits command-line use or embedding text recognition in other programs without necessarily calling a neural-network service. It can run without a graphics card, and it suits embedding in older systems for batch text recognition.

projects.name: stable-diffusion
projects.description: A latent text-to-image diffusion model
projects.summary: CompVis 發佈嘅潛在擴散文字到圖像模型，係後來大量生成工具嘅基礎。你可以用文字描述出圖，之後嘅 WebUI、微調同插件多數都係圍住呢個方向延伸。論文同權重都喺度，想追文字到圖像嘅源頭會由佢睇起。
projects.paper_title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
projects.summary_en: The latent diffusion text-to-image model released by CompVis, and the base for a large number of later generation tools. You can generate images from a text description, and later web UIs, fine-tunes, and plugins mostly extended this direction. The paper and the weights are both here, so if you want to trace text-to-image back to its source, you start with this.

projects.name: Fooocus
projects.description: Focus on prompting and generating
projects.summary: 將 Stable Diffusion 收成一個注重提示詞同出圖嘅簡化介面。好多模型同參數選擇被收埋，令你主要改句子就可以出圖，而唔使先理解成張節點圖。想少調參、快啲看到圖，會比完整節點介面容易開始。
projects.summary_en: Wraps Stable Diffusion into a simplified interface focused on prompts and image output. Many model and parameter choices are tucked away, so you mainly edit the sentence to generate an image without first understanding a whole node graph. If you want to tune fewer parameters and see an image sooner, it is easier to start with than a full node interface.

projects.name: supervision
projects.description: We write your reusable computer vision tools. 💜
projects.summary: 電腦視覺工具庫，用嚟處理偵測結果、標註同視覺化。模型交返嚟嘅框同類別可以喺度過濾、計數同畫上畫面，方便你檢查一套偵測流程是否用得。偵測模型換咗都得，後處理代碼可以留低再用。
projects.summary_en: A computer vision toolkit for handling detection results, annotation, and visualization. Boxes and classes returned by a model can be filtered, counted, and drawn on the frame here, so you can check whether a detection pipeline is usable. You can change the detection model and still keep the post-processing code for reuse.

projects.name: upscayl
projects.description: 🆙 Upscayl - #1 Free and Open Source AI Image Upscaler for Linux, MacOS and Windows.
projects.summary: 桌面版免費 AI 圖像放大器，支援 Linux、macOS 同 Windows。你將低清圖片拖入去，佢用超解像模型放大並補細節，唔使自己配置 Python 環境。唔使開終端機，拖一張相入桌面程式就完成放大。
projects.summary_en: A free desktop AI image upscaler for Linux, macOS, and Windows. You drag in a low-resolution image, and it uses a super-resolution model to enlarge it and fill in detail without you setting up a Python environment. You do not need to open a terminal: drag a photo into the desktop program and the upscale is done.

projects.name: GFPGAN
projects.description: GFPGAN aims at developing Practical Algorithms for Real-world Face Restoration.
projects.summary: 針對真實相片嘅人臉修復算法，用嚟還原模糊或受損嘅臉。佢會盡量保留身份，同時補回五官細節，常見於舊相修復同低清人像增強。舊相同低清人像最常用，風景修復就唔係佢嘅重點。人臉以外嘅背景唔係佢負責修復嘅部分。
projects.summary_en: A face restoration algorithm for real photographs, used to recover blurry or damaged faces. It tries to preserve identity while filling in facial detail, and it is commonly used to restore old photos and enhance low-resolution portraits. Old photos and low-resolution portraits are the main use, and landscape restoration is not its focus. The background outside the face is not the part it is responsible for restoring.

projects.name: pytorch-image-models
projects.description: The largest collection of PyTorch image encoders / backbones. Including train, eval, inference, export scripts, and pretrained weights -- ResNet, ResNeXT, EfficientNet, NFNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), MobileNetV4, MobileNet-V3 & V2, RegNet, DPN, CSPNet, Swin Transformer, MaxViT, CoAtNet, ConvNeXt, and more
projects.summary: 大量 PyTorch 圖像骨幹模型嘅集合，包含訓練、評估同預訓練權重。你可以用同一套介面換 ResNet、ViT 等模型，做分類或者當作其他視覺任務嘅骨幹。換骨幹做實驗時，訓練同評估腳本唔使每次重寫。
projects.summary_en: A large collection of PyTorch image backbone models, including training, evaluation, and pretrained weights. You can swap models such as ResNet and ViT through the same interface, for classification or as the backbone of other vision tasks. When you change backbones for an experiment, the training and evaluation scripts do not have to be rewritten each time.

projects.name: Real-ESRGAN
projects.description: Real-ESRGAN aims at developing Practical Algorithms for General Image/Video Restoration.
projects.summary: 實用嘅圖像同影片修復模型，用嚟放大同改善畫質。對真實相片同動漫畫面都有對應模型，適合將細圖放大，同時減少模糊同壓縮痕跡。相片同動漫要揀唔同權重，放大倍數亦可以分開設。放大倍數太大時要留意臉同文字會唔會變形。
projects.summary_en: A practical image and video restoration model for upscaling and improving quality. It has corresponding models for real photographs and for anime, and it suits enlarging small images while reducing blur and compression artifacts. Photographs and anime need different weights, and the scale factor can be set separately. When the scale factor is too large, watch whether faces and text become distorted.

projects.name: diffusers
projects.description: 🤗 Diffusers: State-of-the-art diffusion models for image, video, and audio generation in PyTorch.
projects.summary: Hugging Face 嘅擴散模型庫，用 PyTorch 做圖像、影片同音訊生成。載入模型、採樣同接調度器都有現成流程，適合將生成能力放進自己嘅程式。圖像、影片同音訊生成都可以沿同一套載入方式接上。
projects.summary_en: Hugging Face's diffusion model library for image, video, and audio generation in PyTorch. Loading a model, sampling, and attaching a scheduler all have ready-made flows, so you can put generation into your own program. Image, video, and audio generation can all be connected through the same loading method.

projects.name: CLIP
projects.description: CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining),  Predict the most relevant text snippet given an image
projects.summary: 將圖像同文字放喺同一個空間嘅模型，可以判斷一段文字同圖片有幾匹配。搜圖、分類同後來嘅生成模型，都會用佢嚟衡量幅圖有幾似你講嘅句子。自己無標籤嘅圖庫，可以用句子做零樣本搜尋。
projects.summary_en: A model that places images and text in the same space and can judge how well a piece of text matches a picture. Image search, classification, and later generative models all use it to measure how close an image is to the sentence you described. For your own unlabeled image collection, you can search with a sentence in a zero-shot way.

projects.name: ControlNet
projects.description: Let us control diffusion models!
projects.summary: 用邊緣、姿勢、深度等條件圖控制擴散模型，令生成跟住指定結構。你可以畀一張線稿或者骨架，模型就按呢個形狀出圖，而唔係只靠文字自由發揮。姿勢、線稿同深度可以同時用，結構會比純文字穩。
projects.paper_title: Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
projects.summary_en: Controls a diffusion model with condition images such as edges, pose, and depth, so generation follows a specified structure. You can give it a line drawing or a skeleton, and the model generates according to that shape instead of freely following the text alone. Pose, line drawings, and depth can be used together, and the structure is more stable than text alone.

projects.name: sharp
projects.description: High performance Node.js image processing, the fastest module to resize JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF and TIFF images. Uses the libvips library.
projects.summary: 高效能 Node.js 圖像處理模組，用 libvips 做縮放同格式轉換。網頁服務常用佢處理上載圖片，記憶體比一次過將成張圖解碼更省。網站後台上載圖片後，縮圖同轉格式多數叫佢。
projects.summary_en: A high-performance Node.js image processing module that uses libvips for resizing and format conversion. Web services often use it to process uploaded images, and it uses less memory than decoding the whole image at once. After a website backend receives an uploaded image, thumbnails and format conversion are usually handed to it.

projects.name: EasyOCR
projects.description: Ready-to-use OCR with 80+ supported languages and all popular writing scripts including Latin, Chinese, Arabic, Devanagari, Cyrillic and etc.
projects.summary: 開箱即用嘅光學字元識別，支援八十幾種語言同多種文字系統。呼叫方式簡單，適合想快啲從相片抽出文字，又唔想先編譯傳統 OCR 引擎嘅專案。相入面有幾種文字系統時，唔使先為每種語言裝引擎。
projects.summary_en: Ready-to-use optical character recognition that supports more than eighty languages and multiple writing systems. The call is simple, which suits projects that want to extract text from photos quickly without first compiling a traditional OCR engine. When a photo contains several writing systems, you do not have to install an engine for each language first.

projects.name: InvokeAI
projects.description: Invoke is a leading creative engine for Stable Diffusion models, empowering professionals, artists, and enthusiasts to generate and create visual media using the latest AI-driven technologies. The solution offers an industry leading WebUI, and serves as the foundation for multiple commercial products.
projects.summary: 面向創作嘅 Stable Diffusion 引擎，用嚟生成同編輯視覺內容。除咗文字出圖，亦着重畫布、局部修改同創作流程，適合想有一個完整工作室而唔係淨係一個提示框。想留喺畫布上改圖，而唔係只得一個提示詞輸入框。
projects.summary_en: A creation-oriented Stable Diffusion engine for generating and editing visual content. Besides text-to-image, it emphasizes the canvas, local edits, and the creative workflow, which suits people who want a full studio rather than only a prompt box. It is for staying on the canvas to edit the image, rather than having only a prompt input box.

projects.name: waifu2x
projects.description: Image Super-Resolution for Anime-Style Art
projects.summary: 針對動漫風格嘅圖像超解像，用嚟放大同時減少鋸齒同雜訊。對線條圖同插畫特別常用，可以將細小嘅動漫圖放大得乾淨啲。相片超解像有別的模型更合適，佢強項係動漫線條。放大動漫截圖時線條會乾淨啲。
projects.summary_en: Anime-style image super-resolution for enlarging images while reducing aliasing and noise. It is especially common for line art and illustrations, and it can enlarge small anime images more cleanly. Other models are a better fit for photograph super-resolution, and its strength is anime linework. When you enlarge an anime screenshot, the lines come out cleaner.

projects.name: Graphite
projects.description: Community-built comprehensive 2D content creation appplication for graphic design, digital art, and interactive real-time motion graphics powered by a node-based procedural graphics engine
projects.summary: 社群開發嘅二維創作軟件，用節點做平面設計、數碼繪圖同動態圖形。工具同效果可以接成圖，適合想要一個仍在發展、方向係矢量同程序化設計嘅編輯器。仍在發展，適合想試節點式平面設計嘅人跟住用。
projects.summary_en: Community-developed 2D creative software that uses nodes for graphic design, digital drawing, and motion graphics. Tools and effects can be connected into a graph, which suits people who want an editor that is still in development and aimed at vector and procedural design. It is still in development, and it suits people who want to try node-based graphic design and keep using it.

projects.name: flux
projects.description: Official inference repo for FLUX.1 models
projects.summary: Black Forest Labs FLUX.1 圖像模型嘅官方推理程式。用佢可以喺本機跑 FLUX 文字到圖像，作為比早期 Stable Diffusion 更新一代嘅出圖模型入口。官方推理入口，接自己流程之前可以先用佢出一張對照。
projects.summary_en: The official inference code for the Black Forest Labs FLUX.1 image model. You can use it to run FLUX text-to-image on your own machine, as an entry point to an image model a generation newer than early Stable Diffusion. It is the official inference entry point, and you can generate a comparison image with it before connecting your own pipeline.

projects.name: pytorch-CycleGAN-and-pix2pix
projects.description: Image-to-Image Translation in PyTorch
projects.summary: PyTorch 實作嘅圖像到圖像轉換，包括 CycleGAN 同 pix2pix。可以用配對或者無配對資料做風格轉換、季節變換同素描變相片呢類翻譯。有配對數據用 pix2pix，只有兩組風格相就用 CycleGAN。
projects.summary_en: A PyTorch implementation of image-to-image translation, including CycleGAN and pix2pix. It can do translations such as style transfer, season change, and sketch-to-photo with paired or unpaired data. Use pix2pix when you have paired data, and use CycleGAN when you only have two sets of images in different styles.

projects.name: rembg
projects.description: Rembg is a tool to remove images background
projects.summary: 用 AI 自動去除圖片背景嘅工具。命令列同程式庫都可以用，將人、產品或者其他主體從背景分離，輸出透明底，方便之後合成。商品圖同人像都可以出透明底，再交俾合成或網店版面。去背結果最好再檢查頭髮同半透明邊緣。
projects.summary_en: A tool that uses AI to remove image backgrounds automatically. It can be used from the command line or as a library, separating a person, a product, or another subject from the background and outputting a transparent background for later compositing. Product shots and portraits can both be exported with a transparent background, then passed to compositing or an online-store layout. After background removal, it is best to check the hair and semi-transparent edges.

projects.name: IOPaint
projects.description: Image inpainting tool powered by SOTA AI Model. Remove any unwanted object, defect, people from your pictures or erase and replace(powered by stable diffusion) any thing on your pictures.
projects.summary: AI 圖像修補工具，可以移除物件，或者用文字同擴散模型重畫指定區域。你塗走不想要嘅部分，模型就按周圍畫面或者提示詞補返，而唔使手動克隆印章。移除路人同按文字重畫一塊區域，都可以喺同一工具做。
projects.summary_en: An AI image inpainting tool that can remove objects or redraw a chosen region with text and a diffusion model. You paint over the part you do not want, and the model fills it in from the surrounding picture or a prompt, without manual clone stamping. Removing passersby and redrawing a region from text can both be done in the same tool.

projects.name: CodeFormer
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2022] Towards Robust Blind Face Restoration with Codebook Lookup Transformer
projects.summary: 人臉修復模型，用碼本還原受損或低清嘅臉部細節。可以喺保真同修復強度之間取捨，避免將一張臉修到完全變成另一個人。修復太強會改樣，所以保真程度要自己調。低清證件相同舊人像都常用。
projects.summary_en: A face restoration model that uses a codebook to recover damaged or low-resolution facial detail. You can trade off fidelity against restoration strength so a face is not restored into a completely different person. If restoration is too strong it changes the likeness, so you set the fidelity yourself. Low-resolution ID photos and old portraits are both common uses.

projects.name: ImageMagick
projects.description: ImageMagick is a free, open-source software suite for creating, editing, converting, and displaying images. It supports 200+ formats and offers powerful command-line tools and APIs for automation, scripting, and integration across platforms.
projects.summary: 處理二百幾種格式嘅圖像工具套件，可以用命令列做轉換、編輯同合成。批次縮圖、轉格式、加字同拼圖都會用到佢，係好多自動化流程嘅底層工具。腳本同伺服器批次處理圖像時，仍然係最常見嘅命令列工具。
projects.summary_en: An image toolkit that handles more than two hundred formats and can convert, edit, and composite from the command line. Batch thumbnails, format conversion, adding text, and montages all use it, and it is the underlying tool in many automated flows. For scripts and server-side batch image processing, it is still the most common command-line tool.

projects.name: LaTeX-OCR
projects.description: pix2tex: Using a ViT to convert images of equations into LaTeX code.
projects.summary: 將數學公式圖片轉成 LaTeX 程式碼。拍低或者截一條公式，就可以得到可編輯嘅源碼，適合整理筆記、論文同掃描件入面嘅算式。手寫或印刷公式都可以試，複雜版面就要再人手改。轉出嚟嘅程式碼仍建議貼回編譯器核對。
projects.summary_en: Turns images of mathematical formulas into LaTeX code. Photograph or screenshot a formula and you get editable source, which suits organizing equations in notes, papers, and scans. Handwritten and printed formulas can both be tried, and complex layouts need further manual editing. The generated code should still be pasted back into a compiler to check.

projects.name: latent-diffusion
projects.description: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
projects.summary: 高解像潛在擴散模型嘅研究程式，係 Stable Diffusion 嘅前身實作。佢示範先喺壓縮空間做擴散、再解碼成圖像，後來嘅文字到圖像模型沿用呢個思路。想讀懂 Stable Diffusion 點解喺潛在空間做擴散，由呢個程式睇起。
projects.paper_title: High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models
projects.summary_en: Research code for high-resolution latent diffusion models, and the predecessor implementation of Stable Diffusion. It demonstrates doing diffusion in a compressed space and then decoding into an image, an approach later text-to-image models carried on. If you want to understand why Stable Diffusion does diffusion in latent space, start with this code.

projects.name: Pillow
projects.description: Python Imaging Library (fork)
projects.summary: Python 圖像處理庫，用嚟開檔、縮放、畫圖同轉格式。幾乎所有 Python 圖像程式都會經佢讀寫檔案，再將像素交俾模型或者存返結果。模型前後嘅開檔同存檔，Python 入面多數經佢完成。
projects.summary_en: A Python image processing library for opening files, resizing, drawing, and converting formats. Almost every Python image program reads and writes files through it, then passes the pixels to a model or saves the result. Opening and saving files before and after a model is, in Python, usually done through it.

projects.name: darktable
projects.description: darktable is an open source photography workflow application and raw developer
projects.summary: 開源相片工作流同 RAW 沖曬軟件，用嚟整理同調色相片。你可以管理相庫、對 RAW 做非破壞性調整，作為商業沖曬軟件嘅開源替代。調整寫喺側邊紀錄，原相唔會被覆蓋。調色步驟可以複製到同一輯嘅其他相。
projects.summary_en: Open-source photo workflow and RAW development software for organizing and color-grading photos. You can manage a photo library and make non-destructive adjustments to RAW files, as an open-source alternative to commercial development software. Adjustments are written to a side record, so the original photo is not overwritten. Color-grading steps can be copied to the other photos in the same set.

projects.name: InstantID
projects.description: InstantID: Zero-shot Identity-Preserving Generation in Seconds 🔥
projects.summary: 用一張參考圖做身份保持生成，喺新畫面入面保留同一個人。你改姿勢、場景或者風格時，臉仍然對應參考相，而唔使先為每一個人訓練模型。一張相就夠，唔使先收幾十張同一個人再訓練。側臉同遮擋較多時，身份會較易漂。
projects.summary_en: Identity-preserving generation from a single reference image, keeping the same person in a new picture. When you change the pose, scene, or style, the face still matches the reference photo, without first training a model for each person. One photo is enough, and you do not have to collect dozens of photos of the same person and train first. With more profile views and occlusion, identity drifts more easily.

projects.name: libvips
projects.description: A fast image processing library with low memory needs.
projects.summary: 低記憶體、高速度嘅圖像處理庫。佢按需要處理大圖，伺服器端縮圖同格式轉換經常揀佢，而唔係將成張高解像圖一次過載入記憶體。處理超大圖時唔使成張解碼，所以伺服器先會揀佢。縮圖服務人多時，記憶體優勢會明顯啲。
projects.summary_en: A low-memory, high-speed image processing library. It processes large images as needed, and server-side thumbnails and format conversion often choose it instead of loading an entire high-resolution image into memory at once. When processing very large images it does not have to decode the whole image, which is why servers choose it. When a thumbnail service has many users, the memory advantage is more noticeable.

projects.name: stable-diffusion-webui-forge
projects.summary: Stable Diffusion WebUI 嘅高效分支，針對速度同新模型做咗優化。介面同原本 WebUI 接近，但更着重記憶體同新一代模型嘅推理效率。顯示卡記憶體較緊，或者要跑較新模型時會考慮呢條分支。
projects.summary_en: A high-efficiency fork of Stable Diffusion WebUI, optimized for speed and newer models. The interface is close to the original WebUI, but it puts more weight on memory and on inference efficiency for newer-generation models. When GPU memory is tight, or you need to run a newer model, this fork is one to consider.

projects.name: kohya_ss
projects.summary: 用嚟訓練 LoRA 同微調擴散模型嘅圖形介面。你可以準備一組圖像，訓練一個小權重，之後喺 WebUI 或 ComfyUI 用佢鎖定角色、畫風或者物件。數據集整理同訓練參數都喺圖形介面設，唔使只靠命令列。
projects.summary_en: A graphical interface for training LoRA and fine-tuning diffusion models. You prepare a set of images, train a small set of weights, then use them in WebUI or ComfyUI to lock in a character, an art style, or an object. Dataset organization and training parameters are both set in the graphical interface, so you do not have to rely only on the command line.

projects.name: stylegan2
projects.description: StyleGAN2 - Official TensorFlow Implementation
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅 StyleGAN2，用生成對抗網絡合成高解像圖像。佢以人臉等類別嘅高質合成出名，亦係後來好多 GAN 編輯同潛在空間研究嘅基礎程式。潛在向量可以再做編輯實驗，係 GAN 人臉研究嘅常用起點。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's StyleGAN2, which synthesizes high-resolution images with a generative adversarial network. It is known for high-quality synthesis of categories such as faces, and it is the base code for much later GAN editing and latent-space research. Latent vectors can be used for further editing experiments, and it is a common starting point for GAN face research.

projects.name: krita-ai-diffusion
projects.description: Streamlined interface for generating images with AI in Krita. Inpaint and outpaint with optional text prompt, no tweaking required.
projects.summary: Krita 入面嘅 AI 繪圖插件，可以按選區同提示做局部重繪同擴圖。你留喺繪圖軟件入面修改畫面，而唔使將圖匯出到另一個生成介面再貼返。畫師可以留喺 Krita 嘅圖層同選區入面用生成。
projects.summary_en: An AI drawing plugin for Krita that can inpaint and outpaint from a selection and a prompt. You stay inside the drawing software to edit the picture, without exporting it to another generation interface and pasting it back. Painters can use generation while staying inside Krita's layers and selections.

projects.name: IC-Light
projects.description: More relighting!
projects.summary: 控制生成圖像打光嘅工具，可以改燈光方向同環境，同時盡量保留主體。適合將一張圖重新打光，令佢似放喺另一個場景，而唔係整張重新抽樣。主體保留，只改光，適合產品圖同人像換環境光。
projects.summary_en: A tool for controlling the lighting of a generated image. It can change light direction and environment while trying to keep the subject. It suits relighting an image so it looks placed in another scene, rather than resampling the whole picture. The subject is kept and only the light changes, which suits product photos and portraits when you change the ambient light.

projects.name: yt-dlp
projects.description: A feature-rich command-line audio/video downloader
projects.summary: 功能完整嘅命令列影音下載器，可以從大量網站保存影片同音訊。你可以揀格式、字幕同播放清單，適合要歸檔或者再處理網上影片嘅人。網站改版後更新密，係而家命令列下載嘅主流選擇。播放清單同字幕可以一次過保存。
projects.summary_en: A full-featured command-line audio and video downloader that can save video and audio from a large number of sites. You can choose the format, subtitles, and playlists, which suits people who need to archive or further process online video. It is updated frequently after sites change, and it is the mainstream choice for command-line downloading now. Playlists and subtitles can be saved in one pass.

projects.name: obs-studio
projects.description: OBS Studio - Free and open source software for live streaming and screen recording
projects.summary: 免費開源嘅直播同螢幕錄製軟件。可以混合畫面、鏡頭、視窗同音訊，再用場景切換，適合直播、上課同錄製教學，而唔使另買擷取軟件。場景可以預先排好，直播時一鍵切鏡頭同畫面。上課、直播同錄螢幕都可以共用同一批場景。
projects.summary_en: Free, open-source live streaming and screen recording software. It can mix screens, cameras, windows, and audio, then switch scenes, which suits livestreaming, teaching, and recording tutorials without buying separate capture software. Scenes can be arranged in advance and switched with one click during a stream. Teaching, livestreaming, and screen recording can share the same set of scenes.

projects.name: OpenMontage
projects.description: World's first open-source, agentic video production system. 12 production pipelines, 100+ tools, 700+ agent skill and production-knowledge files. Turn your AI coding assistant into a full video production studio.
projects.summary: 開源嘅 agent 影片製作系統，用多條製作流程同工具產出影片。你交一個製作目標，系統會調用唔同步驟去組織素材同成片，而唔係只提供一個剪接時間線。適合想由目標驅動成片，而唔係自己逐段拖時間線。
projects.summary_en: An open-source agent video production system that produces video with multiple production pipelines and tools. You give it a production goal, and the system calls different steps to organize the material and a finished cut, rather than only offering an editing timeline. It suits people who want a finished video driven by a goal, rather than dragging the timeline piece by piece themselves.

projects.name: remotion
projects.description: 🎥      Make videos programmatically with React
projects.summary: 用 React 以程式方式製作影片，適合可重複嘅動畫同模板。畫面用組件寫，數據一變就可以渲染出新版本，適合批量做片頭、圖表同社群影片。同一條片可以按數據批量出好多版本，例如每個人一段。
projects.summary_en: Make videos programmatically with React, for repeatable animation and templates. The picture is written as components, and when the data changes a new version can be rendered, which suits batch production of intros, charts, and social videos. The same video can be batch-rendered into many versions from data, for example one clip per person.

projects.name: FFmpeg
projects.description: Mirror of https://git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git
projects.summary: 處理影音嘅核心工具，負責轉碼、剪接、串流同格式轉換。播放器、剪接軟件同網站後台很多時都係叫佢做實際嘅解碼同編碼。自己寫剪接或串流工具時，底層幾乎都會叫到佢。幾乎所有影音軟件最後都會叫到佢。
projects.summary_en: A core tool for audio and video, handling transcoding, cutting, streaming, and format conversion. Players, editing software, and website backends often call it for the actual decoding and encoding. When you write your own editing or streaming tool, the lower layer almost always calls it. Almost all audio and video software ends up calling it.

projects.name: jellyfin
projects.description: The Free Software Media System - Server Backend & API
projects.summary: 自由軟件媒體系統，可以自己架伺服器整理同播放影片。影片庫、字幕同多個客戶端都由你控制，用作家庭影音伺服器，而唔使將片庫放上商業平台。家中幾部裝置可以播自己片庫，帳號同元數據都自己管。
projects.summary_en: A free-software media system you can host yourself to organize and play video. You control the library, subtitles, and multiple clients, and it is used as a home media server without putting the library on a commercial platform. Several devices at home can play your own library, and you manage the accounts and metadata yourself.

projects.name: mpv
projects.description: 🎥 Command line media player
projects.summary: 輕量、高質素嘅命令列媒體播放器。支援大量格式同著色器，可以用鍵盤同腳本控制播放，亦經常被其他介面包一層來用。著色器同腳本可以改播放效果，介面則多數另包。設定檔可以同步到幾部電腦。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, high-quality command-line media player. It supports many formats and shaders, playback can be controlled by keyboard and scripts, and other interfaces often wrap it. Shaders and scripts can change the playback look, while the interface is usually wrapped separately. Configuration files can be synced to several computers.

projects.name: Pixelle-Video
projects.description: 🚀 AI 全自动短视频引擎 | AI Fully Automated Short Video Engine
projects.summary: AI 自動短片引擎，由內容一路做到成片。你可以由文字或素材開始，讓流程負責腳本、畫面同輸出，縮短做一條短片要跨好多工具嘅時間。短片步驟串埋一齊，減少腳本、畫面同輸出各用一個軟件。
projects.summary_en: An AI automatic short-video engine that goes from content all the way to a finished video. You can start from text or source material and let the pipeline handle the script, the visuals, and the output, shortening the time spent across many tools to make one short video. The short-video steps are chained together, so the script, the visuals, and the output do not each use a separate program.

projects.name: Open-Sora
projects.description: Open-Sora: Democratizing Efficient Video Production for All
projects.summary: 開源影片生成項目，目標係降低高質文字到影片嘅製作門檻。提供模型同訓練、推理相關程式，讓研究同創作可以喺開放權重上試文字生成影片。想改訓練或推理而唔係只使用現成網站，就睇呢個開放項目。
projects.summary_en: An open-source video generation project aimed at lowering the barrier to high-quality text-to-video. It provides models and training and inference code so research and creative work can try text-to-video on open weights. If you want to change training or inference rather than only use a ready-made website, look at this open project.

projects.name: generative-models
projects.description: Generative Models by Stability AI
projects.summary: Stability AI 嘅生成模型程式，包含 Stable Video Diffusion 等圖像到影片模型。可以用一張圖作為起點生成短片，亦係佢哋多個生成模型嘅官方程式集合。圖像到影片嘅 Stable Video Diffusion 同其他生成模型程式都收喺呢度。
projects.summary_en: Stability AI's generative model code, including image-to-video models such as Stable Video Diffusion. You can generate a short video starting from a single image, and it is also the official code collection for several of their generative models. Stable Video Diffusion for image-to-video and the code for the other generative models are both collected here.

projects.name: HandBrake
projects.description: HandBrake's development repository
projects.summary: 開源影片轉檔工具，用嚟壓縮同轉換成常見格式。有圖形介面可以揀裝置預設，適合將大檔變成方便播放或者上載嘅版本。預設對應常見裝置，轉完就可以直接播或者上傳。批次轉檔時可以沿用同一個預設。
projects.summary_en: An open-source video transcoding tool for compressing and converting to common formats. It has a graphical interface where you can choose device presets, which suits turning large files into versions that are easy to play or upload. Presets match common devices, so after conversion you can play or upload directly. When batch-converting, you can keep using the same preset.

projects.name: video2x
projects.description: A machine learning-based video super resolution and frame interpolation framework. Est. Hack the Valley II, 2018.
projects.summary: 用機器學習做影片超解像同補幀。可以將低解像影片放大，或者提高幀率，令舊片同動畫喺大畫面播放時少啲鋸齒同卡頓。放大同補幀可以分開做，舊動畫同源影片都用得。模型可以按動畫或實拍分開揀。
projects.summary_en: Video super-resolution and frame interpolation with machine learning. It can enlarge low-resolution video or raise the frame rate, so old footage and animation show less aliasing and stutter on a large screen. Upscaling and frame interpolation can be done separately, and both old animation and source video can be used. Models can be chosen separately for animation or live action.

projects.name: Anime4K
projects.description: A High-Quality Real Time Upscaler for Anime Video
projects.summary: 即時動漫影片放大算法，可以喺播放時提升畫質。佢着重線條同色塊，適合邊播邊放大動漫，而唔使先將成條片離線重新渲染。播放器可以即時套用，唔使先渲染成一條新檔。mpv 等播放器可以直接掛呢套算法。
projects.summary_en: A real-time anime video upscaling algorithm that can improve quality during playback. It focuses on lines and flat color, which suits enlarging anime while you watch without first re-rendering the whole video offline. A player can apply it in real time, without first rendering a new file. Players such as mpv can attach this algorithm directly.

projects.name: Toonflow-app
projects.description: 短剧、漫剧制作工具 Toonflow：开源 AI 视频创作平台，集成剧本创作、智能分镜、角色与场景资产管理、图像生成和视频生成。融合无限画布、AI Agent 与可视化工作流，支持本地部署、自选模型、跨平台客户端、MCP 与插件扩展。Open-source AI short drama and motion comic creation tool with an infinite canvas, AI agents, storyboarding, image and video generation. Self-hosted and extensible, with a canvas-based approach similar to LibTV and TapNow.
projects.summary: 開源短劇同漫劇工具，涵蓋劇本、分鏡、角色場景同圖像、影片生成。一條短片需要嘅前期同畫面步驟可以喺同一個專案入面推進。短劇由劇本走到畫面，中間分鏡同角色可以留喺同一專案。角色設定可以沿用到後面嘅分鏡。
projects.summary_en: An open-source tool for short dramas and comic dramas, covering scripts, storyboards, characters and scenes, and image and video generation. The preproduction and visual steps a short video needs can move forward inside the same project. A short drama goes from script to picture, and the storyboards and characters in between can stay in the same project. Character settings can be carried into later storyboards.

projects.name: LivePortrait
projects.description: Bring portraits to life!
projects.summary: 將一張人像變成會郁嘅肖像動畫。你用一張相做身份，再驅動作表情同頭部動作，適合做會說話或者會轉頭嘅人像，而唔使先拍一段影片。只有一張肖像都做得，驅動則來自另一段動作或表情。
projects.summary_en: Turns a single portrait into a moving portrait animation. You use one photo as the identity, then drive expressions and head movement, which suits portraits that talk or turn their head without first filming a video. A single portrait is enough, and the driving comes from another motion or expression clip.

projects.name: Wan2.2
projects.description: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models
projects.summary: 阿里 Wan 系列嘅開源大型影片生成模型。可以用文字或圖像作為條件生成影片，權重同推理程式開放，方便研究同二次開發接上自己嘅流程。開放權重方便你接到自己嘅剪接或生成流程再試。
projects.summary_en: An open-source large video generation model in Alibaba's Wan series. It can generate video conditioned on text or an image, with open weights and inference code, which makes it easier for research and further development to connect to your own pipeline. Open weights make it easy to connect it to your own editing or generation pipeline and try it.

projects.name: FramePack
projects.description: Lets make video diffusion practical!
projects.summary: 令影片擴散模型嘅生成更加實際，降低長片段對記憶體嘅壓力。佢改變幀嘅處理方式，讓較長嘅生成唔使一次過將所有幀嘅狀態放喺顯示卡入面。顯示卡放唔下長片時，呢種幀處理先有實際意義。
projects.summary_en: Makes generation with video diffusion models more practical by lowering the memory pressure of long clips. It changes how frames are processed so a longer generation does not have to keep the state of every frame on the GPU at once. This way of handling frames becomes practically useful when the GPU cannot hold a long video.

projects.name: filmcraft
projects.description: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written by scratch in pure Rust
projects.summary: 用 Rust 由零寫嘅開源非線性影片剪接軟件。方向係提供一個可以剪接、整理時間線嘅本地工具，而唔係再包一層現成剪接引擎。想睇一個用 Rust 新寫嘅時間線，而唔係再套現成剪接核心。
projects.summary_en: Open-source nonlinear video editing software written from scratch in Rust. The direction is a local tool that can edit and organize a timeline, rather than wrapping another layer around an existing editing engine. It is for people who want to look at a timeline newly written in Rust, rather than another wrap around an existing editing core.

projects.name: Duix-Avatar
projects.description: 🚀 Truly open-source AI avatar(digital human) toolkit for offline video generation and digital human cloning.
projects.summary: 可離線使用嘅開源數位人工具，用嚟生成口播影片同克隆數位人。你可以喺本機做口型同形象，適合不想將聲線同肖像送到雲端嘅口播流程。口播片可以離線出，適合唔想把肖像同聲線送去雲端。
projects.summary_en: An open-source digital-human tool that can be used offline to generate talking-head videos and clone digital humans. You can do lip sync and appearance on your own machine, which suits talking-head workflows where you do not want to send the voice and portrait to the cloud. Talking-head videos can be produced offline, which suits people who do not want to send portraits and voices to the cloud.

projects.name: shotcut
projects.description: cross-platform (Qt), open-source (GPLv3) video editor
projects.summary: 跨平台開源影片剪接軟件，基於 MLT 框架。時間線、濾鏡同匯出都有圖形介面，適合想要一個免費、可以離線剪片嘅桌面工具。基於 MLT，濾鏡同匯出都喺桌面完成，唔使再寫指令。
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform open-source video editing software based on the MLT framework. The timeline, filters, and export all have a graphical interface, which suits people who want a free desktop tool that can edit video offline. Because it is based on MLT, filters and export are finished on the desktop, without writing further commands.

projects.name: moviepy
projects.description: Video editing with Python
projects.summary: 用 Python 做影片剪接、合成同基本特效嘅庫。可以用程式裁片、接音訊、加字同輸出，適合批量生產影片，而唔使打開剪接軟件逐條做。幾條片用同一腳本處理時，會比逐條打開剪接軟件快。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for video editing, compositing, and basic effects. You can cut clips, attach audio, add text, and export in code, which suits producing videos in batches without opening an editor for each one. When several videos are processed with the same script, it is faster than opening an editor for each one.

projects.name: AnimateAnyone
projects.description: Animate Anyone: Consistent and Controllable Image-to-Video Synthesis for Character Animation
projects.summary: 用一張人物圖生成動作一致、可控制嘅人物影片。參考動作片提供舞步或姿態，角色外觀則來自你嘅圖片，用來做人物動畫而唔使真人重拍。角色圖同動作片係分開輸入，所以同一套舞可以換人。
projects.summary_en: Generates controllable character video with consistent motion from a single person image. A reference motion clip supplies the dance or pose, and the character's appearance comes from your image, for character animation without reshooting a real person. The character image and the motion clip are separate inputs, so the same dance can be put on a different person.

projects.name: CogVideo
projects.description: text and image to video generation: CogVideoX (2024) and CogVideo (ICLR 2023)
projects.summary: 文字同圖像到影片嘅模型項目，包含 CogVideo 同 CogVideoX。提供開放權重同相關程式，用嚟由描述或圖片生成短片，並作為研究基線。CogVideoX 亦包含在內，文字或圖片都可以做生成條件。
projects.summary_en: A text- and image-to-video model project that includes CogVideo and CogVideoX. It provides open weights and related code for generating short videos from a description or a picture, and for use as a research baseline. CogVideoX is included as well, and either text or an image can be the generation condition.

projects.name: HunyuanVideo
projects.description: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework For Large Video Generation Model
projects.summary: 騰訊混元嘅大型開源影片生成框架。可以用文字生成影片，並提供推理所需程式，讓開發者喺本地或自己嘅環境試高參數嘅影片模型。大型影片模型嘅推理程式開放，方便喺自己機器試效果。長提示詞可以先用短片試清楚再加長。
projects.summary_en: Tencent Hunyuan's large open-source video generation framework. It can generate video from text and provides the code needed for inference, so developers can try a high-parameter video model locally or in their own environment. The inference code for the large video model is open, which makes it easy to try the result on your own machine. A long prompt can first be tried clearly as a short clip, then lengthened.

projects.name: AnimateDiff
projects.description: Official implementation of AnimateDiff.
projects.summary: 畀文字到圖像模型加時間模組，無需逐個再訓練就可以生成短片。已有嘅圖像模型可以因此產出動作，而唔使為每一個畫風另訓練一條影片模型。你已經有嘅圖像模型可以加時間模組，唔使為每個畫風再練一條片。
projects.summary_en: Adds a temporal module to text-to-image models so they can generate short videos without retraining each one. Existing image models can then produce motion, without training a separate video model for every art style. An image model you already have can be given a temporal module, without training another video for each style.

projects.name: LTX-Video
projects.description: Official repository for LTX-Video
projects.summary: Lightricks 嘅開源影片生成模型同官方程式。可以用文字或圖像生成影片，重點係提供可以自己跑嘅權重同推理流程，方便接入創作工具。官方程式可以直接跑，再決定點樣嵌進自己嘅工具。
projects.summary_en: Lightricks' open-source video generation model and official code. It can generate video from text or an image, and the focus is weights and an inference pipeline you can run yourself, so it is easier to connect to creative tools. The official code can be run directly, and then you decide how to embed it in your own tools.

projects.name: magic-animate
projects.description: [CVPR 2024] Official repository for "MagicAnimate: Temporally Consistent Human Image Animation using Diffusion Model"
projects.summary: 用擴散模型做時間上一致嘅人物圖像動畫。參考動作驅動一張人物圖，目標係整個片段入面身份同動作都保持穩定，而唔係逐幀各做各的。重點係成段身份唔跳，而唔係每一幀單獨好看。動作片要清楚，角色先跟得穩。
projects.summary_en: Temporally consistent character image animation with a diffusion model. A reference motion drives a character image, and the goal is stable identity and motion across the whole clip rather than each frame doing its own thing. The point is that identity does not jump across the clip, rather than each frame looking good on its own. The motion clip needs to be clear for the character to follow it steadily.

projects.name: gyroflow
projects.description: Video stabilization using gyroscope data
projects.summary: 用陀螺儀數據做影片防震。相機或運動相機記錄嘅運動數據會用來校正畫面，適合飛機、單車同運動鏡頭，而唔係只靠畫面估計震動。有陀螺儀記錄嘅運動相機最受用，純畫面防震係另一條路。
projects.summary_en: Video stabilization using gyroscope data. Motion data recorded by a camera or action camera is used to correct the picture, which suits aircraft, bicycles, and action shots rather than estimating shake from the image alone. Action cameras that record gyroscope data benefit the most, and stabilization from the picture alone is a different path.

projects.name: video-retalking
projects.description: [SIGGRAPH Asia 2022] VideoReTalking: Audio-based Lip Synchronization for Talking Head Video Editing In the Wild
projects.summary: 按音訊為實拍人物影片做口型同步。你換一段聲音，畫面入面嘅嘴就跟住新音訊郁，適合配音、換旁白同修正口播，而唔使重拍。配音換咗之後，嘴形跟新聲音，適合口播同旁白修正。口播換旁白時最常用，表情其餘部分變動較少。
projects.summary_en: Lip-syncs live-action footage of a person to audio. You replace the sound, and the mouth in the picture moves with the new audio, which suits dubbing, replacing narration, and fixing a talking-head take without reshooting. After the dubbed audio is changed, the mouth follows the new voice, which suits talking-head and narration fixes. It is most often used when replacing narration on a talking-head video, and the rest of the expression changes less.

projects.name: openshot-qt
projects.description: OpenShot Video Editor is an award-winning free and open-source video editor for Linux, Mac, and Windows, and is dedicated to delivering high quality video editing and animation solutions to the world.
projects.summary: 跨平台開源影片剪接軟件，介面比較直接。時間線、轉場同標題都用圖形操作，適合想快上手、又不想先學一套專業剪接軟件嘅人。功能比專業軟件少，但時間線同標題足夠做一般剪接。家庭影片同簡單片頭通常夠用。
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform open-source video editing software with a fairly straightforward interface. The timeline, transitions, and titles are all operated graphically, which suits people who want to get started quickly without first learning a professional editing suite. It has fewer features than professional software, but the timeline and titles are enough for ordinary editing. Home videos and simple intros are usually within what it can handle.

projects.name: mochi
projects.description: The best OSS video generation models, created by Genmo
projects.summary: Genmo 嘅開源文字到影片模型。提供權重同推理程式，用一句描述生成短片，方便研究者同開發者喺開放模型上試影片生成。開放權重可以用一句描述出短片，再同其他影片模型對照。可以同其他開放影片模型並排出較。
projects.summary_en: Genmo's open-source text-to-video model. It provides weights and inference code to generate a short video from one description, so researchers and developers can try video generation on an open model. With the open weights you can produce a short video from one description and compare it with other video models. It can be compared side by side with other open video models.

projects.name: VideoCrafter
projects.description: VideoCrafter2: Overcoming Data Limitations for High-Quality Video Diffusion Models
projects.summary: 影片擴散模型項目，用嚟喺有限數據下生成影片。包含文字到影片同圖像到影片嘅研究程式，適合作為開放嘅影片生成實驗起點。數據有限時嘅影片擴散研究，可以當實驗基線。想改模型而唔係只用網站，就由呢度起。
projects.summary_en: A video diffusion model project for generating video with limited data. It includes research code for text-to-video and image-to-video, and it suits an open starting point for video generation experiments. For video diffusion research when data is limited, it can serve as an experimental baseline. If you want to change the model rather than only use a website, start here.

projects.name: godot
projects.description: Godot Engine – Multi-platform 2D and 3D game engine
projects.summary: 跨平台 2D／3D 遊戲引擎，可以用嚟做即時圖像、互動同動畫。場景、腳本同渲染都包喺編輯器入面，適合做遊戲同即時視覺，而唔使自己寫引擎。2D 同 3D 都喺同一編輯器，匯出時再揀平台。
projects.summary_en: A cross-platform 2D and 3D game engine for real-time graphics, interaction, and animation. Scenes, scripts, and rendering are all in the editor, which suits games and real-time visuals without writing an engine yourself. 2D and 3D are both in the same editor, and you choose the platform when you export.

projects.name: three.js
projects.description: JavaScript 3D Library.
projects.summary: 用 JavaScript 喺瀏覽器建立同渲染 3D 場景。相機、燈光、模型同材質都有現成物件，係網頁三維、產品展示同不少 WebGL 效果嘅常用底層。產品展示、小遊戲同視覺實驗好多都直接用佢起場景。
projects.summary_en: Create and render 3D scenes in the browser with JavaScript. Cameras, lights, models, and materials are all ready-made objects, and it is a common foundation for web 3D, product showcases, and many WebGL effects. Many product showcases, small games, and visual experiments build their scenes directly with it.

projects.name: pixijs
projects.description: The HTML5 Creation Engine: Create beautiful digital content with the fastest, most flexible 2D WebGL renderer.
projects.summary: 高速 2D WebGL 渲染引擎，用嚟做互動圖像同視覺效果。精靈、濾鏡同場景圖適合遊戲同網頁動畫，當畫面要大量圖形同時郁嘅時候會用到。大量精靈同濾鏡同時郁時，會比普通 DOM 動畫穩。
projects.summary_en: A fast 2D WebGL rendering engine for interactive graphics and visual effects. Sprites, filters, and a scene graph suit games and web animation, and it is used when a large number of graphics have to move at the same time. When many sprites and filters move together, it is steadier than ordinary DOM animation.

projects.name: react-three-fiber
projects.description: 🇨🇭 A React renderer for Three.js
projects.summary: 用 React 方式寫 Three.js 場景嘅渲染器。三維物件可以寫成組件，狀態一變就更新畫面，方便將 3D 放進現有嘅 React 介面。介面狀態同三維場景可以寫喺同一套 React 組件。
projects.summary_en: A renderer for writing Three.js scenes in the React style. 3D objects can be written as components, and the picture updates when state changes, which makes it easier to put 3D into an existing React interface. Interface state and the 3D scene can be written in the same set of React components.

projects.name: Babylon.js
projects.description: Babylon.js is a powerful, beautiful, simple, and open game and rendering engine packed into a friendly JavaScript framework.
projects.summary: 功能完整嘅網頁 3D 渲染同遊戲引擎。除咗顯示模型，亦包含物理、動畫同工具，適合想喺瀏覽器做互動場景，又想有一套較完整引擎嘅人。想要較完整嘅網頁引擎，而唔係只得一個渲染器。
projects.summary_en: A full-featured web 3D rendering and game engine. Besides displaying models, it also includes physics, animation, and tools, for people who want interactive scenes in the browser and a fairly complete engine. It is for when you want a more complete web engine rather than only a renderer.

projects.name: gaussian-splatting
projects.description: Original reference implementation of "3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering"
projects.summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting 嘅原始實作，用大量三維高斯表示場景，可以由相片即時渲染新視角。後來嘅動態場景、壓縮同瀏覽器檢視器，好多都係由呢套程式出發。
projects.paper_title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
projects.summary_en: The original implementation of 3D Gaussian Splatting. It represents a scene with a large number of 3D Gaussians and can render new viewpoints from photos in real time. Many later projects for dynamic scenes, compression, and browser viewers started from this program.

projects.name: blender
projects.description: Official mirror of Blender
projects.summary: Blender 官方原始碼，涵蓋建模、動畫、合成、剪接同渲染。呢個係軟件本身嘅程式庫，想改功能、寫分支或者理解 Blender 點樣運作先需要佢。日常用 Blender 唔使下載呢個倉庫，改程式或者自編譯先要。
projects.summary_en: The official Blender source code, covering modeling, animation, compositing, video editing, and rendering. This is the software's own codebase, and you need it to change features, write a fork, or understand how Blender works. Everyday use of Blender does not require downloading this repository. You need it only to change the program or build it yourself.

projects.name: filament
projects.description: Filament is a real-time physically based rendering engine for Android, iOS, Windows, Linux, macOS, and WebGL2
projects.summary: Google 嘅即時物理式渲染引擎，可用喺多個平台。重點係材質同燈光比較接近真實，適合要喺應用入面嵌一個高質即時渲染器，而唔係整套 DCC 軟件。要嵌進自己嘅應用做即時畫面，而唔係取代 Blender。
projects.summary_en: Google's real-time physically based rendering engine, usable on multiple platforms. The emphasis is materials and lighting that stay closer to reality, for embedding a high-quality real-time renderer in an application rather than building a full DCC application. It is meant to be embedded in your own application for real-time images, not to replace Blender.

projects.name: bgfx
projects.description: Cross-platform, graphics API agnostic, "Bring Your Own Engine/Framework" style rendering library.
projects.summary: 跨圖形 API 嘅渲染庫，方便自己嘅引擎接 OpenGL、Direct3D、Vulkan 同 Metal。你寫一套渲染呼叫，由佢處理不同平台嘅後端差異。自己寫引擎時用佢擋低各平台圖形 API 嘅差異。
projects.summary_en: A cross-graphics-API rendering library that lets your own engine target OpenGL, Direct3D, Vulkan, and Metal. You write one set of rendering calls, and it handles backend differences across platforms. When writing your own engine, use it to absorb the differences between each platform's graphics API.

projects.name: instant-ngp
projects.description: Instant neural graphics primitives: lightning fast NeRF and more
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅即時神經圖形基元，大幅加快 NeRF 一類場景嘅訓練同渲染。用哈希編碼同顯示卡加速，令由相片學一個場景唔使再等好耐。NeRF 訓練由幾小時縮到短很多，先令呢類場景變得實用。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's instant neural graphics primitives, which greatly speed up training and rendering of NeRF-style scenes. Hash encoding and GPU acceleration mean learning a scene from photos no longer takes a long wait. Cutting NeRF training from several hours to much less is what made this kind of scene practical.

projects.name: engine
projects.description: Powerful web graphics runtime built on WebGL, WebGPU, WebXR and glTF
projects.summary: 建基於 WebGL、WebGPU 同 glTF 嘅網頁圖形引擎。用來喺瀏覽器載入三維場景同做互動，編輯器生態亦圍繞呢個執行核心。場景用 glTF 載入，編輯器同運行時都圍繞呢個核心。
projects.summary_en: A web graphics engine built on WebGL, WebGPU, and glTF. It loads 3D scenes and runs interaction in the browser, and the editor ecosystem is built around this runtime core. Scenes load through glTF, and both the editor and the runtime are built around this core.

projects.name: bullet3
projects.description: Bullet Physics SDK: real-time collision detection and multi-physics simulation for VR, games, visual effects, robotics, machine learning etc.
projects.summary: 即時碰撞偵測同物理模擬庫，常用於視覺效果、遊戲同機器人。剛體、約束同碰撞可以放進自己嘅場景，而唔使自己由零寫物理。特效、遊戲同機器人都可以共用同一套碰撞同剛體。碰撞結果可以再交俾渲染或機械人控制。
projects.summary_en: A real-time collision detection and physics library, commonly used in visual effects, games, and robotics. Rigid bodies, constraints, and collisions can go into your own scene without writing physics from scratch. Effects, games, and robots can share the same collision and rigid-body system. Collision results can then be passed on to rendering or robot control.

projects.name: Open3D
projects.description: Open3D: A Modern Library for 3D Data Processing
projects.summary: 現代 3D 數據處理庫，用嚟做點雲、網格同視覺化。掃描數據可以喺度濾波、配準同重建，Python 同 C++ 都可以呼叫。掃描點雲嘅清理同配準可以喺 Python 入面做完再視覺化。
projects.summary_en: A modern 3D data processing library for point clouds, meshes, and visualization. Scan data can be filtered, registered, and reconstructed here, and both Python and C++ can call it. Cleaning and registration of scanned point clouds can be finished in Python and then visualized.

projects.name: assimp
projects.description: The official Open-Asset-Importer-Library Repository. Loads 40+ 3D-file-formats into one unified and clean data structure.
projects.summary: 將四十幾種 3D 檔案格式讀入同一個數據結構。遊戲同工具用佢讀 FBX、glTF、OBJ 等模型，再轉成自己引擎需要嘅網格同材質。上游軟件匯出咩格式都先讀入同一結構，引擎先好處理。
projects.summary_en: Reads more than forty 3D file formats into one data structure. Games and tools use it to read models such as FBX, glTF, and OBJ, then convert them into the meshes and materials their own engine needs. Whatever format upstream software exports is read into that same structure first, so the engine can handle it.

projects.name: Meshroom
projects.description: Node-based Visual Programming Toolbox
projects.summary: 節點式攝影測量工具，可以由相片重建三維模型。你放入一組從不同角度拍嘅相，流程會估計相機同生成網格，適合實物掃描。實物拍一圈相就可以重建，節點可以按需要改流程。拍得越完整，重建出嚟嘅模型越穩。
projects.summary_en: A node-based photogrammetry tool that reconstructs a 3D model from photos. You provide a set of photos taken from different angles, and the pipeline estimates the cameras and generates a mesh, which suits scanning real objects. Photographing an object all the way around is enough to reconstruct it, and the nodes let you change the pipeline as needed. The more completely you photograph it, the more stable the reconstructed model.

projects.name: nerfstudio
projects.description: A collaboration friendly studio for NeRFs
projects.summary: 研究新視角合成嘅工作台，NeRF 同 3D Gaussian Splatting（splatfacto）可以共用同一套資料、訓練同檢視工具。換方法時唔使重寫成套腳本，適合試高斯重建。
projects.summary_en: A workbench for research on novel-view synthesis. NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting (splatfacto) can share the same data, training, and viewing tools. Switching methods does not require rewriting the whole set of scripts, which suits trying Gaussian reconstruction.

projects.name: supersplat
projects.description: 3D Gaussian Splat Editor
projects.summary: 喺瀏覽器入面編輯 3D Gaussian Splat 嘅工具。你可以檢視、修剪同整理掃描得到嘅高斯場景，再匯出，而唔使先裝一套桌面研究程式。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A tool for editing 3D Gaussian splats in the browser. You can view, trim, and tidy Gaussian scenes from scans, then export them, without first installing a desktop research program. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: pytorch3d
projects.description: PyTorch3D is FAIR's library of reusable components for deep learning with 3D data
projects.summary: 用 PyTorch 做 3D 深度學習嘅組件庫。網格、相機同可微分渲染都可以放進訓練流程，適合研究三維視覺，而唔係做最終動畫軟件。研究三維網絡時用，而唔係拿嚟做最終動畫製作。
projects.summary_en: A component library for 3D deep learning with PyTorch. Meshes, cameras, and differentiable rendering can go into a training pipeline. It suits research in 3D vision rather than making finished animation software. Use it when researching 3D networks, not for final animation production.

projects.name: dream-textures
projects.description: Stable Diffusion built-in to Blender
