projects.summary: 內置喺 Blender 嘅 Stable Diffusion，可以直接喺場景入面生成貼圖。你留喺 Blender 用提示詞出材質或圖像，再貼到模型上，少一次匯出同匯入。貼圖喺 Blender 入面生成，模型唔使匯出去另一個軟件再貼返。
projects.summary_en: Stable Diffusion built into Blender, so you can generate textures directly in the scene. You stay in Blender, use a prompt to produce a material or image, and apply it to the model, which saves an export and an import. Textures are generated inside Blender, so the model does not have to be exported to another program and textured there before it comes back.

projects.name: opentoonz
projects.description: OpenToonz - An open-source full-featured 2D animation creation software
projects.summary: 功能完整嘅開源 2D 動畫製作軟件。掃描、上色、時間線同特效都包含在內，係傳統手繪動畫流程可以用嘅免費工具。掃描線稿、上色同時間線可以留喺同一套 2D 動畫流程。上色同時間線不用分開兩個軟件。
projects.summary_en: A full-featured open-source 2D animation production program. Scanning, coloring, the timeline, and effects are all included, so it is a free tool a traditional hand-drawn animation workflow can use. Scanned line art, coloring, and the timeline can stay in one 2D animation workflow. Coloring and the timeline do not need two separate programs.

projects.name: OpenUSD
projects.description: Universal Scene Description
projects.summary: Pixar 嘅通用場景描述，用嚟喺唔同軟件之間交換三維場景。模型、燈光、材質同動畫可以寫成 USD，讓 Blender、渲染器同遊戲引擎讀同一套場景。燈光同動畫都寫入場景描述，唔止係交換一個靜態模型。
projects.summary_en: Pixar's Universal Scene Description, for exchanging 3D scenes between different programs. Models, lights, materials, and animation can be written as USD so that Blender, renderers, and game engines read the same scene. Lights and animation are written into the scene description, so it exchanges more than a static model.

projects.name: meshlab
projects.description: The open source mesh processing system
projects.summary: 開源網格處理系統，用嚟清理、修復同檢視 3D 模型。掃描出來嘅網格可以喺度簡化、補洞同對齊，再送去其他軟件繼續做。掃描網格太亂時，先喺度清理再送去 Blender 或引擎。
projects.summary_en: An open-source mesh processing system for cleaning, repairing, and viewing 3D models. Scanned meshes can be simplified, hole-filled, and aligned here, then sent on to other software. When a scanned mesh is too messy, clean it here first and then send it to Blender or an engine.

projects.name: gsplat
projects.description: CUDA accelerated rasterization of gaussian splatting
projects.summary: 用 CUDA 加速嘅 Gaussian Splatting 光柵化庫，方便研究同整合。其他專案可以呼叫佢做高斯場景嘅渲染核心，而唔使自己寫顯示卡光柵化。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A CUDA-accelerated Gaussian Splatting rasterization library for research and integration. Other projects can call it as the rendering core for Gaussian scenes without writing their own GPU rasterizer. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: slang
projects.description: Making it easier to work with shaders
projects.summary: 讓著色器更容易寫、亦更容易跨平台編譯嘅著色語言。一份著色程式可以編譯到不同圖形 API，減少為 Vulkan、Direct3D 同 Metal 各寫一次。同一份著色碼編譯到幾個圖形 API，引擎先少維護多份。
projects.summary_en: A shading language that makes shaders easier to write and easier to compile across platforms. One shader program can be compiled to different graphics APIs, so you write it fewer times for Vulkan, Direct3D, and Metal separately. The same shader code compiles to several graphics APIs, so an engine maintains fewer copies.

projects.name: Natron
projects.description: Open-source video compositing software. Node-graph based. Similar in functionalities to Adobe After Effects and Nuke by The Foundry.
projects.summary: 開源節點式影片合成軟件，用途接近 After Effects 同 Nuke。遮罩、調色同特效用節點連接，適合做鏡頭合成，而唔係時間線剪接。節點合成接近 Nuke 嘅用法，時間線剪接就用其他軟件。
projects.summary_en: An open-source node-based compositing program, close in purpose to After Effects and Nuke. Masks, color grading, and effects are connected with nodes. It suits shot compositing rather than timeline editing. Node compositing is close to how Nuke is used. Timeline editing belongs in other software.

projects.name: pbrt-v4
projects.description: Source code to pbrt, the ray tracer described in the forthcoming 4th edition of the "Physically Based Rendering: From Theory to Implementation" book.
projects.summary: 《Physically Based Rendering》第四版描述嘅物理式光線追蹤器原始碼。用來學習同實驗真實感渲染算法，係教材對應嘅參考實作，而唔係動畫廠的生產渲染器。讀教材時可以對住呢份碼做實驗，出圖速度唔係生產取向。
projects.summary_en: Source code for the physically based ray tracer described in the fourth edition of Physically Based Rendering. It is for learning and experimenting with photorealistic rendering algorithms, the reference implementation that matches the textbook, not a production renderer for an animation studio. While reading the book you can experiment against this code. Render speed is not aimed at production.

projects.name: openvdb
projects.description: OpenVDB - Sparse volume data structure and tools
projects.summary: 稀疏體積數據結構同工具，係特效入面煙、火、雲嘅常用格式。模擬結果可以存成 VDB，再喺唔同軟件入面渲染同交換。流體模擬交去渲染器時，VDB 係常見嘅中間格式。煙火模擬交去其他軟件時就用呢個格式。
projects.summary_en: A sparse volumetric data structure and toolset, a common format for smoke, fire, and clouds in visual effects. Simulation results can be stored as VDB, then rendered and exchanged in different programs. When a fluid simulation is handed to a renderer, VDB is a common intermediate format. Smoke and fire simulations use this format when they are passed to other software.

projects.name: OpenSubdiv
projects.description: An Open-Source subdivision surface library.
projects.summary: Pixar 嘅開源細分曲面庫。模型用較少控制點描述曲面，渲染或顯示時再細分到平滑，遊戲同動畫軟件都會嵌佢。模型保持低面數，顯示時先細分，遊戲同動畫都會嵌佢。曲面平滑唔使先把模型拆到很密。
projects.summary_en: Pixar's open-source subdivision surface library. A model describes a surface with fewer control points, then subdivides to a smooth result when it is rendered or displayed, and both games and animation software embed it. The model keeps a low polygon count and is subdivided only at display time. Games and animation both embed it. Smoothing a surface does not require splitting the model into a very dense mesh first.

projects.name: mitsuba3
projects.description: Mitsuba 3: A Retargetable Forward and Inverse Renderer
projects.summary: 可重定向嘅正向同逆向渲染器，用嚟做研究級物理渲染。除咗出圖，亦可以對場景參數求梯度，適合研究外觀、材質同反向繪製。可以對材質同燈光求梯度，用嚟做反向渲染研究。研究渲染算法多過拿嚟出動畫成片。
projects.summary_en: A retargetable forward and inverse renderer for research-grade physically based rendering. Besides producing images, it can take gradients of scene parameters, which suits research on appearance, materials, and inverse rendering. Gradients can be taken for materials and lights for inverse rendering research. It is used more to study rendering algorithms than to deliver finished animation.

projects.name: openexr
projects.description: The OpenEXR project provides the specification and reference implementation of the EXR file format, the professional-grade image storage format of the motion picture industry.
projects.summary: 電影工業常用嘅高動態範圍 EXR 圖像格式同參考實作。合成同渲染會用佢保存高於一般螢幕範圍嘅亮度同多個圖層，而唔係只存 8-bit 圖片。一張 EXR 可以帶多個圖層同高光，合成時先唔會夾死亮度。
projects.summary_en: The high-dynamic-range EXR image format widely used in the film industry, and its reference implementation. Compositing and rendering use it to store brightness beyond a normal screen range, plus multiple layers, rather than only 8-bit images. One EXR can carry multiple layers and highlights, so compositing does not clip the brightness.

projects.name: MaterialX
projects.description: MaterialX is an open standard for the exchange of rich material and look-development content across applications and renderers.
projects.summary: 喺唔同軟件同渲染器之間交換材質同外觀描述嘅開放標準。一個材質圖可以帶到另一個軟件，減少因為各自著色器而要重做外觀。材質由一個軟件帶到另一個渲染器時，外觀描述有共同格式。外觀換渲染器時少一次重畫材質。
projects.summary_en: An open standard for exchanging material and look descriptions between different programs and renderers. A material graph can be carried into another program, so a look is rebuilt less often just because each shader is different. When a material moves from one program to another renderer, the look description has a shared format. Changing renderer for a look means redrawing the material one less time.

projects.name: OpenColorIO
projects.description: A color management framework for visual effects and animation.
projects.summary: 視覺效果同動畫用嘅色彩管理框架。佢負責喺拍攝、合成同顯示之間轉換顏色空間，令不同軟件看到嘅顏色保持一致。顯示同合成看到嘅顏色要一致時，會用佢做轉換。鏡頭之間色溫唔同，都靠佢對齊。
projects.summary_en: A color management framework for visual effects and animation. It converts color spaces between capture, compositing, and display so that different programs see the same color. When the displayed color and the composited color need to match, it does the conversion. When color temperature differs between shots, it is also what lines them up.

projects.name: OpenBB
projects.description: Open Data Platform for analysts, quants and AI agents.
projects.summary: 畀分析師、量化研究員同 AI agent 用嘅開源金融數據平台。可以將行情、基本面同宏觀數據拉到同一個介面或程式入面，再做研究而唔使逐個網站抄數。分析師同 agent 都可以叫同一套數據，唔使逐個網站抄數。
projects.summary_en: An open-source financial data platform for analysts, quant researchers, and AI agents. Market quotes, fundamentals, and macro data can be pulled into one interface or program for research, without copying numbers off each website by hand. Analysts and agents can call the same data instead of copying numbers site by site.

projects.name: daily_stock_analysis
projects.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。  LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.
projects.summary: 用語言模型做多市場股票分析，整合行情、新聞同決策看板，可以定時推送。適合想每日收到一份整理好嘅市場摘要，而唔係自己逐隻股票翻新聞。多個市場可以排程出摘要，適合每日睇一次而唔係全日盯盤。
projects.summary_en: Multi-market stock analysis with a language model. It combines quotes, news, and a decision dashboard, and it can push updates on a schedule. It suits someone who wants a prepared market summary each day rather than reading the news stock by stock. Several markets can be scheduled into a summary, for a once-a-day look rather than watching the market all day.

projects.name: qlib
projects.description: Qlib is an AI-oriented Quant investment platform that aims to use AI tech to empower Quant Research, from exploring ideas to implementing productions. Qlib supports diverse ML modeling paradigms, including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and RL, and is now equipped with https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent to automate R&D process.
projects.summary: 微軟面向 AI 嘅量化投資平台，由構思因子、準備數據到研究同落地都涵蓋。重點係用機器學習做預測同組合，而唔係只提供一個下單接口。機器學習因子研究係主線，下單只係後面嘅落地部分。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's AI-oriented quantitative investment platform, covering factor ideas, data preparation, research, and deployment. The focus is using machine learning for prediction and portfolios, not only offering an order-placement interface. Machine-learning factor research is the main line. Order placement is only the later deployment step.

projects.name: vnpy
projects.description: 基于Python的开源量化交易平台开发框架
projects.summary: 基於 Python 嘅開源量化交易框架，覆蓋數據、策略、回測同實盤。事件驅動引擎同交易接口都有，適合想由研究一路接到交易嘅人。策略研究同實盤接口放埋，減少回測同交易各寫一套。
projects.summary_en: An open-source quantitative trading framework based on Python, covering data, strategies, backtesting, and live trading. It has an event-driven engine and trading interfaces, for people who want to go from research all the way to trading. Strategy research and the live-trading interface sit together, so backtesting and trading are less often written as two separate systems.

projects.name: Vibe-Trading
projects.description: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"
projects.summary: 個人交易 agent，用自然語言輔助做交易研究同決策。你可以將問題講俾佢，由佢整理數據同想法，而唔使先自己寫晒所有指標腳本。先用自然語言收窄方向，再決定要唔要寫成正式策略。
projects.summary_en: A personal trading agent that uses natural language to help with trading research and decisions. You can state the question, and it organizes the data and the ideas, so you do not have to write every indicator script yourself first. Use natural language to narrow the direction, then decide whether to write it up as a formal strategy.

projects.name: FinceptTerminal
projects.description: FinceptTerminal is a modern finance application offering advanced market analytics, investment research, and economic data tools, designed for interactive exploration and data-driven decision-making in a user-friendly environment.
projects.summary: 開源金融終端，用嚟睇市場分析、投資研究同經濟數據。方向係將終端機式嘅行情同研究工具開放出嚟，而唔使依賴單一商業終端。想要終端機式研究畫面，又可以自己改數據來源。數據來源可以自己換，唔綁死一家供應商。
projects.summary_en: An open-source financial terminal for market analysis, investment research, and economic data. The aim is to open up terminal-style quotes and research tools so you do not depend on a single commercial terminal. It is for a terminal-style research screen whose data sources you can change yourself. Data sources can be swapped, so you are not locked to one vendor.

projects.name: nautilus_trader
projects.description: Production-grade Rust-native trading engine with deterministic event-driven architecture
projects.summary: 用 Rust 寫嘅實盤級交易引擎，事件驅動而且回測可重現，支援多種資產。同一套事件模型可以用於股票同其他市場，著重速度同回測同實盤一致。回測用嘅事件順序同實盤同一套，減少兩邊結果對唔上。
projects.summary_en: A live-trading-grade trading engine written in Rust. It is event-driven, its backtests are reproducible, and it supports multiple asset types. The same event model can be used for stocks and other markets, with an emphasis on speed and on backtests matching live trading. The event order used in backtesting is the same as in live trading, so the two sets of results diverge less often.

projects.name: yfinance
projects.description: Download market data from Yahoo! Finance's API
projects.summary: 從 Yahoo Finance 下載股票行情同基本資料嘅 Python 庫。幾行程式就可以攞歷史價格同財報摘要，適合研究同教學，正式交易則要再核對數據來源。教學同原型好用，正式交易前要用券商或交易所數據再核對。
projects.summary_en: A Python library that downloads stock quotes and basic information from Yahoo Finance. A few lines of code can fetch historical prices and financial-statement summaries. It suits research and teaching. For real trading, the data source still has to be checked again. It is useful for teaching and prototypes. Before live trading, check the data again against a broker or an exchange.

projects.name: backtrader
projects.description: Python Backtesting library for trading strategies
projects.summary: Python 策略回測庫，用事件驅動方式測試交易策略。你寫策略類別，餵入歷史數據，就可以睇交易、資金曲線同指標，係很多人學回測嘅第一個框架。指標同資金曲線可以一齊睇，係很多人第一個事件驅動回測。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for backtesting trading strategies in an event-driven way. You write a strategy class, feed in historical data, and can see the trades, the equity curve, and the indicators. It is many people's first framework for learning backtesting. Indicators and the equity curve can be viewed together. It is many people's first event-driven backtest.

projects.name: akshare
projects.description: AKShare is an elegant and simple financial data interface library for Python, built for human beings! 开源财经数据接口库
projects.summary: 開源財經數據接口，用 Python 攞股票、宏觀同其他市場數據。接口覆蓋面廣，適合做中文市場研究時快速取數，再交俾自己嘅分析或回測。中文市場嘅宏觀同行情接口多，取完數再交俾自己嘅回測。
projects.summary_en: An open-source financial data interface for fetching stocks, macro data, and other market data in Python. Coverage is broad, which suits quickly pulling data for Chinese market research and then handing it to your own analysis or backtest. There are many macro and quote interfaces for the Chinese market. After the data is fetched, pass it to your own backtest.

projects.name: Lean
projects.description: Lean Algorithmic Trading Engine by QuantConnect (Python, C#)
projects.summary: QuantConnect 嘅演算法交易引擎，可以用 Python 或 C# 做回測同實盤，亦支援加密貨幣。策略寫一次就可以喺引擎跑，資產唔限於股票。同一策略可以跑股票同加密貨幣，語言可以揀 Python 或 C#。
projects.summary_en: QuantConnect's algorithmic trading engine. You can backtest and trade live in Python or C#, and it also supports cryptocurrency. A strategy is written once and run on the engine, and the assets are not limited to stocks. The same strategy can run on stocks and cryptocurrency, and the language can be Python or C#.

projects.name: FinGPT
projects.description: FinGPT: Open-Source Financial Large Language Models!  Revolutionize 🔥    We release the trained model on HuggingFace.
projects.summary: 開源金融大語言模型，用嚟做金融文本同市場相關嘅語言任務。可以處理新聞、報告同情緒呢類文字，而唔係用來直接計算報價或下單。用嚟讀新聞同報告，訊號仍要你自己決定點樣落到交易。
projects.summary_en: An open-source financial large language model for language tasks on financial text and markets. It can handle text such as news, reports, and sentiment. It is not for directly computing quotes or placing orders. Use it to read news and reports. You still decide how a signal is turned into a trade.

projects.name: OpenStock
projects.description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
projects.summary: 開源行情平台，可以追蹤價格、設定提醒同查看公司資料。重點係一個可以自己睇同自己改嘅股票追蹤介面，而唔係完整嘅券商交易系統。提醒同公司資料係重點，落單要另接券商。公司資料同價格提醒可以自己改畫面。
projects.summary_en: An open-source market platform for tracking prices, setting alerts, and viewing company information. The focus is a stock-tracking interface you can view and modify yourself, not a complete broker trading system. Alerts and company information are the point. Placing orders requires a separate broker connection. You can change the screens for company information and price alerts yourself.

projects.name: zipline
projects.description: Zipline, a Pythonic Algorithmic Trading Library
projects.summary: 經典 Python 演算法交易庫。用佢可以用歷史數據回測股票策略，寫法影響咗後來好多框架。官方倉庫已封存，仍然係好多回測教學嘅基礎。官方已封存，而家多用來讀舊教學同對照新框架嘅寫法。
projects.summary_en: A classic Python algorithmic trading library. It backtests stock strategies on historical data, and its style influenced many later frameworks. The official repository is archived, and it is still the basis of many backtesting tutorials. The official project is archived. It is now mostly used to read older tutorials and to compare how new frameworks are written.

projects.name: abu
projects.description: 阿布量化交易系统(股票，期权，期货，比特币，机器学习) 基于python的开源量化交易，量化投资架构
projects.summary: 阿布量化系統，涵蓋股票、期權、期貨同比特幣，並結合機器學習。由揀標的、回測到用模型輔助，都放喺同一套教學式框架入面。股票走到比特幣都可以放喺同一套例子入面學。例子涵蓋幾個市場，方便對照同一套寫法。
projects.summary_en: The Abu quantitative system. It covers stocks, options, futures, and Bitcoin, and it combines them with machine learning. Choosing instruments, backtesting, and help from models all sit in one tutorial-style framework. From stocks through to Bitcoin, you can learn inside the same set of examples. The examples cover several markets, which makes it easy to compare one way of writing.

projects.name: Qbot
projects.description: [🔥updating ...] AI 自动量化交易机器人(完全本地部署) AI-powered Quantitative Investment Research Platform. 📃 online docs: https://ufund-me.github.io/Qbot   ✨ :news: qbot-mini: https://github.com/Charmve/iQuant
projects.summary: 可本地部署嘅 AI 量化研究同交易平台。研究、回測同相關工具可以放喺自己部機，適合想試 AI 同量化流程，又想數據留喺本地嘅人。想試 AI 量化又想數據留本地，可以由呢個平台起。
projects.summary_en: An AI quantitative research and trading platform that can be deployed locally. Research, backtesting, and related tools can sit on your own machine, for people who want to try an AI and quant workflow and want the data to stay local. If you want to try AI quant work and keep the data local, you can start from this platform.

projects.name: lightweight-charts
projects.description: Performant financial charts built with HTML5 canvas
projects.summary: TradingView 開源嘅高效能金融圖表庫。可以喺網頁畫 K 線同成交量，互動流暢，適合自己做行情介面，而唔使嵌入成個 TradingView 網站。自己網站要 K 線時嵌佢就得，唔使打開 TradingView 成頁。
projects.summary_en: TradingView's open-source high-performance financial charting library. It can draw candlesticks and volume on a web page, with smooth interaction, for building your own market interface without embedding the whole TradingView site. When your own site needs candlesticks, embedding this is enough. You do not need to open a full TradingView page.

projects.name: FinRL
projects.description: FinRL®:  Financial Reinforcement Learning. 🔥
projects.summary: 用深度強化學習做金融交易嘅開源庫，包含市場環境同訓練流程。策略係訓練一個代理去交易，而唔係手寫每條進出場規則，適合研究強化學習。環境已經包好市場步驟，你可以集中改強化學習算法。
projects.summary_en: An open-source library for financial trading with deep reinforcement learning, including market environments and a training pipeline. The strategy is a trained agent that trades, rather than hand-written entry and exit rules, which suits reinforcement-learning research. The environment already wraps the market steps, so you can concentrate on changing the reinforcement-learning algorithm.

projects.name: tushare
projects.description: TuShare is a utility for crawling historical data of China stocks
projects.summary: 攞中國股票歷史數據嘅 Python 工具。行情、財務同部分基本面可以經接口下載，係很多中文量化筆記嘅取數起點，部分數據需要權限。中文量化筆記好多由佢取數開始，進階數據可能要權限。
projects.summary_en: A Python tool for fetching historical data on Chinese stocks. Quotes, financials, and some fundamentals can be downloaded through the interface. It is where many Chinese-language quant notes start fetching data, and some data requires access permission. Many Chinese-language quant notes begin by pulling data from it. Advanced data may require permission.

projects.name: stock
projects.description: stock股票.获取股票数据,计算股票指标,筹码分布,识别股票形态,综合选股,选股策略,股票验证回测,股票自动交易,支持PC及移动设备。
projects.summary: 中文股票工具，包含行情、指標、形態、選股、回測同自動交易。功能偏完整工具箱，適合想喺一個專案入面由睇圖走到試策略嘅人。由睇形態到試自動交易都可以留喺同一個中文專案。選股條件同回測可以留喺同一套中文介面。
projects.summary_en: A Chinese-language stock tool that includes quotes, indicators, chart patterns, stock screening, backtesting, and automated trading. The features lean toward a complete toolbox, for people who want to go from reading charts to trying strategies inside one project. From reading patterns to trying automated trading can stay in the same Chinese-language project. Screening conditions and backtesting can stay in the same Chinese-language interface.

projects.name: ta-lib-python
projects.description: Python wrapper for TA-Lib (http://ta-lib.org/).
projects.summary: TA-Lib 技術指標庫嘅 Python 封裝。均線、RSI、MACD 等常見指標可以用陣列一次過計算，回測同選股腳本通常會叫佢，而唔使自己實作公式。回測腳本要 RSI、MACD 時直接叫佢，唔使自己對公式。
projects.summary_en: The Python wrapper for the TA-Lib technical indicator library. Common indicators such as moving averages, RSI, and MACD can be computed on arrays in one pass. Backtest and screening scripts usually call it instead of implementing the formulas themselves. When a backtest script needs RSI or MACD, call it directly instead of matching the formula yourself.

projects.name: QUANTAXIS
projects.description: QUANTAXIS 支持任务调度 分布式部署的 股票/期货/期权  数据/回测/模拟/交易/可视化/多账户 纯本地量化解决方案
projects.summary: 本地量化方案，涵蓋股票、期貨、期權嘅數據、回測、模擬同交易。目標係一套可以擺喺自己機器嘅研究同交易環境，而唔止一個單一策略檔案。股票、期貨同期權可以喺本地由數據一路模擬到交易。
projects.summary_en: A local quantitative system covering data, backtesting, simulation, and trading for stocks, futures, and options. The goal is a research and trading environment you can put on your own machine, not only a single strategy file. Stocks, futures, and options can go locally from data through simulation to trading.

projects.name: easytrader
projects.description: 提供同花顺客户端/miniqmt/雪球的股票量化交易，支持跟踪 joinquant /ricequant 模拟交易 和 实盘雪球组合
projects.summary: 接合同花順、miniQMT 同雪球嘅股票交易接口，亦可以跟蹤模擬組合。用 Python 呼叫常見客戶端落單，適合已經有券商軟件、想再加一層自動化嘅人。你已經開住券商客戶端時，用 Python 再加一層自動落單。
projects.summary_en: A stock trading interface for Tonghuashun, miniQMT, and Xueqiu. It can also follow simulated portfolios. It places orders by calling common desktop clients from Python, for people who already have broker software and want another layer of automation. When your broker client is already open, use Python to add a layer of automated order placement.

projects.name: vectorbt
projects.description: The research engine that gives you an unfair advantage. Run thousands of trading ideas before others finish one.
projects.summary: 向量化量化研究引擎，可以一次過回測大量交易想法。信號用陣列運算，而唔係逐筆事件循環，適合想快速掃很多參數同規則嘅研究。想掃很多參數組合時，向量化會比逐筆迴圈快。參數表可以一次出好多條資金曲線。
projects.summary_en: A vectorized quantitative research engine that can backtest a large number of trading ideas at once. Signals use array operations rather than an event loop one record at a time, for research that needs to scan many parameters and rules quickly. When you want to scan many parameter combinations, vectorization is faster than a per-record loop. A parameter table can produce many equity curves in one pass.

projects.name: backtesting.py
projects.description: 🔎 📈 🐍 💰  Backtest trading strategies in Python.
projects.summary: 用 Python 簡潔地回測交易策略嘅庫。介面短小，可以用幾行程式定義進出場，並畫出結果，適合試一個想法，而唔係搭建完整交易系統。想法尚未成形時先用佢試，複雜撮合再換更大嘅框架。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for backtesting trading strategies in a concise way. The interface is small. A few lines of code can define entries and exits and plot the result. It suits trying an idea rather than building a complete trading system. Use it first while an idea is still unformed. Switch to a larger framework when order matching gets complicated.

projects.name: quantstats
projects.description: Portfolio analytics for quants, written in Python
projects.summary: 用 Python 做投資組合表現同風險分析。可以計回報、回撤同常見風險指標，並生成報告，用嚟檢查一個策略或組合嘅成績，而唔係負責下單。策略跑完先用佢出回撤同風險報告，佢本身唔落單。
projects.summary_en: Portfolio performance and risk analysis in Python. It can compute returns, drawdowns, and common risk metrics, and it can generate reports, for checking how a strategy or portfolio did rather than placing orders. After a strategy has finished running, use it to produce drawdown and risk reports. It does not place orders itself.

projects.name: QuantLib
projects.description: The QuantLib C++ library
projects.summary: 定量金融 C++ 庫，用嚟做定價、利率曲線同風險計算。債券、期權同利率工具嘅模型都有，適合定價同風險，而唔係股票擇時回測。利率曲線同期權定價先會用到，擇時回測唔係佢嘅主場。
projects.summary_en: A quantitative finance library in C++ for pricing, interest-rate curves, and risk calculations. It includes models for bonds, options, and interest-rate instruments. It suits pricing and risk, not stock market-timing backtests. Interest-rate curves and option pricing are where it gets used. Market-timing backtests are not its main ground.

projects.name: rqalpha
projects.description: A extendable, replaceable Python algorithmic backtest && trading framework supporting multiple securities
projects.summary: 可擴展嘅 Python 回測同交易框架，支援多種證券。策略用程式寫，引擎負責數據同撮合，可以加自己嘅模組，而唔使由零寫回測循環。多種證券共用引擎，自己嘅數據或手續費可以加成模組。
projects.summary_en: An extensible Python framework for backtesting and trading, with support for multiple security types. Strategies are written in code, and the engine handles data and order matching. You can add your own modules without writing the backtest loop from scratch. Multiple security types share the engine. Your own data or fees can be added as modules.

projects.name: wondertrader
projects.description: WonderTrader——量化研发交易一站式框架
projects.summary: 將量化研發同交易放在一起嘅一站式框架。研究、回測同實盤接口放喺同一套系統，適合想少分拆幾個專案、由策略直接走到交易嘅人。研發同交易介面放喺一齊，少分拆幾個倉庫先接到實盤。
projects.summary_en: A one-stop framework that puts quantitative research and trading together. Research, backtesting, and live-trading interfaces sit in one system, for people who want fewer separate projects and a direct path from a strategy to trading. The research and trading interfaces are kept together, so fewer repositories have to be split apart before you reach live trading.

projects.name: hikyuu
projects.description: An open-source, high-performance quantitative trading framework in C++/Python focused on strategy analysis and backtesting Trading model R&D · Ultra-fast engine · Efficient backtesting
projects.summary: 用 C++ 同 Python 寫嘅高速量化框架，重點係策略分析同回測。指標同系統測試可以跑得比較快，適合要反覆驗證規則、而唔只係畫一張圖嘅人。規則要反覆跑很多次時，C++ 核心會比純 Python 迴圈快。
projects.summary_en: A high-speed quantitative framework written in C++ and Python, focused on strategy analysis and backtesting. Indicators and system tests can run relatively fast, for people who need to verify rules over and over rather than only draw one chart. When a rule has to be run many times, the C++ core is faster than a pure Python loop.

projects.name: freqtrade
projects.description: Free, open source crypto trading bot
projects.summary: 免費開源嘅加密貨幣交易機械人，包含策略、回測同實盤。你用 Python 寫買賣規則，可以先用歷史數據測試，再接到交易所自動落單。策略檔、歷史回測同實盤設定都喺同一套機械人入面。
projects.summary_en: A free and open-source cryptocurrency trading bot, with strategies, backtesting, and live trading. You write buy and sell rules in Python, test them on historical data first, then connect an exchange for automatic orders. Strategy files, historical backtests, and live settings all live in the same bot.

projects.name: ccxt
projects.description: A unified trading API with more than 100 crypto exchanges and prediction markets in JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C# / PHP / Go / Java / Rust
projects.summary: 統一咗一百幾個加密貨幣交易所嘅交易 API，有多種程式語言。同一套方法可以查價同落單，換交易所時少改程式，係很多交易機械人嘅底層。換交易所時多數只改名稱同密鑰，買賣方法可以留低。
projects.summary_en: A trading API that unifies more than a hundred cryptocurrency exchanges, with support for multiple programming languages. The same methods can check prices and place orders, so changing exchanges means changing less code. It is the base layer of many trading bots. When you change exchanges, you usually change only the name and the keys. The buy and sell methods can stay.

projects.name: hummingbot
projects.description: Open source software that helps you create and deploy high-frequency crypto trading bots
projects.summary: 用嚟建立同部署高頻加密貨幣交易機械人嘅開源軟件，常見於做市。可以喺買賣價之間掛單，亦有連接不同交易所同策略嘅框架。做市掛單同庫存控制係常見用法，唔止係單向追漲。庫存偏了一邊時，做市策略要自己調。
projects.summary_en: Open-source software for building and deploying high-frequency cryptocurrency trading bots, commonly used for market making. It can place orders between the bid and the ask, and it has a framework for connecting different exchanges and strategies. Market-making quotes and inventory control are common uses, not only one-way chasing of rising prices. When inventory leans to one side, you have to adjust the market-making strategy yourself.

projects.name: gekko
projects.description: A bitcoin trading bot written in node - https://gekko.wizb.it/
projects.summary: 用 Node.js 寫嘅比特幣交易機械人，帶紙上交易同策略插件。倉庫已封存，新專案未必再更新，但仍然係早期 JavaScript 交易機械人嘅常見例子。已封存，新策略建議睇仍有人維護嘅機械人，呢個留作對照。
projects.summary_en: A Bitcoin trading bot written in Node.js, with paper trading and strategy plugins. The repository is archived and may no longer be updated for new work, but it is still a common example of an early JavaScript trading bot. It is archived. For new strategies, look at bots that are still maintained, and keep this one for comparison.

projects.name: binance-trade-bot
projects.description: Automated cryptocurrency trading bot
projects.summary: 自動化加密貨幣交易機械人，用嚟按策略落單。建立喺交易所接口之上，適合想要一個現成機械人，而唔係只拿 API 庫自己寫全部流程。想少寫交易所細節、直接有一個會落單嘅程式時用。
projects.summary_en: An automated cryptocurrency trading bot that places orders according to a strategy. It is built on top of an exchange interface, for people who want a ready-made bot rather than taking only an API library and writing the whole flow themselves. Use it when you want to write fewer exchange details and have a program that places orders directly.

projects.name: jesse
projects.description: An advanced crypto trading bot written in Python
projects.summary: 用 Python 寫嘅進階加密貨幣交易機械人，強調研究同實盤。策略、回測同優化放喺同一套框架，方便先驗證規則再接到市場。研究階段嘅優化同之後實盤用同一套策略定義。優化完嘅參數可以沿用到實盤設定。
projects.summary_en: An advanced cryptocurrency trading bot written in Python, with an emphasis on research and live trading. Strategies, backtesting, and optimization sit in one framework, so you can verify rules before connecting to the market. Optimization during research and later live trading use the same strategy definition. Optimized parameters can be carried into the live settings.

projects.name: zenbot
projects.description: Zenbot is a command-line cryptocurrency trading bot using Node.js and MongoDB.
projects.summary: 命令列加密貨幣交易機械人，用策略腳本自動買賣。倉庫已封存，維護已經停低，收錄係因為佢曾經係命令列機械人嘅常見起點。已封存而且維護停低，只適合作為命令列機械人嘅舊例子。唔好期待佢再跟上交易所嘅介面改版。
projects.summary_en: A command-line cryptocurrency trading bot that buys and sells automatically from strategy scripts. The repository is archived and maintenance has stopped. It is included because it was once a common starting point for command-line bots. It is archived and no longer maintained, and it is only suitable as an old example of a command-line bot. Do not expect it to keep up with changes to exchange interfaces.

projects.name: tensortrade
projects.description: An open source reinforcement learning framework for training, evaluating, and deploying robust trading agents.
projects.summary: 用強化學習訓練、評估同部署交易 agent 嘅框架。市場被寫成環境，代理喺入面學習行動，適合研究學習型策略，而唔係手寫指標規則。想訓練一個會交易嘅代理，而唔係寫死均線規則。
projects.summary_en: A framework for training, evaluating, and deploying trading agents with reinforcement learning. The market is written as an environment, and the agent learns actions inside it. It suits research on learned strategies rather than hand-written indicator rules. Use it when you want to train an agent that trades, rather than hard-coding moving-average rules.

projects.name: python-binance
projects.description: Binance Exchange API python implementation for automated trading
projects.summary: 幣安交易所 API 嘅 Python 實作，用嚟寫自動交易。行情、帳戶同下單都可以用 Python 呼叫，係接幣安時常用嘅客戶端，而唔係完整策略框架。只解決幣安 API，策略同風控要你自己寫喺上面。
projects.summary_en: A Python implementation of the Binance exchange API, for writing automated trading. Quotes, the account, and order placement can all be called from Python. It is a commonly used client when connecting to Binance, not a complete strategy framework. It only covers the Binance API. Strategy and risk control have to be written on top by you.

projects.name: OctoBot
projects.description: Free open source crypto trading bot to automate AI, Grid, DCA and TradingView strategies on Binance, Hyperliquid and 15+ exchanges, with a simple interface.
projects.summary: 開源加密貨幣交易機械人，支援網格、定投、TradingView 同 AI 策略。有介面可以配置同監察，適合想用現成策略類型，而唔係由零寫交易循環。網格同定投可以先喺介面開，再先考慮自己寫策略。
projects.summary_en: An open-source cryptocurrency trading bot with support for grid trading, dollar-cost averaging, TradingView, and AI strategies. It has an interface for configuration and monitoring, for people who want ready-made strategy types rather than writing the trading loop from scratch. Grid trading and dollar-cost averaging can be turned on in the interface first. Consider writing your own strategy after that.

projects.name: Superalgos
projects.description: Free, open-source crypto trading bot, automated bitcoin / cryptocurrency trading software, algorithmic trading bots. Visually design your crypto trading bot, leveraging an integrated charting system, data-mining, backtesting, paper trading, and multi-server crypto bot deployments.
projects.summary: 用視覺化方式設計加密貨幣交易機械人同策略嘅開源平台。流程同數據可以用圖形連接，適合想設計策略但又不想全部用純程式表達嘅人。策略用圖形表達，適合唔想全程只對住程式檔嘅人。圖形策略改完可以即刻睇數據點樣流過。
projects.summary_en: An open-source platform for designing cryptocurrency trading bots and strategies visually. Flows and data can be connected graphically, for people who want to design a strategy without expressing all of it in pure code. Strategies are expressed as graphs, which suits people who do not want to face only code files the whole time. After a graph strategy is changed, you can immediately see how the data flows through it.

projects.name: Crypto-Signal
projects.description: Github.com/CryptoSignal - Trading & Technical Analysis Bot - 4,100+ stars, 1,100+ forks
projects.summary: 做技術分析同交易訊號嘅加密貨幣機械人。佢按指標發出訊號，可以用來提醒或者接落單，重點係訊號而唔係一整套研究平台。先出訊號再決定點接落單，研究平台唔係佢嘅範圍。訊號出咗先至決定落唔落單。
projects.summary_en: A cryptocurrency bot for technical analysis and trading signals. It emits signals from indicators, which can be used as alerts or connected to order placement. The focus is the signals, not a full research platform. Produce the signal first, then decide how to connect it to orders. A research platform is outside its scope. Only after a signal is out do you decide whether to place an order.

projects.name: StockSharp
projects.description: Algorithmic trading and quantitative trading open source platform to develop trading robots (stock markets, forex, crypto, bitcoins, and options).
projects.summary: 演算法交易平台，可以開發股票、外匯同加密貨幣交易程式。雖然放喺加密分類，同一套工具亦涵蓋傳統市場，適合寫跨資產嘅交易程式。股票同外匯都寫到，所以唔好當佢只服務加密貨幣。傳統市場同加密貨幣可以放喺同一個程式試。
projects.summary_en: An algorithmic trading platform for developing trading programs for stocks, forex, and cryptocurrency. Although it is placed in the crypto category, the same tools also cover traditional markets, which suits writing cross-asset trading programs. Stocks and forex can both be programmed, so do not treat it as serving only cryptocurrency. Traditional markets and cryptocurrency can be tried in the same program.

projects.name: binance-trading-bot
projects.description: Automated Binance trading bot with pluggable strategies, historical backtesting, and a live dashboard
projects.summary: 可插拔策略嘅幣安交易機械人，帶歷史回測同即時看板。策略可以替換，並喺網頁睇運行情況，適合想有介面監察幣安自動交易嘅人。策略可換，網頁看板用來睇佢有冇按預期落單。看板用來核對策略有冇偏離預期。
projects.summary_en: A Binance trading bot with pluggable strategies, historical backtesting, and a live dashboard. Strategies can be swapped, and you can watch the run on a web page, for people who want an interface to monitor automated Binance trading. Strategies are replaceable, and the web dashboard is for seeing whether orders are placed as expected. The dashboard is for checking whether the strategy has drifted from what you expected.

projects.name: hftbacktest
projects.description: Free, open source, a high frequency trading and market making backtesting and trading bot, which accounts for limit orders, queue positions, and latencies, utilizing full tick data for trades and order books(Level-2 and Level-3), with real-world crypto trading examples for Binance and Bybit
projects.summary: 高頻交易同做市回測工具，會計入限價單、排隊位置同延遲。普通日線回測忽略嘅微觀結構，喺度會影響結果，適合測試做市而唔係波段策略。普通 K 線回測睇唔到排隊同延遲，做市就要用呢類工具。
projects.summary_en: A backtesting tool for high-frequency trading and market making. It accounts for limit orders, queue position, and latency. Microstructure that an ordinary daily backtest ignores affects the results here, which suits testing market making rather than swing strategies. An ordinary candlestick backtest cannot see queue position and latency. Market making needs this kind of tool.

projects.name: rotki
projects.description: A portfolio tracking, analytics, accounting and management application that protects your privacy
projects.summary: 注重私隱嘅投資組合追蹤、會計同分析工具，常用於加密資產。數據可以留喺本地，用來整理持倉同稅務相關紀錄，而唔係自動落單嘅交易機械人。用嚟記持倉同會計，自動交易要另揀機械人。
projects.summary_en: A privacy-focused tool for portfolio tracking, accounting, and analysis, commonly used for crypto assets. Data can stay on the local machine, for organizing holdings and tax-related records. It is not a trading bot that places orders automatically. Use it to record holdings and do the accounting. For automated trading, choose a separate bot.

projects.name: Krypto-trading-bot
projects.description: Self-hosted crypto trading bot (automated high frequency market making) written in C++
projects.summary: 用 C++ 寫、可自託管嘅高頻做市交易機械人。重點係速度同自己部署，適合想跑做市、又想程式留喺自己伺服器嘅人。做市迴圈用 C++ 跑，部署同調校都喺你自己嘅機器。延遲敏感嘅做市先會考慮 C++ 呢類實作。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted high-frequency market-making trading bot written in C++. The focus is speed and deploying it yourself, for people who want to run market making and keep the program on their own server. The market-making loop runs in C++, and both deployment and tuning stay on your own machine. Latency-sensitive market making is when this kind of C++ implementation is worth considering.

projects.name: Binance-volatility-trading-bot
projects.description: This is a fully functioning Binance trading bot that measures the volatility of every coin on Binance and places trades with the highest gaining coins If you like this project consider donating though the Brave browser to allow me to continuously improve the script.
projects.summary: 觀察幣安各幣波動，並交易升幅較高幣種嘅機械人。策略圍繞短時間價格波動，而唔係長線持有，適合研究這類動量機械人點樣掃描市場。佢掃描短線波動，長線組合管理唔係呢個機械人嘅目標。
projects.summary_en: A bot that watches volatility across coins on Binance and trades the coins with larger gains. The strategy is built around short-term price moves rather than long-term holding, for studying how this kind of momentum bot scans the market. It scans short-term volatility. Long-term portfolio management is not this bot's goal.

projects.name: gocryptotrader
projects.description: A cryptocurrency trading bot and framework supporting multiple exchanges written in Golang.
projects.summary: 用 Go 寫、支援多個交易所嘅加密貨幣交易框架。行情、訂單同交易所差異由框架處理，適合想用 Go 建交易系統而唔係 Python 機械人嘅人。想用 Go 同時接幾個交易所時，可以由呢個框架起。
projects.summary_en: A cryptocurrency trading framework written in Go, with support for multiple exchanges. Quotes, orders, and differences between exchanges are handled by the framework, for people who want to build a trading system in Go rather than a Python bot. When you want to use Go and connect several exchanges at once, you can start from this framework.

projects.name: cryptofeed
projects.description: Cryptocurrency Exchange Websocket Data Feed Handler
projects.summary: 處理多個交易所 websocket 行情嘅數據源。可以將成交同訂單簿正規化成統一事件，適合自己寫策略時先解決點樣穩定收價。策略之前先把各交易所嘅即時價收成同一種事件。收齊報價之後先至寫自己嘅訊號。
projects.summary_en: A data feed that handles WebSocket market data from multiple exchanges. Trades and order books can be normalized into one kind of event, so when you write your own strategy you first solve how to receive prices reliably. Before the strategy, collect each exchange's live prices into the same kind of event. Write your own signals only after the quotes have been collected.

projects.name: opentrader
projects.description: 🤖 Open-source crypto trading bot | 📈 DCA & GRID strategies | ✨ UI | ⭐ Star to support the project!
projects.summary: 帶介面嘅開源加密貨幣交易機械人，包含定投同網格策略。可以喺圖形介面配置同查看，適合想用常見策略而又希望程式開放嘅人。定投同網格有現成介面，進階規則再先改程式。想先試網格，再先改自己嘅規則。
projects.summary_en: An open-source cryptocurrency trading bot with an interface, including dollar-cost averaging and grid strategies. It can be configured and viewed in a graphical interface, for people who want common strategies and also want the program to be open. Dollar-cost averaging and grid trading have ready-made interfaces. Change the program later for more advanced rules. Try the grid first, and change your own rules after that.

projects.name: tribeca
projects.description: A high frequency, market making cryptocurrency trading platform in node.js
projects.summary: 用 Node.js 寫嘅高頻加密貨幣做市平台。提供做市所需嘅報價同管理介面，係早期 JavaScript 做市系統嘅一個完整例子。早期 Node.js 做市平台，而家多用來參考報價同管理點樣分層。
projects.summary_en: A high-frequency cryptocurrency market-making platform written in Node.js. It provides the quoting and management interface that market making needs, and it is a complete example of an early JavaScript market-making system. As an early Node.js market-making platform, it is now mostly used as a reference for how quoting and management are split into layers.

projects.name: blankly
projects.description: 🚀 💸  Easily build, backtest and deploy your algo in just a few lines of code. Trade stocks, cryptos, and forex across exchanges w/ one package.
projects.summary: 用少量程式碼做回測同部署，同一套程式可以交易股票、加密貨幣同外匯。雖然放喺加密分類，策略介面亦覆蓋其他市場，方便一個寫法接到不同資產。同一策略檔可以換股票、加密或外匯，減少每個市場重寫一次。
projects.summary_en: Backtesting and deployment with a small amount of code. The same program can trade stocks, cryptocurrency, and forex. Although it is placed in the crypto category, the strategy interface also covers other markets, so one way of writing can connect to different assets. The same strategy file can switch among stocks, crypto, and forex, so each market is rewritten less often.

projects.name: passivbot
projects.description: Trading bot running on Bybit, Bitget, OKX, GateIO, Binance, Kucoin, WEEX and Hyperliquid
projects.summary: 喺 Bybit、Bitget、OKX、Gate、幣安等多個交易所運行嘅交易機械人。同一個機械人可以換交易所配置，適合想喺幾個合約交易所重複部署策略嘅人。合約交易所之間換設定就得，唔使每個所各寫一個機械人。
projects.summary_en: A trading bot that runs on multiple exchanges, including Bybit, Bitget, OKX, Gate, and Binance. The same bot can switch its exchange configuration, for people who want to deploy a strategy repeatedly across several futures exchanges. Between futures exchanges, changing the settings is enough. You do not write a separate bot for each venue.

projects.name: pycryptobot
projects.description: Python Crypto Bot (PyCryptoBot)
projects.summary: 用 Python 寫嘅加密貨幣交易機械人。用程式配置策略並自動交易，結構比較直接，適合想閱讀同修改一個完整 Python 機械人嘅人。程式結構短，適合讀完再改成自己嘅進出場規則。
projects.summary_en: A cryptocurrency trading bot written in Python. You configure the strategy in code and it trades automatically. The structure is relatively straightforward, for people who want to read and modify a complete Python bot. The program is short, so you can read it and then change it into your own entry and exit rules.

projects.name: bbgo
projects.description: The modern cryptocurrency trading bot framework written in Go.
projects.summary: 用 Go 寫嘅現代加密貨幣交易機械人框架。策略、交易所同風控可以模組化組合，適合想用 Go 而唔係腳本語言來跑交易服務嘅人。風控同交易所模組拆開，服務可以長期跑而唔係一次性腳本。
projects.summary_en: A modern cryptocurrency trading bot framework written in Go. Strategies, exchanges, and risk control can be combined as modules, for people who want to run a trading service in Go rather than in a scripting language. Risk control and the exchange modules are separated, so the service can keep running rather than acting as a one-off script.

projects.name: crypto-trading-bot
projects.description: Cryptocurrency trading bot in javascript for Bitfinex, Bitmex, Binance, Bybit ... (public edition)
projects.summary: 支援 Bitfinex、BitMEX、幣安、Bybit 等交易所嘅 JavaScript 交易機械人。策略用程式接入多個場所，適合已經用 Node.js、想自己托管機械人嘅人。已經用 Node.js 又要接幾個交易所時，可以沿呢個機械人改。
projects.summary_en: A JavaScript trading bot that supports exchanges such as Bitfinex, BitMEX, Binance, and Bybit. Strategies connect to multiple venues in code, for people who already use Node.js and want to host the bot themselves. If you already use Node.js and need to connect several exchanges, you can adapt this bot.

projects.name: brush
projects.description: 3D Reconstruction for all
projects.summary: 用 Rust 寫嘅三維重建程式，可以由相片或影片訓練 3D Gaussian Splatting。介面偏實用，想喺自己部機由畫面變成可轉視角嘅場景，可以由此入手。
projects.summary_en: A 3D reconstruction program written in Rust that can train 3D Gaussian Splatting from photos or video. The interface leans practical. If you want to turn footage into a scene you can view from other angles on your own machine, you can start here.

projects.name: 4DGaussians
projects.description: [CVPR 2024] 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering
projects.summary: 把靜態三維高斯擴展到動態場景，用變形場隨時間移動高斯，做到即時渲染會郁嘅畫面。適合由一段影片重建可以換視角嘅四維場景。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Extends static 3D Gaussians to dynamic scenes. A deformation field moves the Gaussians over time so that moving images can be rendered in real time. It suits reconstructing a 4D scene from a video, with a viewpoint you can change. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: LichtFeld-Studio
projects.description: Train, inspect, edit, automate, and export 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from a single native application.
projects.summary: 一套原生桌面程式，用嚟訓練、檢查、編輯同匯出 3D Gaussian Splatting 場景。想唔使自己砌研究腳本，就可以喺同一個介面完成由資料到場景。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A native desktop program for training, inspecting, editing, and exporting 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes. If you do not want to assemble research scripts yourself, you can go from data to a scene in the same interface. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: spark
projects.description: :sparkles:  An advanced 3D Gaussian Splatting renderer for THREE.js
projects.summary: 畀 Three.js 用嘅進階 3D Gaussian Splatting 渲染器。網頁同互動場景可以直接載入高斯點雲，喺瀏覽器入面即時睇新視角，而唔使另開研究檢視器。
projects.summary_en: An advanced 3D Gaussian Splatting renderer for Three.js. Web pages and interactive scenes can load Gaussian point clouds directly and view new angles in real time in the browser, without opening a separate research viewer.

projects.name: SuGaR
projects.description: [CVPR 2024] Official PyTorch implementation of SuGaR: Surface-Aligned Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Mesh Reconstruction and High-Quality Mesh Rendering
projects.summary: 把高斯貼住物體表面嚟重建網格，再保留高質素渲染。想由 3D Gaussian Splatting 場景抽出可以用喺傳統流程嘅 mesh，呢個就係對應嘅實作。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Reconstructs a mesh by keeping the Gaussians against the object surface, while still preserving high-quality rendering. If you want to extract a mesh from a 3D Gaussian Splatting scene for a traditional pipeline, this is the matching implementation. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: UnityGaussianSplatting
projects.description: Toy Gaussian Splatting visualization in Unity
projects.summary: 喺 Unity 入面顯示 Gaussian Splatting 嘅實驗專案。遊戲同互動場景可以載入高斯點雲嚟即時渲染，方便試下研究結果點樣放進引擎。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: An experimental project for displaying Gaussian Splatting inside Unity. Games and interactive scenes can load Gaussian point clouds for real-time rendering, which makes it easier to try how research results fit inside an engine. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: 2d-gaussian-splatting
projects.description: [SIGGRAPH'24] 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields
projects.summary: 用二維高斯平面代替三維高斯球，令輻射場嘅幾何更準。渲染仍然即時，同時表面位置更穩，適合之後要抽取網格或者量度場景。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Replaces 3D Gaussian spheres with 2D Gaussian planes so the radiance field's geometry is more accurate. Rendering stays real time, while surface positions are more stable, which suits extracting a mesh or measuring the scene later. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: splat
projects.description: WebGL 3D Gaussian Splat Viewer
projects.summary: 一個輕量 WebGL 檢視器，喺瀏覽器直接打開 3D Gaussian Splat。掃描或訓練好嘅場景可以分享條連結畀人轉視角睇，而唔使安裝桌面程式。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A lightweight WebGL viewer that opens a 3D Gaussian splat directly in the browser. A scanned or trained scene can be shared as a link so other people can look around it, without installing a desktop program. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: GaussianSplats3D
projects.description: Three.js-based implementation of 3D Gaussian splatting
projects.summary: 用 Three.js 實作嘅 3D Gaussian Splatting 檢視器。網頁可以載入常見嘅 splat 檔，做即時新視角渲染，方便嵌進自己嘅三維頁面。
projects.summary_en: A 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer implemented with Three.js. A web page can load common splat files and render new viewpoints in real time, which makes it easy to embed in your own 3D page.

projects.name: 3dgrut
projects.description: Ray tracing and hybrid rasterization of Gaussian particles
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅高斯粒子渲染研究，同時提供光線追蹤同混合光柵化。想比較傳統 splat 光柵同光追喺反射、深度同畫面質素上嘅分別，可以睇呢套程式。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA research on rendering Gaussian particles, providing both ray tracing and hybrid rasterization. If you want to compare traditional splat rasterization with ray tracing on reflections, depth, and image quality, look at this program. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: OpenSplat
projects.description: Production-grade 3D gaussian splatting with CPU/GPU support for Windows, Mac and Linux 💦
projects.summary: 面向實際生產嘅 3D Gaussian Splatting 工具，支援 CPU 同 GPU，可以喺 Windows、Mac 同 Linux 跑。適合由航拍或相片集重建可即時瀏覽嘅場景。
projects.summary_en: A production-oriented 3D Gaussian Splatting tool with CPU and GPU support, able to run on Windows, Mac, and Linux. It suits reconstructing a scene you can browse in real time from aerial photos or a photo set.

projects.name: SplaTAM
projects.description: SplaTAM: Splat, Track & Map 3D Gaussians for Dense RGB-D SLAM (CVPR 2024)
projects.summary: 用 3D Gaussian 做稠密 RGB-D SLAM，邊行邊建圖同追蹤相機。鏡頭郁嘅時候持續更新高斯地圖，適合機械人或者手持相機嘅即時重建。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Dense RGB-D SLAM with 3D Gaussians, building the map and tracking the camera while moving. The Gaussian map keeps updating as the camera moves, which suits real-time reconstruction with a robot or a handheld camera. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: MonoGS
projects.description: [CVPR'24 Highlight & Best Demo Award] Gaussian Splatting SLAM
projects.summary: 只用單一彩色相機做 Gaussian Splatting SLAM，唔使深度鏡頭都可以追蹤同建圖。相機一邊郁，場景一邊用高斯更新，方便實時新視角查看。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Gaussian Splatting SLAM that uses only a single color camera, so tracking and mapping do not need a depth camera. As the camera moves, the scene is updated with Gaussians, which makes real-time novel-view viewing convenient. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: ooosplat
projects.description: A local desktop app that turns videos and images into 3D Gaussian Splats in one click.
projects.summary: 本地桌面程式，用一段影片或一組圖片一鍵變成 3D Gaussian Splat。想少啲自己調研究參數，先快速睇到一個可轉視角嘅場景，可以用佢試。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A local desktop program that turns a video or a set of images into a 3D Gaussian splat in one click. If you want to tune fewer research parameters yourself and quickly see a scene you can view from other angles, you can try it. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: spirula-studio
projects.description: Cross-vendor 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer - video to splat to mesh, Vulkan or CUDA.
projects.summary: 跨顯示卡嘅 3D Gaussian Splatting 訓練器，支援 Vulkan 或 CUDA，可以由影片訓練 splat 再轉成網格。想喺唔同硬件上跑重建，呢套係一個選擇。
projects.summary_en: A cross-GPU 3D Gaussian Splatting trainer that supports Vulkan or CUDA. It can train a splat from video and then convert it to a mesh. If you want to run reconstruction on different hardware, this is one option.

projects.name: gaustudio
projects.description: A Modular Framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting and Beyond
projects.summary: 模組化嘅 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，把資料、訓練同衍生方法拆開。研究新嘅高斯重建時，可以重用現成組件，而唔使每次由空白專案開始。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A modular 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that separates data, training, and derived methods. When you research a new Gaussian reconstruction, you can reuse existing components instead of starting from a blank project each time. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: InstantSplat
projects.description: InstantSplat: Sparse-view SfM-free Gaussian Splatting in Seconds
projects.summary: 唔使先做傳統 SfM，幾秒內就可以由稀疏視角訓練 Gaussian Splatting。相片少嘅時候仍然可以快速得到可渲染場景，適合即時預覽。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Trains Gaussian Splatting from sparse views within a few seconds, without running traditional SfM first. Even when there are few photos, you can quickly get a renderable scene, which suits a real-time preview. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: gsplat.js
projects.description: JavaScript Gaussian Splatting library.
projects.summary: 用 JavaScript 寫嘅 Gaussian Splatting 庫，方便喺網頁端載入同顯示高斯場景。想把研究結果嵌進自己嘅前端，而唔使靠 Python 檢視器，可以用佢。
projects.summary_en: A Gaussian Splatting library written in JavaScript, for loading and displaying Gaussian scenes on the web. If you want to embed research results in your own frontend without relying on a Python viewer, you can use it.

projects.name: splatviz
projects.description: Full python interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer for real-time editing and analyzing.
projects.summary: 用 Python 寫嘅互動 3D Gaussian Splatting 檢視器，可以即時編輯同分析場景。訓練中途或者訓練完，都可以直接喺視窗入面檢查高斯點。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: An interactive 3D Gaussian Splatting viewer written in Python that can edit and analyze a scene in real time. During training or after it finishes, you can inspect the Gaussian points directly in a window. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: LucidDreamer
projects.description: Official code for the paper "LucidDreamer: Domain-free Generation of 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes".
projects.summary: 由文字或圖像生成 3D Gaussian Splatting 場景，而唔使先影一套實景相片。生成之後可以轉視角睇，適合做可遊走嘅想像空間。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Generates 3D Gaussian Splatting scenes from text or images, without first photographing a real scene. After generation you can look from other angles, which suits making an imaginary space you can walk through. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: mip-splatting
projects.description: [CVPR'24 Best Student Paper] Mip-Splatting: Alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting
projects.summary: 處理 Gaussian Splatting 放大縮小時出現嘅鋸齒同走樣。用類似 mipmap 嘅做法，令遠近唔同尺度都保持清楚，係呢個方向嘅代表實作。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Deals with jagged edges and aliasing that appear when a Gaussian Splatting scene is zoomed in or out. It uses an approach similar to mipmaps so that near and far scales stay clear, and it is a representative implementation of this direction. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: hierarchical-3d-gaussians
projects.description: Official implementation of the SIGGRAPH 2024 paper "A Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Rendering of Very Large Datasets"
projects.summary: 用分層三維高斯表示超大場景，做到即時渲染城市級資料。遠景同近景用唔同層級，避免一次載入全部高斯而拖慢畫面。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Represents very large scenes with hierarchical 3D Gaussians so that city-scale data can be rendered in real time. Distant and near views use different levels, which avoids loading every Gaussian at once and slowing the frame. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: GaussianEditor
projects.description: [CVPR 2024] GaussianEditor: Swift and Controllable 3D Editing with Gaussian Splatting
projects.summary: 用文字或者圖像指示，快速編輯已經重建好嘅 Gaussian Splatting 場景。可以改物件外觀同局部內容，而唔使成個場景重新訓練。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Quickly edits an already reconstructed Gaussian Splatting scene from text or image instructions. Object appearance and local content can be changed without retraining the whole scene. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: street_gaussians
projects.description: [ECCV 2024] Street Gaussians: Modeling Dynamic Urban Scenes with Gaussian Splatting
projects.summary: 用 Gaussian Splatting 重建會郁嘅街道同城市，把車同行人等動態物體同靜態背景分開。適合自動駕駛場景嘅新視角同模擬畫面。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Reconstructs moving streets and cities with Gaussian Splatting, separating dynamic objects such as cars and pedestrians from the static background. It suits novel views and simulated images of autonomous-driving scenes. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: splat-transform
projects.description: CLI tool and library for 3D Gaussian splat processing and conversion
projects.summary: 命令列同程式庫，用嚟轉換、壓縮同處理 3D Gaussian Splat 檔。不同工具之間嘅格式可以互轉，方便之後放進網頁或引擎。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A command-line tool and library for converting, compressing, and processing 3D Gaussian splat files. Formats can be converted between different tools, which makes it easier to put them into a web page or an engine later. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: mvsplat
projects.description: 🌊 [ECCV'24 Oral] MVSplat: Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-View Images
projects.summary: 由少量多視角相片直接預測 3D Gaussian，而唔使每個場景慢慢優化。前饋式重建速度快，適合要一次處理好多組相片嘅情況。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Directly predicts 3D Gaussians from a small number of multi-view photos, without slowly optimizing each scene. Feed-forward reconstruction is fast, which suits processing many sets of photos at once. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: Scaffold-GS
projects.description: [CVPR 2024 Highlight] Scaffold-GS: Structured 3D Gaussians for View-Adaptive Rendering
projects.summary: 用錨點同視角自適應嘅結構嚟組織三維高斯，令渲染更穩、更慳記憶體。大型場景可以按觀看方向調整高斯，而唔使全部一視同仁。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Organizes 3D Gaussians with anchors and a view-adaptive structure so rendering is more stable and uses less memory. A large scene can adjust its Gaussians to the viewing direction instead of treating all of them the same. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: pixelsplat
projects.description: [CVPR 2024 Oral, Best Paper Runner-Up] Code for "pixelSplat: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction" by David Charatan, Sizhe Lester Li, Andrea Tagliasacchi, and Vincent Sitzmann
projects.summary: 由一對圖片前饋生成 3D Gaussian Splat，用嚟做可泛化嘅新視角重建。模型見過唔同場景之後，新嘅相片對都可以快速出場景。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Generates a 3D Gaussian splat from a pair of images in a feed-forward pass, for generalizable novel-view reconstruction. After the model has seen different scenes, a new pair of photos can produce a scene quickly. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: CityGaussian
projects.description: [ECCV`24&ICLR`25] CityGaussian Series for High-quality Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction with Gaussians
projects.summary: 面向城市級大場景嘅 Gaussian Splatting 系列，強調高質素同可以擴展嘅重建。大範圍街景可以分成區塊處理，再合成可即時瀏覽嘅結果。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A Gaussian Splatting series aimed at city-scale scenes, with an emphasis on high-quality reconstruction that can scale. A wide street area can be processed in blocks and then combined into a result you can browse in real time. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: depthsplat
projects.description: [CVPR'25] DepthSplat: Connecting Gaussian Splatting and Depth
projects.summary: 把深度估計同 Gaussian Splatting 接埋，用深度引導高斯點放喺邊。稀疏視角重建時幾何更穩，適合相片之間重疊唔多嘅情況。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: Joins depth estimation with Gaussian Splatting and uses depth to guide where the Gaussian points are placed. Geometry is more stable in sparse-view reconstruction, which suits photos that do not overlap much. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, so you can move to angles that were never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: gaussian-splatting-lightning
projects.description: A 3D Gaussian Splatting framework with various derived algorithms and an interactive web viewer
projects.summary: 用 PyTorch Lightning 整理嘅 3D Gaussian Splatting 框架，收錄多種衍生算法，並附互動網頁檢視器。想喺同一套程式比較唔同高斯方法，可以用佢。
projects.summary_en: A 3D Gaussian Splatting framework organized with PyTorch Lightning. It includes several derivative algorithms and an interactive web viewer. Use it when you want to compare different Gaussian methods in the same codebase.

projects.name: LangSplat
projects.description: Official implementation of the paper "LangSplat: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting" [CVPR2024 Highlight]
projects.summary: 喺三維高斯上面附帶語言特徵，令你可以用語句喺場景入面搵物件。重建完唔單止可以轉視角，仲可以按文字定位到對應嘅高斯區域。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It attaches language features to 3D Gaussians so you can find objects in a scene with a sentence. After reconstruction you can change the viewpoint and also locate the matching Gaussian region from text. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: 4d-gaussian-splatting
projects.description: [ICLR 2024] Real-time Photorealistic Dynamic Scene Representation and Rendering with 4D Gaussian Splatting
projects.summary: 用四維高斯同時表示空間同時間，即時渲染會郁嘅場景。同用變形場嘅做法唔同，動態直接寫喺高斯本身，適合光真實嘅影片新視角。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It uses 4D Gaussians to represent space and time together and renders moving scenes in real time. Unlike methods that use a deformation field, the motion is written directly on the Gaussians themselves, which suits photorealistic novel views of video. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: gaussian-opacity-fields
projects.description: [SIGGRAPH Asia'24 & TOG] Gaussian Opacity Fields: Efficient Adaptive Surface Reconstruction in Unbounded Scenes
projects.summary: 由三維高斯建立不透明度場，喺無邊界場景入面做自適應表面重建。渲染同抽表面可以一齊用，適合要網格又要新視角嘅資料。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It builds an opacity field from 3D Gaussians and does adaptive surface reconstruction in unbounded scenes. Rendering and surface extraction can be used together, which suits data that needs both a mesh and novel views. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: SegAnyGAussians
projects.description: The official implementation of Segment Any 3D GAussians (AAAI-25)
projects.summary: 喺 3D Gaussian 場景入面做分割，可以用提示拎出個別物件。重建完嘅場景可以按物件拆開編輯或刪除，而唔使成幅畫面一齊處理。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It segments a 3D Gaussian scene so prompts can pull out individual objects. A reconstructed scene can be edited or deleted object by object, without processing the whole frame together. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: NoPoSplat
projects.description: [ICLR'25 Oral] No Pose, No Problem: Surprisingly Simple 3D Gaussian Splats from Sparse Unposed Images
projects.summary: 相片未有相機姿態都可以預測 3D Gaussian。稀疏、未對齊嘅圖片直接出場景，省卻先做位姿估計呢一步，適合隨便影低嘅相片集。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It predicts 3D Gaussians even when the photos have no camera poses. Sparse, unaligned images produce a scene directly, skipping pose estimation, which suits casually captured photo sets. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: AnySplat
projects.description: [SIGGRAPH Asia 2025 (ACM TOG)] AnySplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Views
projects.summary: 由隨意視角嘅圖片前饋生成 3D Gaussian Splatting，唔使逐個場景長時間優化。相機唔受控嘅相片都可以快速變成可渲染場景。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It feed-forward generates 3D Gaussian Splatting from images at arbitrary viewpoints, without a long optimization for each scene. Photos from uncontrolled cameras can quickly become a renderable scene. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: mesh2splat
projects.description: Fast mesh to 3D gaussian splat conversion
projects.summary: 把現有三角網格快速轉成 3D Gaussian Splat。已經有模型嘅遊戲或影片資產，可以變成高斯表示嚟做即時渲染，而唔使重新掃描。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It quickly converts an existing triangle mesh into a 3D Gaussian splat. Game or film assets that already have a model can become a Gaussian representation for real-time rendering, without scanning them again. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: spz
projects.description: File format for 3D Gaussian splats. About 10x smaller than the PLY equivalent with virtually no perceptible loss in visual quality. Offered as open source by Niantic Labs. More details at https://scaniverse.com/spz #3dgaussiansplats #gaussiansplatting
projects.summary: Niantic 提出嘅 3D Gaussian Splat 壓縮格式，體積大約係 PLY 嘅十分之一，畫面損失好細。適合把場景放上網頁或者流動裝置傳輸。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: A 3D Gaussian splat compression format from Niantic. The file size is about one tenth of PLY, with very little visual loss. It suits putting a scene on the web or sending it to a mobile device. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: Octree-GS
projects.description: [TPAMI 2025] Octree-GS: Towards Consistent Real-time Rendering with LOD-Structured 3D Gaussians
projects.summary: 用八叉樹同 LOD 組織三維高斯，令大場景可以按距離切換細節，做到較穩定嘅即時渲染。遠景用粗層，近景先載入細高斯。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It organizes 3D Gaussians with an octree and LOD so a large scene can switch detail by distance and render in real time more steadily. Distant views use a coarse level, and fine Gaussians are loaded only for close views. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: GaussianPro
projects.description: [ICML2024] Official code for GaussianPro: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Progressive Propagation
projects.summary: 用漸進式傳播改善 3D Gaussian Splatting 嘅幾何同覆蓋。訓練時逐步補齊表面，減少空洞同漂浮點，令重建更完整。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It uses progressive propagation to improve the geometry and coverage of 3D Gaussian Splatting. During training it fills in the surface step by step, reducing holes and floaters so the reconstruction is more complete. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: LightGaussian
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight]"LightGaussian: Unbounded 3D Gaussian Compression with 15x Reduction and 200+ FPS", Zhiwen Fan, Kevin Wang, Kairun Wen, Zehao Zhu, Dejia Xu, Zhangyang Wang
projects.summary: 壓縮無邊界 3D Gaussian 場景，目標係大幅減少高斯數量同儲存，同時保持超過二百幀嘅渲染。適合要把大場景放到即時應用。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It compresses unbounded 3D Gaussian scenes, aiming to greatly cut the number of Gaussians and the storage while keeping rendering above 200 frames per second. It suits placing a large scene in a real-time application. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: diff-gaussian-rasterization
projects.description: 官方 3D Gaussian Splatting 用嘅可微光柵化核心，用 CUDA 把高斯投影到畫面並反向傳播。自己寫訓練程式時，通常會直接呼叫呢個渲染器。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary: 官方 3D Gaussian Splatting 用嘅可微光柵化核心，用 CUDA 把高斯投影到畫面並反向傳播。自己寫訓練程式時，通常會直接呼叫呢個渲染器。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: The differentiable rasterization core used by official 3D Gaussian Splatting. It uses CUDA to project Gaussians onto the image and backpropagate. When you write your own training code, you usually call this renderer directly. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: Dynamic3DGaussians
projects.description: 用動態三維高斯追蹤會郁嘅場景，同時保留新視角渲染。物體隨時間移動時，高斯可以跟住佢，適合多相機嘅動態捕捉。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary: 用動態三維高斯追蹤會郁嘅場景，同時保留新視角渲染。物體隨時間移動時，高斯可以跟住佢，適合多相機嘅動態捕捉。場景用高斯即時渲染，可以轉去未影過嘅角度，而唔使先重建成傳統網格。
projects.summary_en: It tracks moving scenes with dynamic 3D Gaussians while keeping novel-view rendering. As objects move over time, the Gaussians follow them, which suits multi-camera dynamic capture. The scene is rendered in real time with Gaussians, and you can move to a viewpoint that was never photographed without first reconstructing a traditional mesh.

projects.name: cosmos
projects.description: NVIDIA Cosmos is an open platform of world models, datasets, and tools that enables developers to build Physical AI for robots, autonomous vehicles, smart infrastructure, and more.
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅世界模型平台，提供模型、數據同工具，用嚟做機械人、自動駕駛同實體智能。可以生成同模擬之後會發生嘅畫面，再訓練下游策略。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's world model platform provides models, data, and tools for robotics, autonomous driving, and physical AI. It can generate and simulate what happens next, then train downstream policies. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: LWM
projects.description: Large World Model -- Modeling Text and Video with Millions Context
projects.summary: 用超長上下文同時建模文字同影片嘅大型世界模型。模型可以讀好長嘅影像序列，再預測後續內容，係影片世界模型呢條線嘅代表程式。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A large world model that jointly models text and video with a very long context. The model can read a very long video sequence and then predict what follows, and it is a representative codebase on the video world-model line. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: lingbot-world
projects.description: Advancing Open-source World Models
projects.summary: 開源世界模型項目，用嚟生成同延續可互動嘅視覺世界。畀定目前畫面同動作之後，模型預測接下來嘅觀察，方便研究具身同影片模擬。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: An open-source world model project for generating and continuing an interactive visual world. Given the current frame and an action, the model predicts the next observation, which helps research on embodied and video simulation. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: dreamerv3
projects.description: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
projects.summary: DreamerV3 嘅官方實作，用世界模型喺唔同領域學習控制。智能體喺想像出嚟嘅環境入面練習，再放回真實或模擬任務，涵蓋遊戲同控制。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.paper_title: Mastering Diverse Domains through World Models
projects.summary_en: The official implementation of DreamerV3, which learns control across domains with a world model. The agent practices inside an imagined environment, then is placed back into real or simulated tasks, covering games and control. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: kairos
projects.description: Official code for world model Kairos
projects.summary: 機械人方向嘅世界模型 Kairos 官方程式。模型學習環境點樣隨動作改變，用嚟預測未來觀察同支援操作，而唔使每次都喺真機上試錯。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: The official code for Kairos, a world model aimed at robotics. The model learns how the environment changes with actions, to predict future observations and support manipulation, without trial and error on the real robot every time. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: HunyuanWorld-1.0
projects.description: Generating Immersive, Explorable, and Interactive 3D Worlds from Words or Pixels with Hunyuan3D World Model
projects.summary: 由文字或圖片生成可以漫遊、探索同互動嘅三維世界。場景唔止一張靜態圖，可以行入去睇，係混元三維世界模型嘅第一個公開版本。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: It generates 3D worlds you can roam, explore, and interact with from text or an image. The scene is more than a static picture: you can walk in and look around, and this is the first public version of the Hunyuan 3D world model. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: LongLive
projects.description: Long Video Gen / World Model / World Action Model (Embodied) Infrastructure
projects.summary: 面向長影片、世界模型同帶動作嘅具身生成嘅基建。用嚟研究模型點樣維持長時間一致嘅世界，並按動作繼續演下去，而唔使每段片重新開始。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: Infrastructure for long video, world models, and action-conditioned embodied generation. It is for studying how a model keeps a world consistent over a long time and continues it according to actions, without restarting every clip. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: lyra
projects.description: Project Lyra: Open Generative 3D World Models
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅生成式三維世界模型 Lyra，可以由條件生成可探索嘅立體場景。重點係世界本身可以漫遊，而唔止輸出一段平面影片。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: Lyra, NVIDIA's generative 3D world model, can generate explorable volumetric scenes from a conditioning input. The point is that the world itself can be walked through, rather than only outputting a flat video. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: HY-World-2.0
projects.description: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds
projects.summary: 混元嘅多模態世界模型，可以重建、生成同模擬三維世界。輸入文字或圖像之後，模型維持場景幾何同外觀，用嚟做可互動嘅環境。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: Hunyuan's multimodal world model can reconstruct, generate, and simulate 3D worlds. Given text or an image, the model keeps the scene geometry and appearance for an interactive environment. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: stable-worldmodel
projects.description: A platform for reproducible world model research and evaluation
projects.summary: 用嚟重複實驗同評估世界模型嘅平台。唔同模型可以喺同一套任務、數據同指標下比較，方便知道預測未來狀態嘅能力係咪真係進步。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A platform for repeating experiments and evaluating world models. Different models can be compared on the same tasks, data, and metrics, so you can tell whether the ability to predict future states has actually improved. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: diamond
projects.description: DIAMOND (DIffusion As a Model Of eNvironment Dreams) is a reinforcement learning agent trained in a diffusion world model. NeurIPS 2024 Spotlight.
projects.summary: 喺擴散世界模型入面訓練嘅強化學習智能體。環境嘅下一步畫面由擴散模型想像出嚟，智能體喺呢個夢境入面學習，再回到遊戲任務。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A reinforcement learning agent trained inside a diffusion world model. The next frame of the environment is imagined by the diffusion model, the agent learns inside that dream, and then returns to the game task. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: lingbot-va
