projects.description: [RSS 2026] Causal video-action world model for generalist robot control
projects.summary: 因果嘅影片加動作世界模型，用嚟做通用機械人控制。模型按目前畫面同動作預測之後嘅觀察，令策略可以喺想像嘅世界入面計劃。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A causal video-and-action world model for general robot control. The model predicts later observations from the current frame and the action, so a policy can plan inside an imagined world. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: boundless-world-model
projects.description: High-fidelity world models for general embodied intelligence, such as data engines and world  simulators.
projects.summary: 面向通用具身智能嘅高保真世界模型，可以當數據引擎同世界模擬器。用嚟大量生成機械人會遇到嘅未來畫面，減少只靠真實採集。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A high-fidelity world model for general embodied intelligence that can serve as a data engine and a world simulator. It generates, at scale, future frames a robot will encounter, reducing reliance on real-world collection alone. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: HY-WorldPlay
projects.description: HY-World 1.5: A Systematic Framework for Interactive World Modeling with Real-Time Latency and Geometric Consistency
projects.summary: 混元嘅互動世界建模框架，強調即時延遲同幾何一致。玩家或智能體郁動時，畫面要快，而且場景結構唔好前後矛盾。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: Hunyuan's interactive world-modeling framework, with an emphasis on real-time latency and geometric consistency. When a player or an agent moves, the image has to be fast, and the scene structure should not contradict itself over time. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: giga-world-0
projects.description: GigaWorld-0: World Models as Data Engine to Empower Embodied AI
projects.summary: 把世界模型當成具身智能嘅數據引擎。模型生成機械人訓練用嘅未來場景同互動數據，用嚟補真實採集唔夠嘅情況。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: It treats a world model as a data engine for embodied intelligence. The model generates future scenes and interaction data for robot training, to fill in where real collection is not enough. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: HunyuanWorld-Voyager
projects.description: Voyager is an interactive RGBD video generation model conditioned on camera input, and supports real-time 3D reconstruction.
projects.summary: 按相機運動生成互動式 RGBD 影片，並支援即時三維重建。你移動視角，模型就延續深度同畫面，方便做成可探索嘅場景。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: It generates interactive RGB-D video from camera motion and supports real-time 3D reconstruction. When you move the viewpoint, the model continues the depth and the image, which makes it easy to turn into an explorable scene. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: tinyworlds
projects.description: A minimal implementation of DeepMind's Genie world model
projects.summary: DeepMind Genie 世界模型嘅精簡實作。用少量程式示範點樣由影片學一個可以按動作推進嘅互動世界，適合想讀懂呢類模型嘅人。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A compact implementation of the DeepMind Genie world model. With a small amount of code it shows how to learn, from video, an interactive world that advances according to actions, for people who want to understand this kind of model. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: Motus
projects.description: Official code of Motus: A Unified Latent Action World Model
projects.summary: 統一潛在動作嘅世界模型，把動作同未來觀察放喺同一個潛在空間。機械人控制同視覺預測可以一齊訓練，而唔使分開兩套系統。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A world model with unified latent actions that places actions and future observations in the same latent space. Robot control and visual prediction can be trained together, without two separate systems. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: DreamDojo
projects.description: Official Codebase for "DreamDojo: A Generalist Robot World Model from Large-Scale Human Videos" (ICML 2026)
projects.summary: 由大規模人類影片訓練嘅通用機械人世界模型。模型學人點樣同環境互動，再預測機械人動作之後嘅畫面，用嚟做跨任務嘅模擬。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A general robot world model trained on large-scale human video. The model learns how people interact with the environment, then predicts the frames that follow a robot action, for simulation across tasks. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: dreamerv2
projects.description: Mastering Atari with Discrete World Models
projects.summary: DreamerV2，用離散世界模型玩 Atari。智能體喺模型想像嘅未來入面規劃，而唔使每一步都真係同遊戲互動，係後來 DreamerV3 嘅前作。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: DreamerV2 plays Atari with a discrete world model. The agent plans inside futures imagined by the model, without truly interacting with the game at every step, and it is the predecessor of the later DreamerV3. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: tdmpc2
projects.description: Code for "TD-MPC2: Scalable, Robust World Models for Continuous Control"
projects.summary: 用可擴展嘅世界模型做連續控制。TD-MPC2 喺潛在空間預測狀態同回報，再規劃動作，適合機械臂呢類連續動作任務。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: Continuous control with a scalable world model. TD-MPC2 predicts state and reward in latent space, then plans actions, which suits continuous-action tasks such as a robot arm. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: Vista
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2024] A Generalizable World Model for Autonomous Driving
projects.summary: 面向自動駕駛、可以泛化嘅世界模型。畀定目前行車畫面同未來動作，模型預測之後嘅路況，用嚟模擬駕駛而唔使每次都出真車。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A generalizable world model for autonomous driving. Given the current driving view and future actions, the model predicts the road conditions that follow, for driving simulation without taking a real car out every time. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: iris
projects.description: Transformers are Sample-Efficient World Models. ICLR 2023, notable top 5%.
projects.summary: 用 Transformer 做樣本效率高嘅世界模型。智能體喺模型入面想像未來，再用少量真實互動學會遊戲控制，係 ICLR 2023 嘅代表實作。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A sample-efficient world model built with a Transformer. The agent imagines the future inside the model and learns game control from a small amount of real interaction, and it is a representative implementation from ICLR 2023. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: minWM
projects.description: A Minimal and Elegant Framework & Tutorial for Real-Time Interactive World Models
projects.summary: 即時互動世界模型嘅精簡框架同教學程式。重點係結構清楚，可以睇到模型點樣按動作即時更新畫面，方便自己改同試驗。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A compact framework and tutorial codebase for a real-time interactive world model. The emphasis is a clear structure, so you can see how the model updates the image in real time from an action and can change it and experiment yourself. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: Matrix-3D
projects.description: Generate large-scale explorable 3D scenes with high-quality panorama videos from a single image or text prompt.
projects.summary: 由一張圖或一段文字生成可探索嘅大型三維場景，並配高質素全景影片。重點係可以行入場景，而唔止得到一個孤立物件。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: It generates a large explorable 3D scene from one image or a passage of text, together with high-quality panoramic video. The point is that you can walk into the scene, rather than only getting an isolated object. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: AlayaWorld
projects.description: Full-stack open-source interactive long-horizon world model.
projects.summary: 全端開源嘅長時程互動世界模型。場景要維持好耐都一致，並按使用者動作繼續演化，適合研究長篇互動而唔係短片生成。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A full-stack open-source long-horizon interactive world model. The scene has to stay consistent for a long time and keep evolving with the user's actions, which suits research on long interactive sessions rather than short-clip generation. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: DreamX-World
projects.description: DreamX-World: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model
projects.summary: 通用互動世界模型，用嚟按動作預測之後嘅環境。可以當研究基線，試下模型喺唔同互動任務入面點樣保持畫面同物理合理。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A general interactive world model that predicts the later environment from actions. It can serve as a research baseline for seeing how a model keeps the image and the physics plausible across different interactive tasks. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: WorldModelsExperiments
projects.description: World Models Experiments
projects.summary: Ha 同 Schmidhuber 2018 世界模型論文嘅實驗程式。用視覺編碼、記憶模型同小控制器喺遊戲入面示範，係呢個方向經常被引用嘅起點。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: Experimental code for the 2018 world models paper by Ha and Schmidhuber. It demonstrates a visual encoder, a memory model, and a small controller inside a game, and it is a frequently cited starting point for this direction. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: world-models
projects.description: Reimplementation of World-Models (Ha and Schmidhuber 2018) in pytorch
projects.summary: 用 PyTorch 重寫 2018 年 World Models。程式把視覺模型、時序模型同控制器拆開，方便對照論文，理解點樣喺想像環境入面學習控制。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A PyTorch rewrite of the 2018 World Models. The code separates the vision model, the temporal model, and the controller, so you can follow the paper and see how control is learned inside an imagined environment. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: genesis-world
projects.description: Simulation platform for general-purpose robotics & embodied AI learning.
projects.summary: 通用機械人同具身智能嘅物理模擬平台，可以生成可互動嘅世界嚟訓練同測試策略。場景有物理，而唔止係影片預測，適合當世界模擬器。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A physics simulation platform for general robots and embodied intelligence that can generate interactive worlds for training and testing policies. The scenes have physics, rather than only video prediction, so it suits use as a world simulator. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: opendw
projects.description: An Open-Source World Model for Action-Conditioned Embodied Intelligence.
projects.summary: 開源嘅動作條件世界模型，面向具身智能。畀定動作之後預測環境點變，用嚟做數據生成同策略研究，而唔使每次都靠真實機械人。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: An open-source action-conditioned world model for embodied intelligence. Given an action, it predicts how the environment changes, for data generation and policy research, without relying on a real robot every time. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: nano-world-model
projects.description: A Minimalist, Batteries-included Repository for Advancing World Model Science.
projects.summary: 盡量細、但組件齊全嘅世界模型研究庫。用嚟試新想法同時保持程式可讀，適合想改模型本身，而唔係只呼叫一個大型黑盒。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: A world-model research library that stays as small as possible while keeping a full set of components. It is for trying new ideas while keeping the code readable, for people who want to change the model itself rather than only calling a large black box. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: WorldGen
projects.description: 🌍 WorldGen - Generate Any 3D Scene in Seconds
projects.summary: 由描述快速生成任意三維場景。幾秒內可以得到一個可睇嘅立體空間，適合做世界草稿，再交畀其他工具繼續渲染或編輯。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: It quickly generates an arbitrary 3D scene from a description. Within a few seconds you can get a viewable volumetric space, suitable as a world draft to hand to other tools for further rendering or editing. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: Hunyuan3D-WorldClaw
projects.description: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-world Generation at Scale
projects.summary: 用智能體流程大規模生成三維開放世界。系統可以分步規劃場景、物件同佈局，而唔係只輸出單一模型，適合做可遊走嘅地圖。重點係預測環境之後會點變，用嚟模擬、規劃，或者生成一個可互動嘅世界。
projects.summary_en: It generates 3D open worlds at scale with an agent workflow. The system can plan the scene, objects, and layout step by step, instead of outputting only a single model, which suits walkable maps. The focus is predicting how the environment will change next, for simulation, planning, or generating an interactive world.

projects.name: Hunyuan3D-2
projects.description: High-Resolution 3D Assets Generation with Large Scale Hunyuan3D Diffusion Models.
projects.summary: 混元三維大模型嘅第二代，用大規模擴散模型由圖像生成高解像三維資產。單張圖可以出帶結構嘅模型，係而家公開圖像轉三維入面星數最高嘅一批。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: The second generation of the Hunyuan 3D foundation model uses a large-scale diffusion model to generate high-resolution 3D assets from images. A single image can produce a structured model, and it is among the most-starred public image-to-3D projects today. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: vggt
projects.description: [CVPR 2025 Best Paper Award] VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
projects.summary: 視覺幾何 Transformer，由圖片直接估計相機、深度同三維點。多張相片唔使傳統逐步配對，都可以一次過重建場景幾何，係 CVPR 2025 最佳論文。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: A visual geometry Transformer that estimates cameras, depth, and 3D points directly from images. Multiple photos can reconstruct scene geometry in one pass without traditional step-by-step matching, and it is a CVPR 2025 Best Paper. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: TRELLIS
projects.description: Official repo for paper "Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation" (CVPR'25 Spotlight).
projects.summary: 用結構化三維潛在空間做可擴展嘅三維生成，可以由圖像或文字得到模型。潛在表示同時照顧形狀同外觀，係 CVPR 2025 嘅代表程式。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.paper_title: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation
projects.summary_en: Scalable 3D generation with a structured 3D latent space, producing a model from an image or text. The latent representation covers both shape and appearance, and it is a representative codebase from CVPR 2025. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: TRELLIS.2
projects.description: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation
projects.summary: TRELLIS 嘅下一代，用更原生同更緊湊嘅結構化潛在空間做三維生成。同樣面向由圖像或文字得到高質素資產，而且表示更慳。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: The next generation of TRELLIS, using a more native and more compact structured latent space for 3D generation. It is likewise aimed at high-quality assets from images or text, and the representation takes less space. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: shap-e
projects.description: Generate 3D objects conditioned on text or images
projects.summary: OpenAI 嘅三維生成模型，可以按文字或圖片產生三維物件。輸出係隱式表示，再轉成網格，適合快速由概念得到一個可旋轉嘅模型。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: OpenAI's 3D generation model, which can produce 3D objects from text or an image. The output is an implicit representation that is then converted to a mesh, suited to quickly getting a rotatable model from a concept. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: stable-dreamfusion
projects.description: Text-to-3D & Image-to-3D & Mesh Exportation with NeRF + Diffusion.
projects.summary: 用擴散模型引導 NeRF，做文字轉三維同圖像轉三維，並可以匯出網格。一個場景優化一段時間之後，就可以由新角度睇生成嘅物件。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It guides a NeRF with a diffusion model for text-to-3D and image-to-3D, and it can export a mesh. After a scene is optimized for a while, you can view the generated object from new angles. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: dust3r
projects.description: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy
projects.summary: 由一對圖片直接預測三維點圖，令幾何視覺少咗傳統逐步重建。相片之間嘅形狀同相機關係可以一次估計，係後來好多多視角方法嘅基礎。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It predicts a 3D point map directly from a pair of images, so geometric vision does less traditional step-by-step reconstruction. Shape and camera relationships between photos can be estimated in one pass, and it is the basis of many later multi-view methods. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: TripoSR
projects.description: TripoSR: Fast 3D Object Reconstruction from a Single Image
projects.summary: 由單張圖片快速重建三維物件嘅大型重建模型。前饋推論，唔使每個物件優化幾十分鐘，適合要即時由產品圖或概念圖出模型。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.paper_title: TripoSR: Fast 3D Object Reconstruction from a Single Image
projects.summary_en: A large reconstruction model that quickly rebuilds a 3D object from a single image. Inference is feed-forward, so you do not optimize each object for tens of minutes, which suits turning a product photo or concept image into a model right away. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: threestudio
projects.description: A unified framework for 3D content generation.
projects.summary: 統一嘅三維內容生成框架，把多種文字轉三維同圖像轉三維方法放喺同一套訓練程式。想比較 DreamFusion 一類算法，可以喺度換模組。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: A unified 3D content generation framework that puts several text-to-3D and image-to-3D methods in the same training code. If you want to compare DreamFusion-style algorithms, you can swap modules here. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: point-e
projects.description: Point cloud diffusion for 3D model synthesis
projects.summary: 用擴散模型生成三維點雲，可以再轉成網格。條件可以係文字或圖像，速度快過由零優化一個 NeRF，適合做三維草稿。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It generates 3D point clouds with a diffusion model, which can then be converted to a mesh. The condition can be text or an image, and it is faster than optimizing a NeRF from scratch, which suits a 3D draft. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: Wonder3D
projects.description: Single Image to 3D using Cross-Domain Diffusion for 3D Generation
projects.summary: 由單張圖生成多視角一致嘅法線同色彩，再重建三維。跨域擴散令背面同側面唔會各自矛盾，適合物件級圖像轉三維。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: From a single image it generates multi-view-consistent normals and color, then reconstructs 3D. Cross-domain diffusion keeps the back and the sides from contradicting each other, which suits object-level image-to-3D. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: vggt-omega
projects.description: [CVPR 2026 Oral] VGGT Omega
projects.summary: VGGT 嘅後續模型，繼續用 Transformer 由圖像做前饋三維幾何。重點係更強嘅視覺幾何估計，用喺多圖重建同場景理解。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: A follow-on model to VGGT that continues to do feed-forward 3D geometry from images with a Transformer. The emphasis is stronger visual geometry estimation, for multi-image reconstruction and scene understanding. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: InstantMesh
projects.description: InstantMesh: Efficient 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image with Sparse-view Large Reconstruction Models
projects.summary: 用稀疏視角大型重建模型，由單張圖高效生成三維網格。先想像其他角度，再一次重建，速度快過逐個形狀長時間優化。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: A sparse-view large reconstruction model that efficiently generates a 3D mesh from a single image. It first imagines other angles, then reconstructs in one pass, which is faster than optimizing each shape for a long time. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: dreamgaussian
projects.description: [ICLR 2024 Oral] Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation
projects.summary: 用生成式 Gaussian Splatting 做三維內容，可以由圖像或文字快速得到物件，再抽出網格。優化時間短，適合要效率嘅三維生成。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.paper_title: DreamGaussian: Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation
projects.summary_en: It makes 3D content with generative Gaussian Splatting, quickly producing an object from an image or text and then extracting a mesh. Optimization time is short, which suits 3D generation that needs to be efficient. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: Hunyuan3D-2.1
projects.description: From Images to High-Fidelity 3D Assets with Production-Ready PBR Material
projects.summary: 混元三維 2.1，由圖像生成高保真三維資產，並帶可用於製作嘅 PBR 材質。除咗形狀，材質都可以直接交畀渲染或遊戲流程。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: Hunyuan3D 2.1 generates high-fidelity 3D assets from images, with production-ready PBR materials. Besides the shape, the materials can be handed directly to a rendering or game pipeline. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: map-anything
projects.description: MapAnything: Universal Feed-Forward Metric 3D Reconstruction
projects.summary: 通用前饋度量三維重建，由圖像估計帶真實尺度嘅幾何同相機。唔同場景可以共用一個模型，而唔使每個場景重新優化。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: General feed-forward metric 3D reconstruction that estimates real-scale geometry and cameras from images. Different scenes can share one model, without re-optimizing each scene. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: Unique3D
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2024] Unique3D: High-Quality and Efficient 3D Mesh Generation from a Single Image
projects.summary: 由單張圖高效生成高質素三維網格。模型同時照顧多視角一致性同表面細節，適合要一個可以立刻打開嘅物件，而唔係只有點雲。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It efficiently generates a high-quality 3D mesh from a single image. The model looks after both multi-view consistency and surface detail, which suits needing an object you can open immediately rather than only a point cloud. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: Hunyuan3D-1
projects.description: Tencent Hunyuan3D-1.0: A Unified Framework for Text-to-3D and Image-to-3D Generation
projects.summary: 混元三維第一代，把文字轉三維同圖像轉三維放喺同一個框架。可以由描述或參考圖生成資產，係後代 Hunyuan3D 系列嘅起點。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: The first generation of Hunyuan3D puts text-to-3D and image-to-3D in the same framework. It can generate assets from a description or a reference image, and it is the starting point of the later Hunyuan3D series. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: mast3r
projects.description: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R
projects.summary: 喺 DUSt3R 之上做三維圖像匹配，令對應點有幾何根據。多張圖對齊同重建會更穩，適合相片集要準確拼成一個場景。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It does 3D image matching on top of DUSt3R, so corresponding points have a geometric basis. Aligning and reconstructing multiple images is more stable, which suits photo sets that need to be assembled accurately into one scene. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: zero123
projects.description: Zero-1-to-3: Zero-shot One Image to 3D Object (ICCV 2023)
projects.summary: 由一張圖零樣本想像物件喺新視角嘅樣。新角度圖像可以再交畀重建程式，變成三維，係單圖轉三維經常被引用嘅擴散模型。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: From one image it zero-shot imagines how an object looks from a new viewpoint. The new-view images can then be passed to a reconstruction program and turned into 3D, and it is a frequently cited diffusion model for single-image-to-3D. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: DreamCraft3D
projects.description: [ICLR 2024] Official implementation of DreamCraft3D: Hierarchical 3D Generation with Bootstrapped Diffusion Prior
projects.summary: 分層生成三維：先用擴散先驗定大形，再提高質素同細節。可以由文字或圖像得到較完整嘅物件，而唔係只得一個粗糙形狀。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: Hierarchical 3D generation: a diffusion prior first sets the overall shape, then quality and detail are raised. From text or an image you can get a more complete object rather than only a rough shape. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: PartCrafter
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2025] PartCrafter: Structured 3D Mesh Generation via Compositional Latent Diffusion Transformers
projects.summary: 按部件生成結構化三維網格。物件會拆成可分開嘅部分，而唔係一整塊糊埋嘅表面，方便之後改裝、上材質或者做關節。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It generates structured 3D meshes by part. An object is split into separable parts instead of one fused surface, which makes later modification, materials, or joints easier. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: LGM
projects.description: [ECCV 2024 Oral] LGM: Large Multi-View Gaussian Model for High-Resolution 3D Content Creation.
projects.summary: 大型多視角高斯模型，由圖像快速生成高解像三維內容。先得到多個一致視角，再用高斯融合成可以轉睇嘅物件。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: A large multi-view Gaussian model that quickly generates high-resolution 3D content from images. It first obtains several consistent views, then fuses them with Gaussians into an object you can turn and look at. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: zero123plus
projects.description: Code repository for Zero123++: a Single Image to Consistent Multi-view Diffusion Base Model.
projects.summary: 由單張圖生成一致多視角嘅擴散底模。新角度之間風格同形狀較齊，之後可以接重建程式，變成網格或高斯場景。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: A diffusion base model that generates consistent multiple views from a single image. Style and shape stay more aligned across the new angles, and you can then attach a reconstruction program to turn them into a mesh or a Gaussian scene. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: stable-fast-3d
projects.description: SF3D: Stable Fast 3D Mesh Reconstruction with UV-unwrapping and Illumination Disentanglement
projects.summary: 由單張圖快速重建三維網格，同時做 UV 展開同光照分離。模型表面可以直接貼圖，適合要交去 DCC 或遊戲嘅資產。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It quickly reconstructs a 3D mesh from a single image, and at the same time does UV unwrapping and lighting separation. The surface can be textured directly, which suits assets that need to go to a DCC tool or a game. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: TripoSG
projects.description: TripoSG: High-Fidelity 3D Shape Synthesis using Large-Scale Rectified Flow Models
projects.summary: 用大規模 rectified flow 做高保真三維形狀合成。可以由圖像得到較乾淨嘅幾何，重點放喺形狀質素，而唔止係快。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: High-fidelity 3D shape synthesis with large-scale rectified flow. From an image it can produce cleaner geometry, with the emphasis on shape quality rather than only speed. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: NeuS
projects.description: Code release for NeuS
projects.summary: 用神經隱式表面重建物件，把體渲染同表面約束放埋一齊。多視角相片可以抽出較準嘅網格，係後來好多表面重建程式嘅參考。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It reconstructs objects with a neural implicit surface, combining volume rendering and surface constraints. Multi-view photos can yield a more accurate mesh, and it is a reference for many later surface-reconstruction codebases. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: One-2-3-45
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2023] Official code of "One-2-3-45: Any Single Image to 3D Mesh in 45 Seconds without Per-Shape Optimization"
projects.summary: 任何單張圖大約四十五秒變成三維網格，而且唔使每個形狀再長時間優化。先生成多視角，再重建，係早期實用嘅單圖轉 mesh 流程。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: Any single image becomes a 3D mesh in about 45 seconds, without a long extra optimization for each shape. It first generates multiple views, then reconstructs, and it is an early practical single-image-to-mesh pipeline. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: Magic123
projects.description: [ICLR'24] Official PyTorch Implementation of Magic123: One Image to High-Quality 3D Object Generation Using Both 2D and 3D Diffusion Priors
projects.summary: 同時用二維同三維擴散先驗，由一張圖生成高質素三維物件。二維模型補外觀，三維先驗拉住幾何，減少背面亂估。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It uses 2D and 3D diffusion priors together to generate a high-quality 3D object from one image. The 2D model fills in appearance, and the 3D prior holds the geometry, reducing wild guesses on the back. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: prolificdreamer
projects.description: ProlificDreamer: High-Fidelity and Diverse Text-to-3D Generation with Variational Score Distillation (NeurIPS 2023 Spotlight)
projects.summary: 用變分分數蒸餾由文字生成高保真同多樣嘅三維。同一個描述可以出唔止一個樣，質素亦高過早期 DreamFusion 一類方法。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It uses variational score distillation to generate high-fidelity and diverse 3D content from text. The same description can produce more than one look, and the quality is also higher than early DreamFusion-style methods. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: cube
projects.description: Roblox Foundation Model for 3D Intelligence
projects.summary: Roblox 面向三維智能嘅基礎模型，用嚟理解同生成三維內容。可以協助由圖像或描述得到場景同資產，服務遊戲製作呢類流程。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: Roblox's foundation model for 3D intelligence, used to understand and generate 3D content. It can help turn an image or a description into scenes and assets for pipelines such as game production. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: Direct3D-S2
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2025] Direct3D‑S2: Gigascale 3D Generation Made Easy with Spatial Sparse Attention
projects.summary: 用空間稀疏注意力做大規模三維生成，令高解像生成更容易。可以由條件直接出三維，而唔使把成個立方體密密麻麻計一次。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: Large-scale 3D generation with spatial sparse attention, which makes high-resolution generation easier. It can output 3D directly from a condition, without densely computing the whole volume in one pass. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: ECON
projects.description: [CVPR'23, Highlight] ECON: Explicit Clothed humans Optimized via Normal integration
projects.summary: 由單張人像重建穿着衣服嘅人體三維，並用法線整合優化表面。重點係衫嘅皺褶同身體一齊保留，而唔係只得一個裸體模板。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It reconstructs a clothed human body in 3D from a single portrait and refines the surface with normal integration. The point is that clothing folds are kept together with the body, rather than only a naked template. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: stable-point-aware-3d
projects.description: SPAR3D: Stable Point-Aware Reconstruction of 3D Objects from Single Images
projects.summary: 由單張圖重建三維物件，同時利用點雲資訊穩定形狀。幾何同外觀分開處理，減少單視角常見嘅扁塌同背面缺失。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It reconstructs a 3D object from a single image while using point-cloud information to stabilize the shape. Geometry and appearance are handled separately, reducing the flattening and missing backs common with a single view. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: ICON
projects.description: [CVPR'22] ICON: Implicit Clothed humans Obtained from Normals
projects.summary: 由單張圖同法線重建穿着衣服嘅人體。隱式表面會跟住衣服輪廓，而唔係硬套標準體型，係呢類人體數字化嘅常用程式。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It reconstructs a clothed human body from a single image and normals. The implicit surface follows the clothing outline instead of forcing a standard body shape, and it is a commonly used codebase for this kind of human digitization. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: OpenLRM
projects.description: An open-source impl. of Large Reconstruction Models
projects.summary: 大型重建模型嘅開源實作，由單張或少量圖像前饋得到三維。推論快，適合要批量把產品圖或角色圖轉成可旋轉資產。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: An open-source implementation of a large reconstruction model that feed-forward produces 3D from a single image or a few images. Inference is fast, which suits batch-converting product photos or character images into rotatable assets. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: pifuhd
projects.description: High-Resolution 3D Human Digitization from A Single Image.
projects.summary: 由單張人像做高解像三維人體數字化。像素對齊嘅隱式函數可以保留頭髮同衣服細節，係單圖人體重建經常被引用嘅程式。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: High-resolution 3D human digitization from a single portrait. A pixel-aligned implicit function can preserve hair and clothing detail, and it is a frequently cited codebase for single-image human reconstruction. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: instant-nsr-pl
projects.description: Neural Surface reconstruction based on Instant-NGP. Efficient and customizable boilerplate for your research projects. Train NeuS in 10min!
projects.summary: 基於 Instant-NGP 嘅神經表面重建，可以用大約十分鐘訓練 NeuS 一類方法。多視角相片可以較快抽出網格，適合研究表面重建。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: Neural surface reconstruction based on Instant-NGP that can train NeuS-style methods in about ten minutes. Multi-view photos can yield a mesh more quickly, which suits research on surface reconstruction. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: nerf2mesh
projects.description: [ICCV2023] Delicate Textured Mesh Recovery from NeRF via Adaptive Surface Refinement
projects.summary: 由 NeRF 恢復帶貼圖嘅精細網格，並自適應加密表面。新視角場景可以交回傳統渲染，用 mesh 而唔係只留神經場。由平面圖像或文字得到可以旋轉睇嘅三維資產，再交畀渲染或者遊戲流程。
projects.summary_en: It recovers a fine textured mesh from a NeRF and adaptively densifies the surface. A novel-view scene can be handed back to traditional rendering as a mesh, instead of leaving only a neural field. From a flat image or text you get a 3D asset you can rotate and look at, then pass it to a rendering or game pipeline.

projects.name: unsloth
projects.description: Local UI to run and train LLMs and diffusion models. Supports GGUF, MLX, Qwen3.8, DeepSeek-V4.1, MiniMax-H3, Gemma 4, FLUX and more.
projects.summary: 本機介面，用嚟跑同微調語言模型同擴散模型。支援 GGUF、MLX、FLUX 等，可以喺自己部機訓練圖像模型，而唔使靠雲端服務。想試新模型時，唔使每次重寫成套訓練腳本。
projects.summary_en: A local interface for running and fine-tuning language models and diffusion models. It supports GGUF, MLX, FLUX, and others, so you can train image models on your own machine without a cloud service. When you try a new model, you do not have to rewrite the whole training script each time.

projects.name: LocalAI
projects.description: LocalAI is the open-source AI engine. Run any model - LLMs, vision, voice, image, video - on any hardware. No GPU required.
projects.summary: 開源本地 AI 引擎，可以喺自己部機跑語言模型、視覺、語音、圖像同影片。唔使顯示卡都得，用一個介面取代多個雲端 API。出圖同推理都可以留喺自己部機。資料唔使上傳去外面。
projects.summary_en: An open-source local AI engine that can run language models, vision, speech, images, and video on your own machine. It works without a GPU, and one interface replaces several cloud APIs. Image generation and inference can both stay on your own machine. Data does not have to be uploaded outside.

projects.name: mcp-for-blender
projects.description: Community plugin to control Blender 3D with any LLM of your choice. Not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation.
projects.summary: 社群插件，用嚟喺 Blender 入面用任何語言模型控制三維操作。可以叫模型幫手建模、改場景，同官方 Blender Foundation 無關。指令會轉成 Blender 入面嘅操作。
projects.summary_en: A community plugin for controlling 3D operations inside Blender with any language model. You can ask the model to help with modeling and scene edits, and it is not affiliated with the official Blender Foundation. Commands are turned into operations inside Blender.

projects.name: Open-Generative-AI
projects.description: Unrestricted Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 600+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
projects.summary: 可以自己架設嘅圖像同影片生成工作室，整合 Flux、Kling、Sora、Veo 等模型。用嚟喺本機出圖同出片，採 MIT 授權。模型可以換成自己已經有嘅接口。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted image and video generation studio that integrates models such as FLUX, Kling, Sora, and Veo. It is for generating images and video locally, under the MIT license. Models can be swapped for interfaces you already have.

projects.name: taichi
projects.description: Productive, portable, and performant GPU programming in Python.
projects.summary: 用 Python 寫高效能 GPU 程式嘅語言同編譯器。適合電腦圖像、物理模擬同可微分計算，同一套程式可以喺唔同顯示卡上跑。研究渲染同模擬時可以少寫底層顯示卡程式。
projects.summary_en: A language and compiler for writing high-performance GPU programs in Python. It suits computer graphics, physics simulation, and differentiable computing, and the same program can run on different graphics cards. When researching rendering and simulation, you can write less low-level GPU code.

projects.name: machine-learning-for-trading
projects.description: Code for Machine Learning for Trading, 3rd edition — from data sourcing to live execution.
projects.summary: 《Machine Learning for Trading》第三版嘅程式。由攞市場數據、特徵同模型，去到回測同實盤執行，用嚟學量化交易成個流程。筆記本跟住書嘅章節逐步示範。
projects.summary_en: Code for the third edition of Machine Learning for Trading. It goes from fetching market data, features, and models through to backtesting and live execution, for learning the whole quantitative trading workflow. The notebooks follow the book chapter by chapter.

projects.name: deepseek-harness
projects.description: DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin.
projects.summary: DeepSeek 官方出嘅 agent harness，個架構係「樣樣都係插件」。用 Cordis 將工具同介面砌成可以換嘅部件，你可以喺本機用 npx 開網頁介面。而家仲係開發預覽，插件介面之後可能會改。
projects.summary_en: The official agent harness from DeepSeek, whose architecture treats everything as a plugin. It uses Cordis to assemble tools and interfaces into swappable parts, and you can open a web interface locally with npx. It is still a development preview, and the plugin interface may change later.

projects.name: hermes-agent
projects.description: The agent that grows with you
projects.summary: Nous Research 嘅自主 agent，會將用過嘅經驗寫成技能，同記住你係邊個。可以喺平價伺服器、顯示卡叢集，或者閒置幾乎唔使錢嘅環境跑。新對話會翻查舊紀錄，唔使每次由零介紹自己。
projects.summary_en: An autonomous agent from Nous Research that writes experience it has used into skills and remembers who you are. It can run on an inexpensive server, a GPU cluster, or an idle setup that costs almost nothing. A new conversation looks back through the old record, so you do not have to introduce yourself from scratch every time.

projects.name: khoj
projects.description: Your AI second brain. Self-hostable. Get answers from the web or your docs. Build custom agents, schedule automations, do deep research. Turn any online or local LLM into your personal, autonomous AI (gpt, claude, gemini, llama, qwen, mistral). Get started - free.
projects.summary: 可以自己架嘅個人 AI 第二大腦。用嚟喺網頁同你嘅文件搵答案，又可以砌自訂 agent、排程自動化同做深入研究。本地或者網上嘅語言模型都接得，亦可以出圖，資料可以留喺自己部機。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted personal AI second brain. It finds answers on the web and in your documents, and you can also build custom agents, schedule automation, and do deep research. It can connect to local or online language models and can generate images, and the data can stay on your own machine.

projects.name: tinyrenderer
projects.description: A brief computer graphics / rendering course
projects.summary: 一份簡短嘅電腦圖像課程，用 C++ 由零寫一個細渲染器。跟住課你會自己做光柵化、著色同貼圖，適合想搞清楚畫面點樣畫出嚟，而唔係只係呼叫現成引擎。程式短，方便對住每一行睇渲染點做。
projects.summary_en: A short computer graphics course that writes a small renderer from scratch in C++. Following the lessons, you implement rasterization, shading, and texturing yourself, for people who want to understand how a picture is drawn rather than only calling a ready-made engine. The code is short, so you can read line by line how the rendering is done.

projects.name: questdb
projects.description: QuestDB is a high performance, open-source, time-series database
projects.summary: 高效能開源時間序列資料庫，用嚟存同查市場數據呢類帶時間戳嘅資料。查詢快、延遲低，支援 Parquet 同資本市場常用嘅數據格式，適合作交易系統嘅行情儲存，而唔係一隻自動下單策略。
projects.summary_en: A high-performance open-source time-series database for storing and querying timestamped data such as market data. Queries are fast and latency is low, and it supports Parquet and data formats commonly used in capital markets. It suits market-data storage for a trading system, and it is not an automatic order-placing strategy.

projects.name: stable-diffusion-webui-colab
projects.description: stable diffusion webui colab
projects.summary: 一組 Google Colab 筆記本，用嚟喺 Colab 跑 Stable Diffusion WebUI。可以試文生圖同 Dreambooth，唔使自己先砌顯示卡環境。筆記本係社群整理，模型權重同授權仍然要你自己確認。
projects.summary_en: A set of Google Colab notebooks for running Stable Diffusion WebUI on Colab. You can try text-to-image and DreamBooth without first building a GPU environment yourself. The notebooks are assembled by the community, and you still have to check the model weights and licenses yourself.

projects.name: firecrawl
projects.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥
projects.summary: 開源爬蟲，用嚟將網頁抓成乾淨嘅 Markdown，再交俾 AI agent 用。可以爬成個站、抽取結構化資料，而唔使每個網站自己寫選擇器。適合要將網上資料帶入 agent 嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An open-source crawler that turns web pages into clean Markdown for an AI agent to use. It can crawl a whole site and extract structured data without writing a selector for every website. It suits people who need to bring web data into an agent.

projects.name: satori
projects.description: Enlightened library to convert HTML and CSS to SVG
projects.summary: Vercel 嘅程式庫，用嚟將 HTML 同 CSS 轉成 SVG 圖。常見用途係生成 Open Graph 預覽圖，唔使開瀏覽器截圖。佢係排版出圖，而唔係擴散模型咁由文字生成畫面。
projects.summary_en: A library from Vercel that turns HTML and CSS into an SVG image. A common use is generating Open Graph preview images without opening a browser to take a screenshot. It produces images by layout, and it is not a diffusion model that generates a picture from text.

projects.name: OpenCreator
projects.description: Formerly KrillinAI, VideoTranslation and Dubbing Tool. Open-source AI workspace for creators, powered by Codex. Video downloading, video translation, create videos, images, voice, avatars, and edits with Agents in one place. Suitable for your Social Media like YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, etc.
projects.summary: 前身係 KrillinAI 嘅開源創作工作台。用嚟下載影片、翻譯同配音，亦可以喺同一個地方用 agent 出片、出圖、做聲音同頭像。適合做 YouTube、TikTok 呢類社交內容。
projects.summary_en: An open-source creation workbench formerly known as KrillinAI. It is for downloading video, translation, and dubbing, and in the same place an agent can make video, images, audio, and avatars. It suits social content such as YouTube and TikTok.

projects.name: QuantDinger
projects.description: Open-source AI Trading OS, agent trading, and vibe trading, with Jev System One integration. Research, build Python strategies, backtest, and paper/live trade across crypto, stocks, and forex. Launch your own multi-tenant trading SaaS with built-in user management, billing, payments, and settlement.
projects.summary: 可以自己架嘅量化研究平台。用嚟將交易想法寫成 Python 策略，再做回測、模擬盤同實盤，覆蓋股票、加密貨幣同外匯。重點係研究同執行策略，而唔係一個現成嘅自動揀股訊號。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted quantitative research platform. It turns a trading idea into a Python strategy, then runs backtests, paper trading, and live trading across stocks, cryptocurrency, and forex. The focus is researching and executing strategies, and it is not a ready-made automatic stock-picking signal.

projects.name: ViMax
projects.description: "ViMax: Agentic Video Generation (Director, Screenwriter, Producer, and Video Generator All-in-One)"
projects.summary: 港大嘅多 agent 影片生成系統。導演、編劇、監製同分鏡會分工，可以由一個想法或者劇本做到成條片。用嚟將文字推進到可睇嘅影片，而唔係只出一段提示詞。每個角色負責一段工序，方便你只改劇本或者只改畫面。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent video generation system from the University of Hong Kong. A director, screenwriter, producer, and storyboard artist divide the work, and it can take an idea or a script through to a full video. It pushes text through to a watchable video rather than only producing a prompt. Each role handles one stage, so you can change only the script or only the picture.

projects.name: orca
projects.description: Orca is the place for working with a fleet of agents (e.g. Grok Bot, Claude Code). Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.
projects.summary: 桌面同手機都可以用嘅 agent IDE。用嚟將 Codex、Claude Code 等幾個寫程式 agent 並排跑，每個放喺自己嘅 git worktree。可以用你自己嘅訂閱，喺終端機、遠端機器同手機跟住進度。
projects.summary_en: An agent IDE for desktop and phone. It runs several coding agents, such as Codex and Claude Code, side by side, each in its own git worktree. You can use your own subscription and follow progress in the terminal, on a remote machine, and on a phone.

projects.name: diffusionbee-stable-diffusion-ui
projects.description: Diffusion Bee is the easiest way to run Stable Diffusion locally on your M1 Mac. Comes with a one-click installer. No dependencies or technical knowledge needed.
projects.summary: 喺 M1 Mac 本地跑 Stable Diffusion 嘅桌面程式，有一鍵安裝，唔使自己砌依賴。用嚟喺自己部機出圖，適合唔想先搞 Python 環境嘅人。模型同生成都留喺本機。
projects.summary_en: A desktop app for running Stable Diffusion locally on an M1 Mac, with one-click install, so you do not have to assemble the dependencies yourself. It generates images on your own machine, for people who do not want to set up a Python environment first. The model and the generation both stay on the local machine.

projects.name: CycleGAN
projects.description: Software that can generate photos from paintings,  turn horses into zebras,  perform style transfer, and more.
projects.summary: 用嚟做唔成對圖像翻譯嘅經典程式。可以將畫變成相、馬變成斑馬，或者做風格轉移。兩個域唔使一對一對齊嘅訓練圖，適合想試生成對抗網絡點樣改圖像外觀。論文同程式都公開，方便對住實作睇。
projects.summary_en: Classic code for unpaired image translation. It can turn a painting into a photo, a horse into a zebra, or transfer style. The two domains do not need paired, aligned training images, which suits trying how a generative adversarial network changes image appearance. The paper and the code are both public, so you can read them against the implementation.

projects.name: Concat
projects.description: The truly free, open-source, local-first, cross-platform CapCut replacement. Scriptable through a JSON-RPC API & MCP.
projects.summary: 本地優先嘅開源影片剪輯器，用嚟取代 CapCut。支援多軌剪接、字幕、文字轉語音同去背，用 Rust 引擎喺自己部機跑。片段唔使上傳，亦可以用 JSON-RPC 同 MCP 寫腳本控制。
projects.summary_en: A local-first open-source video editor meant to replace CapCut. It supports multi-track editing, subtitles, text-to-speech, and background removal, and a Rust engine runs it on your own machine. Clips do not have to be uploaded, and you can also script it over JSON-RPC and MCP.

projects.name: quant-trading
projects.description: Python quantitative trading strategies including VIX Calculator, Pattern Recognition, Commodity Trading Advisor, Monte Carlo, Options Straddle, Shooting Star, London Breakout, Heikin-Ashi, Pair Trading, RSI, Bollinger Bands, Parabolic SAR, Dual Thrust, Awesome, MACD
projects.summary: 一套 Python 量化策略例子，包括配對交易、期權、MACD、布林帶同突破。用嚟睇每種策略點樣由數據計到訊號，而唔係一個可以即刻實盤下單嘅平台。你可以揀一條策略改完再自己回測。
projects.summary_en: A set of Python quantitative strategy examples, including pairs trading, options, MACD, Bollinger Bands, and breakouts. It shows how each strategy computes a signal from data, and it is not a platform that can place live orders right away. You can pick one strategy, change it, and backtest it yourself.

projects.name: Sana
projects.description: SANA: Efficient High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Linear Diffusion Transformer
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅高效擴散模型，用線性注意力喺較少計算量下生成高解像圖像，亦包含 SANA-Video 同串流版本。用嚟出圖同出片，適合想喺自己部機跑較輕量嘅擴散模型。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's efficient diffusion model uses linear attention to generate high-resolution images with less computation, and it also includes SANA-Video and a streaming version. It is for generating images and video, for people who want to run a lighter diffusion model on their own machine.

projects.name: BlenderGIS
projects.description: Blender addons to make the bridge between Blender and geographic data
projects.summary: Blender 插件，用嚟將地理數據帶入三維場景。可以拉底圖、數值高程同地圖幾何，喺 Blender 入面砌地形同實景，而唔使先用另一個 GIS 軟件轉檔。適合做地圖可視化同場景佈置。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on for bringing geographic data into a 3D scene. It can pull basemaps, digital elevation, and map geometry, and build terrain and real-world scenery inside Blender, without first converting files in another GIS program. It suits map visualization and scene layout.

projects.name: paperclip
projects.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
projects.summary: 開源嘅 agent 編排程式，用嚟管理一隊 AI 同事。你可以設定目標、分配角色同預算，再喺一個介面追蹤工作同成本。每個 agent 可以揀唔同模型，任務同權限留喺自己架嘅伺服器。
projects.summary_en: An open-source agent orchestrator for managing a team of AI coworkers. You can set goals, assign roles and budgets, then track the work and the cost in one interface. Each agent can use a different model, and tasks and permissions stay on a server you host yourself.

projects.name: openvino
projects.description: OpenVINO™ is an open source toolkit for optimizing and deploying AI inference
projects.summary: Intel 嘅開源推理工具包，用嚟優化同部署已經訓練好嘅模型。可以將視覺同擴散模型轉成喺 CPU 或顯示卡上跑得更快嘅格式，而唔係一個由文字出圖嘅繪圖程式。適合想將模型放到自己部機運行嘅人。
projects.summary_en: Intel's open-source inference toolkit for optimizing and deploying models that are already trained, not for training a new model. It can convert vision and diffusion models into a format that runs faster on a CPU or a GPU, and it is not a drawing program that generates images from text. It suits people who want to run a model on their own machine.

projects.name: paper2gui
projects.description: Convert AI papers to GUI，Make it easy and convenient for everyone to use artificial intelligence technology。让每个人都简单方便的使用前沿人工智能技术
projects.summary: 免安裝嘅 AI 桌面工具箱，將論文入面嘅模型包成即開即用嘅介面。涵蓋繪畫、語音合成、影片補幀同超分、伴奏分離同字幕。用嚟喺自己部機試呢類工具，而唔使逐個項目砌環境。
projects.summary_en: An install-free AI desktop toolbox that wraps models from papers into interfaces you can open and use immediately. It covers painting, speech synthesis, video frame interpolation and super-resolution, accompaniment separation, and subtitles. It is for trying these tools on your own machine without setting up an environment for each project.

projects.name: imagen-pytorch
projects.description: Implementation of Imagen, Google's Text-to-Image Neural Network, in Pytorch
projects.summary: Google Imagen 文字生成圖像嘅 PyTorch 實作。用嚟研究同跑文字出圖，倉庫亦有文字生成影片相關嘅實驗。適合想對住程式睇擴散模型點樣由文字變成畫面嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A PyTorch implementation of Google Imagen for text-to-image. It is for researching and running text-to-image, and the repository also has experiments related to text-to-video. It suits people who want to read the code and see how a diffusion model turns text into an image.

projects.name: Financial-Models-Numerical-Methods
projects.description: Collection of notebooks about quantitative finance, with interactive python code.
projects.summary: 一套量化金融筆記本，用 Python 講期權定價、Heston 模型、布朗運動同數值方法。用嚟理解模型點樣計價格同風險，而唔係一個可以即刻落盤嘅交易程式。你可以改參數再自己重算。
projects.summary_en: A set of quantitative-finance notebooks that use Python to cover option pricing, the Heston model, Brownian motion, and numerical methods. They are for understanding how the models compute prices and risk, not a trading program that can place orders right away. You can change the parameters and recalculate them yourself.

projects.name: pix2pixHD
projects.description: Synthesizing and manipulating 2048x1024 images with conditional GANs
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅高解像條件式生成對抗網絡。用嚟由標籤圖或條件合成 2048 乘 1024 嘅圖像，同埋操控已有畫面。適合想喺電腦圖像同視覺實驗入面做高解像圖像轉換嘅人。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's high-resolution conditional generative adversarial network. It synthesizes 2048 by 1024 images from label maps or other conditions, and it can also manipulate existing images. It suits people who want high-resolution image translation in computer-graphics and vision experiments.

projects.name: claude-mem
projects.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent –  Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More
projects.summary: 跨對話嘅 agent 記憶插件。用嚟記錄每次工作入面用過嘅工具同做法，壓縮之後喺下一輪再注入相關上下文。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 等，等 agent 唔使每次都當專案係新嘅。
projects.summary_en: A cross-conversation agent memory plugin. It records the tools and methods used in each session, compresses them, and injects the relevant context on the next turn. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and others, so the agent does not treat the project as new every time.

projects.name: pix2pix
projects.description: Image-to-image translation with conditional adversarial nets
projects.summary: 用條件式生成對抗網絡做圖像到圖像翻譯嘅經典程式。你可以俾一張標籤圖或者草圖，佢畫出對應嘅真實畫面。適合想對住論文實作睇條件生成點樣改圖像嘅人。程式用 Lua 寫。
projects.summary_en: A classic program that uses conditional generative adversarial networks for image-to-image translation. You can give it a label map or a sketch, and it draws the corresponding realistic image. It suits people who want to read the paper's implementation and see how conditional generation changes an image. The program is written in Lua.

projects.name: runanywhere-sdks
projects.description: Production ready toolkit to run AI locally
projects.summary: 一套喺手機、瀏覽器同桌面本地跑 AI 嘅工具包。語言模型、視覺、語音同圖像生成都可以留喺裝置上，唔使將資料送去雲端。用嚟做離線推理，而唔係一個單獨嘅繪圖網站。八個平台用同一套呼叫方式。
projects.summary_en: A toolkit for running AI locally on phones, in the browser, and on the desktop. Language models, vision, speech, and image generation can stay on the device, without sending data to the cloud. It is for offline inference, not a standalone drawing website. Eight platforms share the same calling style.

projects.name: backgroundremover
projects.description: Background Remover lets you Remove Background from images and video using AI with a simple command line interface that is free and open source.
projects.summary: 用命令列幫圖像同影片去除背景嘅開源工具。一條指令就可以抽出主體，唔使開圖像軟件逐格摳。模型喺本地跑，適合要批量處理相片或者短片嘅人。輸出可以再交俾剪輯軟件，檔案留喺本機。
projects.summary_en: An open-source command-line tool that removes backgrounds from images and video. One command extracts the subject, without opening image software to cut it out frame by frame. The model runs locally, which suits people who need to batch-process photos or short clips. The output can be passed to editing software, and the files stay on the machine.

projects.name: printfilm
projects.description: PRINTFILM: AI short-video marketing and AI short-drama creation platform
projects.summary: 用嚟做 AI 短片同漫劇嘅創作平台。可以由文案去到分鏡、參考圖、圖生影片再合成預覽。角色同場景可以重用，每一步都可以先檢查再繼續，而唔係一次過出成條片。預設係豎屏短片，亦可以改做靜圖成片。
projects.summary_en: A creation platform for AI short films and comic dramas. You can go from copy to a storyboard, reference images, image-to-video, and then a composite preview. Characters and scenes can be reused, and each step can be checked before you continue, rather than producing the whole film in one pass. The default is vertical short video, and it can also be switched to a film made of still images.

projects.name: QuantsPlaybook
projects.description: 量化研究-券商金工研报复现
projects.summary: 用 Python 筆記本重現券商金工研報嘅量化研究合集。用嚟對住研報睇因子、回測同圖表點樣計出嚟，而唔係一個可以即刻落盤嘅交易程式。你可以改數據再自己重算一次。
projects.summary_en: A quantitative-research collection that reproduces brokers' quantitative research reports in Python notebooks. It is for reading the reports alongside the code to see how factors, backtests, and charts are computed, not a trading program that can place orders right away. You can change the data and recalculate it yourself.

projects.name: ai_quant_trade
projects.description: Stock AI Trader: 1-stop platform for learning, sim & live trading. Covers: stock basics, strategies, LLMs, factor mining, ML/DL/RL, graph nets, HFT, C++ deploy & JoinQuant code. 股票AI操盘手：一站式学习、模拟、实盘平台。涵盖：股票基础、策略、大模型、因子挖掘、机器学习/深度学习/强化学习、图网络、高频交易、C++部署及聚宽代码。
projects.summary: 股票 AI 學習同交易嘅一站式筆記同程式。由股票基礎、策略、因子挖掘去到機器學習同模擬、實盤例子，亦有聚寬同 C++ 部署參考。用嚟學成個流程，而唔係一個保證獲利嘅訊號。
projects.summary_en: A one-stop set of notes and programs for learning stock AI and trading. It runs from stock basics, strategies, and factor mining through machine learning, simulation, and live-trading examples, and it also includes JoinQuant and C++ deployment references. It is for learning the whole workflow, not a signal that guarantees a profit.

projects.name: crawl4ai
projects.description: Open-source web crawler and scraper for LLMs and AI agents: any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. Run it yourself, or use Crawl4AI Cloud with one key. Join our Discord https://discord.gg/VuxzM8mtf
projects.summary: 開源爬蟲，用嚟將任何網站抓成乾淨、適合語言模型睇嘅 Markdown。可以自己架，再交俾 AI agent 做資料。唔使每個站自己寫選擇器，佢負責抽取同清理。適合要將網頁內容帶入 agent 嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An open-source crawler that turns any website into clean Markdown suitable for a language model. You can host it yourself and then pass the result to an AI agent as data. You do not write a selector for every site; it handles extraction and cleanup. It suits people who need to bring web content into an agent.

projects.name: OmniRoute
projects.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 375 providers (150+ free), 1,400+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by 900+ contributors
projects.summary: 可以自己架嘅 AI 閘道。用一個接口接住好多模型供應商，Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等都可以指去呢度。配額用盡會自動轉去下一個供應商。金鑰留喺你自己部機，而唔係再逐個軟件分開設定。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted AI gateway. One interface connects many model providers, and Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others can point here. When a quota is used up, it automatically switches to the next provider. Keys stay on your own machine, instead of being configured separately in each program.

projects.name: StableStudio
projects.description: Community interface for generative AI
projects.summary: Stability AI 社群維護嘅生成圖像介面，係 DreamStudio 嘅開源前端。用嚟喺瀏覽器入面寫提示、出圖同管理 Stable Diffusion 嘅生成。介面同模型後端可以分開，方便接自己已經架好嘅服務。
projects.summary_en: A generative-image interface maintained by the Stability AI community, and the open-source front end of DreamStudio. It is for writing prompts, generating images, and managing Stable Diffusion generations in the browser. The interface and the model backend can be separated, so you can connect a service you have already set up.

projects.name: StabilityMatrix
projects.description: Multi-Platform Package Manager for Stable Diffusion
projects.summary: 跨平台嘅 Stable Diffusion 套件管理器。用嚟安裝同切換 Automatic1111、ComfyUI 等介面，模型同設定放喺同一個地方。唔使逐個介面自己砌 Python 環境，適合想喺本機試唔同出圖介面嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A cross-platform package manager for Stable Diffusion. It installs and switches interfaces such as Automatic1111 and ComfyUI, and keeps models and settings in one place. You do not have to build a Python environment for each interface yourself. It suits people who want to try different image-generation interfaces on their own machine.

projects.name: FunClip
projects.description: FunASR-powered video transcription, subtitle generation, and LLM-assisted clipping tool with a local Gradio UI.
projects.summary: 基於 FunASR 嘅影片剪輯工具。用嚟做語音轉文字、生成字幕，再用語言模型幫手揀片段。有本地 Gradio 介面，適合中文口播片要自動上字幕同粗剪嘅人。辨識同剪輯都可以留喺自己部機。
projects.summary_en: A video-editing tool based on FunASR. It does speech-to-text, generates subtitles, and uses a language model to help choose clips. It has a local Gradio interface and suits people who need automatic subtitles and a rough cut for Chinese talking-head videos. Recognition and editing can both stay on your own machine.

projects.name: Amagine3D
projects.description: Amagine3D: From hardware requirements to editable 3D designs
projects.summary: 由產品描述、參考圖同尺寸生成可編輯三維設計嘅開源工具。重點係硬件外殼同裝配結構，可以輸出 STEP、STL 同 3MF。用嚟由需求做到可改嘅 CAD，而唔係只出一張睇落立體嘅圖。
projects.summary_en: An open-source tool that generates editable 3D designs from a product description, reference images, and dimensions. The focus is hardware enclosures and assembly structure, and it can export STEP, STL, and 3MF. It turns requirements into CAD you can edit, rather than only producing an image that looks three-dimensional.

projects.name: hyperframes
projects.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
projects.summary: HeyGen 開源嘅影片渲染框架。用 HTML、CSS 同動畫寫畫面，再輸出穩定嘅 MP4。可以喺本機用命令列跑，寫程式助手亦可以叫佢出片。適合想用網頁排版方式做片，而唔係由零砌 FFmpeg 指令嘅人。
projects.summary_en: HeyGen's open-source video rendering framework. You write the frames with HTML, CSS, and animation, then export a stable MP4. It can run locally from the command line, and a coding assistant can also ask it to produce a video. It suits people who want to make video with web layout, rather than assembling FFmpeg commands from scratch.

projects.name: VAR
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2024 Best Paper Award][GPT beats diffusion🔥] [scaling laws in visual generation📈] Official impl. of "Visual Autoregressive Modeling: Scalable Image Generation via Next-Scale Prediction". An *ultra-simple, user-friendly yet state-of-the-art* codebase for autoregressive image generation!
projects.summary: NeurIPS 2024 最佳論文嘅官方實作。用視覺自回歸、按下一層尺度預測嚟生成圖像，而唔係逐步去噪嘅擴散模型。用嚟研究同跑可擴展嘅圖像生成，程式刻意保持短同易改。
projects.summary_en: The official implementation of a NeurIPS 2024 best paper. It generates images by visual autoregression and next-scale prediction, rather than with a diffusion model that denoises step by step. It is for researching and running scalable image generation, and the code is deliberately kept short and easy to change.

projects.name: PaddleGAN
projects.description: PaddlePaddle GAN library, including lots of interesting applications like First-Order motion transfer,  Wav2Lip, picture repair, image editing, photo2cartoon, image style transfer, GPEN, and so on.
projects.summary: 百度飛槳嘅 GAN 應用庫。收錄動作遷移、人像修復、圖像編輯、風格轉換同相片轉動畫等例子。用嚟喺一個倉庫試呢類生成模型，而唔使逐篇論文自己砌訓練環境。想一次過試幾個經典效果，可以由呢度開始。
projects.summary_en: Baidu PaddlePaddle's GAN application library. It includes examples such as motion transfer, portrait restoration, image editing, style transfer, and turning photos into animation. It lets you try this class of generative model in one repository, without building a training environment for each paper yourself. If you want to try several classic effects at once, you can start here.

projects.name: ticker
projects.description: Track stocks, crypto, and derivatives prices and positions in real time from your terminal
projects.summary: 喺終端機即時睇股票、加密貨幣同衍生品報價同持倉嘅小工具。用嚟開住個畫面監察價格，而唔係自動落盤嘅策略。數據顯示喺命令列，適合想離開瀏覽器睇行情嘅人。報價刷新唔使開圖表網站。
projects.summary_en: A small terminal tool for watching live quotes and positions in stocks, cryptocurrencies, and derivatives. It is for leaving a screen up to monitor prices, not a strategy that places orders automatically. The data is shown on the command line, which suits people who want to watch the market away from a browser. Quotes refresh without opening a chart website.

projects.name: PyPortfolioOpt
projects.description: Financial portfolio optimization in python, including classical efficient frontier, Black-Litterman, Hierarchical Risk Parity
projects.summary: 用 Python 做投資組合優化嘅程式庫。可以計有效前沿、Black-Litterman 同層次風險平價，幫手由預期回報同風險配置權重。用嚟研究點樣分配倉位，而唔係一個落單程式。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for portfolio optimization. It can compute the efficient frontier, Black-Litterman, and hierarchical risk parity, and it helps set weights from expected returns and risk. It is for studying how to allocate positions, not an order-placing program.

projects.name: TradingView-API
projects.description: 📈 Get real-time stocks from TradingView
projects.summary: 非官方嘅程式庫，用嚟從 TradingView 讀即時報價同圖表數據。可以接住做自己嘅監察或回測數據源。佢唔係 TradingView 官方接口，亦唔會代替券商落單。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial library for reading live quotes and chart data from TradingView. You can connect it as a data source for your own monitoring or backtests. It is not TradingView's official API, and it does not replace placing orders through a broker.

projects.name: MochiDiffusion
projects.description: Run Stable Diffusion on Mac natively
projects.summary: 喺 Mac 原生跑 Stable Diffusion 嘅程式，用 Swift 同 Core ML，可以走 Apple 神經網絡引擎。用嚟喺自己部 Mac 出圖，唔使先裝一套 Python 環境。模型同生成都留喺本機。
projects.summary_en: A native Mac program for running Stable Diffusion, written in Swift and Core ML, and able to use the Apple Neural Engine. It generates images on your own Mac without installing a Python environment first. The model and the generations both stay on the machine.

projects.name: auto-editor
projects.description: Effort free video editing!
projects.summary: 自動剪片工具，用嚟偵測無聲同靜止畫面，再將有內容嘅段落接埋。支援影片同音訊，適合口播、錄音同學堂片要快速去掉空白。你可以調閾值，而唔係只得一個自動結果。輸出可以再交俾其他剪輯軟件。
projects.summary_en: An automatic editing tool that detects silence and still frames, then joins the segments that have content. It supports video and audio, and it suits talking-head videos, recordings, and lecture footage that need the empty parts removed quickly. You can adjust the threshold, rather than having only one automatic result. The output can be passed on to other editing software.

projects.name: AI-Youtube-Shorts-Generator
projects.description: Open-source alternative to Opus Clip, Vidyo.ai, Klap & SubMagic. Turn long-form YouTube videos into viral 9:16 shorts using LLM highlight detection, Whisper transcription, and auto vertical cropping — free, no watermarks, no per-clip credits.
projects.summary: 將長片剪成直向短片嘅開源工具。用語音轉文字同語言模型搵重點，再自動裁成 9:16。用嚟喺自己部機出片段，冇浮水印同按條收費。成片仍然要你自己睇過先發佈。字幕同裁切都可以再改。
projects.summary_en: An open-source tool that cuts long videos into vertical shorts. It uses speech-to-text and a language model to find the highlights, then crops them to 9:16 automatically. It produces the clips on your own machine, with no watermark and no per-clip fee. You still need to review the finished video yourself before publishing. Subtitles and the crop can both be changed again.

projects.name: freqtrade-strategies
projects.description: Free trading strategies for Freqtrade bot
projects.summary: Freqtrade 交易機械人嘅策略例子庫。入面係其他人分享嘅買賣規則，可以攞嚟回測同研究。用嚟睇策略點寫，而唔係一套保證獲利、可以即刻實盤嘅訊號。每條策略都要你自己驗證。
projects.summary_en: A library of strategy examples for the Freqtrade trading bot. It contains buy and sell rules shared by other people, which you can take for backtesting and research. It is for seeing how strategies are written, not a set of signals that guarantee a profit and can go live right away. You need to verify each strategy yourself.

projects.name: tf-quant-finance
projects.description: High-performance TensorFlow library for quantitative finance.
projects.summary: Google 用 TensorFlow 寫嘅量化金融庫。用嚟做定價、風險同數值計算，可以放到 GPU 上跑。適合研究金融模型點樣加速，而唔係一個落單或者揀股程式。
projects.summary_en: Google's quantitative-finance library, written in TensorFlow. It is for pricing, risk, and numerical computation, and it can run on a GPU. It suits research into how financial models can be sped up, not a program for placing orders or picking stocks.

projects.name: ai-agent-book
projects.description: 《深入理解 AI Agent：设计原理与工程实践》（李博杰 著）开源主仓库：全书正文、编译版 PDF 与按章配套代码
projects.summary: 李博傑《深入理解 AI Agent》嘅開源倉庫。有全書正文、PDF 同按章配套程式。用嚟對住設計原理睇記憶、工具同工程實踐，而唔係一個裝好即用嘅 agent 產品。你可以由某一章嘅程式開始改。
projects.summary_en: The open-source repository for Bojie Li's Understanding AI Agents in Depth. It includes the full text, a PDF, and companion code by chapter. It is for reading memory, tools, and engineering practice alongside the design principles, not a ready-to-install agent product. You can start by modifying the code for a particular chapter.

projects.name: fast-stable-diffusion
projects.description: fast-stable-diffusion + DreamBooth
projects.summary: TheLastBen 嘅 Stable Diffusion 筆記本同 DreamBooth 流程。用嚟喺 Colab 或本機快啲跑 Automatic1111、ComfyUI 同微調。環境同常用模型會預先接好，適合想少花時間砌依賴嘅人。
projects.summary_en: TheLastBen's Stable Diffusion notebooks and DreamBooth workflow. They are for running Automatic1111, ComfyUI, and fine-tuning more quickly on Colab or on a local machine. The environment and commonly used models are wired up in advance, which suits people who want to spend less time assembling dependencies.

projects.name: stable-diffusion.cpp
projects.description: Diffusion model(SD,Flux,Wan,Qwen Image,Z-Image,...) inference in pure C/C++
projects.summary: 用純 C/C++ 跑擴散模型嘅推理程式，支援 SD、Flux、Wan 等。唔使成套 Python 深度學習框架。用嚟喺自己部機出圖同圖生圖，模型可以量化之後本地跑。
projects.summary_en: An inference program that runs diffusion models in pure C/C++, with support for SD, Flux, Wan, and others. It does not need a full Python deep-learning framework. It is for generating images and image-to-image on your own machine, and models can be quantized and then run locally.

projects.name: FinanceToolkit
projects.description: Transparent and Efficient Financial Analysis
projects.summary: 用嚟做透明財務分析嘅 Python 庫。可以攞財報、計比率同做因子比較。適合研究公司基本面，而唔係一個自動落盤嘅交易程式。數據出處同計算可以對得返。你可以換數據源再重算。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for transparent financial analysis. It can pull financial statements, compute ratios, and compare factors. It suits research into company fundamentals, not an automatic order-placing trading program. Data sources and calculations can be traced. You can switch the data source and recalculate.

projects.name: tinyraytracer
projects.description: A brief computer graphics / rendering course
projects.summary: 一份簡短嘅光線追蹤課程，用 C++ 由零寫一個細渲染器。跟住課你會自己做光線同場景相交。同作者嘅 tinyrenderer 係一連串圖像課，適合想搞清楚光點樣計算出畫面。
projects.summary_en: A short ray-tracing course that writes a small renderer from scratch in C++. As you follow the lessons, you implement ray-scene intersection yourself. Together with the author's tinyrenderer, it is a series of graphics courses, for people who want to understand how light is computed into an image.

projects.name: kaolin
projects.description: A PyTorch Library for Accelerating 3D Deep Learning Research
projects.summary: NVIDIA 加速三維深度學習嘅 PyTorch 庫。入面有相機、可微分渲染同高斯潑濺相關工具。用嚟做三維研究同訓練，而唔係一個單獨嘅場景檢視器。可以接自己嘅數據同模型。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's PyTorch library for accelerating 3D deep learning. It includes tools related to cameras, differentiable rendering, and Gaussian splatting. It is for 3D research and training, not a standalone scene viewer. You can connect your own data and models.

projects.name: openscreen
projects.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
projects.summary: 開源螢幕錄影程式，用嚟錄產品示範片。支援 Windows、macOS 同 Linux，有 GPU 加速，冇浮水印同訂閱。片段留喺自己部機，適合要出 demo 又唔想用閉源錄影工具嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An open-source screen recorder for product demo videos. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, with GPU acceleration and no watermark or subscription. Clips stay on your own machine. It suits people who need to produce demos and do not want a closed-source recording tool.

projects.name: DeepTutor
projects.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
projects.summary: 港大嘅個人化補習 agent。用嚟按你嘅程度做長期輔導、研究同互動練習，可以自己架。重點係持續記住學習進度，而唔係一個只答一條問題嘅聊天窗。教材同對話都可以留喺自己部機。
projects.summary_en: A personalized tutoring agent from the University of Hong Kong. It provides long-term coaching, research, and interactive practice matched to your level, and you can host it yourself. The point is that it keeps remembering learning progress, rather than being a chat window that only answers one question. Teaching materials and conversations can both stay on your own machine.

projects.name: siyuan
projects.description: An open-source, privacy-first, self-hosted knowledge workspace where humans and AI agents work together 开源、隐私优先、自托管的知识工作空间，让人与智能体在此协作
projects.summary: 可以自己架、私隱優先嘅知識工作台。筆記用 Markdown 存喺自己部機，人同 AI agent 可以一齊整理同搜尋。用嚟做個人知識庫，而唔係把筆記交去外面嘅服務。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted, privacy-first knowledge workspace. Notes are stored as Markdown on your own machine, and people and AI agents can organize and search them together. It is for a personal knowledge base, rather than handing notes to an outside service.

projects.name: Dreambooth-Stable-Diffusion
projects.description: Implementation of Dreambooth (https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.12242) with Stable Diffusion
projects.summary: DreamBooth 論文配 Stable Diffusion 嘅實作。用少量相微調一個模型，令佢識一個特定主體。用嚟研究同跑文字生成圖像嘅微調，而唔係一個裝好嘅繪圖網站。
projects.summary_en: An implementation of the DreamBooth paper with Stable Diffusion. It fine-tunes a model on a small number of photos so the model learns a specific subject. It is for researching and running text-to-image fine-tuning, not a ready-made drawing website.

projects.name: lora
projects.description: Using Low-rank adaptation to quickly fine-tune diffusion models.
projects.summary: 用低秩適配快速微調擴散模型嘅早期實作。只訓練一小部分權重，就可以把新風格或者主體加進 Stable Diffusion。適合想自己微調、又唔想成個模型重練嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An early implementation that fine-tunes diffusion models quickly with low-rank adaptation. Training only a small part of the weights can add a new style or subject to Stable Diffusion. It suits people who want to fine-tune it themselves without retraining the whole model.

projects.name: mlfinlab
projects.description: MlFinLab helps portfolio managers and traders who want to leverage the power of machine learning by providing reproducible, interpretable, and easy to use tools.
projects.summary: 金融機器學習工具庫。用嚟做標籤、特徵、投資組合同回測入面常見嘅步驟，方便研究策略點樣用數據訓練。佢係分析工具，而唔係一個自動落盤嘅交易程式。每步計算都可以對返公式。
projects.summary_en: A toolkit for financial machine learning. It covers common steps in labeling, features, portfolios, and backtesting, so you can study how a strategy is trained on data. It is an analysis tool, not an automatic order-placing trading program. Each calculation can be checked against the formula.

projects.name: youtube-automation-agent
projects.description: 🎬 Open-source, self-hosted AI agent that runs a YouTube channel end to end: researches topics, writes scripts, generates narration, visuals and video, optimizes SEO, and publishes after your approval, then learns from analytics. Works with Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, DeepSeek and more.
projects.summary: 可以自己架嘅影片 agent。用嚟由題目寫腳本、配音同畫面，你批准之後先發佈，再按數據調整下一條。模型接口可以換。成片同發佈都要你自己確認。腳本同成片都可以留喺自己部機再改。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted video agent. It writes a script, voiceover, and visuals from a topic, publishes only after you approve, and then adjusts the next video from the data. The model interface can be swapped. You have to confirm the finished video and the publishing yourself. The script and the finished video can stay on your own machine for further edits.

projects.name: FAST-LIVO2
projects.description: FAST-LIVO2: Fast, Direct LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry
projects.summary: 港大馬爾斯實驗室嘅激光雷達、慣性同視覺里程計。用嚟快速估相機同雷達點行，並重建彩色點雲，亦牽涉高斯潑濺。適合做機器人定位同三維重建研究。程式跟住論文，方便對住實作睇。
projects.summary_en: LiDAR-inertial-visual odometry from the MaRS Lab at the University of Hong Kong. It quickly estimates how the camera and the LiDAR move, reconstructs a colored point cloud, and also involves Gaussian splatting. It suits research on robot localization and 3D reconstruction. The code follows the paper, so you can read the implementation alongside it.

projects.name: html-video
projects.description: Programmatic video for coding agents — HTML to video on your laptop. Turn HTML, CSS & data into real MP4s with pluggable render engines, 21 templates, AI soundtrack. Apache-2.0, no per-render fees. An official project by the Open Design team.
projects.summary: 喺自己部電腦將 HTML、CSS 同數據渲成 MP4 嘅工具。寫程式助手可以叫佢出片，有現成模板同可換嘅渲染引擎。用嚟做程式化影片，而唔係按次收費嘅雲端渲染。影片檔留喺你部電腦。
projects.summary_en: A tool that renders HTML, CSS, and data into an MP4 on your own computer. A coding assistant can ask it to produce a video. It has ready-made templates and a swappable rendering engine. It is for programmatic video, not pay-per-render cloud rendering. The video file stays on your computer.

projects.name: lama
projects.description: 🦙  LaMa Image Inpainting, Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions, WACV 2022
projects.summary: LaMa 用傅里葉卷積做大範圍圖像修補，遮住一大塊仍然可以按周圍紋理補返。解析度變咗都唔使重新訓練，所以移除大物件或者補大洞會穩過只睇局部嘅舊方法。想擦走畫面中間一大舊，呢個係常用起點。
projects.summary_en: LaMa uses Fourier convolutions for large-area image inpainting, so a large masked region can still be filled from the surrounding texture. If the resolution changes, it does not need retraining, so removing a large object or filling a large hole is more stable than older methods that only look locally. If you want to erase a large patch in the middle of the frame, this is a common starting point.

projects.name: Inpaint-Anything
projects.description: Inpaint anything using Segment Anything and inpainting models.
projects.summary: 撳一下就圈住物件，再用分割同修補模型移除、填上或者按文字換走。你唔使自己塗遮罩。圖像、影片同三維場景都有對應流程，適合清走路人、雜物，或者將某一件物件換成另一樣。圈選同重繪分開，成張圖唔會一齊被改。
projects.summary_en: One click outlines an object, and segmentation and inpainting models then remove it, fill it, or replace it from text. You do not paint the mask yourself. Images, video, and 3D scenes each have a corresponding workflow, which suits clearing away pedestrians and clutter or swapping one object for another. Selection and redrawing are separate, so the whole image is not changed together.

projects.name: inpaint-web
