projects.description: A free and open-source inpainting & image-upscaling tool powered by webgpu and wasm on the browser。|   基于 Webgpu 技术和 wasm 技术的免费开源 inpainting & image-upscaling 工具, 纯浏览器端实现。
projects.summary: 喺瀏覽器入面做圖像修補同放大，用 WebGPU 同 WASM 喺本機跑，圖片唔使上傳。塗走瑕疵就按周圍補返，亦可以順便放大。適合唔想先裝 Python，又想檔案留喺自己部電腦嘅人。開網頁就用得。
projects.summary_en: Image inpainting and upscaling in the browser, running locally with WebGPU and WASM, so images do not have to be uploaded. Paint over a flaw and it is filled from the surroundings, and you can upscale at the same time. It suits people who do not want to install Python first and want the files to stay on their own computer. Opening the page is enough to use it.

projects.name: adetailer
projects.description: Auto detecting, masking and inpainting with detection model.
projects.summary: Stable Diffusion WebUI 插件，用偵測模型自動圈出區域再局部重繪，預設多係臉同手。出圖之後細節崩咗，可以唔使人手塗遮罩就只重畫嗰一忽，構圖同其他位置保持原樣。臉同手指最常要咁補。
projects.summary_en: A Stable Diffusion WebUI extension that uses a detection model to outline a region automatically and then redraws it locally, mostly faces and hands by default. If the details break after an image is generated, you can redraw only that spot without painting a mask by hand, while the composition and the other areas stay as they were. Faces and fingers are the parts most often repaired this way.

projects.name: stablediffusion-infinity
projects.description: Outpainting with Stable Diffusion on an infinite canvas
projects.summary: 用 Stable Diffusion 喺無限畫布向外擴圖。你由一張圖開始，向邊沿繼續生成，畫面可以一路延伸，而唔使預先決定最終尺寸。呢個係擴圖多過填洞，適合想將構圖拉闊、加長場景嘅人。畫布冇固定邊界。
projects.summary_en: Outpainting on an infinite canvas with Stable Diffusion. You start from one image and keep generating toward the edges, so the picture can keep extending without deciding the final size in advance. This is outpainting more than filling holes, and it suits people who want to widen a composition or lengthen a scene. The canvas has no fixed boundary.

projects.name: generative_inpainting
projects.description: DeepFill v1/v2 with Contextual Attention and Gated Convolution, CVPR 2018, and ICCV 2019 Oral
projects.summary: DeepFill 第一同第二代嘅官方程式，用上下文注意力同門控卷積補不規則缺口。模型會參考缺口周圍嘅畫面嚟決定補咩，而唔係將附近像素糊勻。CVPR 2018 同 ICCV 2019 嘅經典實作，而家多當研究基線嚟對照。
projects.summary_en: The official code for DeepFill v1 and v2, which fills irregular holes with contextual attention and gated convolution. The model looks at the image around the hole to decide what to fill in, rather than smearing nearby pixels together. These are classic implementations from CVPR 2018 and ICCV 2019, and they are now often used as research baselines for comparison.

projects.name: edge-connect
projects.description: EdgeConnect: Structure Guided Image Inpainting using Edge Prediction, ICCV  2019 https://arxiv.org/abs/1901.00212
projects.summary: 先預測缺失區域嘅邊緣，再沿住呢啲線條填色同紋理。建築物同物件輪廓比較容易留住，補完唔會變成一塊冇結構嘅色塊。ICCV 2019 嘅結構引導修補。線條先定、顏色後填，硬邊物件會自然啲。
projects.summary_en: It first predicts the edges of the missing region, then fills color and texture along those lines. Building and object outlines are easier to keep, so the fill does not become a structureless patch of color. This is structure-guided inpainting from ICCV 2019. Lines are fixed first and color is filled afterward, so hard-edged objects look more natural.

projects.name: RePaint
projects.description: Official PyTorch Code and Models of "RePaint: Inpainting using Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models", CVPR 2022
projects.summary: 用去噪擴散模型做圖像修補，唔使為填洞再訓練一個新網絡。已有嘅擴散模型可以按遮罩反覆重畫缺口，已知區域保持原樣。CVPR 2022。你手上已經有生成模型，就可以用嚟補畫面，唔使另訓一隻修補網絡。
projects.summary_en: Image inpainting with a denoising diffusion model, without training a new network just to fill holes. An existing diffusion model can repeatedly redraw the gap according to the mask, while known regions stay as they were. CVPR 2022. If you already have a generative model, you can use it to repair the image without training a separate inpainting network.

projects.name: BrushNet
projects.description: [ECCV 2024] The official implementation of paper "BrushNet: A Plug-and-Play Image Inpainting Model with Decomposed Dual-Branch Diffusion"
projects.summary: 插拔式嘅擴散修補模型，用分開嘅雙分支處理遮罩同原圖。可以接上現有文字生圖模型，按筆刷區域重畫，而唔使將成個底模重新訓練。ECCV 2024。想保留原本個擴散模型，只加一個修補分支就得。
projects.summary_en: A pluggable diffusion inpainting model that uses separate dual branches for the mask and the original image. It can attach to an existing text-to-image model and redraw the brushed region without retraining the whole base model. ECCV 2024. If you want to keep the original diffusion model, adding one inpainting branch is enough.

projects.name: LanPaint
projects.description: High quality training free inpaint for every stable diffusion model. Supports ComfyUI
projects.summary: 唔使再訓練嘅修補採樣器，可以套喺已有嘅擴散同整流模型上。遮罩入面先多諗幾步再去噪，用多啲計算換補得更穩，亦支援按文字換局部。有 ComfyUI 節點，方法本身係一篇採樣論文，唔止一個節點包。TMLR。
projects.summary_en: A training-free inpainting sampler that can be applied to existing diffusion and rectified-flow models. Inside the mask it takes a few extra steps before denoising, spending more compute for a more stable fill, and it also supports replacing a local region from text. It has a ComfyUI node. The method itself is a sampling paper, not only a node package. TMLR.

projects.name: PowerPaint
projects.description: [ECCV 2024] PowerPaint, a versatile image inpainting model that supports text-guided object inpainting, object removal, image outpainting and shape-guided object inpainting with only a single model. 一个高质量多功能的图像修补模型，可以同时支持插入物体、移除物体、图像扩展、形状可控的物体生成，只需要一个模型
projects.summary: 一個模型同時做幾種圖像修補：按文字放入物件、移除物件、向外擴圖，同埋按形狀引導。換任務提示就得，唔使為移除同重繪各裝一個模型。ECCV 2024。同一套權重可以改用途，移除同加物件唔使換權重。
projects.summary_en: One model handles several kinds of image inpainting at once: inserting an object from text, removing an object, outpainting, and guidance by shape. Changing the task prompt is enough, so you do not install a separate model for removal and for redrawing. ECCV 2024. The same weights can change purpose, so removing and adding objects does not require swapping weights.

projects.name: MAT
projects.description: MAT: Mask-Aware Transformer for Large Hole Image Inpainting
projects.summary: 用 Transformer 處理大洞圖像修補，遮罩會影響注意力，等模型知道邊度要生成、邊度要保留。大面積缺失時，遠距離嘅紋理可以對得齊，唔會只靠洞口幾粒像素。適合缺口大到普通卷積睇唔到全局嘅情況。
projects.summary_en: Large-hole image inpainting with a Transformer. The mask affects attention, so the model knows where to generate and where to keep. When a large area is missing, distant texture can be aligned, instead of relying only on a few pixels at the edge of the hole. It suits gaps so large that ordinary convolution cannot see the whole context.

projects.name: MI-GAN
projects.description: [ICCV 2023] MI-GAN: A Simple Baseline for Image Inpainting on Mobile Devices
projects.summary: 面向手機嘅圖像修補基線，用蒸餾同重參數化將模型壓到可以喺流動裝置跑。重點係移除物件之後仍然看得清楚，而唔使靠桌面級顯卡。ICCV 2023。想喺手機做擦除，呢套比桌面大模型實際。
projects.summary_en: A mobile-oriented image-inpainting baseline that uses distillation and reparameterization to compress the model so it can run on a mobile device. The emphasis is that the image still looks clear after an object is removed, without relying on a desktop-class GPU. ICCV 2023. If you want erasure on a phone, this is more practical than a large desktop model.

projects.name: ZITS_inpainting
projects.description: [CVPR 2022] Incremental Transformer Structure Enhanced Image Inpainting with Masking Positional Encoding
projects.summary: CVPR 2022 嘅結構增強圖像修補。先逐步補回線條同邊緣，再用遮罩位置編碼填紋理，等建築物同規則物件唔會補完變形。缺口入面有直線或者輪廓時，結構會先被還原，顏色先至跟住填。
projects.summary_en: Structure-enhanced image inpainting from CVPR 2022. It first restores lines and edges step by step, then fills texture with mask position encoding, so buildings and regular objects do not end up warped. When the gap contains straight lines or outlines, the structure is restored first and the color is filled afterward.

projects.name: Pluralistic-Inpainting
projects.description: [CVPR 2019]: Pluralistic Image Completion
projects.summary: 同一個缺口可以生成幾種都合理嘅補法，而唔係只交一個答案。缺口太大、其實有多種合理內容時，你可以再揀最夾畫面嘅一張。CVPR 2019 嘅多元圖像補全。唔會強迫每一張圖只得一種填法。
projects.summary_en: The same gap can be filled in several ways that are all plausible, rather than returning only one answer. When the hole is large and more than one content would be reasonable, you can pick the one that fits the picture best. This is pluralistic image completion from CVPR 2019. It does not force every image to have only one way of being filled.

projects.name: AOT-GAN-for-Inpainting
projects.description: [TVCG'2023] AOT-GAN for High-Resolution Image Inpainting (codebase for image inpainting)
projects.summary: 用聚合上下文變換喺高解析度圖像做修補，幾個尺度一齊睇缺口周圍。比單尺度卷積容易對齊大圖嘅紋理，適合高清相要補一塊。TVCG 2023 嘅圖像修補程式。高清圖補洞時，細尺度同大尺度會一齊用。
projects.summary_en: High-resolution image inpainting with aggregated contextual transformations, looking around the gap at several scales together. It aligns texture in a large image more easily than single-scale convolution, and it suits high-resolution photos that need a region filled. This is an image-inpainting program from TVCG 2023. When filling a high-resolution image, fine and coarse scales are used together.

projects.name: mmagic
projects.description: OpenMMLab Multimodal Advanced, Generative, and Intelligent Creation Toolbox. Unlock the magic 🪄: Generative-AI (AIGC), easy-to-use APIs, awsome model zoo, diffusion models, for text-to-image generation, image/video restoration/enhancement, etc.
projects.summary: OpenMMLab 嘅生成同創作工具箱，用嚟做文字生圖、圖像同影片修復、放大同編輯。模型同訓練腳本都有現成接口，修補只係其中一種任務。想喺同一個程式庫試多種生成模型，可以喺度切換，而唔使每隻模型各裝一套。
projects.summary_en: OpenMMLab's toolbox for generation and creation, used for text-to-image, image and video restoration, upscaling, and editing. Models and training scripts already have ready interfaces, and inpainting is only one of the tasks. If you want to try several generative models in the same library, you can switch among them here without installing a separate stack for each model.

projects.name: vllm-omni
projects.description: A framework for efficient model inference with omni-modality models
projects.summary: vLLM 嘅多模態推理框架，用嚟高效跑圖像、聲音同影片生成模型。重點係部署同吞吐，而唔係畫布或者剪輯介面。你可以喺自己部機開服務，讓其他程式呼叫呢啲模型。適合要同時服務幾種模態嘅後端。
projects.summary_en: vLLM's multimodal inference framework for running image, audio, and video generation models efficiently. The focus is deployment and throughput, not a canvas or an editing interface. You can start a service on your own machine and let other programs call these models. It suits a backend that needs to serve several modalities at once.

projects.name: pyJianYingDraft
projects.description: 轻量、灵活、易上手的Python剪映草稿生成及导出工具，构建全自动化视频剪辑/混剪流水线。本项目的CapCut版本正于 https://github.com/GuanYixuan/pyCapCut 内开发
projects.summary: 用 Python 生成剪映草稿嘅工具。你可以程式化擺影片、圖片、時間軸同效果，再匯出草稿去剪映繼續改，用嚟砌自動剪輯流水線。CapCut 版本喺另一個倉庫開發。適合要批量出片，又想留低可以再編輯嘅草稿。
projects.summary_en: A Python tool that generates Jianying drafts. You can place video, images, a timeline, and effects in code, then export the draft into Jianying and keep editing, which is a way to build an automatic editing pipeline. The CapCut version is developed in another repository. It suits people who need to produce videos in batches and still want drafts that can be edited again.

projects.name: neuralangelo
projects.description: Official implementation of "Neuralangelo: High-Fidelity Neural Surface Reconstruction" (CVPR 2023)
projects.summary: NVIDIA 嘅高保真神經表面重建，用嚟由相片恢復細緻嘅三維曲面，輪廓比早年神經輻射場更貼物件。CVPR 2023 官方程式。產出係曲面網格，而唔係一張貼圖或者一段影片。適合由實拍重建物件外形。
projects.summary_en: NVIDIA's high-fidelity neural surface reconstruction, for recovering a detailed 3D surface from photos, with contours that fit the object more closely than earlier neural radiance fields. This is the official code from CVPR 2023. The output is a surface mesh, not a texture or a video. It suits reconstructing an object's shape from real footage.

projects.name: Riskfolio-Lib
projects.description: Portfolio Optimization in Python
projects.summary: 用 Python 做投資組合優化嘅程式庫。你可以計有效前沿、風險同權重，比較唔同配置。佢係研究工具，而唔係自動向券商落盤嘅程式。適合做資產配置同風險分析，落單要自己另接交易接口。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for portfolio optimization. You can compute the efficient frontier, risk, and weights, and compare different allocations. It is a research tool, not a program that automatically places orders with a broker. It suits asset allocation and risk analysis, and placing orders requires you to connect a trading interface separately.

projects.name: sdnext
projects.description: SD.Next: All-in-one WebUI for AI generative image and video creation, captioning and processing
projects.summary: SD.Next 係一個本地網頁界面，用嚟跑擴散模型生成同編輯圖像，亦可以處理影片同寫描述。佢支援多種顯示卡同 CPU，模型可以換。適合想要一個持續更新嘅 Stable Diffusion 工作台，而唔係只靠舊版介面。
projects.summary_en: SD.Next is a local web interface for running diffusion models to generate and edit images, and it can also handle video and write descriptions. It supports many GPUs and CPUs, and the model can be swapped. It suits people who want a Stable Diffusion workbench that keeps being updated, rather than relying only on an older interface.

projects.name: stable-diffusion-webui-docker
projects.description: Easy Docker setup for Stable Diffusion with user-friendly UI
projects.summary: 用 Docker 跑 Stable Diffusion 網頁界面嘅安裝包。你唔使自己砌 Python 環境，就可以開現成介面出圖。倉庫本身唔係模型，而係將已有界面包成容器。適合想快啲喺自己部機跑出圖服務嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An install package for running the Stable Diffusion web interface with Docker. You can open a ready-made interface and generate images without building a Python environment yourself. The repository itself is not a model. It packages an existing interface as a container. It suits people who want to run an image-generation service on their own machine quickly.

projects.name: echomimic_v2
projects.description: [CVPR 2025] EchoMimicV2: Towards Striking, Simplified, and Semi-Body Human Animation
projects.summary: 螞蟻集團嘅半身人像動畫，用聲音驅動人講嘢同埋身體動作。你可以畀一段聲同參考圖，生成對嘴同姿勢嘅影片。CVPR 2025。重點係人像表演，而唔係一般剪片或者文字生片。適合做口播同虛擬人。
projects.summary_en: Ant Group's half-body portrait animation, which uses audio to drive speech and body movement. You can give it an audio clip and a reference image, and it generates a video with matched lips and pose. CVPR 2025. The focus is portrait performance, not general video editing or text-to-video. It suits talking-head videos and virtual humans.

projects.name: HunyuanVideo-1.5
projects.description: HunyuanVideo-1.5: A leading lightweight video generation model
projects.summary: 騰訊混元嘅輕量影片生成模型，可以由文字或者圖片出片。重點係模型細、容易跑，同時保持可睇嘅畫面。官方程式同權重說明喺呢個倉庫。適合想喺自己部機試文字生片，而唔使先部署超大模型。
projects.summary_en: Tencent Hunyuan's lightweight video generation model, which can make a video from text or from an image. The focus is a small model that is easy to run while keeping a watchable picture. The official code and the notes on the weights are in this repository. It suits people who want to try text-to-video on their own machine without deploying an extremely large model first.

projects.name: alphalens
projects.description: Performance analysis of predictive (alpha) stock factors
projects.summary: 用嚟評估選股因子有幾準嘅 Python 庫。你可以睇一個信號同之後回報嘅關係、分組收益同換手，再決定值唔值得拿去回測。佢係研究工具，而唔係落盤程式。Quantopian 已經停運，程式仍然可以用嚟做因子分析。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for judging how accurate a stock-selection factor is. You can look at how a signal relates to later returns, grouped returns, and turnover, and then decide whether it is worth taking into a backtest. It is a research tool, not an order-placing program. Quantopian has shut down, but the code can still be used for factor analysis.

projects.name: civitai
projects.description: A repository of models, textual inversions, and more
projects.summary: Civitai 嘅開源程式，用嚟營運一個分享模型、文字反轉同 LoRA 嘅社群網站。你可以瀏覽、上傳同下載別人訓練嘅權重，而唔係喺度由文字生圖。適合想自己架一個模型分享站，或者睇吓個平台點樣做成。
projects.summary_en: Civitai's open-source program for running a community site that shares models, textual inversions, and LoRAs. You can browse, upload, and download weights trained by other people, rather than generating images from text here. It suits people who want to host a model-sharing site themselves, or see how the platform is built.

projects.name: Auto-Photoshop-StableDiffusion-Plugin
projects.description: A user-friendly plug-in that makes it easy to generate stable diffusion images inside Photoshop using either Automatic or ComfyUI as a backend.
projects.summary: Photoshop 插件，用嚟喺 Photoshop 入面直接叫 Stable Diffusion 出圖同改圖。後端可以係 Automatic1111，亦可以接 ComfyUI。你留喺原本嘅圖層同工具，唔使將圖匯出再貼返。插件本身唔係模型。
projects.summary_en: A Photoshop plugin for calling Stable Diffusion directly inside Photoshop to generate and edit images. The backend can be Automatic1111, and it can also connect to ComfyUI. You stay with the original layers and tools, without exporting the image and pasting it back. The plugin itself is not a model.

projects.name: auto-subs
projects.description: On-device subtitle generation that connects directly to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects.
projects.summary: 喺自己部電腦做字幕嘅工具，聲同片唔使上傳。可以獨立用，亦可以駁 DaVinci Resolve、Premiere 同 After Effects。支援多語言轉錄同翻譯，仲可以分辨邊個講緊嘢。適合要本地出字幕、又想直接入剪輯軟件嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A tool for making subtitles on your own computer, so the audio and video do not have to be uploaded. It can be used on its own, and it can also connect to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects. It supports multilingual transcription and translation, and it can tell who is speaking. It suits people who need local subtitles and want them to go straight into editing software.

projects.name: Finance
projects.description: Python toolkit for quantitative finance: stock analysis, technical indicators, strategy backtesting, portfolio optimization, and financial modeling.
projects.summary: 用 Python 做量化研究嘅工具包。你可以拎行情、計技術指標、篩股票、回測策略同做組合優化。例子係起點，規則要自己改。佢係研究工具，而唔係自動向券商落盤嘅程式。適合想由數據開始試策略嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A Python toolkit for quantitative research. You can pull market data, compute technical indicators, screen stocks, backtest strategies, and optimize a portfolio. The examples are a starting point, and you change the rules yourself. It is a research tool, not a program that automatically places orders with a broker. It suits people who want to try a strategy starting from the data.

projects.name: zvt
projects.description: modular quant framework.
projects.summary: 模組化嘅量化框架，用嚟統一攞行情、做因子同回測。股票係主要對象，亦涵蓋加密貨幣數據。你可以換數據源同策略，而唔使每種市場各寫一套。適合想用同一套程式研究唔同市場嘅人。交易執行要自己另接。
projects.summary_en: A modular quantitative framework for pulling market data, building factors, and backtesting in one place. Stocks are the main subject, and it also covers cryptocurrency data. You can swap the data source and the strategy without writing a separate stack for each market. It suits people who want to study different markets with the same program. You have to connect trade execution yourself.

projects.name: champ
projects.description: [ECCV 2024] Champ: Controllable and Consistent Human Image Animation with 3D Parametric Guidance
projects.summary: 用三維參數引導嘅人像動畫，可以將一張人像按動作變成穩定影片。ECCV 2024。重點係人物動作同外觀保持一致，而唔係一般文字生片。適合由一張相做人物動畫研究。官方程式對住論文。
projects.summary_en: Portrait animation guided by 3D parameters, which can turn one portrait into a stable video according to the motion. ECCV 2024. The focus is keeping the person's motion and appearance consistent, not general text-to-video. It suits research on character animation from a single photo. The official code follows the paper.

projects.name: FreeVideo
projects.description: Make videos on the computer you already own. FreeVideo runs MiniMax H3 in as little as 8 GB of VRAM and 16 GB of RAM, and adapts its acceleration path to your hardware.
projects.summary: 喺家用電腦跑 MiniMax H3 出片嘅推理引擎，顯存可以低到 8GB。佢按顯示卡揀精度，並將權重分批載入，唔使成個模型一次過放喺顯存。介面係 ComfyUI 工作區，另有 Windows、Mac 同 Linux 啟動器。模型係現成嘅，呢個倉庫負責喺本機跑。
projects.summary_en: An inference engine for running MiniMax H3 video generation on a home computer, with VRAM that can be as low as 8GB. It chooses precision according to the GPU and loads the weights in batches, so the whole model does not have to sit in VRAM at once. The interface is a ComfyUI workspace, with launchers for Windows, Mac, and Linux as well. The model is an existing one, and this repository runs it locally.

projects.name: anatomy
projects.description: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
projects.summary: Claude 嘅 skill，用嚟將一個概念畫成可以互動嘅等軸測機械圖。輸出係 SVG、WebGL 或者三維，零件分得細。佢叫編程助手砌一個睇得明嘅物件，而唔係只回一段文字。亦可以喺 Codex 同 OpenCode 用。
projects.summary_en: A Claude skill for turning a concept into an interactive isometric mechanical diagram. The output is SVG, WebGL, or 3D, with the parts broken down finely. It asks a coding assistant to build an object you can understand, rather than only returning a passage of text. It can also be used in Codex and OpenCode.

projects.name: android-ad-cleaner
projects.description: 关掉国产安卓手机系统里的广告、热搜、资讯推荐和营销推送。不 root，可还原，支持 AI 智能体一键执行。
projects.summary: 用嚟關掉國產安卓手機入面嘅廣告、熱搜同推銷通知。唔使 root，改動可以還原。可以插上手機用桌面程式撳，亦可以交俾 AI agent 一次過執行。適合想清走系統廣告、又唔想刷機嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A tool for turning off ads, hot-search prompts, and promotional notifications on Chinese-brand Android phones. It does not need root, and the changes can be undone. You can plug in the phone and click through a desktop program, or hand it to an AI agent to run all at once. It suits people who want to clear system ads without flashing the phone.

projects.name: digital-human-koubo
projects.description: AI digital-human talking-head videos from one photo: Renoise MCP generation + 5 editing styles + 48 creator-grade packaging components. Agent skill for Claude Code / Codex / OpenClaw / WorkBuddy …
projects.summary: 一個 agent skill，用一張相同一句稿生成數字人口播片。佢叫 Renoise 嘅服務做對嘴同包裝，而唔係喺你部機由零訓練模型。適合想交俾 Claude Code 或者 Codex 出一條口播片嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that generates a digital-human talking-head video from one photo and one script. It calls Renoise's service for lip sync and packaging, rather than training a model from scratch on your machine. It suits people who want to hand the job to Claude Code or Codex to produce a talking-head video.

projects.name: day-trader-skill
projects.description: 11 Claude skills for day trading: scan thousands of charts, track breaking news, time every entry and exit, and replay every outcome before you risk a dollar.
projects.summary: 一組 Claude skill，用免費公開數據掃圖、追新聞同重播舊走勢。你可以喺落單之前睇返一個形態之後點行。佢係研究同覆盤工具，而唔係券商落盤程式，亦唔會保證賺到錢。
projects.summary_en: A set of Claude skills that scan charts, follow the news, and replay old price paths using free public data. Before you place an order, you can look back at how a pattern moved afterward. It is a research and review tool, not a broker order-placing program, and it does not guarantee that you will make money.

projects.name: effectcraft
projects.description: EffectCraft: An open-source motion graphics and compositing tool written by scratch in pure Rust
projects.summary: 用 Rust 寫嘅開源動態圖形同合成軟件。你可以喺時間線上砌畫面同效果，而唔使靠訂閱制嘅合成工具。程式由作者自己寫，適合想有一個輕量合成器嘅人。同剪輯成片係兩種工作。
projects.summary_en: Open-source motion-graphics and compositing software written in Rust. You can build frames and effects on a timeline without relying on a subscription compositing tool. The program is written by the author, and it suits people who want a lightweight compositor. Compositing and editing a finished film are two different jobs.

projects.name: qwen21-nsfw-pose-skill
projects.description: Qwen-Image 2.1 NSFW/姿势出图 skill：作者级提示词配方 + NSFW LoRA + 136 姿势 VNCCS 人偶控制；适用 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / OpenClaw
projects.summary: 一個 agent skill，用嚟喺 ComfyUI 入面用 Qwen-Image 按姿勢出圖。配方包括提示詞、成人向 LoRA 同一百幾個三維姿勢。適合想用編程助手跟住固定步驟出圖嘅人。內容係成人向，唔係一般插畫工具。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for generating images from a pose with Qwen-Image inside ComfyUI. The recipe includes prompts, an adult-oriented LoRA, and more than a hundred 3D poses. It suits people who want a coding assistant to follow fixed steps and produce the images. The content is adult-oriented, not a general illustration tool.

projects.name: anymove
projects.description: Motion capture for any creature from one AI video: two cameras in one frame, a DINOv2 joint reader, the rig fitted in both views, a GLB out.
projects.summary: 由一段片捉任何生物嘅動作，再套上骨骼輸出 GLB。同一幀有兩個機位，用嚟對齊關節。亦可以當 agent skill 交俾編程助手跑。適合遊戲同三維角色要動作、又冇動作捕捉棚嘅人。
projects.summary_en: It captures the motion of any creature from a video, fits that motion onto a skeleton, and exports GLB. The same frame has two camera views, used to align the joints. It can also be used as an agent skill and handed to a coding assistant to run. It suits games and 3D characters that need motion and do not have a motion-capture studio.

projects.name: deepopen-3d-webs
projects.description: Image-driven 3D scene generation system. Users provide a reference image and prompt words, and the system generates previewable, replayable, and traceable scene results according to the camera trajectory; official 3D demonstration assets allow direct viewing of color/depth animations and Gaussian point clouds in the browser 图像驱动的三维场景生成系统
projects.summary: 用一張參考圖同提示詞，沿住鏡頭軌跡生成可以預覽嘅三維場景。瀏覽器可以播顏色、深度同高斯點雲。網站用 Docker 起。適合想由一張相行出一段可重播場景，而唔係只得一張靜態圖。
projects.summary_en: From one reference image and a prompt, it generates a previewable 3D scene along a camera path. The browser can play color, depth, and a Gaussian point cloud. The site is started with Docker. It suits people who want to go from one photo to a replayable scene, rather than ending with only a still image.

projects.name: open-higgsfield
projects.description: A studio for image and video generation — one prompt bar, each model’s own settings, and every finished run in one gallery.
projects.summary: 一個開源嘅圖像同影片工作室，用一條提示詞呼叫多個現成模型。你要自己帶平台鑰匙，工作室本身唔係模型。適合想喺同一個畫面試唔同出圖同出片模型、又唔想被單一網站綁住嘅人。
projects.summary_en: An open-source image and video studio that calls several existing models with one prompt. You have to bring your own platform keys. The studio itself is not a model. It suits people who want to try different image and video models on the same screen without being locked to a single website.

projects.name: RSI-Anything
projects.description: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
projects.summary: 研究點樣用世界模型做遞迴自我改進。系統先預測下一步結果，再由互動入面學，然後改下一次決定。倉庫跟住論文。適合睇世界模型點樣參與決策，而唔係一個可以即刻玩嘅遊戲。
projects.summary_en: Research on using world models for recursive self-improvement. The system first predicts the next outcome, then learns from the interaction, and then changes the next decision. The repository follows the paper. It suits seeing how a world model takes part in a decision, not a game you can play right away.

projects.name: stickman-video-director
projects.description: Turn any script into viral, multi-style animated stickman videos for Faceless YouTube Channels. Automate visuals, voiceover, captions & SFX. 100% Free & Open-Source.
projects.summary: 將稿或者題目變成火柴人動畫片嘅開源流程。畫面、配音、字幕同音效可以一次過砌。適合做冇露臉嘅頻道，而唔使自己逐格畫。輸出係成片，唔係淨係一張分鏡。成片留喺你部電腦。
projects.summary_en: An open-source pipeline that turns a script or a topic into a stick-figure animation. Picture, voiceover, subtitles, and sound effects can be assembled in one pass. It suits faceless channels, without drawing every frame yourself. The output is a finished video, not only a storyboard. The finished video stays on your computer.

projects.name: easy-stock
projects.description: A股行情分析与AI智能投研智能体：股票分析、量化交易分析、盘后复盘桌面工作台——easy stock
projects.summary: A 股嘅桌面投研工作台。你可以睇行情、做個股研究同盤後復盤，再叫 AI 整理證據。佢係分析工具，而唔係自動向券商落盤嘅程式。適合想喺自己部機做復盤嘅人。判斷要你自己落。
projects.summary_en: A desktop investment-research workbench for A-shares. You can watch quotes, research individual stocks, and review after the close, then ask an AI to organize the evidence. It is an analysis tool, not a program that automatically places orders with a broker. It suits people who want to do that review on their own machine. You make the judgment yourself.

projects.name: blender-plugin
projects.description: Scenario for Blender: AI images, video, 3D and PBR materials in the viewport, plus a local MCP server for agents. Blender 5.0+ extension, GPL-3.0-or-later.
projects.summary: Scenario 嘅 Blender 擴充，可以喺視窗入面生成圖像、影片、三維模型同 PBR 材質。另外開一個本地 MCP，等 agent 可以叫到呢啲功能。需要 Blender 5.0 或更新。生成係呼叫佢哋嘅服務，唔係 Blender 內置模型。
projects.summary_en: Scenario's Blender add-on, which can generate images, video, 3D models, and PBR materials in the viewport. It also opens a local MCP so an agent can call these features. It requires Blender 5.0 or newer. Generation calls their service, and it is not a model built into Blender.

projects.name: aidea
projects.description: An APP that integrates mainstream large language models and image generation models, built with Flutter, with fully open-source code.
projects.summary: 用 Flutter 寫嘅手機應用，將多個大語言模型同圖像生成模型放喺同一個程式。你可以聊天，亦可以出圖，模型接口可以換。程式開源。適合想喺手機用自己嘅鑰匙接唔同模型嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A mobile app written in Flutter that puts several large language models and image-generation models in one program. You can chat and also generate images, and the model interface can be swapped. The program is open source. It suits people who want to connect different models on a phone with their own keys.

projects.name: tstack
projects.description: The agent skills I use every day. Works with Claude Code and Codex.
projects.summary: Theo 每日用嘅 agent skill 合集，清理到其他人都可以用。可以喺 Claude Code 同 Codex 跑，有 T3 Code 時會用佢嘅功能，冇就退返原生工具。適合想直接用一套日常開發技能，而唔使由零寫 skill。
projects.summary_en: A collection of the agent skills Theo uses every day, cleaned up so other people can use them. They can run in Claude Code and Codex. When T3 Code is present they use its features, and when it is not they fall back to the native tools. It suits people who want a ready set of everyday development skills without writing skills from scratch.

projects.name: ex-ussr-kinship-research
projects.description: Evidence-first genealogy skill for AI agents (Codex, Claude Code): church books, civil, military, deportation and repression records across the former USSR. Replies in your language.
projects.summary: 畀 AI agent 用嘅族譜 skill，專門查前蘇聯、蘇聯同俄羅斯帝國嘅親屬紀錄。佢會讀教堂冊、民事、軍事同流放檔案，並且分開已證實同推測。適合要追查家族、又想每條資料留低出處嘅人。
projects.summary_en: A genealogy skill for AI agents, specifically for looking up kinship records from the former Soviet Union, the Soviet Union, and the Russian Empire. It reads church registers and civil, military, and exile archives, and it separates what is confirmed from what is inferred. It suits people who need to trace a family and want every item to keep its source.

projects.name: moli
projects.description: Best headless browser for AI agents. Lite, Fast, High-Compatibility. Built in Rust
projects.summary: 用 Rust 寫嘅無頭瀏覽器，畀 AI agent 操控網頁。重點係輕、快、相容性高。你可以喺冇視窗嘅環境打開頁面同做操作。適合想用自己嘅 agent 瀏覽網頁，而唔使靠一個厚重瀏覽器。
projects.summary_en: A headless browser written in Rust for an AI agent to control web pages. The emphasis is that it is light, fast, and highly compatible. You can open pages and carry out actions in an environment with no window. It suits people who want their own agent to browse the web without relying on a heavy browser.

projects.name: MOSS-Image
projects.description: Official repository for MOSS-Image, a 5B-parameter base DiT model with high-quality text rendering, layout generation, and efficient fine-tuning.
projects.summary: OpenMOSS 嘅 50 億參數圖像模型，擅長畫入面嘅文字同版面。可以微調。官方程式同權重說明喺度。適合要文字渲染清楚嘅生圖，而唔係一個畫布軟件。模型要自己下載再跑。
projects.summary_en: OpenMOSS's image model with 5 billion parameters, strong at text inside images and at layout. It can be fine-tuned. The official code and the notes on the weights are here. It suits image generation that needs clearly rendered text, not a canvas application. You have to download the model yourself and then run it.

projects.name: pele
projects.description: Renders Mermaid diagrams faster than you'd run from a volcano! 🌋
projects.summary: Obsidian 官方嘅 Mermaid 圖渲染器，將圖表轉成 SVG。程式細、同步執行、冇運行時依賴，顏色跟 CSS 變數。支援 Mermaid 12 嘅圖種。適合要快啲出流程圖，而唔係做影片合成。
projects.summary_en: Obsidian's official Mermaid diagram renderer, which turns diagrams into SVG. The program is small, runs synchronously, and has no runtime dependencies, and its colors follow CSS variables. It supports the diagram types in Mermaid 12. It suits producing a flowchart quickly, not doing video compositing.

projects.name: openfilm
projects.description: The open source AI video agent: turns any coding agent into a video agent, with an editor to change anything it makes.
projects.summary: 開源嘅 AI 影片 agent。你可以將而家用緊嘅編程助手變成出片助手，做完仲有編輯器改佢生成嘅畫面。適合想用對話砌片、又想事後逐段改，而唔係只收一條成品。生成同剪接留喺同一條流程。
projects.summary_en: An open-source AI video agent. You can turn the coding assistant you are already using into a video assistant, and after it finishes there is still an editor for changing the frames it generated. It suits people who want to build a video through conversation and then edit it section by section, rather than only receiving a finished piece. Generation and editing stay in the same workflow.

projects.name: pdoom-video
projects.description: Code-rendered music video for "I'm Upping My P(doom)"
projects.summary: 一條用程式渲染嘅音樂影片，字幕跟住歌嘅時間。每一幀由歌曲時間決定，所以瀏覽器預覽同匯出嘅 1080p 或 4K 一樣。佢係呢首歌嘅作品，而唔係通用嘅出片工具。可以喺自己部機再渲染。
projects.summary_en: A music video rendered by a program, with subtitles timed to the song. Each frame is determined by the song's time, so the browser preview matches the exported 1080p or 4K. It is a work for this song, not a general video-making tool. You can render it again on your own machine.

projects.name: web-ocean
projects.description: Real-time WebGPU ocean renderer written from scratch, no engine. FFT waves, whitecaps, sun glitter, physically based sunset sky with clouds, free camera. Built with Claude Code (Opus 5.5). Opens from a single 61 KB HTML file in Chrome.
projects.summary: 一個 WebGPU 海洋渲染示範，單一 HTML 檔就可以喺 Chrome 打開。有 FFT 海浪、白沫、陽光同日落天空。你可以自由飛攝影機。冇遊戲引擎。適合睇即時水面點樣寫，而唔係一套三維軟件。
projects.summary_en: A WebGPU ocean-rendering demo. A single HTML file can open it in Chrome. It has FFT waves, foam, sunlight, and a sunset sky. You can fly the camera freely. There is no game engine. It suits looking at how a real-time water surface is written, not a 3D software package.

projects.name: jaaz
projects.description: The world's first open-source multimodal creative assistant  This is a substitute for Canva and Manus that prioritizes privacy and is usable locally.
projects.summary: 開源嘅多模態創作助手，可以本地跑，用嚟做設計同生成，定位係 Canva 一類工具嘅替代。私隱優先。適合想喺自己部機做圖文創作，而唔使將稿交去一個訂閱網站。稿同對話都可以留喺本機。
projects.summary_en: An open-source multimodal creation assistant that can run locally, for design and generation, positioned as an alternative to tools like Canva. Privacy comes first. It suits people who want to create images and text on their own machine without handing drafts to a subscription website. Drafts and conversations can both stay on the machine.

projects.name: Text2Video-Zero
projects.description: [ICCV 2023 Oral] Text-to-Image Diffusion Models are Zero-Shot Video Generators
projects.summary: 用文字生圖嘅擴散模型，零樣本做出影片。唔使為影片再訓練一個新模型，就可以由文字或圖生成短片。ICCV 2023 口頭報告嘅官方程式。適合研究點樣由圖像模型延伸到影片。
projects.summary_en: It uses a text-to-image diffusion model to make video in a zero-shot way. Without training a new model for video, it can generate short clips from text or from an image. This is the official code for an ICCV 2023 oral. It suits research into how an image model can be extended to video.

projects.name: lightly
projects.description: A python library for self-supervised learning and latent world models on images.
projects.summary: Python 自監督學習庫，用嚟喺圖像上學表示，亦包含潛在世界模型。你可以喺未標註嘅圖上訓練，再將表示用落下游任務。適合做視覺預訓練，而唔係一個出片或交易程式。
projects.summary_en: A Python self-supervised learning library for learning representations on images, and it also includes latent world models. You can train on unlabeled images and then use the representations for downstream tasks. It suits visual pretraining, not a video-making program or a trading program.

projects.name: pyslam
projects.description: pySLAM is a hybrid Python/C++ Visual SLAM pipeline supporting monocular, stereo, and RGB-D cameras. It provides a broad set of modern local and global feature extractors, multiple loop-closure strategies, a volumetric reconstruction module, integrated depth-prediction models, and semantic segmentation capabilities for enhanced scene understanding.
projects.summary: Python 同 C++ 混合嘅視覺 SLAM。支援單目、雙目同 RGB-D，可以估相機點行，亦包含高斯潑濺同語意分割。適合做定位同重建研究。佢係完整流水線，而唔係淨係一個點雲檢視器。
projects.summary_en: Visual SLAM in a mix of Python and C++. It supports monocular, stereo, and RGB-D, can estimate how the camera moves, and also includes Gaussian splatting and semantic segmentation. It suits research on localization and reconstruction. It is a full pipeline, not only a point-cloud viewer.

projects.name: grok-build
projects.description: SpaceXAI's coding agent harness and TUI. Fullscreen, mouse interactive, extensible.
projects.summary: SpaceXAI 嘅終端編程 agent，全螢幕介面可以睇專案、改檔同跑指令。亦可以無介面跑，或者經 Agent Client Protocol 嵌進編輯器。程式用 Rust 寫，由佢哋嘅主倉庫同步出嚟。適合想喺終端交辦開發，而唔使開一個網頁聊天窗。
projects.summary_en: SpaceXAI's terminal coding agent. The full-screen interface can view a project, edit files, and run commands. It can also run with no interface, or be embedded in an editor through the Agent Client Protocol. The program is written in Rust and is synced from their main repository. It suits handing development work to the terminal without opening a web chat window.

projects.name: replica-skill
projects.description: Eleven free Claude skills that clone any app: reverse-engineer it, rebuild it, test it for bugs, then fix what its users hate. Free, MIT.
projects.summary: 十一個 Claude skill，用嚟拆解一個 app 嘅流程，再由 agent 重新砌一個。佢要求只重建功能，唔抄程式、標誌同文案。可以喺 Claude Code 當插件裝。適合想用技能包試做同類產品，而唔係一個現成嘅應用程式。
projects.summary_en: Eleven Claude skills for taking apart an app's workflow and having an agent build one again. They require that only the functionality be rebuilt, without copying the code, the logo, or the copy. They can be installed as a plugin in Claude Code. It suits people who want to use a skill pack to try a similar product, not a ready-made application.

projects.name: BeautifulRust
projects.description: Agent Skills that teach coding agents to write, review, and port idiomatic Rust, plus a tested clippy config. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor, and Gemini CLI.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅 Rust skill。一個教寫得地道，一個負責審查同指出邊條規則，一個將 C、Python 等程式搬去 Rust。另有一份 clippy 設定可以放喺 CI。適合想 agent 寫 Rust 時跟官方風格，而唔使每次自己貼指南。
projects.summary_en: Rust skills for coding agents. One teaches idiomatic writing, one handles review and points out which rule applies, and one ports programs from C, Python, and other languages to Rust. There is also a clippy configuration that can be placed in CI. It suits people who want an agent to follow the official style when writing Rust, without pasting a guide themselves every time.

projects.name: Genjustsu-Open-Source-Workflow
projects.description: Open-source AI video replacement workflow by TEIN. Combine depth maps, SAM segmentation, face meshes, and audio processing to replace characters and objects with Seedance. Includes a local web UI to prepare inputs, review masks, preview generations, and export with original audio.
projects.summary: 本地介面，用嚟換片入面嘅人或物件。佢準備深度、SAM 遮罩同面網，再交畀 Seedance 生成，匯出時保留原本成段聲音。要另外接 Enhancor 嘅 API。適合做角色替換，而唔係一個自己訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A local interface for replacing a person or an object in a video. It prepares depth, a SAM mask, and a face mesh, then hands them to Seedance to generate, and on export it keeps the original audio for the whole clip. You need to connect the Enhancor API separately. It suits character replacement, and it is not a video model trained by this project.

projects.name: BeefTV
projects.description: High-performance · Lightweight · AI Native Video workspace. 面向 AI 时代的视频创作工作台。 在画布中，和Agent一起自由连接创意和素材。
projects.summary: 本地優先嘅 AI 影片工作台，喺畫布入面連接素材、模型同 agent。桌面版可以喺自己部機跑，由分鏡改到成片。新代碼要商業使用就另外授權。適合想喺畫布砌片，而唔係一個由零訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A local-first AI video workbench that connects assets, models, and agents on a canvas. The desktop version can run on your own machine, from storyboard changes through to a finished film. Commercial use of the new code requires a separate license. It suits people who want to build a video on a canvas, and it is not a video model trained from scratch.

projects.name: anything2explainer
projects.description: Topic in, narrated explainer video out. A Claude Code / Codex skill that turns any topic into a black-canvas motion-graphics explainer video with TTS voiceover, subtitles and a chapter progress bar. Chinese or English; every frame drawn in code with Remotion.
projects.summary: 一個 Claude Code 同 Codex skill，用 Remotion 將題目畫成講解短片，有配音、字幕同章節條。每一幀係程式畫出嚟，唔係生成模型。中英文都可以。工具本身係非商業許可。適合用 agent 出講解片，而唔係收一條現成影片。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code and Codex skill that uses Remotion to turn a topic into an explainer short, with voiceover, subtitles, and a chapter bar. Every frame is drawn by code, not by a generative model. Both Chinese and English work. The tool itself is under a non-commercial license. It suits using an agent to produce an explainer, rather than receiving a ready-made video.

projects.name: mono-color-skill
projects.description: One-ink editorial print image skill — warm paper, halftone photography, active negative space, and restrained typography.
projects.summary: 一個圖像 skill，用嚟出單色或雙色嘅編輯風格圖，例如海報、小誌同人像。預設係一隻主色加少少點綴，白紙或暖紙底都可以。佢係風格指示，唔係一個新圖像模型。適合要印刷感嘅圖，而唔係一般彩色生圖。
projects.summary_en: An image skill for producing monochrome or two-color editorial images, such as posters, zines, and portraits. The default is one main color plus a small accent, and the background can be white paper or warm paper. It is style guidance, not a new image model. It suits images with a printed look, not ordinary full-color generation.

projects.name: Hi3Dv1.0
projects.description: Official Hi3D v1.0: high-resolution 3D geometry refinement built on Sparc3D. Inference code, model weights, and documentation.
projects.summary: Hi3D 嘅官方推論程式，用參考圖將粗網格修到更高解像度嘅幾何。底層係 Sparc3D，權重喺 Hugging Face。倉庫有推論，冇訓練碼。適合已有粗模型再加細節，而唔係由一張圖由零生成。
projects.summary_en: Hi3D's official inference program. It uses a reference image to refine a coarse mesh into higher-resolution geometry. The base is Sparc3D, and the weights are on Hugging Face. The repository has inference and no training code. It suits adding detail to a coarse model you already have, not generating from scratch from a single image.

projects.name: fugleramme
projects.description: Bird frame for Raspberry Pi or your homelab - real-time bird detection by audio, fully local AI, rendered as real, hand-cut 1800s bird illustrations. On an e-ink panel, a TV, or any screen.
projects.summary: 用本機聲音模型認花園入面嘅鳥，再顯示成十九世紀手繪插圖。可以放喺電子紙、電視或者樹莓派。識別喺自己部機做。聽到邊種就換邊張圖。適合架一個鳥相框，而唔係做影片合成或者三維場景。
projects.summary_en: It uses a local sound model to recognize birds in the garden, then displays them as nineteenth-century hand-drawn illustrations. It can sit on e-paper, a television, or a Raspberry Pi. Recognition is done on your own machine. Whichever species is heard, that picture is swapped in. It suits setting up a bird picture frame, not video compositing or a 3D scene.

projects.name: cats-blender-plugin
projects.description: :smiley_cat: A tool designed to shorten steps needed to import and optimize models into VRChat. Compatible models are: MMD, XNALara, Mixamo, DAZ/Poser, Blender Rigify, Sims 2, Motion Builder, 3DS Max and potentially more
projects.summary: Blender 外掛，用嚟將 MMD、Mixamo、DAZ 等模型整理好，再送去 VRChat。一鍵可以減面、做口型同步同眼神追蹤，仲會合併骨骼。適合縮短上載虛擬角色嘅步驟，而唔係一個渲染引擎。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on for tidying models from MMD, Mixamo, DAZ, and similar sources, then sending them to VRChat. One click can reduce the polygon count, set up lip sync and eye tracking, and merge bones. It suits shortening the steps for uploading a virtual character, and it is not a render engine.

projects.name: FinRL-Trading
projects.description: FinRL-X: An AI-Native Modular Infrastructure for Quantitative Trading
projects.summary: FinRL 系列嘅量化交易基建，叫 FinRL-X。佢將數據、策略、回測同券商下單收成同一套權重介面。有 PyPI 套件同論文。適合想由研究策略行到模擬落單，而唔係淨係一個強化學習教學庫。
projects.summary_en: Quantitative trading infrastructure in the FinRL series, called FinRL-X. It gathers data, strategies, backtesting, and broker order placement into one weight interface. There is a PyPI package and a paper. It suits people who want to go from researching a strategy to simulated order placement, rather than only a reinforcement-learning tutorial library.

projects.name: TradingAgents-astock
projects.description: A股多Agent投研框架 — 适配A股数据源(龙虎榜/游资/解禁等)，7位分析师基于A股规则的辩论决策，基于TradingAgents深度改造，适配大A。A-share multi-agent investment research framework — 7 AI analysts, bull/bear debate, risk assessment。
projects.summary: 將 TradingAgents 改到適合 A 股嘅多 agent 投研框架。七個分析師會按龍虎榜、解禁等數據辯論。可以用 pip 裝，定位係研究同教學。適合試多角色投研，而唔係一個自動落單嘅交易程式。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent investment-research framework that adapts TradingAgents for A-shares. Seven analysts debate using data such as the dragon-tiger list and lock-up expirations. It can be installed with pip, and it is positioned as research and teaching. It suits trying multi-role investment research, not an automatic order-placing trading program.

projects.name: lottie-web
projects.description: Render After Effects animations natively on Web, Android and iOS, and React Native. http://airbnb.io/lottie/
projects.summary: Airbnb 出嘅網頁 Lottie 播放器，用嚟播 After Effects 經 Bodymovin 匯出嘅 JSON 動畫。佢只負責喺瀏覽器播放，唔係剪片或合成軟件，動作要喺 AE 做好再匯出。
projects.summary_en: Airbnb's web Lottie player renders JSON exported from After Effects through Bodymovin. It only plays the animation in a browser. The motion is authored in AE or another tool, then exported.

projects.name: lottie-android
projects.description: Render After Effects animations natively on Android and iOS, Web, and React Native
projects.summary: Airbnb 嘅 Android Lottie 播放器，用嚟喺 App 播 After Effects 經 Bodymovin 匯出嘅動畫。佢係原生播放元件，唔係剪片軟件，動畫檔要由 AE 或其他工具先做好。
projects.summary_en: Airbnb's Android Lottie player renders animations exported from After Effects through Bodymovin. It is a native playback component, so the file is authored in AE or another tool first.

projects.name: lottie-ios
projects.description: An iOS library to natively render After Effects vector animations
projects.summary: Airbnb 嘅 iOS Lottie 播放器，用嚟喺 iPhone 同 iPad 播 After Effects 匯出嘅向量動畫。佢係播放元件，唔係時間軸編輯器，動作要喺 AE 做好再匯出。
projects.summary_en: Airbnb's iOS Lottie player renders vector animations exported from After Effects on iPhone and iPad. It is a playback component, so the motion is authored in AE and then exported.

projects.name: libpag
projects.description: The official rendering library for PAG (Portable Animated Graphics) files that renders After Effects animations natively across multiple platforms.
projects.summary: 騰訊出嘅 PAG 渲染庫，可以把 After Effects 動畫轉成跨平台檔，喺手機、網頁同桌面播放。PAG 同 Lottie JSON 係兩套格式。佢係播放方案，唔係完整嘅剪片或合成軟件。
projects.summary_en: Tencent's PAG renderer turns After Effects animations into a portable file and plays them on mobile, web, and desktop. PAG and Lottie JSON are different formats. It is a player, not a full editor or compositor.

projects.name: dotlottie-web
projects.description: High-performance Lottie & dotLottie web player powered by Rust + WASM, with React, Vue, Svelte, Solid & Web Components.
projects.summary: LottieFiles 嘅 dotLottie 網頁播放器，用 Rust 同 WebAssembly 播壓縮後嘅 Lottie。佢負責喺瀏覽器播 After Effects 匯出嘅動畫，唔係時間軸編輯器。
projects.summary_en: LottieFiles' dotLottie web player uses Rust and WebAssembly to play compressed Lottie files. It plays After Effects exports in the browser. It is a player, not a timeline editor.

projects.name: lottie-react-native
projects.description: Lottie wrapper for React Native.
projects.summary: React Native 用嘅 Lottie 元件，包住原生播放器，喺 App 播 After Effects 匯出嘅動畫。佢係框架包裝，唔係獨立剪片或合成軟件，動畫仍然要喺 AE 做好。
projects.summary_en: A React Native wrapper around the native Lottie players, used to play After Effects exports inside an app. It is a framework binding, so the animation is still authored in AE.

projects.name: rlottie
projects.description: A platform independent standalone library that plays Lottie Animation.
projects.summary: 三星出嘅 C++ Lottie 播放庫，可以獨立播 After Effects 經 Bodymovin 匯出嘅 JSON，唔使靠瀏覽器。佢係播放引擎，唔係剪片或合成軟件。
projects.summary_en: Samsung's standalone C++ library plays Lottie JSON exported from After Effects through Bodymovin, without a browser. It is a playback engine, not an editor or compositor.

projects.name: motionity
projects.description: The web-based motion graphics editor for everyone 📽
projects.summary: 瀏覽器入面嘅時間軸動態圖形編輯器，可以喺網頁剪動畫、加文字、貼圖同效果，再輸出成片。佢係編輯器，唔係節點合成軟件，亦唔使安裝 After Effects，開個瀏覽器就用到。
projects.summary_en: A timeline motion-graphics editor that runs in the browser, for cutting animation, type, images, and effects, then exporting a clip. It is an editor, not a node compositor. After Effects is not required; a browser is enough.

projects.name: tixl
projects.description: TiXL is an open source software to create realtime motion graphics.
projects.summary: 即時運算嘅動態圖形軟件，用節點同時間軸喺桌面做 motion，改參數可以即時睇到結果。佢係獨立程式，唔係 After Effects 外掛，動畫唔使先喺 AE 做好。
projects.summary_en: TiXL is a desktop app for realtime motion graphics, built with nodes and a timeline. Parameter changes show up immediately. It is a standalone program, not an After Effects plugin.

projects.name: mojs
projects.description: The motion graphics toolbelt for the web
projects.summary: 網頁動態圖形工具組，用程式喺瀏覽器畫形狀、做補間、時間軸同突發效果。動作全部用程式寫，唔使開 AE。佢係前端動畫庫，唔係 After Effects 外掛，亦唔係剪片軟件。
projects.summary_en: A motion-graphics toolbelt for the web. Code draws shapes, tweens, timelines, and burst effects in the browser. The motion is written in code, without opening AE. It is a front-end library, not an After Effects plugin or a video editor.

projects.name: astrofox
projects.description: Astrofox is a motion graphics program that lets you turn audio into stunning visuals.
projects.summary: 跟住音樂做畫面嘅動態圖形程式，可以按音軌生成視覺，畫面跟住節拍同頻譜郁，再輸出成片。佢專做音樂視覺，唔係一般剪片或合成軟件，亦唔使安裝 After Effects。
projects.summary_en: Astrofox is a motion-graphics program that turns an audio track into visuals that follow the beat and the spectrum, then exports a clip. It is built for music visualization, not general editing or compositing, and it does not need After Effects.

projects.name: motion-canvas
projects.description: Visualize Your Ideas With Code
projects.summary: 用 TypeScript 寫動態圖形嘅框架，喺程式入面排時間軸、做補間，再渲染成片。佢係寫程式做 motion，唔係 After Effects 外掛，部機亦唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: A framework for motion graphics written in TypeScript. You lay out a timeline and tweens in code, then render a video. It is code-driven motion, not an After Effects plugin, and AE is not required.

projects.name: theatre
projects.description: Motion design editor for the web
projects.summary: 網頁上嘅動態設計編輯器，可以用視覺時間軸調動畫，再交畀前端程式播放。佢係 motion design 工具，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係剪片軟件，部機唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: A motion-design editor for the web. You adjust animation on a visual timeline and hand it to front-end code to play. It is a motion-design tool, not After Effects or a video editor, and AE is not required.

projects.name: movis
projects.description: Python library for video editing, presentation video generation, motion graphics, shader art coding, and other video production tasks
projects.summary: 用 Python 寫影片同動態圖形嘅庫，可以排層、做 shader art，再渲染成片。佢係程式庫，唔係 After Effects 外掛，部機亦唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for video, motion graphics, and shader art. You stack layers and render from code. It is a library, not an After Effects plugin, and the machine does not need AE.

projects.name: manim
projects.description: A community-maintained Python framework for creating mathematical animations.
projects.summary: 用 Python 做數學動畫嘅社群版，適合講解公式同幾何，公式會一步步畫出嚟，再渲染成教學片。佢係教學影片工具，唔係商業 After Effects 合成，部機亦唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: The community Python framework for mathematical animation. It draws formulas and geometry step by step and renders a teaching film. It makes teaching videos, not commercial After Effects comps, and AE is not required.

projects.name: nexrender
projects.description: 📹  Data-driven render automation for After Effects
projects.summary: 用數據驅動 After Effects 自動渲染嘅工具，可以批量換文字同素材再輸出。部機一定要裝好 After Effects，佢先可以叫 AE 去 render。
projects.summary_en: Data-driven render automation for After Effects. It swaps text and footage in batches and outputs the renders. After Effects must be installed on the machine, because nexrender asks AE to render.

projects.name: Duik
projects.description: Duik Ángela | Rigging and animation tools for After Effects
projects.summary: Duik Ángela 係 After Effects 入面用嘅綁骨同角色動畫工具，可以幫圖層做骨架同控制器。佢係 AE 面板，唔係獨立三維軟件，部機要裝 After Effects。
projects.summary_en: Duik Ángela is a rigging and character-animation tool that runs inside After Effects, adding skeletons and controllers to layers. It is an AE panel, not a standalone 3D app, so After Effects must be installed.

projects.name: ntsc-rs
projects.description: Free, open-source VHS effect. Standalone application + plugin (After Effects, Premiere, and OpenFX).
projects.summary: 用 Rust 做類比電視同 VHS 畫面效果，可以獨立跑，亦有 After Effects、Premiere 同 OpenFX 外掛。佢係效果工具，唔係完整嘅合成軟件。
projects.summary_en: A Rust VHS and analog-TV look. It runs as a standalone app and also as a plugin for After Effects, Premiere, and OpenFX. It is an effect, not a full compositor.

projects.name: ISF4AE
projects.description: After Effects Plug-in enabling to use GLSL written in ISF as an effect
projects.summary: 把 GLSL 同 ISF shader 當成 After Effects 效果嚟用，可以喺 AE 入面跑自訂畫面。佢係 AE 外掛，唔係轉場素材包，部機要裝 After Effects。
projects.summary_en: An After Effects plugin that runs GLSL written as ISF, so a custom shader becomes an effect inside AE. It is a plugin, not a transition pack, and After Effects must be installed.

projects.name: animation_nodes
projects.description: Node based visual scripting system designed for motion graphics in Blender.
projects.summary: Blender 入面用節點做動態圖形嘅附加元件，可以程序化控制物件、時間同效果。佢係 Blender 工具，唔係 After Effects 外掛，部機唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on that builds motion graphics with nodes, driving objects, time, and effects procedurally. It runs in Blender, not as an After Effects plugin, so AE is not required.

projects.name: MOPS
projects.description: Motion OPerators for Houdini, a motion graphics toolkit.
projects.summary: Houdini 入面嘅 Motion Operators，用節點做動態圖形同程序化動畫。佢係 Houdini 工具，唔係 After Effects 圖層系統，部機亦唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: Motion Operators for Houdini, a node toolkit for motion graphics and procedural animation. It runs in Houdini, not on After Effects layers, and the machine does not need AE.

projects.name: commotion
projects.description: Blender add-on for motion graphics
projects.summary: Blender 嘅動態圖形附加元件，用嚟喺 Blender 做程序化動畫同效果。佢跑喺 Blender，唔係 After Effects 外掛，部機唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on for motion graphics, used to build procedural animation and effects inside Blender. It is not an After Effects plugin, and After Effects does not need to be installed.

projects.name: lottie-flutter
projects.description: Render After Effects animations natively on Flutter. This package is a pure Dart implementation of a Lottie player.
projects.summary: 用純 Dart 寫嘅 Flutter Lottie 播放器，喺 App 播 After Effects 匯出嘅動畫。佢係播放元件，唔係剪片軟件，動畫要喺 AE 做好再匯出。
projects.summary_en: A pure-Dart Flutter player for Lottie animations exported from After Effects. It is a playback widget, not a video editor, so the animation is authored in AE and then exported.

projects.name: thorvg
projects.description: A production-ready C++ vector graphics engine supporting SVG and Lottie formats, featuring advanced rendering backends such as WebGPU for high-performance graphics.
projects.summary: C++ 向量繪圖引擎，可以渲染 SVG 同 Lottie 動畫，適合嵌進其他程式。佢係底層繪圖庫，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係剪片軟件，部機唔使裝 AE。
projects.summary_en: A production C++ vector engine that renders SVG and Lottie, meant to be embedded in other programs. It is a graphics library, not After Effects and not a video editor, and AE is not required.

projects.name: totk-pc-recomp
projects.description: Static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom to native Windows x86-64, with a Vulkan renderer. Game files not included.
projects.summary: 將《薩爾達傳說 王國之淚》靜態重編譯成 Windows 程式，用 Vulkan 渲染。遊戲檔唔喺 repo，要自己合法擁有。佢係遊戲移植，唔係 Blender 或合成工具，而家仍然早期。
projects.summary_en: A static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom into a Windows program with a Vulkan renderer. Game files are not in the repo; you need your own legal copy. It is a game port, not a Blender or compositing tool, and it is still early.

projects.name: earshot
projects.description: Ears for coding agents: let AI hear, review and make sound. CPU-only, open source.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅聽覺工具，可以描述一段聲音、用程式造聲，再聽返嚟改。只靠 CPU，亦有 MCP。適合評 UI 聲同配樂。佢唔係剪片軟件，亦唔係新訓練嘅音樂模型。
projects.summary_en: Ears for coding agents: describe a sound, synthesize it in code, then listen and revise. It runs on CPU and includes an MCP server. It is for UI sounds and score, not a video editor or a newly trained music model.

projects.name: esp32-iphone-agent
projects.description: Let an AI model use a real iPhone with a $7 ESP32: AirPlay eyes, USB HID hands, any OpenAI-compatible vision model. No Mac, no developer account, no jailbreak.
projects.summary: 用一塊大約七美元嘅 ESP32 畀現成視覺模型操控一部真 iPhone：AirPlay 當眼，USB HID 當手。唔使 Mac、開發者帳號或越獄。佢係硬件橋，唔係新訓練嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: A roughly seven-dollar ESP32 lets an existing vision model use a real iPhone: AirPlay for eyes and USB HID for hands. No Mac, developer account, or jailbreak. It is a hardware bridge, not a newly trained model.

projects.name: ZCode
projects.description: Z.ai's coding agent harness. Powerful, intelligent, extensible.
projects.summary: Z.ai 出嘅 AI 編程工作台，有桌面、瀏覽器同終端 agent，repo 包含客戶端、後端同 agent 運行時。佢係寫程式嘅 harness，唔係圖像或剪片模型。
projects.summary_en: Z.ai's coding workbench, with desktop, browser, and terminal agents. The repo includes the client, backend, and agent runtime. It is a coding harness, not an image or video model.

projects.name: motionmaxxing
projects.description: Looksmaxxing for motion graphics. An agent skill that turns AI slop videos into films that look made by a motion designer.
projects.summary: 畀 agent 用嘅動態圖形 skill，用 Chrome 同 ffmpeg 渲染，想把 AI 片整得似 motion designer 做。佢係 skill 加渲染流程，唔係 After Effects 外掛。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for motion graphics. It renders with Chrome and ffmpeg and tries to make AI videos look like a motion designer's work. It is a skill plus a render path, not an After Effects plugin.

projects.name: Qwen-Image-2.1
projects.description: Qwen's most powerful open-source image generation model
projects.summary: 通義千問公開嘅圖像模型，視覺部分約七十億參數，可以文字生圖、改圖同出透明圖，亦支援最多十張參考圖。權重同程式喺度，但研究授權只畀研究同評估，商業用途要另外攞授權。
projects.summary_en: Qwen's released image model, about 7B parameters in the visual part. It does text-to-image, editing, transparent images, and up to ten reference images. Weights and code are included, under a research license for research and evaluation only; commercial use needs a separate license.

projects.name: design-agent
projects.description: Open-source design agent: on-brand stills, decks, diagrams, charts and motion graphics from a chat thread, built on Deep Agents.
projects.summary: LangChain 開放嘅設計 agent，喺對話入面做出符合品牌嘅靜態圖、簡報、圖表同動態圖像，建喺 Deep Agents 上面。唔係 After Effects，成品交畀程式同模型。
projects.summary_en: LangChain's open design agent. From a chat it makes on-brand stills, decks, charts, and motion graphics, built on Deep Agents. It is not After Effects; the files come from the agent and the model.

projects.name: StreamEval
projects.description: 🔥 The first-ever interactive streaming video generation benchmark.
projects.summary: 評測互動串流影片生成模型嘅基準同數據集，附論文、測試集同 Hugging Face 數據。佢用嚟量模型嘅即時互動表現，唔係一個會自己出片嘅生成器，亦唔係剪片軟件。
projects.summary_en: A benchmark and dataset for evaluating interactive streaming video-generation models, with a paper, a test set, and Hugging Face data. It measures realtime interaction. It does not generate the videos itself, and it is not a video editor.

projects.name: ChatAny
projects.description: 🌻 一键拥有你自己的 ChatGPT+众多AI 网页服务 | One click access to your own ChatGPT+Many AI web services
projects.summary: 已經停更嘅網頁，基於 ChatGPT-Next-Web，一鍵接上 ChatGPT 同多個 AI 服務，包括圖像。佢係聚合介面，唔係圖像模型，作者話呢個項目唔再維護。
projects.summary_en: An unmaintained web app based on ChatGPT-Next-Web. It connects ChatGPT and several AI services, including image tools. It is an aggregator interface, not an image model, and the author says this project is no longer maintained.

projects.name: PersonaLive
projects.description: [CVPR 2026] PersonaLive! : Expressive Portrait Image Animation for Live Streaming
projects.summary: CVPR 2026 嘅人像動畫研究，用一張肖像做出有表情、可以直播嘅畫面，人像會跟住驅動訊號郁。係論文作者放出嘅模型程式，唔係一般剪片軟件，亦唔係套殼直播工具。
projects.summary_en: A CVPR 2026 portrait-animation model from the paper authors. One photo becomes an expressive face meant for a live stream, driven by a motion signal. It is their research code, not a general video editor or a wrapped streaming app.

projects.name: iGAN
projects.description: Interactive Image Generation via Generative Adversarial Networks
projects.summary: 2016 年 Berkeley 嘅互動圖像生成研究，用草圖同筆刷即時畫出 GAN 圖像。係當年嘅 Torch 程式，唔係 Blender 外掛，亦唔係而家嘅擴散模型。
projects.summary_en: Berkeley's 2016 interactive image generator. Sketches and brush strokes drive a GAN in real time. It is that era's Torch research code, not a Blender plugin or a modern diffusion model.

projects.name: pybroker
projects.description: Algorithmic Trading in Python with Machine Learning
projects.summary: 用 Python 做算法交易回測嘅庫，可以加入機器學習訊號。授權係 Apache 2.0 再加 Commons Clause，將個庫本身攞去賣係唔得。佢係回測工具，唔係券商落單程式。
projects.summary_en: A Python library for algorithmic-trading backtests, including machine-learning signals. The license is Apache 2.0 plus the Commons Clause, so you cannot sell the library itself. It backtests; it is not a broker order tool.

projects.name: eiten
projects.description: Statistical and Algorithmic Investing Strategies for Everyone
projects.summary: Tradytics 出嘅組合工具，用特徵組合、最低方差、最高夏普同遺傳演算法砌股票組合，可以自己揀股票再回測，並附測試框架。佢係研究同配置工具，唔係即時落單嘅券商程式。
projects.summary_en: Tradytics' portfolio toolkit. It builds stock portfolios with eigen portfolios, minimum variance, maximum Sharpe, and genetic algorithms, and you can pick the stocks and test them. It is for research and allocation, not live broker orders.

projects.name: coucou
projects.description: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.
projects.summary: 掛喺 Mac 凹槽、Windows、Linux 同手機上面嘅小工具，用嚟睇住 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 coding agent，可以批權限同傳檔。佢係監察介面，唔係自己寫程式嘅 agent。
projects.summary_en: A small companion in the Mac notch, and on Windows, Linux, and phones, that watches coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. You can approve permissions and drop files. It is a monitor, not an agent that writes the code.

projects.name: artemis
projects.description: ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation. It automates end-to-end workflows, captures logs, and integrates seamlessly with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code.  It also achieves 99%+ success rate on AndroidWorld Benchmark.
projects.summary: Google 出嘅 Android 自動化工具，畀 AI 助手同測試套件好似人手咁操控真手機，可以跑完整流程同擷取 log。佢係手機自動化，唔係一般寫程式 agent。
projects.summary_en: Google's Android automation tool. AI assistants and test suites can use a real phone like a person, run a full workflow, and capture logs. It automates phones, not a general coding agent.

projects.name: OpenDuet
projects.description: An Open Source template for a proactive AI agent that gets your work done and keeps you in the loop.
projects.summary: CopilotKit 出嘅主動 agent 範本，建喺 OpenBot 上面，做完事先同你匯報，你可以中途介入。而家仍然早期。佢係起步範本，唔係一個已經訓練好嘅獨立模型。
projects.summary_en: CopilotKit's template for a proactive agent, built on OpenBot, that does the work and checks back so you can step in. It is still early. It is a starter template, not a separately trained model.

projects.name: openjutsu
projects.description: One-click character swap for videos: an open-source, local Higgsfield Genjutsu alternative built on ComfyUI and MiniMax H3, with FLUX.3 Klein relighting.
projects.summary: 本地一鍵角色替換程式，前面係 Next.js，後面用 ComfyUI 流程呼叫現成 MiniMax H3、SAM 同 Qwen3-VL。佢係套殼應用，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A local one-click character-swap app. The Next.js front end runs a ComfyUI workflow on existing MiniMax H3, SAM, and Qwen3-VL weights. It is a wrapper app, not a newly trained video model.

projects.name: lanshu-create-ai-presenter-video
projects.description: Provider-neutral Codex Skill for producing verified AI presenter videos from a script and an authorized presenter image.
projects.summary: 畀 Codex 用嘅 presenter 影片 skill，用腳本同一張已授權嘅主持人圖做出影片，再用 HyperFrames 渲染。佢係 skill，呼叫現成服務，唔係新訓練嘅數字人模型。
projects.summary_en: A Codex skill for presenter videos. It takes a script and an authorized presenter image, then renders with HyperFrames. It is a skill that calls existing services, not a newly trained digital-human model.

projects.name: Prism
projects.description: We propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K.
projects.summary: 騰訊混元嘅影片加聲音生成研究，用動態稀疏注意力，目標係 2K 同時出畫面同聲。權重放喺 Hugging Face。佢係論文模型，唔係圖像編輯器，亦唔係剪片軟件。
projects.summary_en: Tencent Hunyuan's research model for joint video and audio generation, using dynamic sparse attention and aiming at 2K. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is the paper's model, not an image editor or a video editor.

projects.name: blender-skills
projects.description: Professional Blender 5.2 workflows as Agent Skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot and Cursor: modeling, UVs, PBR, baking, rigging, animation, export and QA.
projects.summary: 二十二個 Blender 5.2 agent skill，涵蓋建模、UV、材質、綁骨、動畫、渲染同檢查，畀 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等用。佢係 skill 包，部機要裝 Blender。
projects.summary_en: Twenty-two Blender 5.2 agent skills for modeling, UVs, materials, rigging, animation, rendering, and checks, for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others. It is a skill pack, and Blender must be installed.

projects.name: holo-card-studio
projects.description: Turn the user's description or uploaded reference into a finished, editable Blender card and an interactive Three.js page. Preserve the requested subject, style, typography and destination. This skill contains code and text only; generated artwork belongs in the user's output project.
projects.summary: 畀 Codex 用嘅閃卡 skill，用一句描述或者參考圖，喺 Blender 搭一張可改嘅全息卡，再出 Three.js 網頁。佢係 skill，唔係獨立嘅三維軟件。
projects.summary_en: A Codex skill for holographic cards. One description or reference image becomes an editable Blender card and a Three.js page. It is a skill, not a standalone 3D application.

projects.name: NullMotion
projects.description: Play a finished motion-graphics ad in sync with the rough drafts it grew from, and export the breakdown as MP4.
projects.summary: 播一條做好嘅動態圖形廣告，同步對住 HyperFrames 草稿，再將分鏡過程匯出成 MP4。佢係對稿播放器，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係由零開始嘅剪片軟件。
projects.summary_en: Plays a finished motion-graphics ad in sync with the HyperFrames drafts it grew from, then exports that breakdown as an MP4. It is a breakdown player, not After Effects or an editor you start from scratch.

projects.name: open-edit
projects.description: Open-source, agent-driven editing pipeline: create subtitles, motion graphics, slides, edit and render videos.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅剪片流程，用文字描述就可以加字幕、動態圖形同簡報，再渲染成 MP4。佢係 agent 剪片管線，唔係 After Effects。
projects.summary_en: An editing pipeline for coding agents. A text description can add subtitles, motion graphics, and slides, then render an MP4. It is an agent editing pipeline, not After Effects.

projects.name: StyleTTS2
projects.description: StyleTTS 2: Towards Human-Level Text-to-Speech through Style Diffusion and Adversarial Training with Large Speech Language Models
projects.summary: 用 style diffusion 做文字轉語音嘅研究模型，唔使參考錄音都可以配聲線。佢係語音合成，唔係圖像生成模型，雖然 topic 有 diffusion。
projects.summary_en: A research text-to-speech model that uses style diffusion to pick a voice without a reference recording. It synthesizes speech, not images, even though its topics mention diffusion.

projects.name: AlphaGPT
projects.description: 基于深度强化学习的开源自动因子工厂。
projects.summary: 用深度強化學習自動搜量化因子嘅研究程式，repo 有數據管道、模型核心同策略管理，可以自己接數據做實驗。實驗結果要自己核。佢係因子研究工具，唔係券商落單程式，亦唔保證賺錢。
projects.summary_en: A research program that searches for quantitative factors with deep reinforcement learning. The repo has a data pipeline, model core, and strategy manager, and you connect your own data. Check the results yourself. It is a factor-research tool, not a broker, and it does not guarantee profit.

projects.name: quant-mind
projects.description: QuantMind is an open source agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.
projects.summary: 畀量化研究用嘅知識抽取同檢索框架，本身係一個 Python 套件，可以用 agent 整同查金融資料，再交畀之後嘅研究流程。佢係資料同檢索工具，唔係回測引擎，亦唔係自動落單程式。
projects.summary_en: A knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It is a Python package an agent can use to build and query financial material for later research. It is a data tool, not a backtester or an order-placing program.

projects.name: CloddsBot
projects.description: Open Source AI trading agent that operates autonomously across 1000+ markets - Polymarket, Kalshi, Binance, Hyperliquid, Solana DEXs, 5 EVM chains. Scans    for edge, executes instantly, manages risk while you sleep. Agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments. Self-hosted. Built on Claude.
projects.summary: 加密貨幣、期貨同預測市場嘅交易終端，可以用 AI agent 掃描市場同落單，支援多個交易所同預測市場。落單前要自己睇風險。佢係交易程式，唔係保證獲利嘅策略，虧損要自己承擔。
projects.summary_en: A trading terminal for crypto, futures, and prediction markets. An AI agent can scan markets and place orders across exchanges and prediction markets. Review the risk before an order. It is trading software, not a strategy that guarantees profit, and losses are yours.

projects.name: huashu-motion
projects.description: 让你的agent一键直出商业级产品宣传片：会作曲，能指着画面改。Commercial-grade launch films by your coding agent — point at the frame to change it.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅產品宣傳片 skill，可以作曲，亦可以指住畫面改。片由程式渲染。佢係 skill，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A product-film skill for coding agents. It can compose music and you can point at a frame to change it. The film is rendered from code. It is a skill, not After Effects or a newly trained video model.

projects.name: answer-me-with-html
projects.description: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
projects.summary: 畀 agent 用嘅 skill，遇到複雜問題就交一頁睇得明嘅 HTML，可以有圖、表同流程，而唔係一長段純文字。佢係回答格式，唔係瀏覽器，亦唔係新訓練嘅模型。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that answers a hard question with one readable HTML page, including figures, tables, and flows, instead of a long block of plain text. It is an answer format, not a browser or a newly trained model.

projects.name: logo-design-skill
projects.description: A comprehensive logo-design skill for Claude, Gemini CLI, Codex and other AI agents: principles, process, SVG craft, testing tools and a 1,400+ logo reference library.
projects.summary: 畀 Claude、Codex、Gemini 用嘅標誌設計 skill，有原則、流程、SVG 做法同測試工具，另外附一千四百個標誌參考。佢係 skill，唔係會自己出圖嘅設計軟件。
projects.summary_en: A logo-design skill for Claude, Codex, and Gemini, with principles, a process, SVG craft, and test tools, plus a library of about 1,400 reference logos. It is a skill, not a design app that draws logos by itself.

projects.name: Papermorph
projects.description: An AI skill that turns books into animated, narrated, interactive web experiences
projects.summary: 把一本書變成有旁白、有動畫、可以互動嘅網頁 skill，agent 跟住內容排畫面，旁白可以用現成語音。佢係 skill，唔係剪片軟件。書本內容要你自己有權用。
projects.summary_en: A skill that turns a book into an interactive web page with animation and narration. The agent lays out the frames, and narration can use an existing voice. It is a skill, not a video editor. You need the right to use the book.

projects.name: wallstreet-explainer
projects.description: 华尔街式财经/科技解读短片 skill：设计思路、风格语言，以及找片、截图、配音、渲染和混音工具。
projects.summary: 華爾街風格財經短片 skill，負責畫面風格、搵素材、截圖、配音同渲染，數字用簡潔圖表表達。樣片入面嘅實拍同新聞圖係引用。佢係 skill，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A skill for spare, finance-explainer shorts. It sets the look, finds footage, takes stills, adds voice, and renders, with numbers shown as simple charts. The sample's live footage and news images are credited sources. It is a skill, not a newly trained video model.

projects.name: dsh-blender-plugin
projects.description: DSH × Blender 直连实时插件 v2.6.1：15 个模型工具让 AI 驱动 GUI Blender；支持 dsh-TUI（选中 chip / 页脚状态 / @ 提及 / /blender），活动状态置顶并可一键暂停 AI，原生选中/集合/子元素直送 DSH，随包建模 skill，支持 WSL / Windows / macOS。
projects.summary: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 Blender 嘅外掛，agent 可以喺開住嘅 Blender 入面改場景、檢查同匯出，無介面時亦可以無頭跑。部機要裝 Blender，隨包有建模 skill。
projects.summary_en: A plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness to Blender. An agent can change, check, and export a scene in an open Blender, or run the same loop headless. Blender must be installed, and a modeling skill is included.

projects.name: anidoodle
projects.description: Art and animation, written as code. Illustrations, loops, interactive web art, launch-videos and scored films in dozens of styles, identical on every render.
projects.summary: 用程式畫插畫、循環動畫同有聲短片嘅工具，每一幀同聲效都由程式畫，agent 可以用 skill 叫佢渲染成片。佢唔係 After Effects，亦唔係手繪軟件。
projects.summary_en: A tool for illustrations, loops, and scored films drawn in code. Every frame and sound effect is drawn by the program, and an agent skill can ask it to render. It is not After Effects or a hand-drawing app.

projects.name: CYLTabBarController
projects.description: [EN]It is an iOS UI module library for adding animation to iOS tabbar items and icons with Lottie, Liquid Glass and adding a bigger center UITabBar Item.  [CN]【中国特色 TabBar】一行代码实现 Lottie 动画TabBar，支持中间带+号的TabBar样式，自带红点角标，支持动态刷新。【iOS27 & Dark Mode & iPhone 18 & iPhone Duo tested】
projects.summary: iOS 嘅 TabBar 元件庫，用 Lottie 同 Liquid Glass 做分頁 icon 動畫，亦可以加中間大按鈕同紅點。佢係 App 介面元件，唔係剪片或 After Effects。
projects.summary_en: An iOS tab-bar library. It animates tab icons with Lottie and Liquid Glass, and can add a larger center button and a badge. It is an app UI component, not a video editor or After Effects.

projects.name: LatentSync
projects.description: Taming Stable Diffusion for Lip Sync!
projects.summary: 字節跳動嘅對口型研究，用擴散模型令畫面嘅嘴跟住聲音郁，適合虛擬人同配音對嘴。權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係口型模型，唔係圖像編輯器，亦唔係一般剪片軟件。
projects.summary_en: ByteDance's lip-sync research. A diffusion model moves the mouth to match audio, for avatars and dubbed speech. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is a lip-sync model, not an image editor or a general video editor.

projects.name: free-stockdb
projects.description: 面向 A 股日K、分钟K与ETF分钟数据的本地量化引擎，集成增量同步、本地缓存、复权、批量查询、回测与指标计算。
projects.summary: 本地 A 股同 ETF 數據引擎，可以增量同步日 K、分鐘 K，做復權、指標同回測。數據放喺自己部機，亦可以計三十九種指標。佢係數據同研究工具，唔係券商落單程式。
projects.summary_en: A local data engine for China A-shares and ETFs. It incrementally syncs daily and minute bars, adjusts prices, computes indicators, and backtests. Data stays on your machine. It is a research store, not a broker.

projects.name: QuantResearch
projects.description: Quantitative analysis, strategies and backtests
projects.summary: 量化研究筆記同回測例子，用 Jupyter 做組合優化、機器學習同深度強化學習策略，附有筆記同示範。佢係研究筆記，策略只係示範，唔係即時落單嘅交易系統，例子要自己核。
projects.summary_en: Quantitative research notebooks and backtest examples. Jupyter covers portfolio optimization, machine learning, and deep-reinforcement-learning strategies. The strategies are demonstrations, not a live order system, and you should check the examples yourself.

projects.name: Ultra-Water
projects.description: Real-time FFT ocean renderer for three.js (WebGL2): shore breakers, foam, caustics, underwater rendering and buoyancy at 200+ fps
projects.summary: three.js 嘅即時海洋渲染，用 FFT 做碎浪、泡沫、焦散同浮力，目標係瀏覽器入面高幀率跑。佢係網頁水面，唔係 Blender 流體模擬，公開不足一日，畫面仍會再改。
projects.summary_en: A real-time ocean renderer for three.js. FFT drives shore breakers, foam, caustics, and buoyancy, aiming at a high frame rate in the browser. It is a web water surface, not a Blender fluid sim, and it has been public for less than a day, so the look can still change.

projects.name: video-shotcraft
projects.description: AI video skill for Claude Code & Codex — cinematic, editable product promos with Remotion: 124 shot recipe cards, 150 motion previews, beat sync, sound design, Motion Workbench & JianYing (CapCut CN) export.
projects.summary: 畀 Claude Code 同 Codex 用嘅影片 skill，用 Remotion 做可以改嘅產品宣傳片，有鏡頭卡、動態預覽同剪映匯出。佢係 skill，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A video skill for Claude Code and Codex. It builds editable product promos in Remotion, with shot cards, motion previews, and a JianYing export. It is a skill, not a newly trained video model.

projects.name: cleanyourtv-app
projects.description: A community-built phone app for Clean Your TV: clean up an Android TV from your phone. No laptop, no coding agent, nothing uninstalled.
projects.summary: 用 Android 手機清理 Android TV 同 Fire TV 嘅廣告同預裝項目，唔使電腦。分類因為描述有 agent 呢個字，但佢唔係 AI agent，亦話唔會卸載系統。
projects.summary_en: An Android phone app that clears ads and preinstalled items from an Android TV or Fire TV, without a computer. It is listed under AI Agent because the description mentions the word agent. It is not an AI agent, and it says it does not uninstall the system.

projects.name: bama
projects.description: BAMA: Build Any Mac App. Agent skills to research, clone, design, build, optimize, and test native macOS apps with Swift and SwiftUI.
projects.summary: 畀 agent 用嘅 Mac app skill，用 Swift 同 SwiftUI 由構思做到 Dock，可以參考一個現有 app 再自己重做。唔使開 Xcode 介面。佢係 skill，成品要你自己編譯。
projects.summary_en: Agent skills for Mac apps. They take a Swift and SwiftUI app from an idea to the Dock, and can study an existing app so you rebuild your own. You do not open the Xcode interface. It is a skill, and you compile the result.

projects.name: vibe-knowledge-film
projects.description: 抖音爆款Vibe知识大赏知识短片skill，深度拆解爆款视频，复刻画风，导演分镜表，自动配音效，一键出片
projects.summary: 抖音知識短片風格嘅 skill，可以拆解參考片、排分鏡、自動配音效再出片。畫風係模仿參考片，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型，樣片亦唔等於你擁有原片。成片要自己再睇一次先。
projects.summary_en: A skill for the look of viral knowledge shorts. It studies a reference, builds a shot list, adds sound, and renders. The look imitates the reference. It is not a newly trained video model, the sample does not give you the original film, and you should watch the result.

projects.name: reelbench-skills
projects.description: Learning notes and tooling skills for AI video - AI 视频相关的学习与工具 skill
projects.summary: 畀 Claude Code 同 Codex 用嘅影片 skill，包括鏡頭分析同 ffmpeg 工具。README 亦當學習筆記。佢係 skill，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。
projects.summary_en: Video skills for Claude Code and Codex, including shot analysis and ffmpeg tools. The README also treats the repo as learning notes. It is a skill pack, not a newly trained video model.

projects.name: claude-motion-design
projects.description: A Claude Code skill to make motion design videos in pure code: HTML + Playwright + ffmpeg. No After Effects, no Remotion license.
projects.summary: 畀 Claude Code 用嘅動態設計 skill，用 HTML、Playwright 同 ffmpeg 由程式出片。唔使 After Effects，亦唔使 Remotion 授權。佢係 skill，唔係剪片軟件。
projects.summary_en: A Claude Code skill for motion design. It renders films from HTML with Playwright and ffmpeg. After Effects is not required, and neither is a Remotion license. It is a skill, not a video editor.

projects.name: guizang-ppt-skill
projects.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
projects.summary: 畀 agent 用嘅簡報 skill，用 HTML 做出雜誌或瑞士風格投影片，可以帶圖片提示同社交封面。佢係 skill，唔係 PowerPoint，亦唔係圖像模型。授權係 AGPL。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill for slide decks. It builds magazine or Swiss-style HTML slides, with image prompts and social covers. It is a skill, not PowerPoint and not an image model. The license is AGPL.

projects.name: remove-ai-watermarks
