projects.description: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks.
projects.summary: Python 庫、命令列同 agent skill，用嚟清走你自己生成嘅圖同片上嘅可見標記，以及 C2PA、EXIF 呢類來源資料。清走標記唔會將生成圖變成實拍。
projects.summary_en: A Python library, command-line tool, and agent skill that clears visible marks and provenance metadata such as C2PA and EXIF from images and video you generated. Stripping those marks does not turn a generated image into a photograph.

projects.name: BlenderProc
projects.description: A procedural Blender pipeline for photorealistic training image generation
projects.summary: 德國宇航中心出嘅 Blender 流程，用程序生成逼真訓練圖，可以控制場景同相機。部機要裝 Blender。輸出係訓練用嘅合成圖，適合偵測同分割嘅訓練集，唔係電影合成軟件。
projects.summary_en: A Blender pipeline from the German Aerospace Center. It procedurally renders photorealistic training images and can control the scene and camera. Blender must be installed. The output is synthetic training data, not a finished film composite.

projects.name: openalgo
projects.description: The Open Source Trading Ecosystem for Everyone.
projects.summary: 開源算法交易平台，可以接券商、圖表同策略，策略可以用 Python 寫，亦有交易介面。平台係一個 Python 服務。佢係下單同研究嘅系統，唔係保證賺錢嘅機械人。授權係 AGPL。
projects.summary_en: An open algorithmic-trading platform. It connects brokers, charts, and strategies written in Python, and it includes a trading interface. It is a Python service for orders and research, not a bot that guarantees profit. The license is AGPL.

projects.name: thetagang
projects.description: ThetaGang is an IBKR bot for collecting money
projects.summary: 接 Interactive Brokers 嘅期權機械人，用嚟跑 theta 類策略。分類雖然喺加密貨幣，佢實際係股票期權，唔係交易所現貨程式，亦唔保證賺，虧損要自己承擔。
projects.summary_en: An options bot for Interactive Brokers that runs theta-style strategies. It is listed under crypto, but it trades stock options, not exchange spot crypto. It does not guarantee a profit, and losses are yours.

projects.name: nof0
projects.description: Open-source AI trading arena. A full reproduction of NOF1 Alpha Arena for running and comparing LLM agents.
projects.summary: 重現 NOF1 交易擂台嘅開源項目，用嚟比較唔同 LLM agent 喺 Hyperliquid 嘅交易。擂台結果唔等於實盤。佢係對打環境，唔係一個已被證明獲利嘅策略。
projects.summary_en: An open reproduction of the NOF1 trading arena, for comparing LLM agents as they trade on Hyperliquid. Arena results are not the same as live trading. It is a comparison environment, not a strategy that has been shown to profit.

projects.name: elephant-goldfish-model
projects.description: Open-source skills for designing and reviewing software with AI agents
projects.summary: Google 出嘅軟件設計同審查 skill，個名有 model，實際係畀 Claude Code、Codex 等用嘅技能包。裝落 coding agent 先用到。唔係一個新訓練嘅語言模型。
projects.summary_en: Google's skills for designing and reviewing software. The name says model, but the repo is a skill pack for Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents. You install it into a coding agent. It is not a newly trained language model.

projects.name: crm
projects.description: Comp AI CRM is an open source, CRM designed for AI agents. Agentic-first CRM.
projects.summary: 畀 AI agent 用嘅開源客戶關係管理，由 agent 先出發去記客戶同跟進，可以記銷售、客戶紀錄同下一步。佢係 CRM 軟件，唔係一個會自己做生意嘅助理。
projects.summary_en: An open CRM designed so AI agents can record customers and follow-ups, including sales, records, and the next step. It is CRM software, not an assistant that runs a business by itself.

projects.name: reef
projects.description: Infrastructure for continually self‑improving agents
projects.summary: 做會持續自我改進嘅 agent 基建，repo 涵蓋推理、訓練同強化學習，用嚟撐住長期運行嘅 agent。佢係底層設施，唔係一個開箱即用、已經學完嘅助手。仍然係研究基建。
projects.summary_en: Infrastructure for agents that keep improving. The repo covers inference, training, and reinforcement learning for agents that run for a long time. It is a foundation, not a finished assistant you can open and use, and it is still research infrastructure.

projects.name: JoyAI-Video-Edit
projects.description: [Official Repo] JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion
projects.summary: 京東開源嘅即時影片編輯模型，用自回歸擴散做開放式修改，可以跟住文字改片入面嘅內容。權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係編輯模型，唔係剪片時間軸軟件。改完要再睇一次。
projects.summary_en: JD's open real-time video-editing model. Autoregressive diffusion makes open-ended changes from text. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is an editing model, not a timeline editor, and you should watch the result.

projects.name: world-execute-me-dsh-pv
projects.description: Code-rendered TUI fan PV for Mili world.execute(me); with a DeepSeek Harness-style chat window. MIT code; CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 artwork.
projects.summary: 用程式渲染嘅一首歌粉絲 PV，畫面係 TUI 同對話窗。程式碼係 MIT，畫作係 CC BY-NC-SA，唔可以當商業素材。歌名只係題材。佢係一條片，唔係 VFX 工具。
projects.summary_en: A code-rendered fan PV for one song, shown as a TUI and a chat window. The code is MIT and the artwork is CC BY-NC-SA, so the pictures are not commercial stock. The song title is the subject. It is one film, not a VFX tool.

projects.name: frametell
projects.description: Frametell: turn your ideas and material into vivid explainer videos with an AI director agent. Local-first, any model.
projects.summary: 本地優先嘅解說片導演 agent，可以用你自己嘅模型，把點子同素材排成片。成片喺你部機渲染。佢係導演流程，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。授權係 AGPL。素材要你自己有權用。
projects.summary_en: A local-first director agent for explainer videos. It can use whatever model you already have, arrange your ideas and material, and render on your machine. It is a directing flow, not a newly trained video model. The license is AGPL, and you need the right to use the material.

projects.name: kage
projects.description: An interactive five-chapter night walk through a Kyoto mountain temple, rendered live in Three.js.
projects.summary: 一個京都山寺夜行嘅互動網頁，一共五章，用 Three.js 即時行過場景，再疊上生成畫面。可以喺瀏覽器入面行。佢係一件作品，唔係 Blender 或合成工具。山寺係虛構遊覽。
projects.summary_en: An interactive five-chapter night walk through a Kyoto mountain temple. Three.js moves a live camera through the scene and layers generated imagery on top. It runs in the browser. It is one artwork, not a Blender or compositing tool, and the temple walk is fictional.

projects.name: guizang-product-video-skill
projects.description: 归藏 product video skill：复用真实产品组件和设计语言，用代码制作软件更新宣传片。包含分镜文案、原创配乐、动作音效与视频渲染，支持 Claude Code 和 Codex。
projects.summary: 畀 Claude Code 同 Codex 用嘅產品宣傳片 skill，用真實產品元件同程式做更新片，包含分鏡、配樂同渲染。佢係 skill，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。授權係 AGPL。
projects.summary_en: A product-video skill for Claude Code and Codex. It reuses real product components and design language to make an update film in code, with a shot list, music, and a render. It is a skill, not a newly trained video model. The license is AGPL.

projects.name: lora-scripts
projects.description: SD-Trainer. LoRA & Dreambooth training scripts & GUI use kohya-ss's trainer, for diffusion model.
projects.summary: 用 kohya-ss 訓練器做 LoRA 同 Dreambooth 嘅腳本同圖形介面，可以微調擴散模型。要自己準備數據集。佢係訓練工具，唔係新模型本身。授權係 AGPL。
projects.summary_en: Scripts and a graphical interface around the kohya-ss trainer for LoRA and DreamBooth fine-tuning of diffusion models. You bring your own dataset. It is a training tool, not a new model. The license is AGPL.

projects.name: SUPIR
projects.description: SUPIR aims at developing Practical Algorithms for Photo-Realistic Image Restoration In the Wild. Our new online demo is also released at suppixel.ai.
projects.summary: CVPR 2024 嘅相片修復研究，用擴散模型把野外爛相整到更清晰。有論文同網上示範。授權係 SupPixel 自訂條款，商業用途要另外睇條件，唔係一般開源許可。
projects.summary_en: CVPR 2024 photo-restoration research. A diffusion model tries to make damaged real-world photos look clearer. There is a paper and an online demo. The license is SupPixel's own terms, so commercial use has extra conditions. It is not a standard open-source grant.

projects.name: giga-brain-0
projects.description: GigaBrain-0: A World Model-Powered Vision-Language-Action Model
projects.summary: 機械人用嘅視覺語言動作模型，用世界模型做基礎，目標係浮現出操作能力。而家公開嘅係程式同權重說明。佢係具身模型，唔係俾人遊玩嘅影片世界。權重同程式一齊喺 repo 公開。
projects.summary_en: A vision-language-action model for robots, built on a world model, aiming at emergent manipulation skills. The repo publishes the code and the weight notes. It is an embodied model, not a video world you walk around in.

projects.name: exchange-core
projects.description: Ultra-fast matching engine written in Java based on LMAX Disruptor, Eclipse Collections, Real Logic Agrona, OpenHFT, LZ4 Java, and Adaptive Radix Trees.
projects.summary: 用 Java 寫嘅超快撮合引擎，主題包括加密貨幣、外匯同高頻交易。可以用喺交易所後台。佢係撮合核心，唔係一套交易策略，亦唔保證賺。高頻只係設計目標，延遲要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A Java matching engine aimed at crypto, forex, and high-frequency exchanges. It can sit in an exchange backend. It matches orders. It is not a trading strategy, it does not guarantee profit, and high frequency is a design goal you have to measure yourself.

projects.name: motion-design-skill
projects.description: Universal motion design principles for AI agents — timing, easing, choreography, and Disney animation principles adapted for UI
projects.summary: LottieFiles 出嘅動態設計 skill，把時間、緩動同迪士尼動畫原則寫畀 AI agent 用。佢係原則技能包，唔係 Lottie 播放器，亦唔係 After Effects。
projects.summary_en: A LottieFiles skill that gives AI agents motion-design principles: timing, easing, choreography, and Disney-style animation rules. It is a principles pack, not a Lottie player and not After Effects.

projects.name: Mika
projects.description: Mika — 你手机上的私人 AI 助理，替你操作 App、上网、把事办成。An on-device AI agent for Android that operates apps and the web to get things done for you.
projects.summary: Android 上嘅私人助理，用一句交代，佢喺後台畫面操作你已裝嘅 App 同網頁。模型要你自己配 API 或者本機服務，佢唔係新訓練嘅模型。而家係公開測試版。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A private assistant on Android. You give it one sentence, and it operates apps you already installed and web pages on a background screen. You bring the model, through an API or a local server. It is not a newly trained model. It is a public beta. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: dsh-Go
projects.description: dsh-go — DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机本机运行，也能遥控你的电脑。
projects.summary: DeepSeek Harness 嘅非官方 Android 客戶端，手機可以裝 Linux 環境本機跑，亦可以連去你自己電腦上嘅 DSH。模型請求仍然交畀你配置嘅服務商。同 DeepSeek 官方無關。授權係 AGPL-3.0，吉祥物唔喺呢個授權入面。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial Android client for DeepSeek Harness. The phone can run it in a local Linux environment, or connect to DSH on your own computer. Model requests still go to the provider you configure. It is not affiliated with DeepSeek. The app license is AGPL-3.0, and the mascots are outside that license.

projects.name: genoffice
projects.description: Free, open-source AI Office suite: Docs, Sheets, Slides, PDF, Markdown and HTML editors with a built-in AI agent, plus a `genoffice` CLI and agent skill so Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can create and edit real .docx/.xlsx/.pptx files locally. Bring your own key. macOS, Windows & Linux.
projects.summary: 開源辦公室套件，可以開同儲存真正嘅 docx、xlsx、pptx，亦可以改 PDF。內置 agent 改文件，另外有 CLI 同 skill 畀 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 本地用。要自己帶 API key。唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An open office suite that opens and saves real docx, xlsx, and pptx files, and can edit PDFs. A built-in agent edits the document, and a CLI plus a skill let Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor do that locally. You bring your own API key. It is not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: maya-workflow-kit-for-blender
projects.description: Maya Workflow Kit: the whole Maya workflow in Blender, in one install. Hotbox, marking menus, Channel Box, Attribute Editor, menu sets, shelves and Maya concepts. Free, GPL Blender extension for Maya users.
projects.summary: 把 Maya 嘅操作習慣搬入 Blender 嘅免費擴充，包括熱盒、標記選單、Channel Box 同屬性編輯器。要裝 Blender 先用到。佢係 Blender 擴充，唔係 Autodesk Maya。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A free Blender extension that brings Maya habits into Blender: a hotbox, marking menus, a Channel Box, and an attribute editor. You need Blender. It is a Blender extension, not Autodesk Maya. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: vmodal_sdk_flutter
projects.description: V- Modal AI: Visual Video / Image Search - Flutter Video SDK
projects.summary: 畀 Flutter 用嘅影片搜尋 SDK，可以按畫面、語音同字幕搵片段，上傳同索引都經 VModal 嘅服務。要自己申請 API key。佢係客戶端 SDK，唔係你部機跑嘅影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Flutter SDK for searching video by picture, speech, and on-screen text. Uploads and indexing go through VModal's service, and you need your own API key. It is a client SDK, not a video model that runs on your machine. The license is MIT.

projects.name: mcopt
projects.description: mcopt, a Minecraft mod: a native Metal renderer for Minecraft: Java Edition on Apple Silicon Macs (alpha)
projects.summary: Minecraft Java 版嘅 Fabric 模組，喺 Apple Silicon Mac 用 Metal 自己畫世界。而家仍然係 alpha，要備份存檔。佢係遊戲渲染模組，唔係 Blender 或合成工具。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition. On Apple Silicon Macs it draws the world with its own Metal renderer. It is still alpha, so back up your worlds. It is a game renderer, not a Blender or compositing tool. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: world-execute-me-lyric-mv
projects.description: world.execute(me); — an unofficial fan-made lyric MV told as a chat with Claude, rendered frame by frame from code. Prompts included; no music or lyrics. 非官方同人歌詞 MV:以程式碼逐幀渲染,附完整提示詞,不含歌曲與歌詞。
projects.summary: 用程式逐幀畫出嚟嘅一首歌粉絲歌詞 MV，畫面係對話窗同版畫。倉庫冇歌、冇歌詞，兩樣都要你自己有權先放進去。佢係一條片，唔係 VFX 工具。程式碼授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A fan lyric video for one song, drawn frame by frame in code, as a chat window and print-style pictures. The repo has no song and no lyrics; you need the right to add both. It is one film, not a VFX tool. The code license is MIT.

projects.name: ai-promo-video-maker
projects.description: 一句话让 AI 帮你做产品宣传片！把产品名或网址告诉 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具，它会自己调研产品、画出多种风格样图让你挑选、截取 4K 真实页面、按音乐节拍卡点剪辑、生成 AI 旁白并逐句转写校验、自动审图，最后交付一支 4K 商业宣传视频和可在线播放的网页版。App、网站、SaaS、开源项目、课程、AI 模型都能做，你只需确认需求、试听配乐。不用学剪辑软件，也不用花钱找外包。基于 Remotion + ElevenLabs，可直接克隆使用，也能一键安装为 Agent Skill。
projects.summary: 畀 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 用嘅產品宣傳片 skill，用 Remotion 模板同腳本做片。配音可以用 ElevenLabs，冇 key 就用字幕。佢係 skill，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。授權係 MIT。Remotion 對較大公司要另外買授權。
projects.summary_en: A product-video skill for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex. It builds the film from a Remotion template and scripts. Voiceover can use ElevenLabs; without a key it uses captions. It is a skill, not a newly trained video model. The license is MIT. Larger companies need a separate Remotion license.

projects.name: tick-stock-panel
projects.description: TSP自托管、零运维的 A 股「自建策略 + 监控 + 回测」量化工作台  | LLM能力驱使策略定制+个股分析+复盘 | 自由接入第三方数据源与个性化扩展数据 | 个人开源
projects.summary: 自托管嘅 A 股量化工作台，可以用嚟寫策略、監控同回測，亦可以接你自己嘅數據源。作者講明唔當投資軟件，亦冇內置薦股。佢係研究工作台，唔係券商。授權係 MIT，只供研究。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted A-share research workbench for writing strategies, monitoring, and backtests. You can plug in your own data. The author says it is not investment software and it does not recommend stocks. It is a research bench, not a broker. The license is MIT, for research.

projects.name: ComfyUI-Copilot
projects.description: An AI-powered custom node for ComfyUI designed to enhance workflow automation and provide intelligent assistance
projects.summary: ComfyUI 入面嘅智能節點，可以幫你查工作流、除錯同按描述改節點。原廠 API 已經停，要自己填 API key 同位址。佢係助手節點，唔係新圖像模型，亦唔係一份工作流收藏。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A smart node inside ComfyUI that can inspect a workflow, debug it, and change nodes from a description. The vendor API is suspended, so you fill in your own API key and address. It is an assistant node, not a new image model and not a workflow collection. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ArcticDB
projects.description: ArcticDB is a high performance, serverless DataFrame database built for the Python Data Science ecosystem.
projects.summary: 用嚟存 Pandas 表格嘅無伺服器資料庫，可以放上 S3 或 LMDB，適合時間序列。研究可以用。正式生產或者做成資料庫服務要另外買授權。佢係資料庫，唔係交易策略。GitHub 未標標準開源許可。
projects.summary_en: A serverless database for Pandas tables, stored on S3 or LMDB, suited to time series. Research use is available. Production use, or offering it as a database service, needs a paid license. It is a database, not a trading strategy. GitHub does not mark a standard open-source license.

projects.name: PanWatch
projects.description: PanWatch — AI stock monitoring for A-shares, HK & US markets, powered by TradingAgents. Portfolio insights, real-time alerts & automated reports.｜盯盘侠：覆盖 A股/港股/美股的 AI 盯盘、持仓分析、实时提醒与自动报告。
projects.summary: 自托管嘅股票監察，覆蓋 A 股、港股同美股，用現成嘅 TradingAgents 做分析、持倉同提醒，亦有模擬交易。佢係監察台，唔係交易所，亦唔保證賺。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted stock monitor for A-shares, Hong Kong, and US stocks. It uses the existing TradingAgents project for analysis, holdings, and alerts, and it includes paper trading. It is a monitor, not an exchange, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: lumibot
projects.description: Python trading framework with AI agents that actually place the trade. Backtest, paper and live trade on 12 brokers: stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto and prediction markets.
projects.summary: Python 交易框架，可以回測、模擬同實盤落單，覆蓋股票、期權、期貨、外匯、加密貨幣同預測市場。策略用你自己嘅模型同券商。佢係框架，唔係一套賺到錢嘅策略。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A Python trading framework for backtests, paper trading, and live orders across stocks, options, futures, forex, crypto, and prediction markets. A strategy uses your own model and broker. It is a framework, not a strategy that earns money. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: codex-with-chatgpt
projects.description: ChatGPT thinks. Codex works. Use ChatGPT as the planning brain while keeping the Codex harness.
projects.summary: 把你已付費嘅 ChatGPT 網頁用嚟做規劃同審查，Codex 先負責改程式。中間係官方網頁加一條只讀 MCP，倉庫唔會成個上傳。佢係橋接，唔係逆向代理，亦唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Use the ChatGPT website you already pay for as the planner and reviewer, while Codex edits the code. The bridge is the official site plus a read-only MCP, and the whole repo is not uploaded. It is a bridge, not a reverse proxy and not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: OpenBot
projects.description: Open-source AI coworkers that each get a computer of their own: a browser, files and tools, with every action decided before it happens and recorded after. Bring any AG-UI agent.
projects.summary: 每個同事 agent 有自己嘅瀏覽器、檔案同工具，動作先決定再記錄。你帶任何 AG-UI agent 過嚟，喺你自己部機跑。而家係 beta。佢係同事殼，唔係新訓練嘅模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Each coworker agent gets its own browser, files, and tools. An action is decided first and recorded after. You bring any AG-UI agent and run it on your own machine. It is still beta. It is a coworker shell, not a newly trained model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: coop-anything
projects.description: Co-op Anything: point your AI agent at any single-player game and play it with friends (online and/or splitscreen!). MCP server and playbook to let you reverse engineer, fix, test, ship and share what it learns.
projects.summary: 技能包同 MCP，畀 coding agent 研究你已有嘅單人遊戲，再試吓加網上或者分屏合作。佢係技能同流程，唔係已經做好嘅聯機補丁。遊戲要你自己有。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A skill pack and MCP so a coding agent can study a single-player game you already have and try to add online or split-screen co-op. It is skills and a process, not a finished multiplayer patch. You need the game. The license is MIT.

projects.name: explainroo
projects.description: Explainer videos and product demos made by your AI agent. Free and open source: a local voice (Kokoro), word timing (Whisper) and a canvas renderer turn a script into a narrated MP4.
projects.summary: 畀 AI agent 用嘅解說片 skill，配音用現成 Kokoro，對字用 Whisper，畫面喺你部機嘅畫布渲染成 MP4。佢係本地流程，唔係新訓練嘅影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An explainer-video skill for an AI agent. Speech uses the existing Kokoro model, word timing uses Whisper, and a canvas on your machine renders the MP4. It is a local flow, not a newly trained video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: 3dviz-pro-max
projects.description: Agent skill for creative 3D visualization: turn an idea into a Three.js/Blender scene worth exploring. Claude Code + Codex plugin, 223 recipes, 440 knowledge records, 22 proved kits, 37 runnable studies.
projects.summary: 畀 Claude Code 同 Codex 用嘅立體可視化 skill，把一個點子做成 Three.js 或 Blender 場景，附食譜同可跑範例。畫面要你嘅 agent 先砌出嚟。佢係技能包，唔係一個開箱渲染器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A 3D visualization skill for Claude Code and Codex. It turns an idea into a Three.js or Blender scene, with recipes and runnable examples. Your agent still has to build the picture. It is a skill pack, not a renderer you open and use. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ng-native
projects.description: Angular apps, rendered as real native iOS and Android views, on React Native's Fabric renderer.
projects.summary: 把 Angular 程式畫成真正嘅 iOS 同 Android 原生畫面，用 React Native 嘅 Fabric 渲染器。要熟悉呢兩套框架先用到。佢係手機介面框架，唔係 Blender 或特效工具。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: It draws Angular apps as real native iOS and Android views, using React Native's Fabric renderer. You need both frameworks. It is a mobile interface framework, not a Blender or effects tool. The license is MIT.

projects.name: 4DAnyone
projects.description: [SIGGRAPH Asia 2026] 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video
projects.summary: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 嘅研究，用一條隨便拍嘅單鏡片，生成多角度一致嘅影片，方便之後做 4D Gaussian。首次用會下載權重，要有 GPU。佢係生成模型，唔係剪片軟件。程式授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 research. A casual single-camera video becomes consistent multi-view video for a later 4D Gaussian reconstruction. Weights download on first use, and you need a GPU. It is a generative model, not an editor. The code license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: ohmygame
projects.description: The open-source studio for making games with AI. Your own one-person game studio. Everything you need to make games with AI, in one app. Game canvas.  Bring your own key.
projects.summary: 一個人用嘅開源遊戲工作室，用畫布同你自己嘅模型 key 做遊戲。支援多個模型服務商。佢係做遊戲嘅程式，唔係影片模型，亦唔保證你賺到錢。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An open game studio for one person. You make games on a canvas with your own model key, and it talks to many model providers. It is a game-making app, not a video model, and it does not guarantee you earn money. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: transformerlab-app
projects.description: The open source research environment for AI researchers to seamlessly train, evaluate, and scale models from local hardware to GPU clusters.
projects.summary: 畀研究者用嘅訓練同評估環境，可以由本機硬件去到 GPU 叢集，涵蓋語言模型同擴散模型。你要自己準備數據同硬件。佢係研究工作台，唔係一個新圖像模型。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A training and evaluation environment for researchers, from a local machine to a GPU cluster, covering language models and diffusion models. You bring the data and the hardware. It is a research bench, not a new image model. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: clarity-upscaler
projects.description: Clarity AI | AI Image Upscaler & Enhancer - free and open-source Magnific Alternative
projects.summary: 本地圖像放大同增強，建喺 Stable Diffusion 網頁介面上，用現成模型同 LoRA 把圖拉清晰。要自己跑。佢係放大流程，唔係新訓練嘅基礎模型。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A local image upscaler and enhancer built on a Stable Diffusion web interface. It uses an existing model and LoRAs to make a picture clearer. You run it yourself. It is an upscaling flow, not a newly trained base model. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: skfolio
projects.description: Python library for portfolio optimization, factor model construction, and risk management built on scikit-learn
projects.summary: 建喺 scikit-learn 上嘅投資組合庫，用嚟做配置、因子模型同風險管理，亦可以回測。佢係研究程式庫，唔係券商，亦唔保證賺。授權係 BSD-3-Clause。
projects.summary_en: A portfolio library on scikit-learn for allocation, factor models, and risk, and it can backtest. It is a research library, not a broker, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is BSD-3-Clause.

projects.name: technicalindicators
projects.description: A javascript technical indicators written in typescript with pattern recognition right in the browser
projects.summary: 用 TypeScript 寫、可以喺瀏覽器計嘅技術指標同蠟燭形態。你把股價數據傳入去，佢計數字。佢係指標函式庫，唔係落單軟件，亦唔係一套策略。授權係 MIT。最後更新已有幾年。
projects.summary_en: Technical indicators and candlestick patterns written in TypeScript and calculated in the browser. You pass in prices and it returns numbers. It is an indicator library, not order software and not a strategy. The license is MIT. The last update was years ago.

projects.name: solana-swap-api
projects.description: Solana Swap API & Router
projects.summary: 示範點樣用 Vybe 嘅托管交換 API 攞報價，同組未簽名嘅 Solana 交易。要自己申請 API key。佢係示範客戶端，唔係你自己跑嘅路由程式。GitHub 未標授權。
projects.summary_en: A demo of Vybe's hosted swap API: it fetches quotes and builds unsigned Solana transactions. You need your own API key. It is a demo client, not a router you run yourself. GitHub does not mark a license.

projects.name: Bench2Drive
projects.description: [NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track] Closed-Loop E2E-AD Benchmark Enhanced by World Model RL Expert
projects.summary: NeurIPS 2024 嘅閉環自動駕駛評測，用世界模型強化學習專家做參考。用嚟比較駕駛模型。佢係基準，唔係你可以遊玩嘅世界。授權係 CC BY-NC-ND，唔可以商用，亦唔可以改作再散佈。
projects.summary_en: A NeurIPS 2024 closed-loop driving benchmark. A world-model reinforcement-learning expert supplies the reference, and you compare driving models. It is a benchmark, not a world you play. The license is CC BY-NC-ND, so commercial use and redistributing changes are not allowed.

projects.name: omnirush-gui
projects.description: A desktop coding agent with free access to frontier models.
projects.summary: 桌面 coding agent，模型由 omnirush.ai 帳戶目錄揀，唔支援你自己嘅供應商 key。技能同本機 MCP 可以加。佢係客戶端，唔係你訓練嘅模型。桌面程式係 MIT，ee 目錄另有授權。
projects.summary_en: A desktop coding agent. Models come from the catalog on your omnirush.ai account, and your own provider keys are not supported. You can add skills and local MCP servers. It is a client, not a model you trained. The desktop app is MIT, and the ee directory has a separate license.

projects.name: new-term-radar
projects.description: Daily radar for new AI terms: names of new models, products and repos, caught on X, Hugging Face, GitHub and sitemaps before keyword tools list them.
projects.summary: 每日雷達同 agent skill，喺 X、Hugging Face、GitHub 同網站地圖搵新模型同產品個名，再出每日報告。佢係監察工具，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A daily radar and agent skill. It watches X, Hugging Face, GitHub, and sitemaps for names of new models and products, then writes a daily report. It is a monitor, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: geo-sleuth
projects.description: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.
projects.summary: agent skill，用街景、衛星、等高同 OpenStreetMap 估一張相喺邊度，同埋點樣收窄。要裝喺 coding agent 先用到。佢係技能，唔係新訓練嘅視覺模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that estimates where a photo was taken, using street view, satellite tiles, elevation, and OpenStreetMap, and it shows how it narrowed the search. You install it in a coding agent. It is a skill, not a newly trained vision model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: framefields
projects.description: Code-first video & image, rendered natively on WebGPU.
projects.summary: 用 WebGPU 做合成、動態圖形同立體嘅程式庫，agent 用程式驅動出片。而家係 beta。佢係渲染庫，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係新影片模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A library for compositing, motion graphics, and 3D on WebGPU. An agent drives it with code to make a picture. It is still beta. It is a render library, not After Effects and not a new video model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: CorridorKey2.0
projects.description: Corridor Key 2.0 for all your green and blue screen needs
projects.summary: 綠幕同藍幕摳像模型，要 NVIDIA GPU，權重約 5GB 另外下載。授權係 CC BY-NC-SA 變體，商業軟件整合要另外睇條款。佢係摳像模型，唔係 Blender 插件。
projects.summary_en: A green-screen and blue-screen keying model. It needs an NVIDIA GPU, and the weights are about 5 GB downloaded separately. The license is a variation of CC BY-NC-SA, so integrating it into commercial software has extra terms. It is a keying model, not a Blender plugin.

projects.name: psp-web-recomp
projects.description: PSP games in the browser, static recompilation to WebAssembly, an HLE kernel and a WebGL2 renderer
projects.summary: 把你自己擁有嘅 PSP 遊戲譯成 WebAssembly，喺瀏覽器入面跑。倉庫冇遊戲檔。佢係遊戲重編譯同 WebGL 渲染，唔係 Blender 或特效工具。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: It translates a PSP game you already own into WebAssembly and runs it in the browser. The repository does not include game files. It is a game recompiler and a WebGL renderer, not a Blender or effects tool. The license is MIT.

projects.name: context-attachment-manager
projects.description: Turn Codex and Claude Code into your AI assistant director. Pair them with your favorite image-generation tools, keep image-heavy chats lightweight, and find the right image from a rough description—even after repeated context compaction.
projects.summary: Codex 同 Claude 嘅插件，把對話入面嘅圖抽起，模型需要先再拎返嚟，長對話就唔使塞滿。佢係附件管理，唔係圖像生成模型，亦唔會幫你畫新圖。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A plugin for Codex and Claude. It lifts images out of the chat and fetches one back only when the model needs it, so a long conversation stays lighter. It manages attachments. It is not an image-generation model, and it does not draw a new picture. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ComfyUI-H3-Motion-Context
projects.description: Clip chaining for MiniMax H3 in ComfyUI - motion and audio genuinely continue across joins
projects.summary: ComfyUI 節點，把 MiniMax H3 上一段片嘅尾幀同聲音交畀下一段，動作同聲可以接住。要你已有 ComfyUI 同 H3。佢係接片節點，唔係新影片模型。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A ComfyUI node. It passes the last frames and audio of one MiniMax H3 clip into the next, so motion and sound can continue. You need ComfyUI and H3 already. It is a join node, not a new video model. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: multidiffusion-upscaler-for-automatic1111
projects.description: Tiled Diffusion and VAE optimize, licensed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
projects.summary: Automatic1111 嘅擴充，用分塊擴散喺細顯存畫大圖。建喺現成 Stable Diffusion 上。授權係 CC BY-NC-SA，唔可以拿代碼去賣，你畫出嚟嘅圖唔受呢個限制。
projects.summary_en: An Automatic1111 extension. Tiled diffusion draws large images on a small graphics card, on top of an existing Stable Diffusion model. The license is CC BY-NC-SA, so you cannot sell this code. Pictures you make are not under that restriction.

projects.name: VACE
projects.description: [ICCV 2025] Official implementations for paper: VACE: All-in-One Video Creation and Editing
projects.summary: ICCV 2025 嘅影片生成同編輯研究，可以用文字同條件做片同改片。權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係模型，唔係剪片時間軸。程式授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: ICCV 2025 research for creating and editing video from text and other conditions. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is a model, not a timeline editor. The code license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: SGX-Full-OrderBook-Tick-Data-Trading-Strategy
projects.description: Providing the solutions for high-frequency trading (HFT) strategies using data science approaches (Machine Learning) on Full Orderbook Tick Data.
projects.summary: 用機器學習睇高頻訂單簿嘅筆記本，示範一種簡單策略點計盈虧。冇授權檔。佢係研究筆記，唔係實盤程式，結果要你自己再驗。最後更新已有幾年，數據亦唔喺倉庫入面。只供參考。
projects.summary_en: A notebook that studies a high-frequency order book with machine learning and shows how one simple strategy's profit and loss was counted. There is no license file. It is research notes, not a live trading program, and you have to recheck the result. The last update was years ago, and the data is not in the repo. For reference only.

projects.name: barter-rs
projects.description: Open-source Rust framework for building event-driven live-trading & backtesting systems
projects.summary: 用 Rust 寫嘅交易框架，可以實盤、模擬同回測，策略同風控可以自己插。支援多種市場。佢係框架，唔係一套賺到錢嘅策略，落單前要你自己接交易所。授權係 MIT。延遲要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A Rust trading framework for live trading, paper trading, and backtests. You plug in your own strategy and risk checks, across more than one market. It is a framework, not a strategy that earns money. You connect the exchange yourself before any order. The license is MIT. Measure the latency yourself.

projects.name: TradingGym
projects.description: Trading and Backtesting environment for training reinforcement learning agent or simple rule base algo.
projects.summary: 畀強化學習用嘅交易練習環境，支援逐筆同 K 線，可以訓練同回測。數據要你自己帶。佢係練習場，唔係券商，亦唔會自己落實盤單。授權係 MIT。最後更新已有一段時間。
projects.summary_en: A practice environment for reinforcement-learning trading. It supports tick data and candlesticks, for training and backtests. You bring the data. It is a gym, not a broker, and it does not place live orders by itself. The license is MIT. The last update was a while ago.

projects.name: go-binance
projects.description: A Go SDK for Binance API
projects.summary: 用 Go 寫嘅 Binance API 客戶端，REST 同 websocket 都有。要你自己嘅帳戶同 key。佢係交易所 SDK，唔係交易策略。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Go client for the Binance API, with REST and websockets. You need your own account and key. It is an exchange SDK, not a trading strategy. The license is MIT.

projects.name: TokenEconomizer
projects.description: Experience-Driven Black-Box Cost Control for Coding Agents
projects.summary: 微軟出嘅研究，喺黑盒外面按經驗控制 coding agent 嘅 token 花費。你帶自己嘅 agent。佢係成本控制，唔係一個新訓練嘅 agent。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft research that controls a coding agent's token spend from outside the black box, using past experience. You bring your own agent. It is cost control, not a newly trained agent. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: OpenMausBot
projects.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative with a virtual machine that bots can use
projects.summary: 開源聊天殼，側欄每個 bot 底層係你本機嘅 Claude 或 Codex，再加一部雲端電腦。同 Grok Bot、Meta Muse 無關。佢係殼，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An open chat shell. Each bot in the sidebar is Claude or Codex running on your machine, plus a cloud computer. It is independent of Grok Bot and Meta Muse. It is a shell, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: ARTEX
projects.description: ARTEX · AI autonomous penetration testing system (multi-agent LLM, Go + Next.js) · AI 自主渗透测试系统 · 百度 agent+ 攻防挑战赛冠军
projects.summary: 多 agent 嘅滲透測試研究系統，設計喺隔離實驗環境用，行動要人確認。佢係研究系統，唔係一個可以指向別人網絡嘅成品工具。授權係 AGPL-3.0。用之前先睇實驗範圍。
projects.summary_en: A multi-agent research system for penetration testing, meant for an isolated lab, with a person confirming actions. It is a research system, not a finished tool you point at someone else's network. The license is AGPL-3.0. Read the lab scope before use.

projects.name: KytyPS5
projects.description: Experimental KytyPS5 U59 with merged shader and renderer fixes; complete sanitized main history and Windows releases.
projects.summary: 實驗性 PS5 模擬器分支，合併咗渲染同 shader 修正。冇聲稱可以穩 60 幀。遊戲要你自己有。佢係模擬器，唔係 Blender 或特效工具。授權係 GPL-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An experimental PS5 emulator fork with merged renderer and shader fixes. It does not claim a stable 60 frames per second. You supply the game. It is an emulator, not a Blender or effects tool. The license is GPL-2.0.

projects.name: camera-to-blender
projects.description: Take a photo of real objects, and paste them in Blender
projects.summary: 用手機影一張相，經 Tripo3D 現成服務變成模型，再自動貼入 Blender。要 API key，而且 Blender 要開住。佢係接駁，唔係新訓練嘅立體模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Take a phone photo, send it through the existing Tripo3D service to make a model, and paste that into Blender. You need an API key, and Blender has to be open. It is a bridge, not a newly trained 3D model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: baocut
projects.description: BaoCut: an AI video agent with an editable timeline. Transcribe, subtitle, translate, dub, cut and animate.
projects.summary: 本機優先嘅影片 agent，有可以再改嘅時間軸，可以轉寫、字幕、翻譯、配音同剪接。用現成本地模型或者網上 API。源碼可用，但拿程式本身去賣要另外書面授權。佢係剪片 agent，唔係新影片模型。
projects.summary_en: A local-first video agent with a timeline you can edit again. It can transcribe, subtitle, translate, dub, and cut, using existing local models or an online API. The source is usable, but selling the program itself needs a separate written license. It is an editing agent, not a new video model.

projects.name: motion-graphics-skills
projects.description: 13 Claude Code skills for launch-grade motion graphics. Every frame is code. No After Effects, no video generator.
projects.summary: 15 個 Claude Code skill，用程式畫每一幀，做發佈級動態圖形同 MP4。冇 After Effects，亦冇影片生成模型。要裝喺 coding agent 先用到。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Fifteen Claude Code skills that draw every frame in code for launch-grade motion graphics and an MP4. There is no After Effects and no video-generation model. You install them in a coding agent. The license is MIT.

projects.name: Generals-Mac-iOS-iPad
projects.description: Command & Conquer Generals: Zero Hour running natively on macOS, iPhone & iPad — real engine (EA GPL v3 source, via GeneralsX), DXVK/MoltenVK renderer, RTS touch controls. No game assets included.
projects.summary: 把《命令與征服：零點行動》嘅引擎編譯到 Mac、iPhone 同 iPad，用 Metal 渲染。倉庫冇遊戲素材，要你自己有正版。佢係遊戲移植，唔係 Blender。源碼跟 EA 放出嘅 GPL v3。
projects.summary_en: It compiles the Command and Conquer Generals: Zero Hour engine for Mac, iPhone, and iPad, and renders with Metal. The repo has no game assets; you need your own legitimate copy. It is a game port, not Blender. The source follows EA's GPL v3 release.

projects.name: StableSwarmUI
projects.description: StableSwarmUI, A Modular Stable Diffusion Web-User-Interface, with an emphasis on making powertools easily accessible, high performance, and extensibility.
projects.summary: Stable Diffusion 嘅模組化網頁介面，方便用現成模型同擴充。Stability 已經唔再維護呢個 repo，獨立版本喺 SwarmUI。佢係介面，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A modular web interface for Stable Diffusion, for using existing models and extensions. Stability no longer maintains this repo; the independent continuation is SwarmUI. It is an interface, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: DragGAN
projects.description: Unofficial Implementation of DragGAN - "Drag Your GAN: Interactive Point-based Manipulation on the Generative Image Manifold" （DragGAN 全功能实现，在线Demo，本地部署试用，代码、模型已全部开源，支持Windows, macOS, Linux）
projects.summary: 非官方重現嘅 DragGAN，用拖點喺 GAN 圖上改姿勢同形狀。要自己跑，模型權重要另外準備。GitHub 未標授權。佢係編輯示範，唔係新訓練嘅基礎模型。最後更新已有幾年。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial recreation of DragGAN. You drag points to change pose and shape on a GAN image. You run it yourself, and the model weights are separate. GitHub does not mark a license. It is an editing demo, not a newly trained base model. The last update was years ago.

projects.name: SageAttention
projects.description: [ICLR2025, ICML2025, NeurIPS2025 Spotlight] Quantized Attention achieves speedup of 2-5x compared to FlashAttention, without losing end-to-end metrics across language, image, and video models.
projects.summary: 量化 attention 嘅 CUDA 程式，推理可以快過 FlashAttention，語言、圖像同影片模型都可以插。佢係加速核，唔係影片模型，亦唔改模型指標。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A CUDA library for quantized attention. Inference can be faster than FlashAttention, and it plugs into language, image, and video models. It is a speed kernel, not a video model, and it does not change the model's scores. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: bulbea
projects.description: :boar: :bear: Deep Learning based Python Library for Stock Market Prediction and Modelling
projects.summary: 用深度學習做股票預測同建模嘅 Python 庫，輸入歷史價。最後更新已有幾年，介面可能過時。佢係預測程式庫，唔係券商，亦唔保證準。授權係 Apache-2.0。只供研究。
projects.summary_en: A Python library that uses deep learning to model and predict stocks from historical prices. The last update was years ago, so the interface may be stale. It is a prediction library, not a broker, and it does not guarantee accuracy. The license is Apache-2.0. For research.

projects.name: intelligent-trading-bot
projects.description: Intelligent Trading Bot: Automatically generating signals and trading based on machine learning and feature engineering
projects.summary: 用機器學習同特徵工程出信號，再自動做加密貨幣交易嘅實驗程式。要你自己接數據同交易所。佢係實驗，唔保證賺，回測結果要你自己再驗。授權係 MIT。一個訊號唔等於落單。
projects.summary_en: An experiment that uses machine learning and feature engineering to emit signals and then trade crypto. You connect the data and the exchange yourself. It is an experiment, it does not guarantee profit, and you recheck any backtest. The license is MIT. A signal is not an order.

projects.name: onetake
projects.description: Motion films that never cut to the next slide: every beat grows out of the one before, one continuous camera, continuity measured by an oracle. Product launch films and feature demos, made with a coding agent.
projects.summary: Claude agent skill，做一鏡到底嘅產品片，每一格由上一格長出嚟，用 oracle 量連續性。佢係技能，唔係新影片模型。授權係 PolyForm Noncommercial，只可以非商業用。
projects.summary_en: A Claude agent skill for product films that never cut to the next slide. Each beat grows out of the one before, and an oracle measures continuity. It is a skill, not a new video model. The license is PolyForm Noncommercial, so only noncommercial use is allowed.

projects.name: Octop
projects.description: A smarter, self-hosted AI assistant — multi-user, multi-agent.
projects.summary: 騰訊雲出嘅自托管助理，可以多用戶、多 agent，檔案留喺你部機。對話模型要你自己接，佢唔會附送一個新聊天模型。本機下載嘅只係嵌入模型。授權係 MIT。而家係助理殼。
projects.summary_en: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted assistant, with multiple users and agents, and files stay on your machine. You connect the chat model yourself. It does not include a new chat model. The local download is only an embedding model. The license is MIT. It is an assistant shell.

projects.name: founder-skill
projects.description: Eleven free Claude skills that test a business before you launch it: a board trained on Hormozi, Thiel and Jobs, a marketing director, a CFO, and a consumer panel of 100 buyer agents. Free, MIT.
projects.summary: 11 個 Claude skill，開業前試吓董事會、市場、定價同買家面板。唔使 API key。個董事會只係提示框架，唔係真人。佢係技能包，唔保證賺。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Eleven Claude skills that test a business before launch: a board, marketing, pricing, and a buyer panel. No API key is required. The board is a prompt framework, not real people. It is a skill pack, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: bang-motion
projects.description: Agent skill for browser motion graphics — openers, promos, bumpers, kinetic typography, and five explainer styles that move like video, not slides. Single index.html output. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor.
projects.summary: 瀏覽器動態圖形 skill，用一份 index.html 做片頭、宣傳同動態字。畀 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 用。佢係技能，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A browser motion-graphics skill. One index.html makes openers, promos, and kinetic type for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. It is a skill, not After Effects and not a video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: print3d
projects.description: Print 3D skill from text to 3D printing using Bambu Lab slicer.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅 3D 打印 skill，可以由文字或相片做到 Bambu Lab 切片專案。只對 X2D 或 P2S、0.4mm 噴嘴。佢係技能，唔係新訓練嘅立體模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A 3D-printing skill for a coding agent. Text or a photo becomes a Bambu Lab slice project. It targets the X2D or P2S with a 0.4 mm nozzle. It is a skill, not a newly trained 3D model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: SparkDiffusion
projects.description: SparkDiffusion: Accelerating DiT video generation by 265× via joint Sparsity, Distillation, Quantization, etc.
projects.summary: 加速 DiT 影片生成嘅框架，作者聲稱推理可以快 265 倍，用稀疏、蒸餾同量化。權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係加速，唔係新影片模型，速度要你自己量。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A framework that accelerates DiT video generation. The authors claim inference can be 265 times faster, using sparsity, distillation, and quantization. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is an accelerator, not a new video model, and you measure the speed yourself. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: blender-skills
projects.description: 94 specialist Blender skills for Cursor, Claude Code, Kiro & Codex -> MCP-powered production pipeline from blockout to engine export.
projects.summary: 94 個 Blender skill，畀 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 用，經 MCP 由粗模做到匯出。要開住 Blender。同另一個 blender-skills 唔同作者。佢係技能包。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Ninety-four Blender skills for Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex. Through MCP they go from a blockout to an export. Blender has to be open. This pack is by a different author from the other blender-skills repo. It is a skill pack. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ldraw-nova
projects.description: Agent tooling for generative LEGO models building, built with Astra and Opus 5.5, powered by Jev
projects.summary: 用 agent 砌 LEGO 嘅工具，輸出可改嘅 LDraw 檔。要你自己裝零件庫同 LeoCAD。生成用現成 coding agent。佢係工具，唔係新模型。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: Tools so an agent can build LEGO and write an editable LDraw file. You install the parts library and LeoCAD yourself. Generation uses an existing coding agent. It is a tool, not a new model. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: FastVideo
projects.description: A unified inference and post-training framework for accelerated video generation.
projects.summary: 影片生成嘅推理同後訓練框架，有由 MiniMax H3 蒸餾出嚟嘅快版本。要 GPU。佢係框架，唔係剪片軟件，亦唔係圖像編輯器。授權係 Apache-2.0。速度要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: An inference and post-training framework for video generation, including a fast checkpoint distilled from MiniMax H3. You need a GPU. It is a framework, not an editor and not an image editor. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure the speed yourself.

projects.name: geekai
projects.description: AI 助手全套开源解决方案，自带运营管理后台，开箱即用。集成了 ChatGPT, Azure, ChatGLM,讯飞星火，文心一言等多个平台的大语言模型。支持 MJ AI 绘画，Stable Diffusion AI  绘画，微博热搜等插件工具。采用 Go + Vue3 + element-plus 实现。
projects.summary: 自托管嘅創作後台，接住 ChatGPT、Midjourney、Stable Diffusion 等現成服務做對話、畫圖同片。要你自己嘅帳戶。佢係介面，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A self-hosted creation console. It connects to existing services such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, and Stable Diffusion for chat, pictures, and video. You bring your own accounts. It is an interface, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: TurboDiffusion
projects.description: TurboDiffusion: 100–200× Acceleration for Video Diffusion Models
projects.summary: 影片擴散加速框架，用 SageAttention 等把生成加快，論文話 100 到 200 倍。checkpoint 未定稿，長英文 prompt 先準。佢係加速，唔係新影片模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A video-diffusion accelerator. It uses SageAttention and related kernels. The paper says 100 to 200 times faster. The checkpoints are not final, and long English prompts work better. It is an accelerator, not a new video model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: investing-algorithm-framework
projects.description: Framework for quantitative trading. Complete framework for development, backtesting, and deploying automated trading algorithms and trading bots.
projects.summary: 量化交易框架，可以用嚟寫策略、大規模回測同部署，邊套先上線要你自己判斷。你自己接市場。佢係框架，唔係一套賺到錢嘅策略。授權係 Apache-2.0。滑價要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A quantitative trading framework for writing strategies, large backtests, and deployment. You decide which one goes live, and you connect the market yourself. It is a framework, not a strategy that earns money. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure slippage yourself.

projects.name: robin_stocks
projects.description: This is a library to use with Robinhood Financial App. It currently supports trading crypto-currencies, options, and stocks. In addition, it can be used to get real time ticker information, assess the performance of your portfolio, and can also get tax documents, total dividends paid, and more. More info at
projects.summary: 用 Python 呼叫 Robinhood、Gemini 同 TD Ameritrade 嘅非官方庫，可以睇報價同落單。要你自己嘅帳戶。佢係 API 庫，唔係券商，亦唔保證賺。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial Python library for the Robinhood, Gemini, and TD Ameritrade APIs. It can read quotes and place orders. You need your own account. It is an API library, not a broker, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: react-lottie
projects.description: Render After Effects animations on React based on lottie-web
projects.summary: React 元件，用 lottie-web 播放由 After Effects 經 Bodymovin 匯出嘅 JSON。你可以控制播放。佢係播放器，唔係 After Effects，亦唔會畫新動畫。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A React component that plays JSON exported from After Effects through Bodymovin, using lottie-web. You can control playback. It is a player, not After Effects, and it does not draw a new animation. The license is MIT.

projects.name: reason-network
projects.description: Reason Network: your team's coding agents, talking to each other. The engine behind `reason network`.
projects.summary: 一個 daemon，令你同隊友嘅 coding agent 可以互相發訊息，點對點加密，冇中央伺服器讀到內容。支援 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等。佢係通訊層，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A daemon so your coding agents and your teammates' agents can message each other, end-to-end encrypted, with no central server reading the content. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others. It is a messaging layer, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: Trail-Code
projects.description: Turbocharge Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini & every coding agent: faster, cheaper, with contextual understanding specific to your codebase.
projects.summary: 畀 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 一張代碼地圖，記低函數同團隊學過嘅決定，等改碼之前睇到邊度會壞。佢係上下文層，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Gives Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex a map of the code, recording functions and decisions the team has learned, so a change shows what it can break. It is a context layer, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ip-as-logo-skill
projects.description: A compact Agent Skill for highly simplified, rounded, subtly neo-skeuomorphic IP mascot logos.
projects.summary: agent skill，指導現成圖像模型畫簡化、圓角嘅 IP 吉祥物標誌。要裝喺 coding agent，圖仍然係你嘅模型畫。佢係技能，唔係新圖像模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that guides an existing image model to draw a simple, rounded IP mascot logo. You install it in a coding agent, and the picture is still drawn by your model. It is a skill, not a new image model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ffmpeg-skill
projects.description: Local video editor for coding agents: 42 FFmpeg tools with a machine-readable contract and an MCP server, for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Cut, captions, reframe, loudness, platform exports. No cloud, no API keys.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅本地剪片 skill，用 FFmpeg 做切割、字幕、響度同平台匯出。冇雲、唔使 API key。佢係技能，唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A local editing skill for a coding agent. FFmpeg cuts, captions, loudness, and platform exports. No cloud and no API key. It is a skill, not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: CozyClay
projects.description: Open source previs software in the browser: block a scene, pose characters, author camera moves and cuts, then take the same shots to an AI video model.
projects.summary: 瀏覽器入面嘅預覽軟件，可以擺場景、擺角色同運鏡，再把同一鏡頭交畀你已有嘅 AI 影片模型。佢係預覽，唔係影片模型本身。要你自己有模型。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: Browser previs. You block a scene, pose characters, and move the camera, then hand the same shot to an AI video model you already have. It is previs, not the video model itself. You need that model. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: pireel
projects.description: The open-source alternative to Capcut、ChatCut. Drivable by any AI agent over MCP.
projects.summary: 開源影片編輯器，可以喺畫布同時間軸改，亦可以由 AI agent 經 MCP 驅動。成片要你再睇一次先出。佢係剪片軟件，唔係新影片模型。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: An open video editor. You edit on a canvas and a timeline, and an AI agent can drive it over MCP. Watch the finished cut once more before you export. It is editing software, not a new video model. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: dsh-image-gen
projects.description: 可在对话内生成、编辑、对比图像；内置 500 + 提示词、图库、多模型工作流，支持 ComfyUI。AI image studio for DeepSeek Harness — generate, edit & compare images in chat, with 500+ prompts, gallery, multi-model workflows and ComfyUI.
projects.summary: DeepSeek Harness 嘅圖像工作室插件，可以喺對話入面生圖、改圖同對比，亦可以接 ComfyUI 同其他現成模型。內置提示詞庫。佢係插件，唔係新圖像模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An image-studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It can generate, edit, and compare images in chat, and it can connect to ComfyUI and other existing models. It includes a prompt library. It is a plugin, not a new image model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: CAD_Sketcher
projects.description: Constraint-based geometry sketcher for blender
projects.summary: Blender 嘅約束素描擴充，用相切、距離等條件畫精確二維形。而家仍然係實驗，用之前要備份。要 Blender 5.0。佢係擴充，唔係獨立 CAD 軟件。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A Blender constraint sketcher. Tangent, distance, and similar constraints draw a precise 2D shape. It is still experimental, so back up first. It needs Blender 5.0. It is an extension, not a standalone CAD program. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: BlenderTools
projects.description: Blender addons that improve the game development workflow between Blender and Unreal.
projects.summary: Epic 出嘅 Blender 附加組件，一鍵把資產由 Blender 送到 Unreal。要兩邊都裝。佢係遊戲流水線工具，唔係新渲染器，亦唔係 Blender 本體。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Epic's Blender add-ons. One click sends assets from Blender to Unreal. You need both installed. It is a game-pipeline tool, not a new renderer and not Blender itself. The license is MIT.

projects.name: stock-sdk
projects.description: 为前端设计的无需 Python、无需后端服务、零依赖的获取股票数据 JavaScript SDK。
projects.summary: 前端同 Node 用嘅股票行情 SDK，可以攞 A 股、港股、美股同基金報價，亦有 MCP。唔使自己起後端。佢係行情庫，唔係券商，報價要你自己核。授權係 ISC。
projects.summary_en: A stock-quote SDK for the browser and Node. It fetches A-share, Hong Kong, US, and fund quotes, and it has MCP. You do not stand up your own backend. It is a quote library, not a broker, and you should check the quotes. The license is ISC.

projects.name: meteocons
projects.description: Beautiful, hand-crafted animated weather icons that feel alive.
projects.summary: 手繪天氣圖示包，超過 475 個，分四種風格，有 SVG 同 Lottie，可以播動畫。佢係圖示，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係天氣預測模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A hand-drawn weather icon pack, more than 475 icons in four styles, as SVG and Lottie, and they can animate. They are icons, not After Effects and not a weather-forecast model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: node-binance-api
projects.description: Node Binance API is an asynchronous node.js library for the Binance API designed to be easy to use.
projects.summary: Node.js 嘅 Binance API 庫，可以查詢同落單。要你自己嘅帳戶同 key。佢係 SDK，唔係交易策略，亦唔保證賺。授權係 MIT。延遲要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A Node.js library for the Binance API. It can query and place orders. You need your own account and key. It is an SDK, not a trading strategy, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is MIT. Measure latency yourself.

projects.name: yomiyasu
projects.description: AI生成の日本語を自然な日本語へ推敲するAgent Skill / Agent Skill for Refining AI-Generated Japanese into Natural Japanese
projects.summary: agent skill，把 AI 寫嘅日文改到順口，留低意思、數字同否定，唔會自己加事實。寫唔清就問你，唔會估。只處理日文。佢係技能，唔係新語言模型。程式碼授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that rewrites AI-written Japanese so it reads more naturally. It keeps the meaning, numbers, and negations, and it does not add facts. If the wording is unclear, it asks you instead of guessing. It handles Japanese only. It is a skill, not a new language model. The code license is MIT.

projects.name: anti-slop
projects.description: Rules for an AI coding agent to filter out generic AI-generated UI designs, text, and code.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅規則同 skill，擋走樣板介面、空泛文字同 AI 味代碼。唔指定顏色、字體定排版，方向仍然係你嘅。佢係技能，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Rules and a skill for a coding agent. They filter out generic interfaces, empty wording, and AI-shaped code. They do not prescribe colors, fonts, or layout, so the direction stays yours. It is a skill, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: dsh-routing-suite
projects.description: dsh-routing-suite — injector + router-standard kit: install the runtime injector first, then the task-aware reasoning-mode router preset (measured P1-P23).
projects.summary: DeepSeek Harness 嘅插件套件，先裝熱載入 injector，再按任務揀推理模式。作者公開咗自己嘅量度，你可以重跑個腳本。佢係插件，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A plugin kit for DeepSeek Harness. Install the hot-reload injector first, then a preset that picks a reasoning mode for the task. The author published their own measurements, and you can rerun the script. It is a plugin, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: simon-skills
projects.description: 不露脸做视频账号的 AI skill 合集：调查长片 + 手绘白板讲解视频，一句选题出片、配音字幕、封面与各平台文案
projects.summary: 兩個影片 skill，一個用 Remotion 做調查長片，一個用手繪白板風講解。畀 coding agent 一句題目就出片。成片要你再睇。佢係技能，唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Two video skills. One builds an investigation film in Remotion, and the other builds a hand-drawn whiteboard explainer. Give a coding agent one topic and it makes a cut. Watch the result again. It is a skill, not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: GAE-GeometricAutoEncoder
projects.description: [arxiv'26] GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation
projects.summary: 騰訊 ARC 嘅研究模型，用一張圖加一句提示，生成帶幾何一致嘅多視角影片。權重喺 Hugging Face。只可以學術用，唔可以商業或正式上線。授權係騰訊自訂條款。
projects.summary_en: Tencent ARC's research model. One image plus a prompt becomes a multi-view video with consistent geometry. Weights are on Hugging Face. Academic use only: no commercial use and no production use. The license is Tencent's custom terms.

projects.name: SwarmUI
projects.description: SwarmUI (formerly StableSwarmUI), A Modular Stable Diffusion Web-User-Interface, with an emphasis on making powertools easily accessible, high performance, and extensibility.
projects.summary: 而家繼續維護嘅 Stable Diffusion 網頁介面，前身係 StableSwarmUI。你自己接現成模型同 GPU。佢係介面，唔係新圖像模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: The Stable Diffusion web interface that is still maintained. It used to be called StableSwarmUI. You connect an existing model and a GPU yourself. It is an interface, not a new image model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: stable-diffusion-videos
projects.description: Create 🔥 videos with Stable Diffusion by exploring the latent space and morphing between text prompts
projects.summary: 用現成 Stable Diffusion checkpoint，喺兩句提示之間插值，做成變形影片。要你自己有模型同 GPU。佢係工具，唔係新影片模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: It uses an existing Stable Diffusion checkpoint and interpolates between two prompts to make a morphing video. You need that model and a GPU. It is a tool, not a new video model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: armory
projects.description: 3D Engine with Blender Integration
projects.summary: 開源 3D 遊戲引擎，以 Blender 附加組件形式裝入，渲染器可以用腳本改，有延遲同前向兩條路徑。要 Blender。佢係引擎，唔係 Blender 本體。授權係 Zlib。
projects.summary_en: An open-source 3D game engine, installed as a Blender add-on. The renderer can be scripted, with deferred and forward paths. You need Blender. It is an engine, not Blender itself. The license is Zlib.

projects.name: retopoflow
projects.description: A suite of retopology tools for Blender
projects.summary: Blender 嘅重拓樸工具組，用嚟喺高模上面重新拉乾淨嘅低模網格。要開住 Blender，改之前先備份。佢係附加組件，唔係獨立建模軟件。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A Blender retopology toolkit. It rebuilds a clean low-poly mesh on top of a high-poly model. Blender has to be open, so back up first. It is an add-on, not a standalone modeler. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: AIAlpha
projects.description: Use unsupervised and supervised learning to predict stocks
projects.summary: 用自編碼器降維，再用 LSTM 或隨機森林預測股票回報嘅研究程式。原始行情唔喺 repo。2020 年後少更新。佢係實驗，唔係券商，一個預測唔等於落單。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A research program that reduces features with an autoencoder, then predicts stock returns with an LSTM or a random forest. The raw quotes are not in the repo. It has had few updates since 2020. It is an experiment, not a broker, and a prediction is not an order. The license is MIT.

projects.name: Binance-News-Sentiment-Bot
projects.description: This is a fully functioning Binance trading bot that takes into account the news sentiment for the top 100 crypto feeds. If you like this project consider donating though the Brave browser to allow me to continuously improve the script.
projects.summary: Binance 交易機械人，睇加密新聞標題嘅情緒，正面先落買單。要你自己嘅帳戶同 key。2022 年後少更新。佢係機械人，唔保證賺，延遲要自己量。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Binance trading bot. It reads the sentiment of crypto news headlines and places a buy when the sentiment is positive. You need your own account and key. It has had few updates since 2022. It is a bot, it does not guarantee profit, and you measure latency yourself. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ninjabot
projects.description: A fast trading bot platform for cryptocurrency in Go (Binance)
projects.summary: 用 Go 寫嘅加密貨幣交易框架，可以為 Binance 現貨同期貨寫策略同回測。要你自己嘅 key 同策略。佢係框架，唔係一套賺到錢嘅策略。授權係 MIT。滑價要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A cryptocurrency trading framework written in Go. You can write strategies and backtests for Binance spot and futures. You bring your own key and strategy. It is a framework, not a strategy that earns money. The license is MIT. Measure slippage yourself.

projects.name: pixelfx
projects.description: 232 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code. Plus a Claude Code skill to make your own.
projects.summary: 232 個像素特效，每個都係一小段代碼，可以喺瀏覽器播、轉色，或者匯出 sprite sheet。另有一個 Claude skill 用嚟畫新嘅。佢係特效庫，唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Two hundred thirty-two pixel-art effects, each a small piece of code. You can play them in a browser, recolor them, or export a sprite sheet. It also includes a Claude skill for drawing new ones. It is an effect library, not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: artex-global
projects.description: Global edition of ARTEX — an LLM multi-agent autonomous penetration-testing framework. English default, switchable to Korean/Chinese/Spanish/Japanese. For authorized, defensive and detection use only. (upstream: Autumn-27/ARTEX, AGPL-3.0)
projects.summary: ARTEX 嘅多語言版本，介面同報告可以轉英、韓、中、西、日。設計喺隔離實驗環境用，行動要人確認。同目錄入面另一個 ARTEX 唔同 repo。佢係研究系統。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A multilingual edition of ARTEX. The interface and reports can switch among English, Korean, Chinese, Spanish, and Japanese. It is meant for an isolated lab, and a person confirms actions. It is a different repository from the other ARTEX in this catalog. It is a research system. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: jevgrep
projects.description: Find code by asking what it does. A CLI for coding agents that uses Jev to discover relevant files and source context.
projects.summary: 畀 coding agent 用嘅搜尋命令，用一句問題搵相關檔案同原文片段。要 Node 22，同 Vercel、OpenRouter 或其他相容端點嘅 key。作者話平三成，你自己量。佢係搜尋，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A search command for a coding agent. One question returns relevant files and verbatim excerpts. You need Node 22 and a key for Vercel, OpenRouter, or another compatible endpoint. The author says it costs about 30 percent less; measure that yourself. It is search, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: youtube-agent-skill
projects.description: Eleven Claude skills that run a YouTube channel: scripts off 21 hook formulas with a scored hook, title and thumbnail linted as one pairing, an edit decision list from your transcript, a retention reader that finds where viewers actually leave, a Shorts cutter, and a virality engine. Free, MIT.
projects.summary: 11 個 Claude skill，幫手寫稿、對標題同縮圖、讀留存、出剪接清單同搵 Shorts。唔使 API key。片要你自己上載。佢係技能包，唔保證有人睇。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Eleven Claude skills that help write a script, pair a title with a thumbnail, read retention, make an edit list, and find Shorts. No API key. You upload the video yourself. It is a skill pack, and it does not guarantee viewers. The license is MIT.

projects.name: skills
projects.description: Get production-ready images, video, audio, and 3D from any AI agent: skills that pick the right model, price before spending, and keep characters and brands consistent through the Scenario MCP, plus expert teams that drive Blender, Maya, ZBrush, Unreal, and Unity.
projects.summary: 一大組 agent skill，經 Scenario MCP 用現成模型出圖、片、聲同立體。要 Scenario 帳戶或 API key。亦有技能可以驅動 Blender、Maya 等，要你自己開住軟件。佢係技能，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A large set of agent skills. Through the Scenario MCP they use existing models for images, video, audio, and 3D. You need a Scenario account or an API key. Other skills can drive Blender, Maya, and similar tools, which you have to open yourself. It is a skill pack, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: snappy
projects.description: PHP library allowing thumbnail, snapshot or PDF generation from a url or a html page. Wrapper for wkhtmltopdf/wkhtmltoimage
projects.summary: PHP 庫，把網址或 HTML 變成縮圖、截圖或 PDF。要你自己裝 wkhtmltopdf 0.12。佢係轉檔庫，唔係 AI 圖像模型。授權係 MIT。唔好把唔信嘅網頁直接交畀佢。
projects.summary_en: A PHP library that turns a URL or HTML into a thumbnail, a snapshot, or a PDF. You install wkhtmltopdf 0.12 yourself. It is a conversion library, not an AI image model. The license is MIT. Do not hand it a page you do not trust.

projects.name: lite.ai.toolkit
projects.description: A lite C++ AI toolkit: 100+ models with MNN, ORT and TRT, including Det, Seg, Stable-Diffusion, Face-Fusion.
projects.summary: C++ 工具箱，用 MNN、ONNX Runtime 同 TensorRT 跑一百幾個現成模型，包括偵測、分割、摳圖、人臉同 Stable Diffusion。權重要另外攞。佢係執行器，唔係新模型。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A C++ toolkit. It runs more than a hundred existing models with MNN, ONNX Runtime, and TensorRT, including detection, segmentation, matting, faces, and Stable Diffusion. You obtain the weights separately. It is a runner, not a new model. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: MAGI-1
projects.description: MAGI-1: Autoregressive Video Generation at Scale
projects.summary: 自回歸影片生成模型，有 4.5B 同 24B，另有蒸餾同量化版。權重喺 Hugging Face。24B 要多張 H100。佢係影片模型本身。授權係 Apache-2.0。速度同畫質要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: An autoregressive video-generation model, with 4.5B and 24B sizes plus distilled and quantized builds. Weights are on Hugging Face. The 24B model needs several H100s. It is the video model itself. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure speed and image quality yourself.

projects.name: FireRed-OpenStoryline
projects.description: FireRed-OpenStoryline is an AI video editing agent that transforms manual editing into intention-driven directing through natural language interaction, LLM-powered planning, and precise tool orchestration. It facilitates transparent, human-in-the-loop creation with reusable Style Skills for consistent, professional storytelling.
projects.summary: 用自然語言指揮嘅剪片 agent，可以計劃、呼叫工具，同把一套剪法存成 skill 再套去新素材。成片要你再睇。佢係剪片 agent，唔係新影片模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: A video-editing agent you direct in natural language. It can plan, call tools, and save one editing setup as a skill to apply to new footage. Watch the result again. It is an editing agent, not a new video model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: RustQuant
projects.description: Rust library for quantitative finance.
projects.summary: 用 Rust 寫嘅量化金融庫，可以做期權定價同相關數學。你自己接行情同決定落唔落單。佢係庫，唔係券商，唔保證賺。授權係 MIT 同 Apache-2.0。滑價要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A quantitative-finance library written in Rust. It can price options and do the related math. You connect the market yourself and decide whether to place an order. It is a library, not a broker, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is MIT and Apache-2.0. Measure slippage yourself.

projects.name: Kinetic Film
projects.description: One film, one Claude skill. Launch films written as code and scored with Scenario. Every frame is one web page, rendered with real motion blur.
projects.summary: Claude skill，用嚟做發佈片。一句 brief 變成一頁網頁，逐格渲染，有真實動態模糊。音樂同音效經 Scenario MCP 生成，要你自己嘅帳戶。佢係技能，唔係 After Effects，亦唔係影片模型。ZIP 冇寫開源授權，字型係 OFL。
projects.summary_en: A Claude skill for launch films. A brief becomes one web page, rendered frame by frame with real motion blur. Music and sound effects come from the Scenario MCP, so you need your own account. It is a skill, not After Effects and not a video model. The ZIP names no open-source license. The fonts are OFL.

projects.name: awesome-short-drama-skills
projects.description: AI 短剧 · 漫剧 Skill（技能包）精选：剧本、改编、分镜、Seedance / 可灵 / MiniMax 视频提示词，千问、豆包、龙虾 OpenClaw、WorkBuddy、Claude Code、Codex 等智能体可用 | Curated agent skills for AI short drama, micro drama / microdrama, vertical drama and manju (AI comic drama): screenwriting, storyboards, Seedance / Kling / MiniMax video prompts
projects.summary: 精選短劇 skill 目錄，多數係別人寫嘅 SKILL.md，可以裝去 Claude Code、Codex 等。劇本同分鏡之後，片仍然係 Seedance、可靈、MiniMax 等現成模型出。佢係技能目錄，唔係新影片模型。授權係 CC0-1.0。
projects.summary_en: A curated catalog of short-drama skills. Most are SKILL.md files written by other people, and you install them in Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents. After the script and storyboard, the picture still comes from an existing model such as Seedance, Kling, or MiniMax. It is a skill catalog, not a new video model. The license is CC0-1.0.

projects.name: cindy
projects.description: Consider it done. The open-source AI agent that works out of the box · 想到，就能做到。开源、开箱即用的 AI Agent。
projects.summary: 開箱用嘅 AI agent 客戶端，可以連你部電腦同電話。模型要你自己帶：Claude、Codex 訂閱、API key、本地模型，或者佢哋嘅代管服務。客戶端免費，模型用量另計。佢係殼，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An AI agent client that works out of the box and can connect your computer and phone. You bring the model: a Claude or Codex subscription, an API key, a local model, or their managed service. The client is free. Model usage is billed separately. It is a shell, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: goutoujunshi
projects.description: 一个先接住情绪、再分析关系并给出可执行策略的 Codex 恋爱军师，内置心理、法律、社会、人文、哲学、婚姻家庭与性学知识库，支持多元关系。
projects.summary: Codex skill，睇成人關係嘅對話，幫你判斷局勢同下一步，涵蓋曖昧、衝突、分手同復合。建議要你自己再睇。佢係技能，唔係輔導員，亦唔係法律意見，更唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Codex skill that reads an adult relationship conversation and suggests how to read the situation and what to do next, including attraction, conflict, breakups, and reconciliation. Read the suggestion again yourself. It is a skill, not a counselor, not legal advice, and not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: OmniGen
projects.description: OmniGen: Unified Image Generation. https://arxiv.org/pdf/2409.11340
projects.summary: 一個統一圖像生成模型，可以用文字同參考圖做多種編輯。權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係圖像模型本身。授權係 MIT。2025 年底之後少更新，效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A unified image-generation model. Text and reference images drive several kinds of edits. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is the image model itself. The license is MIT. It has had few updates since the end of 2025, and you measure the results yourself.

projects.name: AnyDoor
projects.description: Official implementations for paper: Anydoor: zero-shot object-level image customization
projects.summary: 研究模型，把一件物件零樣本放進另一張圖，物件外形可以保留。有 Gradio 示範。2024 年後少更新。用之前先備份原圖。佢係研究代碼，唔係修圖軟件。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A research model that places one object into another image with no extra training, and it can keep the object's shape. There is a Gradio demo. It has had few updates since 2024. Back up the original image first. It is research code, not a photo editor. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ResearchStudio
projects.description: ResearchStudio: Our AI co-author, from research problem to final publication.
projects.summary: 微軟嘅研究 skill 包，由一個未定嘅題目行到論文，Reel 再做成互動簡報片。要 Claude Code 或 Codex。佢係技能，唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Microsoft's research skill pack. It goes from an unsettled topic to a paper, and Reel turns that into an interactive briefing film. You need Claude Code or Codex. It is a skill, not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: Pyramid-Flow
projects.description: [ICLR 2025] Pyramidal Flow Matching for Efficient Video Generative Modeling
projects.summary: 自回歸影片生成模型，用 flow matching，作者話可以出約 10 秒、768p、24 幀。權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係影片模型本身。授權係 MIT。畫質同速度要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: An autoregressive video-generation model using flow matching. The authors say it can make about 10 seconds at 768p and 24 frames. Weights are on Hugging Face. It is the video model itself. The license is MIT. Measure image quality and speed yourself.

projects.name: yocto-gl
projects.description: Yocto/GL: Tiny C++ Libraries for Data-Driven Physically-based Graphics
projects.summary: 幾份好細嘅 C++ 圖形庫，有數學、顏色、幾何、採樣同著色。用嚟寫自己嘅渲染實驗。佢係庫，唔係 Blender，亦唔係開箱渲染器。README 話授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Several very small C++ graphics libraries: math, color, geometry, sampling, and shading. You use them to write your own rendering experiments. It is a library, not Blender and not a renderer you just open. The README says the license is MIT.

projects.name: Blender-For-UnrealEngine-Addons
projects.description: I have created this addons for export asset from Blender to Unreal Engine
projects.summary: Blender 附加組件，可以批量把網格、骨骼、動畫同相機交去 Unreal。要 Blender 2.8 或更新，同 Unreal 4.26 或 5。佢係匯出工具，唔係新渲染器。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A Blender add-on. It batch-sends meshes, skeletons, animations, and cameras to Unreal. You need Blender 2.8 or newer, and Unreal 4.26 or 5. It is an export tool, not a new renderer. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: instagram-agent-skill
projects.description: Thirteen Claude skills that run an Instagram account: Reels off 26 scored hook formulas, a viral research skill, a caption linter, and a humanizer. Free, MIT.
projects.summary: 13 個 Claude skill，幫手寫 Reels、對稿、排一週內容。唔使 API key。帖要你自己先發。其中一個會把樣板腔改走。佢係技能包，唔保證有人睇。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Thirteen Claude skills that help write Reels, check a caption, and plan a week. No API key. You post it yourself. One of them rewrites a draft that sounds like a template. It is a skill pack, and it does not guarantee viewers. The license is MIT.

projects.name: skills
projects.description: A collection of agent skills that help you build great interfaces.
projects.summary: 一組介面 skill，睇無障礙、排版、字體、顏色同文案，再交一份排序報告。畀 coding agent 用。佢係技能，唔係新模型，亦唔會代替你嘅設計決定。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A set of interface skills. They look at accessibility, layout, type, color, and copy, then return one ranked report. You use them in a coding agent. They are skills, not a new model, and they do not replace your design decision. The license is MIT.

projects.name: oil-ui
projects.description: UI design skill for Claude Code, Codex and other AI agents: explore distinct directions, compare them side by side, refine against real screenshots. 给 AI Agent 用的 UI 设计 Skill。
projects.summary: 畀 AI agent 用嘅介面設計 skill，可以推薦一個方向，或者幾個風格並排比較，再對住真實截圖改。方向仍然係你嘅。佢係技能，唔係新圖像模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An interface-design skill for an AI agent. It can recommend one direction, or compare several styles side by side, then refine them against real screenshots. The direction stays yours. It is a skill, not a new image model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ComfyUI-LTXVideo
projects.description: LTX-Video Support for ComfyUI
projects.summary: ComfyUI 節點，用嚟跑現成嘅 LTX-2 影片模型。權重要另外攞。年收入一千萬美元或以上嘅公司要另買商業授權。佢係節點，唔係新模型。授權係 LTX-2 Community License。
projects.summary_en: ComfyUI nodes that run the existing LTX-2 video model. You obtain the weights separately. A company with annual revenue of 10 million US dollars or more needs a separate commercial license. These are nodes, not a new model. The license is the LTX-2 Community License.

projects.name: InternGPT
projects.description: InternGPT (iGPT) is an open source demo platform where you can easily showcase your AI models. Now it supports DragGAN, ChatGPT, ImageBind, multimodal chat like GPT-4, SAM, interactive image editing, etc. Try it at igpt.opengvlab.com (支持DragGAN、ChatGPT、ImageBind、SAM的在线Demo系统)
projects.summary: 開放示範平台，可以掛現成模型，例如 SAM、DragGAN 同聊天模型。2024 年後少更新，README 仍然話施工中。佢係示範殼，唔係新模型。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An open demo platform. You can attach existing models such as SAM, DragGAN, and a chat model. It has had few updates since 2024, and the README still says it is under construction. It is a demo shell, not a new model. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: locally-uncensored
projects.description: The all-in-one local AI studio for your desktop: chat, image and video generation and a coding agent in one free, open source app. Windows and Linux. No Docker, no terminal, no cloud required.
projects.summary: 本機 AI 工作室，對話、生圖、生片同 coding agent 放埋一齊。Windows 同 Linux。模型要你自己揀，跑喺你部機。佢係殼，唔係新模型。授權係 AGPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A local AI studio. Chat, image generation, video generation, and a coding agent sit in one app. It runs on Windows and Linux. You pick the model, and it runs on your machine. It is a shell, not a new model. The license is AGPL-3.0.

projects.name: fSpy
projects.description: A cross platform app for quick and easy still image camera matching
projects.summary: 獨立程式，用一張靜態相估相機參數，方便之後對位。Blender 匯入係另一個附加組件。2022 年後少更新。佢係相機匹配工具，唔係 Blender 本體。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A standalone program. It estimates camera parameters from one still photo so you can match the shot later. The Blender importer is a separate add-on. It has had few updates since 2022. It is a camera-matching tool, not Blender itself. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: contrastive-unpaired-translation
projects.description: Contrastive unpaired image-to-image translation, faster and lighter training than cyclegan (ECCV 2020, in PyTorch)
projects.summary: 研究代碼，做不成對嘅圖到圖翻譯，作者話訓練比 CycleGAN 快同省記憶體。2023 年後少更新。佢係研究模型，唔係修圖軟件。授權係 BSD 式條款，要保留版權聲明。
projects.summary_en: Research code for unpaired image-to-image translation. The authors say training is faster and uses less memory than CycleGAN. It has had few updates since 2023. It is a research model, not a photo editor. The license is BSD-style, and you keep the copyright notice.

projects.name: AlphaPy
projects.description: Python AutoML for Trading Systems and Sports Betting
projects.summary: 用 scikit-learn 等做 AutoML 嘅開源框架，可以用嚟做交易同體育投注實驗。Pro 係另一個套件。佢係框架，唔係券商，唔保證賺。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An open AutoML framework built around scikit-learn and related libraries. You can use it for trading and sports-betting experiments. Pro is a separate package. It is a framework, not a broker, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: fastquant
projects.description: fastquant — Backtest and optimize your ML trading strategies with only 3 lines of code!
projects.summary: Python 回測庫，幾行代碼就可以試一個交易策略同做優化。2023 年後少更新。你自己接行情。佢係回測庫，唔係券商，一個回測唔等於賺到。授權係 MIT。滑價要自己量。
projects.summary_en: A Python backtesting library. A few lines of code try a trading strategy and an optimization. It has had few updates since 2023. You connect the market yourself. It is a backtest library, not a broker, and a backtest is not a profit. The license is MIT. Measure slippage yourself.

projects.name: cointrol
projects.description: ฿ Bitcoin trading bot with a real-time dashboard for Bitstamp.
projects.summary: Bitstamp 嘅比特幣交易機械人，附實時儀表板。儀表板可以只睇單，唔使落單。要你自己嘅帳戶同 key。2023 年後少更新。佢係機械人，唔保證賺。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Bitcoin trading bot for Bitstamp, with a real-time dashboard. The dashboard can watch orders without placing them. You need your own account and key. It has had few updates since 2023. It is a bot, and it does not guarantee profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: nanoMuse
projects.description: nanoMuse: an open-source personal agent for every device you own. One agent with a name and a look of its own that does things, keeps working while the app is closed, remembers you, and asks before anything you cannot undo. On Android, iPhone and iPad, Windows / macOS / Linux and in the browser; your phone's screen and your computer as its hands.
projects.summary: 跨裝置嘅個人 agent，可以喺手機、電腦同瀏覽器做事，關咗 app 都繼續。唔可以撤銷嘅行動會先問你。手機畫面同電腦係佢嘅手。佢係 agent，唔係新模型。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A personal agent across your devices. It can work on a phone, a computer, and in the browser, and it keeps going after you close the app. It asks before an action you cannot undo. The phone screen and the computer are its hands. It is an agent, not a new model. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: anti-slop
projects.description: Opinionated Oxlint rules for rejecting low-evidence TypeScript and JavaScript patterns
projects.summary: Oxlint 規則，擋走作者覺得證據唔夠嘅 TypeScript 同 JavaScript 寫法。要抄入你個 repo，冇官方 npm 套件。附一個 skill 幫手抄第一次。同目錄另一個 anti-slop 唔同。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Oxlint rules that reject TypeScript and JavaScript patterns the author treats as low-evidence. You copy them into your repo. There is no official npm package. A skill does the first copy. This is a different repository from the other anti-slop in the catalog. The license is MIT.

projects.name: agent-memory
projects.description: Long-term memory runtime for AI agents — plain Markdown as the source of truth, local ranked retrieval, and an independent sleep-time Manage layer. Claude Code and Codex share one store. No API key.
projects.summary: agent 嘅長期記憶層，用 Markdown 做來源，本機排序搵返。Claude Code 同 Codex 可以共用。唔使 API key。佢係記憶層，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A long-term memory layer for an agent. Markdown is the source of truth, and retrieval is ranked on your machine. Claude Code and Codex can share one store. No API key. It is a memory layer, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: a-stock-data
