projects.description: A股全栈数据工具包：行情K线·当日逐笔·研报·信号·资金面·新闻·财务·公告·打板·ETF期权·舆情·宏观利率·期货大宗(含大商所日K)·事件驱动·可转债 | 15层·87端点·34数据源·除iwencai外免Key | A-share data for AI agents: K-lines, ticks, reports, fund flow, news, financials, filings, options, macro, futures, events, convertibles | 15 layers·87 endpoints·34 sources
projects.summary: A 股數據工具包，可以攞 K 線、逐筆、公告、資金面同可轉債。作者話除 iwencai 外唔使 key。佢係行情庫，唔係券商，報價要你自己核。授權係 Apache-2.0。
projects.summary_en: An A-share data toolkit. It can fetch K-lines, tick trades, filings, fund flow, and convertible bonds. The author says every source except iwencai needs no key. It is a quote library, not a broker, and you should check the quotes. The license is Apache-2.0.

projects.name: narrator-ai-cli-skill
projects.description: AI 解说大师 — Agent skill；封装 narrator-ai-cli 供 Claude/Codex 等工具调用
projects.summary: agent skill，教 coding agent 呼叫 narrator-ai-cli 做解說片。要另外裝個 CLI。片要用你有權用嘅素材。佢係技能，唔係新影片模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An agent skill that teaches a coding agent to call narrator-ai-cli and make a narration video. You install that CLI separately. The footage has to be material you have the rights to use. It is a skill, not a new video model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: DynamiCrafter
projects.description: [ECCV 2024, Oral] DynamiCrafter: Animating Open-domain Images with Video Diffusion Priors
projects.summary: 研究模型，用影片擴散先驗把一張開放領域嘅圖做成短片。ECCV 2024。權重要另外下載。2024 年後少更新。佢係影片模型本身。授權係 Apache-2.0。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A research model. It uses a video-diffusion prior to turn one open-domain image into a short clip. It was presented at ECCV 2024. You download the weights separately. It has had few updates since 2024. It is the video model itself. The license is Apache-2.0. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: TripoSplat
projects.description: TripoSplat converts a single 2D image into high-quality and variable number of 3D Gaussians, developed by TripoAI.
projects.summary: 推理代碼，把一張圖轉成數量可變嘅 3D Gaussian，用嚟做資產。訓練代碼喺另一個 repo。權重要跟倉庫說明下載。佢係高斯濺射模型，唔係剪片軟件。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: Inference code. One image becomes a variable number of 3D Gaussians you can use as an asset. The training code is in another repository. Download the weights as the repo explains. It is a Gaussian-splatting model, not an editor. The license is MIT.

projects.name: objaverse-xl
projects.description: 🪐 Objaverse-XL is a Universe of 10M+ 3D Objects. Contains API Scripts for Downloading and Processing!
projects.summary: 下載同處理腳本，對象超過一千萬個立體檔。代碼授權係 Apache-2.0。每個檔嘅使用權要你自己核，唔好當全部都可以商用。下載之前先睇來源。佢係資料集工具，唔係新嘅立體生成模型。
projects.summary_en: Scripts that download and process more than ten million 3D files. The code license is Apache-2.0. Check the rights for each file, and do not assume every file is free for commercial use. Read the source before you download. It is a dataset tool, not a new 3D generator.

projects.name: pandacode
projects.description: PandaCode: a calm desktop workspace for coding agents
projects.summary: 桌面工作區，用嚟開你已有嘅 coding CLI，例如 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot。佢係工作區，唔係新模型。PandaCode License 係 MIT，商用或公開發佈嘅 fork 要寫明 This is a fork of PandaCode，並連去呢個 repo。
projects.summary_en: A desktop workspace for coding CLIs you already have, such as Claude Code, Codex, and Copilot. It is a workspace, not a new model. The PandaCode License is the MIT License plus one rule: a fork used commercially or released publicly must say “This is a fork of PandaCode” and link this repository.

projects.name: mcd-saver-strategist
projects.description: 麦当劳省钱点餐助手（麦门精算师）｜麦当劳优惠券组合优化 Skill：拉取麦当劳菜单与全部可用优惠券，算出最省的点餐组合，巨无霸套餐 ¥47 → ¥21.9（省 53%）。McDonalds MCP（麦当劳 MCP）coupon optimizer · McDonalds China MCP Server · Agent Skill for WorkBuddy · 麦当劳程序员创意开发大赛参赛作品
projects.summary: 非官方嘅麥當勞中國優惠券組合 skill，係比賽作品，唔係麥當勞官方產品。佢經 MCP 攞菜單同優惠，計最平嘅合法組合，落單前要你確認。作者舉過 ¥47 變 ¥21.9，嗰個係佢當時嘅例子，唔係保證。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An unofficial McDonald's China coupon skill, entered in a contest. It is not an official McDonald's product. Through an MCP it reads the menu and coupons, finds the cheapest valid combination, and can place the order only after you confirm. The author's ¥47 to ¥21.9 example is their snapshot, not a guarantee. The license is MIT.

projects.name: talorys
projects.description: Your personal AI agent in your own Cloudflare account. Chat, memory, tasks, notes and scheduled reminders, deployed with one command: npx create-talorys@latest. Free-tier friendly, single-user, no telemetry.
projects.summary: 個人 agent，部署喺你自己嘅 Cloudflare 帳戶，一條 npx create-talorys@latest。單人用。傾偈用 Workers AI 嘅 glm-4.7-flash，有每日免費額。即使嗰個模型停咗，任務、筆記同提醒仍然行到。佢係殼，唔係新模型。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A personal agent you deploy into your own Cloudflare account with npx create-talorys@latest. It is single-user. Chat uses Workers AI glm-4.7-flash, which has a free daily allocation. Tasks, notes, and reminders still run if that model is down. It is a shell, not a new model. The license is MIT.

projects.name: ta-lib
projects.description: Technical analysis library: indicators and candlestick patterns, batch and streaming, native in C, Rust, Java, C#... and more
projects.summary: 技術分析庫，有指標同蠟燭形態，可以批量或者串流計。有 C、Rust、Java、C# 等。安裝說明喺 ta-lib.org/install。佢係指標庫，唔係券商，亦唔係自動交易程式。授權係 BSD-3-Clause。
projects.summary_en: A technical-analysis library with indicators and candlestick patterns, for batch and streaming use. Bindings include C, Rust, Java, and C#. Install notes are at ta-lib.org/install. It is an indicator library, not a broker and not an automated trading program. The license is BSD-3-Clause.

projects.name: algotrading
projects.description: Algorithmic trading framework for cryptocurrencies.
projects.summary: 加密貨幣嘅演算法交易框架，用 Python 寫。目錄放喺股票分類，佢做嘅係加密貨幣，唔係股票券商。有 quickstart。2026 年 1 月之後少更新。回測同實盤都唔代表賺到錢。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: An algorithmic-trading framework for cryptocurrencies, written in Python. The catalog lists it under stocks, but it is for crypto, not a stock broker. It includes a quickstart. It has had few updates since January 2026. A backtest or a live run is not a profit. The license is MIT.

projects.name: EA31337
projects.description: 🤖📈 EA31337 Lite, Advanced and Rider - Forex multi-strategy trading robot for MT4/MT5 platforms
projects.summary: 外匯自動交易機械人，有 Lite、Advanced 同 Rider，行喺 MT4 同 MT5。目錄放喺加密貨幣分類，佢做嘅係外匯，唔係幣圈策略。2026 年 4 月之後少更新。跑到唔代表賺到。授權係 GPL-3.0。
projects.summary_en: A Forex trading robot with Lite, Advanced, and Rider builds, for MT4 and MT5. The catalog lists it under crypto, but it trades Forex, not a crypto strategy. It has had few updates since April 2026. Running it is not a profit. The license is GPL-3.0.

projects.name: vue-lottie
projects.description: Render After Effects animations on Vue based on Bodymovin
projects.summary: Vue 播放器，用 Bodymovin 播 After Effects 匯出嘅動畫。你要自己出 JSON。同作者嘅 react-lottie 係另一個 repo。2022 年 12 月之後少更新。佢係播放器，唔係 After Effects。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Vue player. It uses Bodymovin to play animations exported from After Effects, and you supply the JSON. The same author's react-lottie is a different repository. It has had few updates since December 2022. It is a player, not After Effects. The license is MIT.

projects.name: Difix3D
projects.description: [CVPR 2025 Oral & Best Paper Finalist] Difix3D+: Improving 3D Reconstructions with Single-Step Diffusion Models
projects.summary: 研究模型，用單步擴散改善三維重建，包括 Gaussian。CVPR 2025 oral。權重喺 Hugging Face 嘅 nvidia/difix。2025 年 6 月之後少更新。佢係修復模型，唔係新嘅濺射訓練器。授權係 NVIDIA License。效果要你自己量。
projects.summary_en: A research model. Single-step diffusion improves a 3D reconstruction, including Gaussian splats. It was a CVPR 2025 oral. Weights are on Hugging Face as nvidia/difix. It has had few updates since June 2025. It is a repair model, not a new splatting trainer. The license is the NVIDIA License. Measure the result yourself.

projects.name: ib-gateway-docker
projects.description: Docker image with IB Gateway/TWS and IBC
projects.summary: Docker 映像，包住 Interactive Brokers 嘅 Gateway 或者 TWS，再加 IBC。目錄放喺加密貨幣分類，佢係券商閘道，用嚟連你自己嘅 IB 帳戶，唔係交易策略。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A Docker image that packages the Interactive Brokers Gateway or TWS, plus IBC. The catalog lists it under crypto. It is a broker gateway for your own IB account, not a trading strategy. The license is MIT.

projects.name: FastGS
projects.description: [CVPR 2026 Highlight, the CVPR Compute Gold Star] Offical code for "FastGS: Training 3D Gaussian Splatting in 100 Seconds"
projects.summary: 3D Gaussian 訓練加速。作者話 Deep Blending 可以大約一百秒訓完，比 DashGaussian 快 3.32 倍、比原版快 15.45 倍。數字係作者嘅，要你自己量。預訓練權重喺 Hugging Face。佢係加速器，唔係新檢視器。授權係 MIT。
projects.summary_en: A training accelerator for 3D Gaussian splatting. The author says Deep Blending can finish in about 100 seconds, 3.32 times faster than DashGaussian and 15.45 times faster than the original. Those figures are the author's, so measure them yourself. Pretrained weights are on Hugging Face. It is an accelerator, not a new viewer. The license is MIT.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.summary: 呢篇論文提出推理同行動要交替進行。語言模型先寫低自己嘅思考，再決定調用邊個工具，然後讀取觀察結果，繼續下一步。後來好多 agent 框架都跟住呢個「諗、做、再諗」嘅循環。
papers.summary_en: This paper argues that reasoning and acting should alternate. The language model writes down its thinking, chooses a tool, reads the observation, and continues. Many later agent frameworks follow this think, act, think loop.

papers.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
papers.summary: 用記憶、反思同計劃，模擬小鎮入面多個 AI 角色點樣自己過日常。每個角色會記住發生過嘅事、整理成較高層嘅看法，再決定同邊個傾偈、做咩活動，從而互相影響。
papers.summary_en: Memory, reflection, and planning let several AI characters live through a day in a simulated town. Each one remembers what happened, turns it into a higher-level view, and decides who to talk to and what to do, so they influence one another.

papers.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
papers.summary: Agent 做完一次嘗試之後，用自然語言寫低自己點解失敗，將呢段教訓放入記憶，下次再試就避開同一啲錯。重點係靠文字反思改進，而唔係重新訓練模型權重。
papers.summary_en: After an attempt, the agent writes in plain language why it failed, stores that lesson in memory, and avoids the same mistake next time. The improvement comes from written reflection, not from retraining the model weights.

papers.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
papers.summary: 一個喺 Minecraft 入面自己寫程式、累積技能庫嘅 agent。佢會探索地圖、將成功嘅程式存低做技能，之後遇到新任務可以重用，所以可以持續學新嘢而唔使每次由零開始。
papers.summary_en: An agent that writes its own programs and builds a skill library inside Minecraft. It explores, saves programs that worked as skills, and reuses them on later tasks, so it can keep learning without starting from scratch.

papers.title: SDXL: Improving Latent Diffusion Models for High-Resolution Image Synthesis
papers.summary: Stable Diffusion 嘅較大版本，針對高解像圖像生成。佢改善構圖、提示詞跟隨同整體畫質，尤其係人物同文字細節。研究同產品都常用佢做比第一代更清楚嘅出圖底子。
papers.summary_en: A larger Stable Diffusion model aimed at high-resolution images. It improves composition, prompt following, and overall quality, especially people and text. Research and products often use it when they want a clearer base than the first generation.

papers.title: InstructPix2Pix: Learning to Follow Image Editing Instructions
papers.summary: 用一句自然語言指令直接改一張現有圖像，例如換背景、加物件或者轉風格。模型要同時睇住原圖同指示，所以改動跟住你講嘅嘢，而唔係由文字重新生成成張新圖。
papers.summary_en: Edit an existing image with one natural-language instruction, such as changing the background, adding an object, or shifting the style. The model sees both the original and the instruction, so the edit follows what you asked instead of generating a new picture from text alone.

papers.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis
papers.summary: 用神經網路表示一個立體場景，由多張相片合成未拍過嘅新視角。場景被寫成連續嘅輻射場，沿光線取樣就可以渲染。後來大量新視角合成同神經渲染工作都由呢篇論文開始。
papers.summary_en: A neural network represents a 3D scene and synthesizes viewpoints that were never photographed. The scene is a continuous radiance field, and rendering samples along rays. A lot of later view-synthesis and neural-rendering work starts from this paper.
